source: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) working paper
title_zh: 从外到内的人工智能问责：企业责任、人工智能治理和管理职责
abstract_zh: 人工智能问责制的问题在公司外部和内部都存在。与人工智能相关的对第三方的损害可能会引发企业责任，还会引发针对董事和高级管理人员的直接和衍生索赔，将外部风险传递给董事会和最高管理层。从表面上看，现有的企业责任原则仍然具有广泛的适应性，尽管随着人工智能系统的不透明和自治运行，依赖于离散的人为过错的归因模型变得紧张。需要高度知识或意图的责任制度同样容易受到攻击：如果没有任何人类或企业行为者具备必要的心态，人工智能可能会产生有害结果，从而造成责任差距。在内部，类似的挑战再次出现。董事和高级管理人员与人工智能相关的信托义务的细节仍然悬而未决，尽管算法损害的外部公司责任的轮廓可能有助于确定这些义务。尽管存在新的挑战，但人工智能尚未改变当前的信托义务体系。然而，从长远来看，人工智能可能会成为向完全非个性化、以实体为中心的企业问责制根本性转变的催化剂，在这种转变中，管理者的责任

title: Competing Visions of the Corporation and Fiduciary Obligation: Some Comparative Law Perspectives
authors: Jennifer Hill, Steve Kourabas
abstract: Corporate law has periodically been declared moribund or intellectually exhausted, most notably in Bayless Manning’s influential assessment of mid-twentieth-century scholarship. Contrary to such predictions, however, the field experienced a resurgence from the 1980s onward, driven by the emergence of new theoretical frameworks, including agency theory, communitarianism, team production theory, and convergence debates. Among these, agency theory, as advanced via the law and economics movement, achieved dominance. By recasting the corporation as a nexus of contracts, this contractarian movement narrowed the focus of corporate law to the mitigation of agency costs between managers and shareholders. Contractarianism, while analytically powerful, contributed to the marginalization of fiduciary law and attenuated the moral and social dimensions traditionally associated with corporate governance. This article revisits these developments through the lens of Professor Deborah DeMott’s scholarship, which offers a sustained critique of law and economics orthodoxy. DeMott reconceptualizes fiduciary obligation as a historically grounded, equitable doctrine that operates not merely as a set of c
source: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) working paper
title_zh: 公司与信托义务的竞争愿景：一些比较法视角
abstract_zh: 公司法时不时地被宣布已濒临死亡或智力枯竭，最明显的是贝勒斯·曼宁对二十世纪中叶学术的有影响力的评估。然而，与这些预测相反，在代理理论、社群主义、团队生产理论和趋同辩论等新理论框架出现的推动下，该领域从 20 世纪 80 年代起经历了复兴。其中，代理理论通过法经济学运动而取得了统治地位。通过将公司重新塑造为合同的纽带，这种契约主义运动将公司法的焦点缩小到减少管理者和股东之间的代理成本。契约论虽然具有强大的分析能力，但却导致了信托法的边缘化，并削弱了传统上与公司治理相关的道德和社会维度。本文通过黛博拉·德莫特教授的学术观点重新审视这些发展，对法律和经济学的正统观念提出了持续的批判。德莫特将信托义务重新概念化为一种有历史依据的公平学说，它不仅仅作为一套信托义务来运作。

title: What Europe can learn from the law & economics of Delaware SB 21
authors: Alessio Pacces
abstract: Senate Bill 21 (SB 21) recast Delaware's law of controlling shareholder transactions, making it easier for controlling shareholders to obtain approval of related-party transactions. The reform has been controversial. This article argues that the central issue is not conflict of interest as such, but the opportunistic use of control discretion. SB 21 established procedures through which controllers may cleanse conflicts of interest, while leaving Delaware courts to police opportunistic compliance with those procedures. The broader lesson is that a European corporate law model, such as the EU Inc., requires a specialized EU court able to apply statutory rules uniformly and predictably while constraining their opportunistic use.
source: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) working paper
title_zh: 欧洲可以从特拉华州 SB 21 的法律和经济学中学到什么
abstract_zh: 参议院第 21 号法案 (SB 21) 重新修改了特拉华州控股股东交易法，使控股股东更容易获得关联方交易的批准。这项改革引起了争议。本文认为，核心问题不是利益冲突本身，而是机会主义地使用控制自由裁量权。 SB 21 制定了控制者可以消除利益冲突的程序，同时让特拉华州法院监督机会主义遵守这些程序。更广泛的教训是，欧洲公司法模式（例如欧盟公司）需要专门的欧盟法院能够统一且可预测地适用法定规则，同时限制其机会主义使用。

title: AI Gatekeepers
authors: Katja Langenbucher
abstract: The paper gives an overview on what established gatekeeper theory on financial markets was designed to achieve. It moves on to introduce three groups of AI-gatekeepers: established auditors, new entrants, and publicly accredited gatekeepers. Then, the paper describes designated AI-laws and designated AI-gatekeepers, both optional and mandatory. It concludes with a preliminary roadmap for regulating AI-gatekeepers. The paper makes three contributions to the debate. First, it shows why a transplant of the proposal to introduce a version of strict gatekeeper liability from the financial-market setting is inadequate for AI-gatekeepers. Second, it suggests a two-layer transparency regime: aggregate disclosure of testing methodologies and standards, combined with compact certifications or scores at the individual level. Third, the paper proposes ex ante governance requirements operating at two sites: At the gatekeeper itself, through accreditation and independence requirements modelled on the EU's notified-body regime. Additionally, at the interface of the gatekeeper with the client, through institutional structures analogous to the audit committee but designed for the interdisciplinary
source: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) working paper
title_zh: 人工智能看门人
abstract_zh: 本文概述了金融市场既定看门人理论的目的。接下来介绍了三组人工智能看门人：成熟的审计师、新进入者和公开认可的看门人。然后，本文描述了指定的人工智能法律和指定的人工智能看门人，包括可选的和强制性的。最后给出了监管人工智能看门人的初步路线图。该论文对这场辩论做出了三点贡献。首先，它说明了为什么从金融市场环境中引入严格看门人责任版本的提案的移植对于人工智能看门人来说是不够的。其次，它提出了一个双层透明度制度：测试方法和标准的总体披露，与个人层面的紧凑认证或分数相结合。第三，本文提出了在两个地点实施的事前治理要求：在看门人本身，通过仿照欧盟公告机构制度的认证和独立要求。此外，在看门人与客户的界面上，通过类似于审计委员会但专为跨学科的机构结构

title: Complex Organizations, Leverage, and Interest Rates
authors: Giovanna Nicodano
abstract: Our trade-off model studies optimal leverage responses to interest rates within a sponsor–backed unit structure. This setup captures organizational forms-including private equity, parent–subsidiary, and securitization arrangements- in which a sponsor provides contingent support to an affiliated unit. When interest rates fall below a cutoff, the sponsor chooses zero leverage, while the backed unit increases borrowing. Unlike stand-alone firms, whose leverage declines monotonically as interest rates fall, backed units generate higher expected default costs in low-interest-rate environments. Our results show how complex organizations can reallocate leverage toward less constrained entities, highlighting a new governance channel shaping borrowing decisions.
source: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) working paper
title_zh: 复杂的组织、杠杆和利率
abstract_zh: 我们的权衡模型研究赞助商支持的单位结构中对利率的最佳杠杆反应。这种设置涵盖了组织形式，包括私募股权、母子公司和证券化安排，其中发起人向附属单位提供应急支持。当利率低于截止点时，发起人选择零杠杆，而受支持单位则增加借款。与独立公司的杠杆率随着利率下降而单调下降不同，受支持单位在低利率环境下会产生更高的预期违约成本。我们的结果表明，复杂的组织如何将杠杆重新分配给受约束较少的实体，突出了塑造借贷决策的新治理渠道。

title: Why Shareholder-Driven Corporate Social Responsibility Failed
authors: Mark Roe
abstract: Pressure from the new, large, economically-powerful institutional shareholders, like BlackRock, for more corporate social responsibility—on issues like climate change, the environment, and justice—became a major feature of the corporate landscape in this century, with much hope for its success. That hope arose because incentives emanating from America’s shareholding structure had shifted when firm-by-firm investments by large shareholding institutions evolved to market-wide, across-the-economy investments in very large portfolios. Institutional investors of this sort no longer picked stocks; they invested broadly across the stock market and the American economy. Investors with across-the-economy ownership had more reason to make their companies internalize externalities; if one firm in the portfolio profited at the expense of another firm, the new investor’s profit in one would be offset by the loss in the other firm. And turning from government regulation to private pressure was needed, said many analysts and activists, because of our broken government. The new institutional investor class could do—or at least help to do—what government had not. That new shareholder class indeed b
source: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) working paper
title_zh: 为什么股东驱动的企业社会责任失败了
abstract_zh: 来自贝莱德等新的、经济实力雄厚的大型机构股东的压力，要求企业在气候变化、环境和正义等问题上承担更多社会责任，成为本世纪企业格局的一个主要特征，人们对它的成功抱有很大希望。这种希望之所以出现，是因为当大型持股机构的逐家公司投资演变成对整个市场、跨经济体的超大型投资组合投资时，美国股权结构的激励措施发生了变化。这类机构投资者不再挑选股票；而是选择股票。他们广泛投资于股市和美国经济。拥有跨经济体所有权的投资者更有理由让其公司将外部性内部化；如果投资组合中的一家公司以牺牲另一家公司为代价而获利，则新投资者在其中一家公司的利润将被另一家公司的损失所抵消。许多分析人士和活动人士表示，由于我们政府的破碎，我们需要从政府监管转向私人压力。新的机构投资者阶层可以做——或者至少帮助做——政府没有做的事情。新的股东阶层确实是

title: Corporate National Identity
authors: Curtis J. Milhaupt, Mariana Pargendler, Dan Puchniak
abstract: What makes a corporation American, Italian, Chinese, or any other nationality – and who gets to decide? In the contemporary global economy, corporate national identity (CNI) can no longer be understood as a fixed legal attribute. Rather, it emerges from the interaction of four interrelated facets – legal, economic, (geo)political, and symbolic – whose relative salience varies across contexts and over time. Classical legal tests such as the jurisdiction of incorporation, real seat doctrine, and corporate control remain important, but they are increasingly insufficient. In a world of weaponized interdependence, data location and access, supply-chain geography, state influence over private firms, and efforts to shape public perceptions of corporate identity now play central roles in determining how firms are classified and treated. Two nascent tests are emerging across these facets: what might be called a “data seat” doctrine that treats data location and access as a marker of CNI, and a government influence test that looks beyond voting equity to assess the degree of state leverage over corporate decision-making. Drawing on case studies involving TikTok, Shein, Pirelli, and Nippon St
source: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) working paper
title_zh: 企业国家形象
abstract_zh: 是什么让一家公司成为美国、意大利、中国或任何其他国籍的公司——由谁来决定？在当代全球经济中，企业国家身份（CNI）不再被理解为固定的法律属性。相反，它是由四个相互关联的方面——法律、经济、（地缘）政治和象征——的相互作用产生的，其相对显着性因环境和时间的不同而不同。公司管辖权、实际席位原则和公司控制权等经典法律检验仍然很重要，但它们越来越不够充分。在相互依存武器化的世界中，数据定位和访问、供应链地理、国家对私营企业的影响以及塑造公众对企业形象认知的努力现在在决定如何对企业进行分类和对待方面发挥着核心作用。在这些方面正在出现两项新兴测试：所谓的“数据席位”原则，将数据位置和访问视为 CNI 的标志；以及政府影响力测试，超越投票公平性，评估国家对企业决策的影响力程度。借鉴涉及 TikTok、Shein、Pirelli 和 Nippon St 的案例研究

title: EU Inc.: A Flexible but Incomplete Blueprint for European Startup Finance
authors: Giovanni Strampelli
abstract: This article examines the financial structure provisions of the EU Inc. Proposal (COM(2026) 321 final) by assessing their innovative scope and actual capacity to facilitate Europe-wide financing of start-ups and scale-ups. The analysis focuses on three areas: the abolition of the minimum share capital requirement and the introduction of no-par-value shares; the regime governing contributions in kind and distributions to shareholders; and the provisions on capital increases, paying particular attention to instruments that entitle the holder to new shares, and their relationship with Simple Agreements for Future Equity (SAFEs). While the EU Inc. framework introduces meaningful simplifications by largely consolidating solutions already adopted by certain Member States for private limited liability companies, the article argues that it falls short of creating a genuinely harmonised financing framework. The provisions of Article 68 are not specific enough to overcome the fragmentation of national SAFE practices, and Article 60 raises concerns about regulatory arbitrage because it allows EU Inc. to access regulated markets without adequate governance safeguards. The article concludes wit
source: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) working paper
title_zh: EU Inc.：欧洲初创企业融资的灵活但不完整的蓝图
abstract_zh: 本文通过评估欧盟公司提案（COM(2026) 321 最终版）的财务结构条款，评估其创新范围和促进欧洲范围内初创企业和规模化企业融资的实际能力。分析主要集中在三个方面：废除最低股本要求和引入无面值股票；管理实物出资和股东分配的制度；以及关于增资的规定，特别关注赋予持有人获得新股权利的工具及其与未来股权简单协议（SAFE）的关系。尽管欧盟公司框架通过在很大程度上整合某些成员国已经为私人有限责任公司采用的解决方案而引入了有意义的简化，但文章认为，它未能创建一个真正统一的融资框架。第 68 条的规定不够具体，不足以克服国家外汇管理局实践的分散性，第 60 条引发了对监管套利的担忧，因为它允许欧盟公司在没有充分治理保障的情况下进入受监管市场。文章的结论很机智

title: Reining in Big Tech Corporations: Why Platform Governance Requires Structural Regulation
authors: Susan Watson
abstract: This paper argues that modern corporations, particularly Big Tech Platform Corporations (BTPCs), should be understood not as private contractual arrangements but as artificial legal entities created and empowered by States. Through incorporation, corporations receive State-like attributes including perpetual existence, legal personhood, capital lock-in, and entity shielding, enabling them to accumulate and organise capital across time and space. The paper introduces the concepts of “Recursive Capital” and “Capital-Constituting Corporations” to explain how BTPCs extend beyond market participation to shape the very conditions under which economic activity becomes capitalisable. Drawing historical parallels with the English East India Company and Gilded Age monopolies, the paper contends that BTPCs now exercise infrastructural and governance power comparable to semi-sovereign actors. Existing antitrust and contractual theories are therefore inadequate. The paper concludes that platform governance requires structural regulation and a reassertion of democratic oversight to recalibrate the delegated powers States have granted corporations.
source: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) working paper
title_zh: 控制大型科技公司：为什么平台治理需要结构性监管
abstract_zh: 本文认为，现代企业，特别是大型科技平台公司（BTPC），不应被理解为私人合同安排，而应被理解为由国家创建和授权的人造法律实体。通过注册，企业获得了类似国家的属性，包括永久存在、法人地位、资本锁定和实体屏蔽，使其能够跨越时空积累和组织资本。本文介绍了“递归资本”和“资本构成公司”的概念，以解释 BTPC 如何超越市场参与，塑造经济活动资本化的条件。该论文将历史与英国东印度公司和镀金时代的垄断进行比较，认为 BTPC 现在行使的基础设施和治理权力与半主权行为者相当。因此，现有的反垄断和契约理论是不够的。该文件的结论是，平台治理需要结构性监管和重申民主监督，以重新调整国家授予企业的授权。

title: Legal Liability vs. Proportional Representation: What Works in Improving Poor Investor Protection?
authors: Woojin Kim, Joon Hyug Chung
abstract: There are two alternative ways of improving board’s monitoring function; increasing their legal liability or allowing more proportional representation of minority shareholders. We evaluate their relative effectiveness by taking advantage of sequential regulatory changes in Korea, which has been widely known for poor investor protection. We find that market reacts positively when board members become more easily liable for making decisions that harm shareholders’ interest, and this effect is more pronounced for firms with low market-to-book ratios. In contrast, market reacts negatively when minority shareholders are provided with more proportional representation on board. Our results suggest that while market participants welcome prevention of “tunneling”, they may be concerned about potential confrontations in boardrooms which may distort strategic decisions.
source: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) working paper
title_zh: 法律责任与比例代表制：什么对改善不良投资者保护有效？
abstract_zh: 改善董事会监督功能有两种替代方法：增加他们的法律责任或允许少数股东增加比例代表。我们利用韩国连续的监管变化来评估它们的相对有效性，众所周知，韩国的投资者保护不力。我们发现，当董事会成员更容易做出损害股东利益的决策时，市场会做出积极反应，而这种影响对于市净率较低的公司来说更为明显。相比之下，当少数股东在董事会中获得更多比例的代表权时，市场会做出负面反应。我们的研究结果表明，虽然市场参与者欢迎防止“利益输送”，但他们可能担心董事会中潜在的对抗可能会扭曲战略决策。

title: Organization capital, large startups, and the dearth of IPOs
authors: Ruediger Fahlenbrach, René Stulz
abstract: Many startups in the 2000s have remained private after achieving large valuations, a pattern that funding availability alone cannot explain. We propose that startups relying heavily on organization capital to achieve economies of scale and network effects through digital technologies are more likely to become large private firms than exit earlier via an IPO or acquisition. Using LinkedIn data, we construct a novel measure of organization capital intensity for startups. Exploiting a legal shock that strengthened organization capital protection, we provide causal evidence that organization-capital-intensive startups are more likely to remain private and grow large rather than exit early.
source: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) working paper
title_zh: 组织资本、大型初创企业和首次公开募股的缺乏
abstract_zh: 2000 年代的许多初创公司在实现高估值后仍保持私有状态，这种模式仅靠资金来源无法解释。我们认为，严重依赖组织资本通过数字技术实现规模经济和网络效应的初创企业更有可能成为大型私营企业，而不是通过首次公开募股或收购提前退出。利用 LinkedIn 数据，我们构建了一种衡量初创企业组织资本强度的新方法。利用加强组织资本保护的法律冲击，我们提供了因果证据，表明组织资本密集型初创企业更有可能保持私有并发展壮大，而不是提前退出。

title: Voice Without Influence? Global Investor Voting Rationale Disclosures in Korea
authors: Woochan Kim
abstract: This study investigates how global institutional investors respond to gender diversity and climate risk concerns in Korean firms through disclosed voting rationales and how these disclosures subsequently influence corporate policies. We find mixed results. First, voting rationale disclosures are more sensitive to gender diversity concerns than to climate risk. Specifically, investor opposition citing gender diversity decreases as the ratio of female directors rises. However, opposition citing climate risk does not increase in response to higher total CO2 emissions. Second, we find that voting rationale disclosures have a limited influence on gender or climate-related corporate policies. While opposition citing gender diversity appears to prompt increases in the number and ratio of female directors in subsequent years, this pattern is confined to large firms subject to gender quota laws and is observed only during the years preceding the law's implementation. Furthermore, we find that opposition based on climate risk concerns is associated with subsequent reductions in total CO2 emissions, but only for small firms. source: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) working paper
title_zh: 没有影响力的声音？韩国全球投资者投票理由披露
abstract_zh: 本研究调查了全球机构投资者如何通过披露投票理由来应对韩国企业的性别多样性和气候风险担忧，以及这些披露随后如何影响企业政策。我们发现结果好坏参半。首先，投票理由披露对性别多样性问题比对气候风险更敏感。具体而言，随着女性董事比例的上升，投资者以性别多样性为由的反对意见会减少。然而，以气候风险为由的反对并没有因二氧化碳总排放量的增加而增加。其次，我们发现投票理由披露对性别或气候相关企业政策的影响有限。虽然反对派以性别多样性为由似乎促使女性董事的数量和比例在随后几年有所增加，但这种模式仅限于受性别配额法约束的大公司，并且仅在该法实施之前的几年中出现。此外，我们发现基于气候风险担忧的反对与随后二氧化碳排放总量的减少有关，但仅限于小企业。最后，可持续发展报告的发布与

title: AI Corporate Governance and Ben & Jerry's Risk
authors: Jesse Fried
abstract: This paper critically analyzes the governance arrangements of OpenAI and Anthropic. These firms have an unusual built-in conflict: each raises funds from profit-seeking investors, then lets self-appointed individuals decide how much profit to sacrifice for the firm's mission-ensuring its AI benefits humanity. We explain that such investor-overriding "self-appointed mission guardians" have been used only once before, at former Unilever subsidiary Ben & Jerry's. That experiment ended in failure, with the guardians causing double trouble: both harming investors and achieving the opposite of their mission. Our analysis highlights the risk of installing such guardians, and can explain Anthropic's adoption of a "kill switch" allowing a super-majority of investors to dump theirs.
source: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) working paper
title_zh: 人工智能公司治理与本杰利风险
abstract_zh: 本文批判性地分析了 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的治理安排。这些公司有一个不同寻常的内在冲突：每家公司都从追求利润的投资者那里筹集资金，然后让自封的个人决定为公司的使命牺牲多少利润——确保其人工智能造福人类。我们解释说，这种凌驾于投资者之上的“自封使命监护人”以前只在前联合利华子公司 Ben & Jerry's 中使用过一次。该实验以失败告终，守护者们造成了双重麻烦：既伤害了投资者，又实现了与他们的使命相反的目标。我们的分析强调了安装此类监护人的风险，并可以解释 Anthropic 采用“终止开关”，允许绝大多数投资者抛弃他们的监护人。

title: A Theory of Corporate Remedies
authors: William Bratton, Simone Sepe
abstract: Corporate law scholarship finely parses fiduciary duties and judicial findings of breach thereof. Yet it largely ignores the matter of judicial choice of remedies. This Article supplies the first systematic treatment of the subject. It covers public corporations and divides them into two categories, those with separated ownership and control and those with control shareholders. For the separated ownership and control category we use information economics to propose a four-step remedial pecking order designed to economize on enforcement costs by reducing evidentiary uncertainty and the risk of error. Injunctive and other specific relief come first, disgorgement of private gains comes second, then compensatory damages, and finally rescissory damages. Nominal damages, made available to plaintiffs who establish a breach but cannot sustain the burden to prove financial injury, play an important backstop role, making it possible to sustain an exacting burden of proof on awards of disgorgement, compensatory damages, and rescissory damages while simultaneously maintaining a vigorous private enforcement apparatus. We offer a contrasting analysis of controlled companies. Here deterrence trum
source: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) working paper
title_zh: 公司救济理论
abstract_zh: 公司法学术界对信托义务和违反信托义务的司法裁决进行了细致的分析。然而，它在很大程度上忽视了司法选择补救措施的问题。本文首次系统地阐述了该主题。它涵盖上市公司并将其分为两类：所有权和控制权分离的公司以及控股股东的公司。对于所有权和控制权分离的类别，我们利用信息经济学提出了一个四步补救优先次序，旨在通过减少证据的不确定性和错误风险来节省执法成本。首先是禁令救济和其他具体救济，其次是没收私人收益，然后是补偿性损害赔偿，最后是撤销性损害赔偿。名义损害赔偿金向确定违约行为但无法承担证明经济损失的责任的原告提供，它发挥着重要的后盾作用，使得在维持强有力的私人执法机构的同时，能够对没收非法所得、补偿性损害赔偿金和撤销损害赔偿金的裁决承担严格的举证责任。我们提供受控公司的对比分析。这里威慑

title: Templates in the EU Inc. Regulation Proposal
authors: Luca Enriques, Casimiro Nigro, Tobias Tröger
abstract: European debates on competitiveness increasingly treat corporate law as a lever to help innovative firms scale. The European Commission’s Proposal for a new “28th regime” seeks to introduce an optional, EU-wide corporate legal form designed, inter alia, to facilitate the cross-border scaling of innovative firms. A central instrument of the Proposal is the use of model articles of association to be adopted through future implementing acts. This Article argues that, while standardised articles may ease incorporation and lower drafting costs for ordinary unlisted firms, they fall short for VC-backed companies—the very cases that motivated the initiative. Building on prior work on venture capital contracting under mandatory corporate law, we identify four shortcomings. First, the architecture is incomplete: the Proposal omits a model shareholder agreement, even though effective VC contracting depends on the interaction between articles of association and shareholder arrangements. Second, the drafting process is overly generalist and unlikely to yield genuinely VC-specific templates. source: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) working paper
title_zh: 欧盟公司监管提案中的模板
abstract_zh: 欧洲关于竞争力的辩论越来越多地将公司法视为帮助创新企业扩大规模的杠杆。欧盟委员会关于新“第 28 条制度”的提案旨在引入一种可选的、欧盟范围内的公司法律形式，旨在促进创新公司的跨境扩张。该提案的一个核心手段是使用未来实施法案中采用的示范公司章程。本文认为，虽然标准化条款可能会简化普通非上市公司的注册流程并降低起草成本，但它们对于风险投资支持的公司来说却达不到要求——而这正是推动这一举措的案例。基于强制性公司法下风险投资承包的先前工作，我们发现了四个缺点。首先，架构不完整：该提案省略了股东协议范本，尽管有效的风险投资合同取决于公司章程和股东安排之间的相互作用。其次，起草过程过于笼统，不太可能产生真正针对 VC 的模板。第三，该提案以公平为导向的逻辑存在产生与不对称、统计相冲突的条款的风险。

title: The Design and Business Models of Financial Ratings
authors: Pierre Chaigneau
abstract: Who pays for financial information determines its design: investor-paid ratings maximize informativeness about firm fundamentals to increase trading profits; firm-paid ratings bundle signals about fundamentals and corporate insiders' effort, strengthening incentives via their effect on market prices. When fundamental uncertainty is sufficiently high, firm-paid ratings achieve time horizon irrelevance: insiders exert the same effort as under commitment, regardless of their exit horizon. However, in liquid markets, the equilibrium rating is investor-paid. With competition, the mere threat of entry distorts rating design and reduces effort. The framework sheds light on the funding of credit ratings, the narrow focus of venture capital, and the coexistence of investor-paid and firm-paid ESG information.
source: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) working paper
title_zh: 财务评级的设计和商业模式
abstract_zh: 谁为财务信息买单决定了其设计：投资者付费的评级最大限度地提供了有关公司基本面的信息，以增加交易利润；公司付费评级捆绑了有关基本面和企业内部人员努力的信号，通过对市场价格的影响加强了激励。当基本面不确定性足够高时，公司支付的评级就会实现时间范围无关性：内部人士会付出与承诺下相同的努力，无论他们的退出期限如何。然而，在流动性市场中，均衡评级是由投资者支付的。在竞争中，仅仅进入威胁就会扭曲评级设计并减少工作量。该框架阐明了信用评级的融资、风险投资的狭隘关注以及投资者付费和公司付费的 ESG 信息的共存。

title: One Size Fails All? EU Insolvency Law between Harmonisation and 28th Regime
authors: Wolf-Georg Ringe
abstract: The European Union’s efforts to harmonise national insolvency laws have long been seen as a key step towards the completion of the Internal Market and, in particular, its Capital Markets Union project. Yet despite years of legislative activity, meaningful convergence has remained elusive. This article argues that the obstacles to insolvency harmonisation are not merely technical but structural: insolvency law reflects deeply rooted national choices concerning creditor protection, corporate governance, and economic policy. As long as economic conditions, market structure and business realities remain diverse across the EU, harmonising insolvency standards risks producing superficial convergence at best and counterproductive rigidity at worst. Against this background, the article considers the idea of an optional ‘28th regime’ as a more flexible alternative. A supranational regime available for voluntary adoption could, in principle, combine legal certainty with respect for national diversity and allow for gradual learning through practice. Yet this approach, too, is plagued by design challenges and political constraints, and its success would depend heavily on its institutional deta
source: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) working paper
title_zh: 一种尺寸无法满足所有需求？欧盟破产法协调与第 28 条制度
abstract_zh: 长期以来，欧盟协调各国破产法的努力一直被视为完成内部市场，特别是资本市场联盟项目的关键一步。然而，尽管进行了多年的立法活动，有意义的趋同仍然难以实现。本文认为，破产协调的障碍不仅是技术性的，而且是结构性的：破产法反映了根深蒂固的国家在债权人保护、公司治理和经济政策方面的选择。只要整个欧盟的经济状况、市场结构和商业现实仍然多样化，统一破产标准就有可能产生表面上的趋同，最坏的情况下会产生适得其反的僵化。在此背景下，本文认为可选的“第28政权”的想法是一种更灵活的选择。原则上，可供自愿采用的超国家制度可以将法律确定性与尊重国家多样性结合起来，并允许通过实践逐步学习。然而，这种方法也受到设计挑战和政治限制的困扰，其成功将在很大程度上取决于其制度细节。

title: The EU Inc. - half European, fully digital, and genuinely innovative
authors: Jessica Schmidt
abstract: The EU Inc. is intended to create a harmonised limited liability company that offers great flexibility in particular for start-ups and scale-ups and is based on the guiding principles of “digital-only" and “once-only". The paper discusses the main contents of the European Commission's proposal for a regulation presented on 18 March 2026 and evaluates them in the context of national and European company law.
source: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) working paper
title_zh: EU Inc. - 一半欧洲、完全数字化、真正创新
abstract_zh: EU Inc. 旨在创建一家协调的有限责任公司，为初创企业和规模扩张企业提供极大的灵活性，并基于“仅限数字化”和“仅限一次”的指导原则。本文讨论了欧盟委员会于 2026 年 3 月 18 日提出的监管提案的主要内容，并在国家和欧洲公司法的背景下对其进行了评估。

title: Converging on Disclosure
authors: martinez
abstract: In Disclosureland, Atinuke Adediran offers a powerful and timely account of how corporate racial disclosures function not just as mere statements of corporate virtue, but as instruments of governance. The book demonstrates that racial progress in corporate America has historically depended on federal intervention—particularly through disclosure mandates, contracting requirements, and civil rights enforcement—and that voluntary corporate commitments, absent regulatory backbone, are fragile and prone to retrenchment. In doing so, Disclosureland makes an invaluable contribution to the literature by revealing disclosure as a structural mechanism through which the federal government has shaped the governance of issues related to race within corporate firms. Yet the book implicitly assumes that meaningful federal disclosure reform depends upon political consensus around demographic diversity as a shared social good. In today’s polarized environment—marked by backlash against DEI initiatives, litigation invoking Reconstruction-era statutes, and contested narratives about racial equity—that consensus appears elusive. If diversity itself is politically divisive, the path to mandatory corpor
source: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) working paper
title_zh: 汇聚信息披露
abstract_zh: 在《Disclosureland》中，阿蒂努克·阿迪兰 (Atinuke Adediran) 有力而及时地阐述了企业种族信息披露如何不仅作为企业美德的陈述，而且作为治理工具发挥作用。该书表明，美国企业界的种族进步历来依赖于联邦政府的干预——特别是通过披露授权、合同要求和民权执法——而企业的自愿承诺，如果缺乏监管支柱，是脆弱的，而且容易被紧缩。在此过程中，Disclosureland 揭示了披露是一种结构性机制，联邦政府通过这种机制塑造了公司内部种族相关问题的治理，从而为文献做出了宝贵的贡献。然而，这本书隐含地假设，有意义的联邦信息披露改革取决于围绕人口多样性作为共同社会利益的政治共识。在当今两极分化的环境中——以对 DEI 倡议的强烈反对、援引重建时代法规的诉讼以及有关种族平等的争议性叙述为标志——这种共识似乎难以捉摸。如果多样性本身会造成政治分歧，那么通往强制性公司的道路

title: Legal Form and Corporate Outcomes: Evidence from the Societas Europaea
authors: Edith Ginglinger
abstract: We examine firms' adoption of the Societas Europaea (SE), a supranational corporate form introduced in 2004, to study how legal structure affects corporate decisions and shareholder outcomes. At the end of 2024, SE companies accounted for more than 25% of the EURO STOXX 50 index. Adopters are more likely to be family-controlled firms with higher operating growth and market performance. Following adoption, firms attract greater foreign investor ownership and increase their cross-border acquisitions outside Europe, which is consistent with signaling a global identity. However, markets react negatively to SE implementation, except when headquarters relocation accompanies the change, and postadoption information asymmetry increases. Our evidence suggests that while the SE structure enhances contractual flexibility and global positioning, it also gives considerable latitude to CEOs and blockholders, with uncertainty about subsequent decisions and their consequences for shareholders.
source: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) working paper
title_zh: 法律形式和公司成果：来自欧洲协会的证据
abstract_zh: 我们研究了企业采用欧洲协会 (SE)（2004 年推出的一种超国家公司形式）的情况，以研究法律结构如何影响公司决策和股东结果。截至 2024 年底，SE 公司在 EURO STOXX 50 指数中的占比超过 25%。采用者更有可能是经营增长和市场表现较高的家族控制企业。采用后，企业会吸引更多的外国投资者所有权，并增加欧洲以外的跨境收购，这与发出全球身份的信号是一致的。然而，市场对SE的实施反应消极，除非总部搬迁伴随着变化，并且采用后信息不对称加剧。我们的证据表明，虽然SE结构增强了合同灵活性和全球定位，但它也为首席执行官和大股东提供了相当大的自由度，而后续决策及其对股东的影响具有不确定性。

title: Optional Shareholder Voting
authors: Michelle Lowry
abstract: Shareholder voting is optional for institutional managers (IMs), a category that includes activists, hedge funds, private wealth, and mixed asset management. Only 44% of IMs vote on firms' say-on-pay policies. However, their impact is large: the dollar value of their shares voted is twice that of mutual funds. Results suggest they use voting as a monitoring tool: among larger positions, where the benefits of monitoring are greater, they are both more likely to vote and more likely to vote against management. Yet, there is substantial heterogeneity across IMs, with some using voting to pursue other objectives, such as signaling friendliness toward management. We find that smaller firms attract fewer IM votes overall, but among shares voted, there is a more anti-management stance.
source: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) working paper
title_zh: 可选股东投票
abstract_zh: 机构管理者 (IM) 可以选择股东投票，该类别包括激进分子、对冲基金、私人财富和混合资产管理。只有 44% 的 IM 会对公司的薪酬发言权政策进行投票。然而，它们的影响很大：它们投票的股票的美元价值是共同基金的两倍。结果表明，他们使用投票作为监督工具：在职位较大的地方，监督的好处更大，他们更有可能投票，也更有可能投票反对管理层。然而，各个即时消息之间存在很大的异质性，一些即时消息使用投票来实现其他目标，例如向管理层表示友好。我们发现，总体而言，规模较小的公司吸引的 IM 选票较少，但在投票的股票中，反管理层的立场较多。

title: Conflicts of Interest and (Retail) Investor Protection in EU IPOs. An Analysis of the EU/Italian Regulatory Regime including the Prospectus Regulation, the Market Abuse Regulation and MiFID II-CDR 2017/565
authors: Stefano Lombardo
abstract: The article starts with an introduction to the “economics” of Initial Public Offerings (IPOs), the “economics” of book-building and clarification of the important role played by institutional investors in determining the final offer price and the allocation of shares. The article then goes on to analyse the interrelation between the provisions of the CDR 2017/565 supplementing MiFID II (in particular Articles 38-40) and the complex system established by the PR (in particular under Article 17) and the MAR (especially with respect to market manipulation) during IPOs for the purposes of investor protection from a European perspective. The question addressed is the extent to which the IPO conflict of interest rules laid down by the CDR 2017/565, particularly where they may give rise to market abuse, can function as an ex ante preventive mechanism, as opposed to relying on ex post sanctions for market manipulation. The article then considers the Italian IPO system by analysing certain practices that may be considered to be problematic in the light of the CDR 2017/565 rules. In particular, the article argues that, even if the important role played by institutional investors in final pric
source: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) working paper
title_zh: 欧盟首次公开募股中的利益冲突和（零售）投资者保护。欧盟/意大利监管制度分析，包括招股说明书监管、市场滥用监管和 MiFID II-CDR 2017/565
abstract_zh: 文章首先介绍了首次公开募股（IPO）的“经济学”、簿记建档的“经济学”，并阐明了机构投资者在确定最终发行价格和股票分配方面所发挥的重要作用。然后，本文从欧洲角度分析了补充 MiFID II 的 CDR 2017/565 条款（特别是第 38 至 40 条）与 PR（特别是第 17 条）和 MAR（特别是关于市场操纵）在 IPO 期间为保护投资者而建立的复杂制度之间的相互关系。所讨论的问题是，CDR 2017/565 规定的 IPO 利益冲突规则，特别是在可能导致市场滥用的情况下，可以在多大程度上发挥事前预防机制的作用，而不是依靠事后制裁来操纵市场。然后，本文通过分析根据 CDR 2017/565 规则可能被认为存在问题的某些做法来考虑意大利 IPO 制度。文章特别指出，即使机构投资者在最终定价中发挥了重要作用，

title: Financing Constraints, Performance Manipulation, and Founder Replacement
abstract: Granting investors the right to replace founders with professional managers benefits founders ex ante through improved financing terms or access to funding that would otherwise be unavailable. Ex post, however, founders prefer to remain in charge and have incentives to manipulate the performance metrics that trigger their replacement. When founders are financially unconstrained, the optimal contract eliminates manipulation incentives through generous exit packages. When founders are financially constrained, however, such packages leave insufficient pledgeable income to satisfy investors. Constrained founders must therefore offer contracts that induce them to manipulate performance metrics in equilibrium, leading to insufficient founder replacement. The model predicts that lower capital requirements, from technological shifts such as cloud computing, and greater founder wealth lead to larger exit packages, less manipulation, and more frequent turnover. In technologically complex sectors where performance metrics are opaque, exit packages are smaller, manipulation is more prevalent, and replacement is less frequent. The framework extends to staged financing, where founders distort th
source: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) working paper
title_zh: 融资限制、业绩操纵和创始人更换
abstract_zh: 赋予投资者用职业经理人替换创始人的权利，可以通过改善融资条件或获得原本无法获得的资金，让创始人事前受益。然而事后，创始人更愿意继续负责，并有动力操纵绩效指标来触发他们的替代。当创始人在财务上不受限制时，最优合约会通过慷慨的退出方案消除操纵激励。然而，当创始人财务困难时，此类方案就无法满足投资者的可抵押收入。因此，受到约束的创始人必须提供合同，促使他们平衡地操纵绩效指标，从而导致创始人替代不足。该模型预测，云计算等技术变革带来的资本要求降低以及创始人财富的增加将导致更大的退出方案、更少的操纵和更频繁的人员流动。在技​​术复杂的行业，绩效指标不透明，退出方案较小，操纵更加普遍，更换频率较低。该框架延伸至分阶段融资，创始人扭曲了

title: Rethinking Priority Rules in Insolvency
authors: Anthony Casey, Aurelio Gurrea-Martinez
abstract: Priority rules shape the core dynamics of insolvency law: distributive outcomes, bargaining in reorganization, and the ex ante behavior of debtors and creditors alike – including their decisions about risk taking, capital structure, and the cost of credit. This Article maps significant cross-jurisdictional variations in priority rules, examining how various countries’ insolvency laws treat different classes of claimants including secured creditors, employees, tax authorities and equity holders, and special categories of claims such as those for rescue financing, tort damages, environmental obligations and shareholder loans. The Article then evaluates the desirability of the observed priority rules. This evaluation provides several normative lessons about the appropriate design of insolvency law, including guidance on when to deviate from the principles of full priority and equal treatment. In particular, the Article addresses whether and when to subordinate shareholder loans, the special protections that should be afforded to tort victims and employees, the right legal tools to address environmental threats, and the safeguards necessary when priority is given to administrative clai
source: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) working paper
title_zh: 重新思考破产中的优先规则
abstract_zh: 优先权规则塑造了破产法的核心动力：分配结果、重组中的讨价还价以及债务人和债权人的事前行为——包括他们关于风险承担、资本结构和信贷成本的决策。本文描绘了优先权规则的重大跨司法管辖区差异，研究了各国破产法如何对待不同类别的债权人，包括有担保债权人、雇员、税务机关和股权持有人，以及特殊类别的债权，例如救援融资、侵权损害、环境义务和股东贷款。然后本文评估所观察到的优先级规则的可取性。该评价提供了有关破产法适当设计的若干规范性经验教训，包括关于何时偏离完全优先和平等待遇原则的指导。该条特别讨论了是否以及何时提供次级股东贷款、应向侵权受害者和雇员提供的特殊保护、解决环境威胁的正确法律工具以及优先考虑行政索赔时所需的保障措施。

title: When Does Acquisition Integration Succeed? Evidence from Inside the Integration Black Box
authors: René Stulz
abstract: We penetrate the black box of post-acquisition integration by examining whether business unit leaders (BULs)-executives responsible for integrating and operating acquired targets-shape integration outcomes. Using natural language processing-based measures of realized integration outcomes and financial metrics, we find that BULs' target-industry experience increases (decreases) integration success (failures) through superior realization of transaction synergies. Other BUL attributes are unrelated to integration outcomes. Consistent with the importance of integration for acquisition success, such experience enhances acquisition performance. BULs' target-industry experience improves integration planning and their post-acquisition career outcomes but is unrelated to earlier stages of the acquisition process.
source: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) working paper
title_zh: 收购整合何时成功？来自集成黑匣子内部的证据
abstract_zh: 我们通过检查负责整合和运营收购目标的业务部门领导者 (BUL) 高管是否塑造整合结果来穿透收购后整合的黑匣子。使用基于自然语言处理的已实现整合结果和财务指标的衡量标准，我们发现 BUL 的目标行业经验通过卓越地实现交易协同效应来增加（减少）整合成功（失败）。其他 BUL 属性与集成结果无关。与整合对于收购成功的重要性相一致，此类经验可以提高收购绩效。 BUL 的目标行业经验改善了整合规划及其收购后的职业成果，但与收购过程的早期阶段无关。

title: Influence Without Control: Private Funds, Shareholder Engagement, and the New Law of Control
authors: Yaron Nili
abstract: Delaware Senate Bill 21 (“SB 21”) has been widely framed as a politically motivated response to corporate flight, billionaire backlash, and perceived judicial overreach in controlling-shareholder doctrine. This Article argues that those accounts miss one of SB 21’s most consequential legal developments: its redefinition of the boundary between shareholder influence and corporate control. By replacing Delaware’s open-ended “actual control” doctrine with a statutory framework anchored in ownership thresholds and board-level authority, SB 21 transforms control from an ex post judicial determination into an ex-ante design choice. Through doctrinal analysis and original qualitative interviews with leading corporate advisors, this Article shows how SB 21 stabilizes transaction planning while formally insulating traditional forms of minority shareholder engagement—persuasion, voting, proxy contests, and limited board representation—from fiduciary status below a one-third ownership threshold. The statute’s effects extend well beyond founder-led firms, reshaping the governance strategies of private equity sponsors, venture capital funds, and activist investors. Finally, this Article undersc
source: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) working paper
title_zh: 不受控制的影响：私募基金、股东参与和新控制法
abstract_zh: 特拉华州参议院第 21 号法案（“SB 21”）被广泛认为是针对企业外逃、亿万富翁的强烈反对以及控股股东原则中司法越权行为的出于政治动机的回应。本文认为，这些说法忽略了 SB 21 最重要的法律发展之一：它重新定义了股东影响力和公司控制权之间的界限。通过用以所有权门槛和董事会级别权力为基础的法定框架取代特拉华州开放式的“实际控制”原则，SB 21 将控制权从事后司法决定转变为事前设计选择。通过理论分析和对领先企业顾问的原始定性访谈，本文展示了 SB 21 如何稳定交易计划，同时正式将传统形式的少数股东参与（说服、投票、代理竞争和有限的董事会代表）与低于三分之一所有权门槛的信托地位隔离开来。该法规的影响远远超出了创始人领导的公司，重塑了私募股权发起人、风险投资基金和激进投资者的治理策略。最后，本文下面

title: Disclosure Incentives and Bondholder Bargaining Power
authors: Audra Boone
abstract: We study how financially distressed firms adjust disclosure when creditor bargaining power increases. Exploiting the 2014 Marblegate Asset Management v. Education Management Corporation ruling, which unexpectedly strengthened public bondholders' ability to hold out in out-of-court restructurings, we find that distressed firms with publicly traded debt significantly reduce voluntary disclosure following the ruling. The decline is concentrated among firms with high blockholder ownership, consistent with informed shareholders curtailing public information to limit bondholders' ability to assess continuation values and coordinate holdout strategies. Disclosure reductions persist among firms with stable capital structures, ruling out financing switching as an alternative explanation. Remaining disclosures become more complex and litigious and are associated with lower likelihoods of positive market reactions. These changes coincide with a deterioration in market information environments and more restrictive covenants in subsequent bond issues. Our findings establish disclosure as a strategic instrument in debt renegotiation, with implications for financial reporting, creditor protection
source: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) working paper
title_zh: 披露激励措施和债券持有人的议价能力
abstract_zh: 我们研究当债权人议价能力增强时，陷入财务困境的公司如何调整披露。 2014 年 Marblegate 资产管理公司诉教育管理公司案的裁决出人意料地增强了公共债券持有人坚持庭外重组的能力，利用该裁决，我们发现拥有公开交易债务的陷入困境的公司在裁决后显着减少了自愿披露。这种下降主要集中在大股东持股比例较高的公司中，这与知情股东减少公开信息以限制债券持有人评估持续价值和协调抵制策略的能力相一致。资本结构稳定的公司持续减少披露，排除了融资转换作为替代解释的可能。其余的披露变得更加复杂和诉讼，并且与市场积极反应的可能性较低相关。这些变化与市场信息环境的恶化以及后续债券发行中的更多限制性条款同时发生。我们的研究结果表明，披露是债务重新谈判的战略工具，对财务报告、债权人保护具有影响

title: Corporate Governance as National Security Strategy - Supply Chain Resilience as an Oversight Duty
authors: parellak
abstract: The nation’s security depends on decisions made in corporate boardrooms: Corporations own, control and govern the critical physical and digital infrastructure upon which we daily depend. The strength of this infrastructure depends on the routine decisions made by the directors and officers who govern these corporations – choices relating to risk management, strategic development, sourcing, growth, and investments. The public stakes of these choices transform traditionally internal matters of corporate governance into contemporary issues of national security. But these corporate decisions are driven by market incentives, not security objectives, creating a significant problem of misalignment between corporate decision-making and national security policy. Multiple White House administrations have sought to address this misalignment through enhanced public governance using both executive orders and direct equity investments in corporations – measures that signal a potential re-calibration in the relationship between state and industry while still failing to reach the full range of corporations whose ordinary decisions determine national security outcomes. This Article argues that priv
source: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) working paper
abstract_zh: 国家的安全取决于公司董事会做出的决策：公司拥有、控制和管理我们日常依赖的关键物理和数字基础设施。该基础设施的强度取决于管理这些公司的董事和管理人员做出的日常决策——与风险管理、战略发展、采购、增长和投资相关的选择。这些选择的公共利益将传统的公司治理内部问题转变为当代的国家安全问题。但这些企业决策是由市场激励而非安全目标驱动的，造成企业决策与国家安全政策不一致的严重问题。多届白宫政府都试图通过利用行政命令和对企业的直接股权投资来加强公共治理来解决这种失调问题，这些措施表明国家与行业之间关系可能会重新调整，但仍未能覆盖到所有企业，这些企业的日常决策决定着国家安全的结果。本文认为，私有

title: Sustainable Finance and Corporate Law: Lessons from the US
authors: Jill Fisch
abstract: This chapter traces the trajectory of two major US sustainability initiatives, the Securities & Exchange Commission’s climate risk disclosure rule and California’s mandates requiring disclosure of climate-related risks and greenhouse gas emissions. The chapter explores the motivation behind both efforts and explains how the backlash against disclosure mandates led to challenges that in both cases have, to date, been successful. The success of the challenges has been due, in part, to distinctive features of the US regulatory structure. At the same time, these features offer unique possibilities for experimentation, innovation and incremental regulatory reform. As the debate over corporate sustainability continues, we offer cautious optimism about the potential of the US to respond to its demands.
source: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) working paper
title_zh: 可持续金融和公司法：美国的经验教训
abstract_zh: 本章追溯了美国两项主要可持续发展举措的轨迹，即美国证券交易委员会的气候风险披露规则和加州要求披露气候相关风险和温室气体排放的规定。本章探讨了这两项努力背后的动机，并解释了对披露授权的强烈反对如何导致了迄今为止在这两种情况下都取得成功的挑战。这些挑战的成功部分归功于美国监管结构的独特特征。同时，这些特征为实验、创新和渐进式监管改革提供了独特的可能性。随着有关企业可持续发展的争论仍在继续，我们对美国回应其要求的潜力持谨慎乐观态度。

title: Socially-Minded Investors and Corporate Behavior
authors: Merritt Fox
abstract: Many equity investors are concerned with the world’s worsening social and environmental problems and are losing faith in the capacity of political institutions to respond. Where corporate behavior is contributing to these problems, these investors would, at least if fully informed as to costs and benefits involved, favor corrective changes even where that would lessen their investment returns. Two important questions arise: (1) given existing law, are such willing-to-sacrifice equity investors currently affecting firm behavior; and (2) should there be legal reform that makes firms more sensitive to these willing-to-sacrifice investors’ preferences? This Article seeks to answer these two questions, applying the teachings of corporate governance and financial economics. We go back to first principles to explore, relative to the politics of governmental regulation, this alternative way of harnessing people’s other-regarding values to improve social welfare. Under current corporate governance arrangements, a firm’s business decisions are, in the first instance, the product of its managers, not its shareholders. If willing-to-sacrifice investors are to have any effect on firm behavior,
source: European Corporate Governance Institute (ECGI) working paper
title_zh: 具有社会意识的投资者和企业行为
abstract_zh: 许多股票投资者担心世界上日益恶化的社会和环境问题，并对政治机构的应对能力失去信心。当企业行为导致这些问题时，这些投资者至少在充分了解所涉及的成本和收益的情况下，会倾向于采取纠正性改变，即使这会减少他们的投资回报。出现了两个重要问题：（1）根据现行法律，这些愿意牺牲的股权投资者目前是否正在影响公司行为？ （2）是否应该进行法律改革，使公司对这些愿意牺牲投资者偏好的人更加敏感？本文旨在运用公司治理和金融经济学的理论来回答这两个问题。我们回到首要原则，探索与政府监管政治相关的这种利用人们的其他价值观来改善社会福利的替代方式。在当前的公司治理安排下，公司的业务决策首先是其管理者的产物，而不是股东的产物。如果愿意牺牲的投资者要对公司行为产生任何影响，

title: Bank Runs With and Without Bank Failure
authors: Sergio A. Correia, Stephan Luck, Emil Verner
abstract: We study the causes and consequences of bank runs. By applying large language models to historical newspapers, we create a comprehensive database of bank runs in U.S. history with information on 3,984 runs on individual banks from 1863 to 1934. Our novel data allow us to establish that runs are considerably more likely in weak banks but also occur in strong banks, especially in response to negative news about the real economy or the broader banking system. However, runs typically only result in failure for banks with poor fundamentals. Strong banks survive runs through various mechanisms, including signaling strength, interbank cooperation, and temporary suspension. At the local level, runs on banks with poor fundamentals translate into substantially larger declines in deposits, lending, and manufacturing activity than runs on strong banks. Our findings imply that poor fundamentals are central to explaining both when runs occur and when they have severe economic effects, tempering the view that small shocks can generate discontinuous jumps to bad equilibria through self-fulfilling run dynamics.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 有或没有银行倒闭的银行挤兑
abstract_zh: 我们研究银行挤兑的原因和后果。通过将大型语言模型应用于历史报纸，我们创建了一个美国历史上银行挤兑的综合数据库，其中包含 1863 年至 1934 年期间各银行发生的 3,984 次挤兑信息。我们的新颖数据使我们能够确定，挤兑在实力较弱的银行中发生的可能性要大得多，但在实力雄厚的银行中也会发生，特别是在针对实体经济或更广泛的银行体系的负面消息时。然而，挤兑通常只会导致基本面较差的银行破产。实力雄厚的银行可以通过多种机制生存下来，包括信号强度、银行间合作和临时停牌。在地方层面，基本面较差的银行的挤兑会导致存款、贷款和制造业活动的下降幅度远远大于实力雄厚的银行的挤兑。我们的研究结果表明，不良的基本面对于解释何时发生挤兑以及何时产生严重的经济影响至关重要，这缓和了这样一种观点，即小冲击可能会通过自我实现的挤兑动态导致不连续的跳跃到不良均衡。

title: The International RBC Model Finally Works!
authors: Sushant Acharya, Edouard Challe, Louphou Coulibaly
abstract: We show that incorporating uninsurable countercyclical income risk into a standard international RBC model can qualitatively and quantitatively account for the quantity puzzles in open-economy macro, namely (i) the Backus-Smith puzzle, (ii) the Backus-Kehoe-Kydland puzzle, and (iii) the weak correlation between the trade balance and the exchange rate. We also show that our model can simultaneously account for the Fama puzzle and the evidence that high interest rate countries have stronger currencies—which representative-agents models that rely only on financial or demand shocks cannot jointly account for. Crucially, our model resolves all these puzzles while relying solely on productivity shocks and thus generates the observed domestic and cross-country macroeconomic comovement.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 国际红细胞模型终于奏效了！
abstract_zh: 我们证明，将不可保的反周期收入风险纳入标准国际 RBC 模型可以定性和定量地解释开放经济宏观中的数量难题，即（i）巴科斯-史密斯难题，（ii）巴科斯-基霍-基德兰难题，以及（iii）贸易平衡与汇率之间的弱相关性。我们还表明，我们的模型可以同时解释 Fama 难题和高利率国家货币走强的证据——仅依赖金融或需求冲击的代表-代理模型无法共同解释这一点。至关重要的是，我们的模型解决了所有这些难题，同时仅依靠生产率冲击，从而产生了观察到的国内和跨国宏观经济联动。

title: Regulatory Arbitrage Within the Firm
authors: Nicola Cetorelli, Shohini Kundu
abstract: Regulation shapes the boundaries of firms. When prudential standards bind asymmetrically across subsidiaries of an integrated organization, internal capital markets become a mechanism for regulatory arbitrage. We study this in U.S. banking, where holding companies encompass both heavily regulated depository institutions and lightly regulated nonbank affiliates. Following Basel III in 2015, holding companies extract equity from nonbank subsidiaries to recapitalize their banks. Bank subsidiaries accumulate 5-8 percentage points more excess capital than comparable standalone banks through internal transfers; consolidated equity, assets, and lending are unchanged. In response to the same regulatory shock, nonbank affiliates within these organizations exhibit declining capital ratios, deteriorating credit quality, and expansion into consumer lending. The consolidated organization remains exposed to nonbank distress. We calibrate stress scenarios to 2008-scale losses on nonbank assets. If parents were to recapitalize distressed subsidiaries, 4-6 percent of holding companies would exhaust their capital buffers. For the most exposed institutions, the apparent improvement in bank safety is substantially overstated once the implicit liability to nonbank affiliates is accounted for. Organizational structure is a fundamental determinant of regulatory outcomes.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 公司内部的监管套利
abstract_zh: 监管塑造了企业的边界。当审慎标准对一体化组织的子公司之间的约束力不对称时，内部资本市场就成为监管套利的机制。我们在美国银行业中研究了这一点，其中控股公司既包括受到严格监管的存款机构，也包括受到轻度监管的非银行附属机构。 2015 年巴塞尔协议 III 出台后，控股公司从非银行子公司提取股权，以对其银行进行资本重组。银行子公司通过内部转移积累的超额资本比同类独立银行多5-8个百分点；合并权益、资产和贷款未发生变化。为了应对同样的监管冲击，这些组织内的非银行附属机构表现出资本比率下降、信贷质量恶化以及消费贷款扩张。合并后的组织仍然面临非银行困境。我们根据 2008 年非银行资产损失规模来校准压力情景。如果母公司对陷入困境的子公司进行资本重组，4-6% 的控股公司将耗尽其资本缓冲。对于风险最大的机构来说，一旦考虑到非银行附属机构的隐性负债，银行安全性的明显改善就被大大夸大了。组织结构是监管结果的基本决定因素。

title: Micro and Macro Cost-Price Dynamics in Normal Times and During Inflation Surges
authors: Luca Gagliardone, Mark Gertler, Simone Lenzu, Joris Tielens
abstract: We develop a unified approach to studying cost-price dynamics in the cross-section of firms in order to jointly explain the time series of aggregate inflation and the frequency of price changes, both during normal times and inflation surges. A key novelty is the use of microdata on firms’ prices and production costs to construct an empirical measure of price gaps—the deviation between a firm’s listed and optimal price. Conditional on the path of aggregate cost shocks extracted from the data, a state-dependent pricing model with strategic complementarities accounts well for both the linear cost-price dynamics of the pre-pandemic period and the nonlinear increase in inflation and frequency of price adjustment that followed.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 正常时期和通胀飙升期间的微观和宏观成本价格动态
abstract_zh: 我们开发了一种统一的方法来研究企业横截面的成本价格动态，以便共同解释正常时期和通货膨胀高峰期间总通货膨胀的时间序列和价格变化的频率。一个关键的新颖之处是利用企业价格和生产成本的微观数据来构建价格差距的实证衡量标准，即企业上市价格与最优价格之间的偏差。以从数据中提取的总成本冲击路径为条件，具有战略互补性的依赖于国家的定价模型很好地解释了大流行前时期的线性成本价格动态以及随后的通货膨胀和价格调整频率的非线性增长。

title: Bayesian Persuasion and Cryptography
authors: Pablo D. Azar
abstract: Bayesian Persuasion assumes that a sender can commit ex ante to an information structure and then release the realized signal ex post. This paper asks when that commitment technology can itself be implemented. After observing the state, a sender who also observes the realized signal can suppress unfavorable draws even if every disclosed signal is verifiably correct. We define Receiver-Private Certified Bayesian Persuasion, a benchmark in which the receiver obtains the signal and a certificate of correct generation while the sender does not learn the realized branch of the experiment. The main theorem shows that this benchmark is equivalent in cryptographic power to secure two-party computation. Thus cryptography is not merely an implementation device for persuasion; when the sender must be prevented from changing the signal sent to the receiver, hiding the signal from the sender is necessary. In stress-test applications, the primitive removes ex post discretion over which realized disclosure reaches depositors.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 贝叶斯说服和密码学
abstract_zh: 贝叶斯说服假设发送者可以事前提交信息结构，然后事后释放已实现的信号。本文询问承诺技术本身何时可以实施。在观察状态之后，即使每个公开的信号都经过验证是正确的，也观察已实现的信号的发送者可以抑制不利的抽奖。我们定义了接收者私有认证贝叶斯说服，这是一个基准，接收者获得信号和正确生成的证书，而发送者不了解实验的实现分支。主要定理表明，该基准在安全两方计算的加密能力方面是等效的。因此密码学不仅仅是一种说服的实现手段；当必须防止发送者改变发送给接收者的信号时，有必要对发送者隐藏信号。在压力测试应用中，原语消除了储户所实现的披露的事后自由裁量权。

title: Financial Shocks, Productivity, and Prices
authors: Shi Hu, Simone Lenzu, David A. Rivers, Joris Tielens
abstract: We study the interconnection between the productivity and pricing effects of financial shocks. Combining administrative records on firm-level output prices and quantities with quasi-experimental variation in credit supply, we show that a tightening of credit conditions has a persistent, yet delayed, negative effect on firms’ long-run physical productivity growth (TFPQ) but also induces firms to change their pricing policies. Commonly used revenue-based productivity measures (TFPR)—which conflate price and productivity—offer biased predictions regarding the consequences of financial shocks for firms’ productivity growth, underestimating the long-run elasticity of physical productivity to credit supply by half. We also show that the pricing adjustments themselves have productivity implications. Firms use low pricing as a source of internal financing, allowing them to avoid cutting expenditures on productivity-enhancing activities, thereby softening the impact of financial shocks. We incorporate these forces into a quantitative model of firm dynamics to quantify the importance of productivity and pricing dynamics (and their interplay) in driving the scarring effects of financial crises on aggregate productivity and welfare.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 金融冲击、生产力和价格
abstract_zh: 我们研究金融冲击的生产率和定价效应之间的相互关系。将企业层面产出价格和数量的行政记录与信贷供应的准实验变化相结合，我们发现信贷条件的收紧对企业的长期实物生产率增长（TFPQ）具有持续但延迟的负面影响，但也会促使企业改变其定价政策。常用的基于收入的生产率指标（TFPR）——将价格和生产率混为一谈——对金融冲击对企业生产率增长的影响提供了有偏见的预测，低估了实体生产率对信贷供应的长期弹性一半。我们还表明，定价调整本身会对生产率产生影响。企业利用低价作为内部融资来源，从而避免削减提高生产率活动的支出，从而减轻金融冲击的影响。我们将这些力量纳入企业动态的定量模型中，以量化生产率和定价动态（及其相互作用）在推动金融危机对总生产率和福利造成的创伤影响方面的重要性。

title: Artificial Intelligence and Monetary Policy: A Framework and Perspective on Cyclical Transmission, Structural Transition, and Financial Stability
authors: Simone Lenzu
abstract: I develop a framework analyzing how artificial intelligence (AI) reshapes monetary policy through three interrelated channels: cyclical transmission, structural transition, and financial stability. In the short run, AI can alter inflation dynamics by changing how supply and demand disturbances map into prices—through shifts in production technologies, pricing behavior, cost pass-through, and expectations—even when conventional measures of economic slack are unchanged. Over longer horizons, AI may shift the natural benchmarks around which policy is calibrated, including potential output and the natural rate of interest. For financial stability, AI may improve credit allocation and risk assessment, but can also heighten systemic vulnerabilities through inflated expectation-driven asset valuations and model monocultures. A particular risk arises at the intersection of these channels: if AI initially depresses realized efficiency through adoption frictions while simultaneously fueling elevated asset valuations, the economy may face cost-push inflation and financial fragility at once—an AI-specific stagflation risk that the interest rate instrument alone is ill-suited to address. I argue that AI does not call for a redefinition of central banks’ objectives, but it does require a recalibration of existing frameworks: its diffusion blurs the distinction between cyclical fluctuations and structural shifts, raising the value of cost-side diagnostics and robust policy strategies over exclusive reliance on reduced-form inflation-gap relationships.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 人工智能与货币政策：周期性传导、结构转型和金融稳定的框架和视角
abstract_zh: 我开发了一个框架，分析人工智能 (AI) 如何通过三个相互关联的渠道重塑货币政策：周期性传导、结构转型和金融稳定。从短期来看，人工智能可以通过改变供需扰动如何映射到价格来改变通胀动态——通过生产技术、定价行为、成本转嫁和预期的转变——即使传统的经济疲软衡量标准没有改变。从长远来看，人工智能可能会改变政策校准的自然基准，包括潜在产出和自然利率。为了金融稳定，人工智能可以改善信贷配置和风险评估，但也可以通过夸大的预期驱动的资产估值和单一文化模型来加剧系统脆弱性。这些渠道的交叉点会出现一个特殊的风险：如果人工智能最初通过采用摩擦降低了实际效率，同时又推高了资产估值，那么经济可能会同时面临成本推动型通胀和金融脆弱性——这是一种人工智能特有的滞胀风险，仅靠利率工具是不适合解决的。我认为人工智能并不要求重新定义央行的目标，但它确实需要重新调整现有框架：它的扩散模糊了周期性波动和结构性转变之间的区别，提高了成本方诊断和稳健政策策略的价值，而不是完全依赖简化形式的通胀缺口关系。

title: Estimating Demand Shocks from Foot Traffic: A Big-Data Approach
authors: Marina Azzimonti, David Wiczer, Yang Xuan
abstract: This study leverages high-frequency foot-traffic data from SafeGraph to estimate demand shocks in customer-facing establishments across New York City’s retail, service, and health sectors. Recognizing that variations in foot traffic can arise from both unpredictable demand shocks and firm-driven strategies to attract customers, we present a theoretical framework that isolates establishment-level demand fluctuations from firm-level strategic choices. Implementing this empirically, we employ an unsupervised machine learning approach to classify establishments into distinct categories that are largely orthogonal to location and sector. We find important heterogeneity in the persistence of shocks, important heterogeneity in their trends, and that estimation on a pooled sample importantly understates the variance experienced by some establishments.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 估计人流量带来的需求冲击：大数据方法
abstract_zh: 本研究利用 SafeGraph 的高频人流量数据来估计纽约市零售、服务和卫生部门面向客户的机构的需求冲击。认识到客流量的变化可能是由不可预测的需求冲击和公司驱动的吸引客户的策略引起的，我们提出了一个理论框架，将机构层面的需求波动与公司层面的战略选择分开。根据经验实现这一点，我们采用无监督的机器学习方法将机构分类为基本上与位置和部门正交的不同类别。我们发现冲击的持续时间存在重要的异质性，其趋势也存在重要的异质性，并且对汇总样本的估计严重低估了某些企业所经历的方差。

title: Structural Changes in Investment and the Waning Power of Monetary Policy
authors: Justin Bloesch, Jacob P. Weber
abstract: We argue that secular change in both the production and composition of investment goods has weakened investment’s role in the transmission of monetary policy to labor earnings and consumption. We show analytically that fluctuations in the production of investment goods amplify the response of consumption to monetary policy shocks by varying labor income for hand-to-mouth agents. We document three secular changes weakening this channel: (i) labor’s share of value added in investment goods production has declined, (ii) the import share of investment goods has risen, and (iii) the composition of investment has shifted towards components that are less responsive to monetary policy. A small open economy, two agent New Keynesian model calibrated to match these facts implies a 23 percent weaker response of labor income and a 17 percent weaker response of consumption to real interest rate shocks in a 2020s economy relative to a 1960s economy.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 投资的结构性变化和货币政策力量的减弱
abstract_zh: 我们认为，投资品生产和构成的长期变化削弱了投资在货币政策向劳动力收入和消费传导中的作用。我们分析表明，投资品生产的波动通过改变糊口代理人的劳动收入，放大了消费对货币政策冲击的反应。我们记录了削弱这一渠道的三个长期变化：(i) 投资品生产中劳动力增加值份额下降，(ii) 投资品进口份额上升，(iii) 投资构成转向对货币政策反应较弱的部分。一个小型开放经济体，根据这些事实进行校准的两个主体新凯恩斯模型意味着，与 1960 年代的经济相比，2020 年代的经济对实际利率冲击的劳动收入反应要弱 23%，消费对实际利率冲击的反应要弱 17%。

title: Repo and the Liquidity Risk Premium
authors: Adam Copeland, Owen Engbretson
abstract: Securities dealers play a central role intermediating funds in the U.S. short-term money markets. This intermediation involves risk, which can be mitigated by holding buffers of liquid securities. The cost of holding these buffers—the liquidity risk premium—is driven by the opportunity cost of holding money and so is influenced by monetary policy. We use detailed data on the pricing of repurchase agreements (repo), the main contract used to provide secured funding in the money markets, to measure by how much changes in monetary policy affect the liquidity risk premium embedded in repo pricing. The results imply that both changes in administrative rates and in aggregate reserves have effects on this risk premium and that this relationship is nonlinear. Using the average values of rates and reserves in 2024, the estimated coefficients predict that a 100-basis-point increase in the interest rate on reserve balances results in a 0.9 basis point increase in the liquidity risk premium—a 10 percent increase in the spread charged by securities dealers to their clients. The same effect on this risk premium can be achieved by a $429 billion decrease in the aggregate reserves.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 回购协议和流动性风险溢价
abstract_zh: 证券交易商在美国短期货币市场的资金中介中发挥着核心作用。这种中介涉及风险，可以通过持有流动证券缓冲来减轻风险。持有这些缓冲的成本——流动性风险溢价——是由持有货币的机会成本驱动的，因此也受到货币政策的影响。我们使用回购协议（repo）定价的详细数据来衡量货币政策的变化对回购定价中嵌入的流动性风险溢价的影响程度，回购协议是货币市场上用于提供担保融资的主要合同。结果表明，行政利率和总准备金的变化都会影响风险溢价，并且这种关系是非线性的。使用 2024 年利率和准备金的平均值，估计系数预测准备金余额利率上升 100 个基点会导致流动性风险溢价增加 0.9 个基点，即证券交易商向客户收取的利差增加 10%。通过减少总准备金 4,290 亿美元，也可以对风险溢价产生同样的影响。

title: Intraday Price Pressure and Order Flow Around U.S. Treasury Auctions
authors: Michael J. Fleming, Weiling Liu, Giang Nguyen
abstract: Using thirty-three years of intraday Treasury data, we provide the first high-frequency evidence on auction-day price pressure: yields rise in the hours before auction and reverse afterward. This pressure strengthens when dealers face tighter risk-bearing constraints and weakens when investor demand is stronger or more elastic. More importantly, net order flow dominates in explaining the pressure, providing the first direct evidence that trading transmits dealer constraints into prices. Despite concerns about dealer capacity amid rapid federal debt growth, price pressure has not increased in recent years, partly because non-dealer participants now absorb more auction supply and ease dealers’ intermediation burden.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 美国国债拍卖的盘中价格压力和订单流
abstract_zh: 利用三十三年的日内美国国债数据，我们提供了拍卖日价格压力的第一个高频证据：收益率在拍卖前几个小时上升，然后反转。当交易商面临更严格的风险承担约束时，这种压力就会增强；而当投资者需求更强或更有弹性时，这种压力就会减弱。更重要的是，净订单流在解释压力方面占主导地位，提供了第一个直接证据，证明交易将经销商的限制传递给价格。尽管在联邦债务快速增长的情况下人们对经销商的产能感到担忧，但近年来价格压力并未增加，部分原因是非经销商参与者现在吸收了更多的拍卖供应并减轻了经销商的中介负担。

title: When Long-Run Trends Are Unknown: Bond Pricing Implications
authors: Borel Ahonon, Guillaume Roussellet
abstract: We propose a macro-finance model in which inflation, growth, and the policy rate are driven by unobservable long-run trends and transitory cycles that investors must infer from aggregate data. Their subjective estimates of these trends, and the uncertainty surrounding them, are priced into the Treasury yield curve in a tractable way through both interest rate expectations and bond risk premia. Empirical estimates reveal an upward smooth trend in the long-run real interest rate (r-star) until the 1980s, and large investor uncertainty with confidence bands on as wide as 3.4 percentage points, contrasting with the volatile rate implied by perfect information models.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 当长期趋势未知时：债券定价的影响
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个宏观金融模型，其中通货膨胀、增长和政策利率是由投资者必须从总体数据中推断出的不可观察的长期趋势和短暂周期驱动的。他们对这些趋势的主观估计以及围绕这些趋势的不确定性，通过利率预期和债券风险溢价以易于处理的方式计入国债收益率曲线。实证估计显示，直到 20 世纪 80 年代，长期实际利率（r-star）一直呈平稳上升趋势，投资者的不确定性很大，置信区间宽达 3.4 个百分点，这与完美信息模型所暗示的波动率形成鲜明对比。

title: Systemic Cyber Risk
authors: Steven D. Baker, Michael Junho Lee
abstract: We propose a quantitative framework to track systemic risk arising from cyber vulnerabilities of the U.S. financial system. Synthesizing financial, economic, cyber, and network data that covers thousands of financial institutions and technological firms, we develop an index that tracks financial-system-level cyber vulnerability (SCV) for the financial system. Geopolitical risk, ransomware and malware incidents, and seasonal factors significantly drive the estimated adversarial component. Estimated technological and financial components exhibit fat tails in the distribution. In the cross-section, SCV is attributable to a small set of the largest firms. Large technology firms, including Microsoft, Google, Cisco, and Apple, emerge as key contributors to SCV. These providers also represent the largest cumulative count of vulnerabilities, pointing to financial stability considerations arising from the common exposure to client firms. SCV for service providers co-varies with that of financial institutions, which could amplify financial stability risks. The framework puts forth an approach to include a broad set of entities into an aggregate assessment of cyber vulnerability.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 系统性网络风险
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个量化框架来跟踪美国金融体系网络漏洞引起的系统性风险。我们综合了涵盖数千家金融机构和科技公司的金融、经济、网络和网络数据，开发了一个跟踪金融系统金融系统级网络漏洞 (SCV) 的指数。地缘政治风险、勒索软件和恶意软件事件以及季节性因素显着驱动了估计的对抗成分。估计的技术和金融成分在分布中呈现出厚尾。从横截面来看，SCV 归因于一小部分最大的公司。微软、谷歌、思科和苹果等大型科技公司成为 SCV 的主要贡献者。这些提供商还代表了最大的累积漏洞数量，指出了由于对客户公司的共同风险而产生的金融稳定性考虑。服务提供商的 SCV 与金融机构的 SCV 共同变化，这可能会放大金融稳定风险。该框架提出了一种将广泛的实体纳入网络脆弱性总体评估的方法。

title: Stablecoin Disintermediation
authors: Michael Junho Lee, Donny Tou
abstract: We propose a theory of stablecoin disintermediation, whereby stablecoins not only erode banks’ deposit franchises but also transmit liquidity stress to the banking system. Using transaction-level data linking on-chain transactions to wholesale interbank payments, we document the first evidence of liquidity-driven bank disintermediation. Stablecoins directly transmit liquidity shocks to the banking system: banks with stablecoin deposits experience substantial increases in payment demand and heightened liquidity exposure to daily stablecoin primary market activity. Consistent with theory, banks operate “narrowly” to support liquidity-hungry stablecoin deposits – requiring substantially larger bank reserve balances to mitigate potential shortfalls. Even as beneficiaries of stablecoin growth within the banking system, partner banks’ loan share of assets contracts relative to peers. Our results substantially broaden the scope for stablecoins to disintermediate banks, impact bank lending, and complicate monetary policy implementation.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 稳定币脱媒
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种稳定币脱媒理论，即稳定币不仅会侵蚀银行的存款特权，还会将流动性压力传递给银行体系。使用将链上交易与批发银行间支付联系起来的交易级数据，我们记录了流动性驱动的银行脱媒的第一个证据。稳定币直接将流动性冲击传递给银行系统：拥有稳定币存款的银行的支付需求大幅增加，日常稳定币一级市场活动的流动性敞口也增加。与理论一致，银行的运营“狭义”是为了支持急需流动性的稳定币存款——需要大幅增加银行准备金余额，以缓解潜在的短缺。即使作为银行体系内稳定币增长的受益者，合作银行的资产贷款份额相对于同行也有所收缩。我们的研究结果大大拓宽了稳定币的范围，使银行脱中介化，影响银行贷款，并使货币政策实施复杂化。

title: Sports Betting Across Borders: Spatial Spillovers, Credit Distress, and Fiscal Externalities
authors: Jacob Goss, Daniel Mangrum
abstract: Since the 2018 Murphy v. NCAA decision, 38 states have legalized mobile sports betting. We study effects on betting and consumer credit, emphasizing spatial spillovers across state lines. Using consumer spending data and an extended two-way fixed effects framework that separately identifies direct and spillover effects, we find that legalization increases total sportsbook spending roughly tenfold and take-up by 3.1 percentage points. Counties in non-legal states within 15 miles of a legal state experience spillover spending equal to roughly 14 percent of the direct effect, with these spillovers declining to roughly zero by 60 miles. Using the New York Fed Consumer Credit Panel, we find that median credit scores decline by roughly 1 point and overall delinquency rises 0.3 percentage points from a 10.7 percent base, with spillover delinquency rising nearly 0.2 percentage points. Under-40 auto loan delinquency increases by half a percentage point and credit card delinquency by one percentage point, driving the overall increase in delinquency. Scaling the population-level delinquency effect by take-up yields implied delinquency increases of roughly 10 percentage points among induced bettors. We conclude with a policy simulation which reveals that spillovers create a fiscal asymmetry: states that have not legalized bear costs from cross-border betting without capturing tax revenue, giving high exposure states a stronger case for legalization. This incentive is increasing in states that have higher pre-legalization betting activity, population centers near legal states, and a younger population. Methodologically, we show that ignoring spatial spillovers can contribute to attenuated estimates and an under-count of the affected population.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 跨境体育博彩：空间溢出、信用困境和财政外部性
abstract_zh: 自 2018 年墨菲诉 NCAA 案判决以来，已有 38 个州将移动体育博彩合法化。我们研究对博彩和消费信贷的影响，强调跨州的空间溢出效应。使用消费者支出数据和单独识别直接效应和溢出效应的扩展双向固定效应框架，我们发现合法化使体育博彩总支出大约增加十倍，使用率增加 3.1 个百分点。距离合法州 15 英里以内的非合法州县的溢出支出大约相当于直接影响的 14%，而这些溢出在距离合法州 60 英里后下降到大约为零。根据纽约联邦储备银行消费者信贷小组的数据，我们发现信用评分中位数下降了大约 1 个百分点，总体拖欠率从 10.7% 的基数上升了 0.3 个百分点，溢出拖欠率上升了近 0.2 个百分点。 40 岁以下的汽车贷款拖欠率增加了 0.5 个百分点，信用卡拖欠率增加了 1 个百分点，导致拖欠率整体增加。通过接受率来衡量人口水平的犯罪率，意味着诱导投注者的犯罪率增加了大约 10 个百分点。我们通过政策模拟得出结论，该模拟揭示了溢出效应造成了财政不对称：尚未将跨境博彩合法化的国家承担了跨境博彩的成本，却没有获得税收收入，这使得高风险国家有更强有力的合法化理由。在合法化前博彩活动较高、人口中心靠近合法州以及人口较年轻的州，这种激励措施正在增加。从方法上讲，我们表明，忽略空间溢出可能会导致受影响人口的估计值减弱和低估。

title: Open-Ended Treasury Purchases: From Market Functioning to Financial Easing
authors: Stefania D'Amico, Max Gillet, Sam Schulhofer-Wohl, Tim Seida
abstract: We assess whether the Fed’s asset purchases can be tailored to either restore market functioning or provide economic stimulus. When the communicated goal is restoring market functioning and purchases’ implementation is flexible, flow effects are significant: relative price deviations narrow. However, stock effects remain near zero and hence not stimulative. When the communicated goal links purchases to the achievement of the dual mandate, improving their size’s predictability, stock effects rise consistently above zero. When the communicated implementation improves the predictability of the purchases’ maturity composition, stock effects become large. Jointly, the communicated goal and implementation can shape the purchases’ effects.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 开放式国债购买：从市场运作到金融宽松
abstract_zh: 我们评估美联储的资产购买计划是否可以调整以恢复市场功能或提供经济刺激。当传达的目标是恢复市场功能且采购实施灵活时，流动效应显着：相对价格偏差缩小。然而，库存效应仍然接近于零，因此不具有刺激作用。当传达的目标将采购与实现双重使命联系起来时，提高其规模的可预测性，库存效应就会持续上升到零以上。当沟通的实施提高了采购期限构成的可预测性时，库存效应就会变得很大。共同传达的目标和实施可以塑造购买的效果。

title: The Payoffs of Higher Pay: Labor Supply and Productivity Responses to a Voluntary Firm Minimum Wage
authors: Natalia Emanuel, Emma Harrington
abstract: What are the returns to firms of paying more? We study a Fortune 500 firm’s voluntary firm-wide $15/hour minimum wage, which affected some warehouses more than others. Using a continuous difference-in-differences design, we find that a $1/hour pay increase (5.5 percent) halves worker departures, reduces absenteeism by 18.6 percent, and increases productivity (boxes moved per hour) by 5.7 percent. These productivity gains fully defrayed increased labor costs, offsetting the firm’s incentive to mark down wages. We develop a simple model that connects efficiency-wage incentives and monopsony power, showing how these forces can counterbalance each other to keep wages closer to workers’ marginal revenues.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 高工资的回报：劳动力供应和生产力对自愿企业最低工资的反应
abstract_zh: 支付更多费用会给公司带来什么回报？我们研究了一家财富 500 强公司在全公司范围内自愿实行的 15 美元/小时最低工资，这对一些仓库的影响比其他仓库更大。使用连续的双重差分设计，我们发现每小时加薪 1 美元（5.5%）可以使员工离职率减少一半，缺勤率减少 18.6%，生产率（每小时移动的箱子）提高 5.7%。这些生产率的提高完全抵消了劳动力成本的增加，抵消了公司降低工资的动力。我们开发了一个简单的模型，将效率工资激励和垄断权力联系起来，展示这些力量如何相互抵消，以使工资更接近工人的边际收入。

title: Bank Failures: The Roles of Solvency and Liquidity
authors: Sergio A. Correia, Stephan Luck, Emil Verner
abstract: Bank failures can stem from runs on otherwise solvent banks or from losses that render banks insolvent, regardless of withdrawals. Disentangling the relative importance of liquidity and solvency in explaining bank failures is central to understanding financial crises and designing effective financial stability policies. This paper reviews evidence on the causes of bank failures. Bank failures—both with and without runs—are almost always related to poor fundamentals. Low recovery rates in failure suggest that most failed banks that experienced runs were likely fundamentally insolvent. Examiners’ postmortem assessments also emphasize the primacy of poor asset quality and solvency problems. Before deposit insurance, runs commonly triggered the failure of insolvent banks. However, runs rarely caused the failure of strong banks, as such runs were typically resolved through other mechanisms, including interbank cooperation, equity injections, public signals of strength, or suspension of convertibility. We discuss the policy implications of these findings and outline directions for future research.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 银行倒闭：偿付能力和流动性的作用
abstract_zh: 银行倒闭可能源于其他有偿付能力的银行的挤兑，或者导致银行资不抵债的损失，无论提款情况如何。理清流动性和偿付能力在解释银行倒闭方面的相对重要性对于理解金融危机和设计有效的金融稳定政策至关重要。本文回顾了有关银行倒闭原因的证据。银行倒闭——无论有没有挤兑——几乎总是与糟糕的基本面有关。破产后的低回收率表明，大多数经历过挤兑的倒闭银行很可能从根本上资不抵债。审查人员的事后评估还强调了资产质量差和偿付能力问题的首要性。在存款保险出现之前，挤兑通常会引发破产银行的倒闭。然而，挤兑很少导致实力雄厚的银行倒闭，因为此类挤兑通常通过其他机制解决，包括银行间合作、股权注入、公开显示实力或暂停可兑换。我们讨论这些发现的政策含义并概述未来研究的方向。

title: Programming Money Without Programmable Money
authors: Michael Junho Lee, Antoine Martin
abstract: Programmability is at the heart of ongoing work on the future of money and payments by central banks around the world. Despite its potential, there is growing concern that programmability conflicts with the provision of “good” money. This paper overviews key principles of “good” money and argues that the discourse on programmability inadequately differentiates between programmable money, which is generally negatively viewed, and programmable payments, which is generally accepted as part of the future. We provide a framework for programmable monetary systems that sharply distinguishes between programmable money and programmable payments. We show that our framework nests a broader set of financial arrangements and revisit the debate on programmability in the design of monetary systems.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 在没有可编程货币的情况下对货币进行编程
abstract_zh: 可编程性是世界各地中央银行针对货币和支付的未来正在进行的工作的核心。尽管其潜力巨大，但人们越来越担心可编程性与提供“优质”资金相冲突。本文概述了“好”货币的关键原则，并认为关于可编程性的讨论没有充分区分可编程货币（通常被负面看待）和可编程支付（通常被认为是未来的一部分）。我们为可编程货币系统提供了一个框架，明确区分了可编程货币和可编程支付。我们表明，我们的框架包含了更广泛的金融安排，并重新审视了关于货币体系设计中的可编程性的辩论。

title: Stablecoins vs. Tokenized Deposits: The Narrow Banking Debate Revisited
authors: Xuesong Huang, Todd Keister
abstract: We study how the type of money used in blockchain-based trade affects interest rates, investment, and welfare. Stablecoins in our model are backed by safe assets, while banks issue deposits (both traditional and tokenized) to fund a portfolio of safe and risky assets. Deposit insurance creates a risk-shifting incentive for banks, and regulation increases banks’ costs. If regulatory costs are large and risk-shifting is limited, we show that allowing only tokenized deposits to be used in crypto trade raises welfare by expanding bank credit. If regulation is lighter and the risk-shifting incentive is strong, in contrast, allowing only stablecoins is desirable despite crowding out credit. In between these cases, allowing stablecoins and tokenized deposits to compete is optimal. The tradeoffs between these policies are reminiscent of both historical and recent debates over the desirability of narrow banking.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 稳定币与代币化存款：狭义银行业辩论重温
abstract_zh: 我们研究基于区块链的贸易中使用的货币类型如何影响利率、投资和福利。我们模型中的稳定币由安全资产支持，而银行发行存款（传统的和代币化的）来为安全和风险资产组合提供资金。存款保险为银行创造了风险转移的动力，而监管则增加了银行的成本。如果监管成本很高且风险转移有限，我们表明只允许在加密货币交易中使用代币化存款可以通过扩大银行信贷来提高福利。相比之下，如果监管较宽松且风险转移动机较强，那么尽管会挤出信贷，但只允许稳定币是可取的。在这些情况之间，允许稳定币和代币化存款竞争是最佳选择。这些政策之间的权衡让人想起历史上和最近关于狭义银行业务的可取性的争论。

title: Interest Rate Surprises When the Fed Doesn’t Speak
authors: Silvia Miranda-Agrippino, John C. Williams
abstract: The predictability of monetary policy surprises based on past, public information has been interpreted in two related yet fundamentally different ways. The “Fed information effect” posits that it arises due to markets updating their view of the economy, based on signals implicitly revealed by the FOMC. The “Fed reaction to news” explanation posits that markets update their view of the FOMC’s reaction function instead. We show that interest rate surprises calculated around macroeconomic releases exhibit the same predictability pattern as monetary policy surprises. Since these occur at a time when there is no scope for markets to learn about the Fed’s behavior, this pattern suggests an additional information channel unrelated to FOMC communication.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 当美联储不说话时，利率会令人惊讶
abstract_zh: 基于过去的公共信息的货币政策意外的可预测性已被以两种相关但根本不同的方式解释。 “美联储信息效应”认为，它的产生是由于市场根据联邦公开市场委员会隐含的信号更新了对经济的看法。 “美联储对新闻的反应”解释认为，市场会更新对联邦公开市场委员会反应函数的看法。我们发现，围绕宏观经济数据计算的利率意外表现出与货币政策意外相同的可预测性模式。由于这些事件发生时市场没有空间了解美联储的行为，因此这种模式表明存在与 FOMC 沟通无关的额外信息渠道。

title: Composable Finance
authors: Michael Junho Lee
abstract: Composability—open interactions between assets and protocols—facilitates a modular financial architecture. I document the emergence of composed asset transformation, where tokenized assets are re-bundled to alter access, liquidity, and risk characteristics to broaden and enhance the set of tokenized U.S. dollar instruments. Yet, I argue that “naive” composability fundamentally conflicts with the provision of pooled arrangements needed for liquidity provision, risk-sharing, and capital backstops. I demonstrate this in an economy consisting of a vertical chain of protocols. Upper-layer protocols expand access to users, but bootstrap contingent liquidity from lower-layer protocols, resulting in a waterfall of externalities. In equilibrium, the base protocol rations liquid reserves, resulting in systemic illiquidity across the economy. Under severe circumstances, total utilization shrinks with composability. I offer principles and direction for building a sustainable, composable system.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 可组合金融
abstract_zh: 可组合性——资产和协议之间的开放交互——促进了模块化金融架构。我记录了组合资产转型的出现，其中代币化资产被重新捆绑，以改变准入、流动性和风险特征，从而扩大和增强代币化美元工具集。然而，我认为“天真的”可组合性与提供流动性、风险分担和资本支持所需的集合安排存在根本冲突。我在由垂直协议链组成的经济中证明了这一点。上层协议扩大了对用户的访问，但从下层协议引导或有流动性，导致外部性瀑布。在均衡状态下，基础协议会分配流动性储备，导致整个经济体出现系统性流动性不足。在严峻的情况下，总利用率会随着可组合性而缩小。我提供了构建可持续、可组合系统的原则和方向。

title: Transformed Intermediation: Credit Risk to NBFIs, Liquidity Risk to Banks
authors: Viral V. Acharya, Nicola Cetorelli, Bruce Tuckman
abstract: We argue that the rapid asset growth of nonbank financial intermediaries (NBFIs) relative to banks is the outcome of transformations of risks between banks and NBFIs that increase the interconnectedness of the two sectors. These transformations are consistent with avoiding tighter, post-GFC bank regulation while harnessing the funding and liquidity advantages of bank deposit franchises and access to safety nets. Specifically, we show that banks fund NBFIs through senior loans and credit lines, which NBFIs use for acquiring junior credit claims, warehouse financing, and liquidity management. We empirically demonstrate that shocks experienced by NBFIs spill over to the banks that provide them with credit lines, particularly in times of stress. We then suggest policy approaches consistent with our transformation view and conclude with suggestions for future research.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
