title_zh: 转型后的中介：非银行金融机构的信用风险、银行的流动性风险
abstract_zh: 我们认为，非银行金融中介机构（NBFI）相对于银行的资产快速增长是银行和非银行金融中介机构之间风险转变的结果，这种转变增加了两个部门的相互联系。这些转变与避免全球金融危机后更严格的银行监管，同时利用银行存款特许经营权和安全网的资金和流动性优势是一致的。具体来说，我们表明银行通过高级贷款和信贷额度为非银行金融机构提供资金，非银行金融机构将其用于获取初级信贷债权、仓库融资和流动性管理。我们凭经验证明，非银行金融机构所经历的冲击会溢出到为其提供信贷额度的银行，特别是在面临压力的时候。然后，我们提出与我们的转型观点一致的政策方法，并为未来的研究提出建议。

title: Deposit Specialization and Lending Behavior
authors: Kristian S. Blickle, Cecilia Parlatore, Anthony Saunders
abstract: Using granular supervisory data on deposits, loans, and securities for the largest U.S. banks, we document persistent differences in depositor structures that directly shape asset structures. Retail-depositor oriented banks, for instance, enjoy cheap and stable funding. They thus hold lower-rate, longer-maturity loans and conduct more real estate lending than NBFI-depositor oriented banks. This has aggregate implications. Using exogenous deposit growth around COVID, we show bank depositor orientation shapes their response to deposit growth as well as to interest rate changes. Finally, we augment the paper with a risk measure that captures deviations between asset duration and liability maturity.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 存款专业化与借贷行为
abstract_zh: 利用美国最大银行的存款、贷款和证券的精细监管数据，我们记录了直接影响资产结构的储户结构的持续差异。例如，以零售储户为导向的银行享有廉价且稳定的融资。因此，与非银行金融机构存款人导向的银行相比，它们持有利率较低、期限较长的贷款，并进行更多的房地产贷款。这具有总体影响。利用围绕新冠疫情的外生存款增长，我们发现银行存款人的导向决定了他们对存款增长和利率变化的反应。最后，我们用风险度量来补充本文，以捕获资产期限和负债期限之间的偏差。

title: How Do Banks Build Equity Capital?
authors: Lily Gordon, Beverly Hirtle
abstract: We examine the evolution of equity capital in the U.S. banking industry over the past thirty-five years. Earnings are the major driver of increases in equity capital in the banking industry. While common stock issuance is frequent, amounts issued are generally small and do not contribute meaningfully to equity capital growth in most cases. Common stock dividends and repurchases are significant drains on equity capital. It is not uncommon for banks to pay out more than they earn, driven both by capital planning motivations and negative shocks to earnings. It is also common for banks to both issue new common stock and make repurchases in the same year, with these offsetting actions related to employee stock-based compensation.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 银行如何建立股权资本？
abstract_zh: 我们研究了过去三十五年来美国银行业股权资本的演变。盈利是银行业股本增加的主要驱动力。虽然普通股发行很频繁，但发行量通常较小，并且在大多数情况下对股本增长没有显着贡献。普通股股息和回购会严重消耗股本。在资本规划动机和盈利负面冲击的推动下，银行支出多于收入的情况并不少见。银行在同一年发行新普通股并进行回购也是很常见的，这些抵消行动与员工股票薪酬相关。

title: Less for You, More for Me: Credit Reallocation and Rationing Under Usury Limits
authors: Rajashri Chakrabarti, Daniel Garcia, Donald P. Morgan, Lee Seltzer
abstract: Many states have capped consumer loan interest rates to protect households from high-cost lenders. Using triple-difference and event study analysis, we investigate how these usury limits affect the availability and allocation of credit across households. Consistent with standard price theory, we find that credit to the riskiest borrowers contracts under usury limits without improving delinquencies. More surprisingly, credit to lower risk borrowers expands under usury limits. This reallocation suggests that usury limits have unintended effects that are not entirely explained by standard theory.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 对你少，对我多：高利贷限额下的信贷重新分配和配给
abstract_zh: 许多州已经限制了消费贷款利率，以保护家庭免受高成本贷款的影响。使用三重差异和事件研究分析，我们调查了这些高利贷限制如何影响家庭信贷的可用性和分配。与标准价格理论一致，我们发现，对风险最高的借款人的信贷在高利贷限额之下签订，却没有改善拖欠率。更令人惊讶的是，对低风险借款人的信贷在高利贷限额下扩大。这种重新分配表明，高利贷限制会产生意想不到的影响，而标准理论无法完全解释这种影响。

title: Navigating Geoeconomic Risk: Evidence from U.S. Mutual Funds
authors: Matteo Crosignani, Lina Han, Marco Macchiavelli
abstract: How do investors perceive and navigate the emerging geoeconomic risk? We identify firm-level geoeconomic risk using supply-chain links to Chinese firms targeted by U.S. export controls. Affected U.S. suppliers experience negative abnormal returns around policy announcements. These shocks propagate to mutual funds through portfolio holdings, raising volatility and lowering performance. Fund managers respond by reducing exposure to China-linked exporters, increasing portfolio concentration, and buying more lottery-like stocks. A long–short portfolio based on geoeconomic risk exposure earns positive and significant future returns, suggesting investors demand compensation for bearing the high geoeconomic risk.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 应对地缘经济风险：来自美国共同基金的证据
abstract_zh: 投资者如何看待和应对新兴的地缘经济风险？我们利用与美国出口管制目标中国企业的供应链联系来识别企业层面的地缘经济风险。受影响的美国供应商在政策公告前后经历负异常回报。这些冲击通过投资组合传播到共同基金，从而增加波动性并降低业绩。基金经理的应对措施是减少对中国相关出口商的投资，提高投资组合集中度，并购买更多彩票类股票。基于地缘经济风险敞口的多空投资组合可以获得积极且可观的未来回报，这表明投资者要求为承担高地缘经济风险而获得补偿。

title: Economics of Property Insurance
authors: Hyeyoon Jung, Jaehoon (Kyle) Jung
abstract: We study the economics of homeowners’ property insurance by examining how contract design balances the trade-off between incentive alignment and risk sharing. Using granular contract-level property insurance data merged with property-level disaster risk for millions of U.S. households, we develop and structurally estimate a model in which insurers optimally determine contract terms given property risk and household risk preferences. The estimates provide, to our knowledge, the first large-scale contract-level structural measures of risk aversion, risk premia, and the cost of moral hazard, allowing us to quantify how disaster risk is allocated between insurers and households. We find that the cost of moral hazard is small, yet the very mechanism used to mitigate it substantially increases households’ exposure to disaster risk: contract design leaves policyholders exposed to roughly 29 percent of total expected losses. This residual exposure is most pronounced for low-FICO households and for properties with the greatest tail risk. Counterfactuals indicate that mandating full insurance would lead to substantial market exit, increasing household vulnerability. We further show that insurers’ financial constraints are systematically correlated with the riskiness of underwritten properties and with household characteristics.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 财产保险经济学
abstract_zh: 我们通过研究合同设计如何平衡激励调整和风险分担之间的权衡来研究房主财产保险的经济学。利用详细的合同级财产保险数据与数百万美国家庭的财产级灾害风险相结合，我们开发并结构性地估计了一个模型，在该模型中，保险公司根据财产风险和家庭风险偏好来最佳地确定合同条款。据我们所知，这些估计提供了第一个大规模合同层面的风险规避、风险溢价和道德风险成本的结构性衡量标准，使我们能够量化灾害风险在保险公司和家庭之间的分配方式。我们发现，道德风险的成本很小，但用于减轻道德风险的机制却大大增加了家庭面临的灾害风险：合同设计使保单持有人面临约 29% 的预期总损失。对于低 FICO 家庭和尾部风险最大的房产，这种残余风险最为明显。反事实表明，强制实行全额保险将导致大量市场退出，增加家庭的脆弱性。我们进一步表明，保险公司的财务约束与承保财产的风险和家庭特征系统相关。

title: Liquidity and Trading Dynamics in the Off-the-Run U.S. Treasury Market
authors: Alain P. Chaboud, Michael J. Fleming, Ellen Correia Golay, Yesol Huh, Frank M. Keane, Or Shachar
abstract: In this article, we study trading activity and liquidity of off-the-run U.S. Treasury securities. Off-the-run Treasuries are seasoned securities, account for about 98 percent of all Treasuries outstanding, and played a central role in the pandemic-fueled dash-for-cash in March 2020. Understanding these securities better can improve thinking around how market resilience might be improved. We document and discuss the evolution of trading activity and liquidity for these securities and how these attributes differ from on-the-run securities. We also consider several potential market structure changes that could improve the liquidity of off-the-run Treasuries, including debt buybacks, expanded central clearing, and increased data transparency.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 现成美国国债市场的流动性和交易动态
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们研究了现成美国国债的交易活动和流动性。新发行的国债是经验丰富的证券，约占所有流通国债的 98%，并在 2020 年 3 月大流行引发的现金抢购中发挥了核心作用。更好地了解这些证券可以改善对如何提高市场弹性的思考。我们记录并讨论这些证券的交易活动和流动性的演变，以及这些属性与现有证券的不同之处。我们还考虑了一些可能改善现成国债流动性的潜在市场结构变化，包括债务回购、扩大中央清算和提高数据透明度。

title: Cognitive Health, Household Financial Decision-Making, and Intrahousehold Financial Spillovers
authors: Carole Roan Gresenz, Jean M Mitchell, R. Scott Turner, Wilbert Van der Klaauw, Crystal Wang
abstract: We study the spillover effects of cognitive decline in one member of a coupled household on the financial outcomes of their partner and assess how “own” and spillover effects are moderated by the structure of household financial decision-making. We use a large, nationally representative longitudinal data set spanning 2000-2017 that includes credit report data merged at the individual level with Medicare claims and enrollment data. We find the own adverse financial consequences of cognitive decline depend on household financial integration and other characteristics associated with household financial management, and find significant, albeit smaller (vs own), adverse financial spillover effects on partners.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 认知健康、家庭财务决策和家庭内部金融溢出
abstract_zh: 我们研究了夫妻家庭中一名成员认知能力下降对其伴侣财务结果的溢出效应，并评估了家庭财务决策结构如何调节“自身”效应和溢出效应。我们使用跨越 2000 年至 2017 年的大型、具有全国代表性的纵向数据集，其中包括在个人层面与医疗保险索赔和登记数据合并的信用报告数据。我们发现认知能力下降对自身的不利财务后果取决于家庭财务一体化以及与家庭财务管理相关的其他特征，并发现对伴侣的不利财务溢出效应虽然较小，但很显着。

title: Supervising Failing Banks
authors: Sergio A. Correia, Stephan Luck, Emil Verner
abstract: We examine the role of banking supervision in identifying and disciplining failing banks. We show that bank failures typically result from supervisory closure decisions based on hard information about book equity. Yet hard information is itself partly produced by supervision, as supervisors require troubled banks to recognize potential losses. To establish causality, we exploit exogenous variation in supervisory strictness during the Global Financial Crisis. Stricter supervision leads to more loss recognition, lower book equity, and a higher likelihood and speed of closure. It also reduces FDIC resolution costs at failure but can contract credit, consistent with a trade-off between supervisory strictness and forbearance.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 监管失败的银行
abstract_zh: 我们研究了银行监管在识别和惩戒失败银行方面的作用。我们表明，银行倒闭通常是由于基于账面净值的硬信息而做出的监管关闭决定造成的。然而，硬信息本身部分是由监管产生的，因为监管者要求陷入困境的银行认识到潜在的损失。为了建立因果关系，我们利用了全球金融危机期间监管严格程度的外生变化。更严格的监管会导致更多的损失确认、更低的账面净值以及更高的可能性和速度。它还可以降低 FDIC 失败时的解决成本，但可以收缩信贷，这与严格监管和宽容之间的权衡是一致的。

title: Understanding Consumer Demand for “Buy Now, Pay Later”
authors: Felix Aidala, Gizem Koşar, Daniel Mangrum, Wilbert Van der Klaauw
abstract: We estimate consumer preferences for “Buy Now, Pay Later” (BNPL) using a large-scale probabilistic stated choice survey experiment. Average willingness to pay (WTP) for the standard BNPL bundle is negative, but younger, lower-income, and less credit-worthy consumers exhibit higher demand. The share with positive estimated WTP closely matches actual BNPL take-up. Consumers strongly dislike interest charges and hard credit checks. Counterfactual simulations show that incorporating these features into the standard bundle lowers demand and worsens adverse selection toward riskier borrowers. These findings have implications for the sustainability of the BNPL market, consumer credit supply, and quality of securitized BNPL receivables.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 了解消费者“先买后付”的需求
abstract_zh: 我们使用大规模概率陈述选择调查实验来估计消费者对“立即购买，稍后付款”(BNPL) 的偏好。标准 BNPL 捆绑包的平均支付意愿 (WTP) 为负，但年轻、低收入和信用较差的消费者表现出更高的需求。预期支付意愿为正值的比例与 BNPL 的实际使用量非常接近。消费者非常不喜欢收取利息和严格的信用检查。反事实模拟表明，将这些功能纳入标准捆绑包会降低需求，并加剧对风险较高借款人的逆向选择。这些发现对 BNPL 市场的可持续性、消费者信贷供应以及证券化 BNPL 应收账款的质量具有影响。

title: Transformative and Subsistence Entrepreneurs: Origins and Impacts on Economic Growth
authors: Ufuk Akcigit, Harun Alp, Jeremy Pearce, Marta Prato
abstract: This paper studies how individuals sort into entrepreneurship and invention-related occupations and how their interactions shape innovation and economic growth. We develop an endogenous growth model in which occupational sorting jointly determines the supply of R&D talent and entrepreneurs’ demand for it. Empirically, using Danish microdata, we show that transformative entrepreneurs—those who hire R&D workers—tend to have higher IQ and education and build faster-growing firms than other entrepreneurs. Quantitatively, the estimated model indicates that financial barriers to education misallocate talent; alleviating them through education subsidies increases both demand and supply of R&D workers, raising innovation and long-run growth. Broad startup subsidies are ineffective.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 变革型企业家和自给型企业家：起源及其对经济增长的影响
abstract_zh: 本文研究个人如何分类创业和发明相关职业以及他们的相互作用如何影响创新和经济增长。我们开发了一种内生增长模型，职业排序共同决定研发人才的供给和企业家对其的需求。根据经验，利用丹麦的微观数据，我们表明，变革型企业家（那些雇用研发人员的企业家）往往比其他企业家拥有更高的智商和教育水平，并且建立的公司发展速度更快。从数量上看，估计模型表明，教育方面的财务障碍导致了人才的错误配置；通过教育补贴缓解这些问题可以增加研发人员的需求和供给，从而促进创新和长期增长。广泛的启动补贴是无效的。

title: How Retrainable Are AI-Exposed Workers?
authors: Benjamin Lahey, Benjamin Hyman, Karen Ni, Laura Pilossoph
abstract: We document the extent to which workers in AI-exposed occupations can successfully retrain for AI-intensive work. We assemble a new workforce development dataset spanning over 1.6 million job training participation spells from all U.S. Workforce Investment and Opportunity Act programs from 2012-2023 linked with occupational measures of AI exposure. Using earnings records observed before and after training, we compare high AI exposure trainees to a matched sample of similar workers who only received job search assistance. We find that AI-exposed workers have high earnings returns from training that are only 25 percent lower than the returns for low AI exposure workers. However, training participants who target AI-intensive occupations face a penalty for doing so, with 29 percent lower returns than AI-exposed workers pursuing more general training. We estimate that between 25 percent to 40 percent of occupations are “AI retrainable” as measured by its workers receiving higher pay for moving to more AI-intensive occupations—a large magnitude given the relatively low-income sample of displaced workers. Positive earnings returns in all groups are driven by the most recent years when labor markets were tightest, suggesting training programs may have stronger signal value when firms reach deeper into the skill market.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 接触人工智能的工人的再培训程度如何？
abstract_zh: 我们记录了从事人工智能职业的工人可以在多大程度上成功地接受人工智能密集型工作的再培训。我们收集了一个新的劳动力发展数据集，涵盖 2012 年至 2023 年所有美国劳动力投资和机会法案计划中超过 160 万个工作培训参与期，并与人工智能暴露的职业测量相关。利用培训前后观察到的收入记录，我们将高人工智能暴露程度的受训者与仅接受求职帮助的类似工人的匹配样本进行比较。我们发现，接触人工智能的员工从培训中获得的收入回报很高，仅比接触人工智能较少的员工的回报低 25%。然而，针对人工智能密集型职业的培训参与者会因此面临惩罚，其回报比接受更一般培训的人工智能员工低 29%。我们估计，25% 到 40% 的职业是“人工智能可再培训的”，以工人因转向人工智能密集型职业而获得更高工资来衡量——考虑到失业工人收入样本相对较低，这一数字很大。所有群体的正收益回报都是由最近几年劳动力市场最紧张的情况推动的，这表明当企业更深入地进入技能市场时，培训计划可能具有更强的信号价值。

title: How Do Supply Shocks to Inflation Generalize? Evidence From the Pandemic Era in Europe
authors: Viral V. Acharya, Matteo Crosignani, Tim Eisert, Christian Eufinger
abstract: We document how the interaction of supply chain pressures, elevated household inflation expectations, and firm pricing power contributed to the pandemic-era surge in consumer price inflation in the euro area. Initially, supply chain disruptions raised inflation, particularly in manufacturing, through a cost-push channel, while also elevating inflation expectations. In turn, higher inflation expectations appear to have lowered the price elasticity of consumer demand and strengthened firms’ pricing power, enabling even firms in service sectors that were initially unaffected by supply constraints to raise markups. Through this expectations mechanism, localized inflation in sectors sensitive to supply-side shocks generalized into broad-based inflation.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 供给冲击对通胀的影响如何普遍化？欧洲大流行时代的证据
abstract_zh: 我们记录了供应链压力、家庭通胀预期上升和企业定价能力的相互作用如何导致了疫情期间欧元区消费者价格通胀的飙升。最初，供应链中断通过成本推动渠道加剧了通胀，尤其是制造业的通胀，同时也提高了通胀预期。反过来，更高的通胀预期似乎降低了消费者需求的价格弹性，增强了企业的定价能力，甚至使最初不受供应限制影响的服务业企业也能提高加价。通过这种预期机制，对供给侧冲击敏感的部门的局部通胀会普遍化为广泛的通胀。

title: A Practitioner’s Note on the Shapley-Owen-Shorrocks Decomposition
authors: Richard Audoly, Rory McGee, Sergio Ocampo, Gonzalo Paz-Pardo
abstract: Decomposing empirical or economic phenomena into the contributions of different inputs is a frequent goal of economic analysis. However, in many settings, the quantity of interest depends on many inputs which are aggregated non-linearly. In these settings, decompositions need not sum to one and often depend on the order in which inputs are “zeroed out.” In this note we describe a simple but convenient alternative. We show that using the Shapley-Owen value, extended to inequality decompositions in Shorrocks (1999, 2013), provides an additive decomposition that sums to one and is easily interpretable in terms of the contribution of different inputs (or groups of them) to some aggregate outcome. We provide several examples to help implement the approach. We believe this is exceptionally well-suited to decompositions in rich-structural models of economic phenomena which are typically non-linear.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 关于 Shapley-Owen-Shorrocks 分解的实践者注释
abstract_zh: 将经验或经济现象分解为不同投入的贡献是经济分析的常见目标。然而，在许多情况下，感兴趣的数量取决于许多非线性汇总的输入。在这些设置中，分解不需要总和为 1，并且通常取决于输入“清零”的顺序。在这篇文章中，我们描述了一个简单但方便的替代方案。我们证明，使用 Shapley-Owen 值，扩展到 Shorrocks（1999，2013）中的不平等分解，提供了一种加法分解，其总和为 1，并且很容易根据不同输入（或一组输入）对某些总体结果的贡献来解释。我们提供了几个示例来帮助实施该方法。我们认为，这非常适合对通常是非线性的经济现象的丰富结构模型进行分解。

title: Nonlinear Micro Income Processes with Macro Shocks
authors: Manuel Arellano, Richard Blundell, Stéphane Bonhomme, Martín Almuzara
abstract: We propose a nonlinear framework to study the dynamic transmission of aggregate and idiosyncratic shocks to household income that exploits both macro and micro data. Our approach allows us to examine empirically the following questions: (a) How do business-cycle fluctuations modulate the persistence of heterogeneous individual histories and the risk faced by households? (b) How do aggregate and idiosyncratic shocks propagate over time for households in different macro and micro states? (c) How do these shocks shape the cost of business-cycle risk? We develop new identification and estimation techniques and provide a detailed empirical analysis combining macro time series for the U.S. and a time series of household panels from the PSID.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 宏观冲击下的非线性微观收入过程
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个非线性框架，利用宏观和微观数据来研究总体和特殊冲击对家庭收入的动态传递。我们的方法使我们能够根据经验检验以下问题：（a）商业周期波动如何调节异质个人历史的持续性和家庭面临的风险？ (b) 总体冲击和特殊冲击如何随着时间的推移对不同宏观和微观状态的家庭传播？ (c) 这些冲击如何影响商业周期风险的成本？我们开发新的识别和估计技术，并结合美国宏观时间序列和 PSID 家庭面板时间序列提供详细的实证分析。

title: Understanding the Pricing of Carbon Emissions: New Evidence from the Stock Market
authors: Matteo Crosignani, Emilio Osambela, Matthew Pritsker
abstract: Are carbon emissions priced in equity markets? The literature is split with different approaches yielding conflicting results. We develop a stylized model showing that, if emissions are priced, stock returns depend on expected emissions and the product of the innovation in emissions and the price-dividend ratio. Building on this insight, we derive and test new predictions. We find that emissions are priced in equity markets, but the magnitude of such pricing is highly sensitive to the inclusion of a few “super emitters” (mostly operating in electric power generation). Our theoretical insight also helps reconcile seemingly divergent results in the literature.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 了解碳排放定价：来自股票市场的新证据
abstract_zh: 碳排放量是否已在股票市场定价？文献中有不同的方法，产生了相互矛盾的结果。我们开发了一个程式化模型，表明如果排放量被定价，股票回报取决于预期排放量以及排放量创新和价格股息率的乘积。基于这一见解，我们得出并测试新的预测。我们发现，排放量在股票市场上定价，但这种定价的幅度对少数“超级排放者”（主要从事发电业务）的纳入高度敏感。我们的理论洞察力还有助于协调文献中看似不同的结果。

title: Can Redemption Fees Prevent Runs on Funds?
authors: Xuesong Huang, Todd Keister
abstract: We ask whether imposing fees on redeeming investors can prevent runs on money market mutual funds (MMFs) and related intermediation arrangements. We first show that imposing a fee only in extraordinary times often leaves the fund susceptible to a preemptive run where investors rush to redeem before the fee applies. We then show how a policy that imposes a fee when current redemption demand is above a threshold, even in normal times, can make the fund run proof. We characterize the best policy of this type, which is immune to a run of any size. We show that the reform adopted in the U.S. in 2023 leaves funds vulnerable to runs in some market conditions and imposes an inefficiently large fee in others.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 赎回费用可以防止资金挤兑吗？
abstract_zh: 我们询问向赎回投资者收取费用是否可以防止货币市场共同基金（MMF）和相关中介安排的挤兑。我们首先表明，仅在非常时期收取费用通常会使基金容易受到先发制人的影响，投资者会在收取费用之前急于赎回。然后，我们展示了即使在正常情况下，当当前赎回需求高于阈值时收取费用的政策如何可以使基金运行良好。我们描述了这种类型的最佳策略，它不受任何规模的运行影响。我们表明，美国 2023 年采取的改革使基金在某些市场条件下容易受到挤兑，而在其他市场条件下则征收低效的高额费用。

title: Market Concentration and Aggregate Productivity: The Role of Demand
authors: Jeremy Pearce, Liangjie Wu
abstract: This paper studies the relationship between market concentration and aggregate productivity when firm-level demand emerges from past marketing investments. Granular firms may invest in demand both to complement their productivity and to amplify market power—this second force can create persistent mismatch between customer capital and productivity. The importance of this mismatch depends on the relative persistence of productivity and demand. Empirically, we find that demand is more persistent than productivity, implying a sizable role for mismatch. This leads to sluggish demand-side adjustment in the face of productivity shocks in the quantified model. Policies targeting static markup distortions—such as production subsidies—can exacerbate excessive marketing and thus are subject to a tradeoff between static gains and dynamic losses.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 市场集中度和总生产率：需求的作用
abstract_zh: 本文研究了当企业层面的需求从过去的营销投资中产生时，市场集中度与总生产率之间的关系。颗粒公司可能会根据需求进行投资，以补充其生产力并扩大市场力量——这第二种力量可能会造成客户资本与生产力之间持续的不匹配。这种不匹配的重要性取决于生产力和需求的相对持续性。根据经验，我们发现需求比生产力更持久，这意味着不匹配的作用相当大。这导致量化模型中面对生产率冲击时需求侧调整缓慢。针对静态加价扭曲的政策（例如生产补贴）可能会加剧过度营销，因此需要在静态收益和动态损失之间进行权衡。

title: A Danger to Self and Others: Health and Criminal Consequences of Involuntary Hospitalization
authors: Valentin Bolotnyy, Natalia Emanuel, Pim Welle
abstract: Involuntary hospitalization of people experiencing a mental health crisis is a widespread practice, 2.4 times as common as death from cancer and as common in the U.S. as incarceration in state and federal prisons. The intent of involuntary hospitalization is to prevent individuals from harming themselves or others through incapacitation, stabilization and medical treatment over a short period of time. Does involuntary hospitalization achieve its goals? We leverage quasi-random assignment of the evaluating physician and administrative data from Allegheny County, Pennsylvania, to estimate the causal effects of involuntary hospitalization on harm to self (proxied by death by suicide or overdose) and harm to others (proxied by violent crime charges). For individuals whose cases are judgment calls, where some physicians would hospitalize but others would not, we find that hospitalization nearly doubles both the probability of dying by suicide or overdose and also nearly doubles the probability of being charged with a violent crime in the three months after evaluation. We provide evidence of earnings and housing disruptions as potential mechanisms. Our results suggest that, on the margin, the system we study is not achieving the intended effects of the policy.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 对自己和他人的危险：非自愿住院的健康和犯罪后果
abstract_zh: 经历精神健康危机的人非自愿住院是一种普遍的做法，其发生率是癌症死亡的 2.4 倍，在美国与州和联邦监狱的监禁率相同。非自愿住院治疗的目的是防止个人在短时间内通过失能、稳定和医疗治疗伤害自己或他人。非自愿住院是否达到了目标？我们利用评估医生的准随机分配和宾夕法尼亚州阿勒格尼县的行政数据来估计非自愿住院对自我伤害（以自杀或服药过量死亡为代表）和对他人伤害（以暴力犯罪指控为代表）的因果影响。对于那些需要判断的病例，一些医生会住院，而另一些医生则不会，我们发现，在评估后的三个月内，住院使自杀或服药过量死亡的可能性几乎增加了一倍，而且被指控暴力犯罪的可能性也几乎增加了一倍。我们提供收入和住房中断作为潜在机制的证据。我们的结果表明，我们研究的系统在一定程度上没有达到政策的预期效果。

title: Management and Firm Dynamism
authors: Nicholas Bloom, Jonathan S. Hartley, Raffaella Sadun, Rachel Schuh, John Van Reenen
abstract: We show better-managed firms are more dynamic in plant acquisitions, disposals, openings, and closings in U.S. Census and international data. Better-managed firms also birth better-managed plants and improve the performance of the plants they acquire. To explain these findings, we build a model with two key elements. First, management is a combination of firm-level management ability (e.g. CEO quality), which can be transferred to all plants, and plant-level management practices, which can be changed through intangible investment (e.g. consulting or training). Second, management both raises productivity and also reduces the operational costs of dynamism: buying, selling, opening, and closing plants. We structurally estimate the model on Census microdata, fitting our key dynamic moments, and then use it to establish three additional results. First, mergers and acquisitions raise economy-wide management and productivity by reallocating plants to firms with higher management ability. Banning M&A would depress GDP and management by about 15 percent. Second, greater product market competition improves both management and productivity by reallocating away from badly managed plants. Finally, management practices account for about a fifth of the cross-country productivity differences with the U.S.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 管理与企业活力
abstract_zh: 我们根据美国人口普查和国际数据显示，管理较好的公司在工厂收购、处置、开设和关闭方面更具活力。管理更好的公司也会诞生管理更好的工厂，并提高其收购的工厂的绩效。为了解释这些发现，我们构建了一个包含两个关键要素的模型。首先，管理是企业层面的管理能力（例如CEO素质）和工厂层面的管理实践的结合，前者可以转移到所有工厂，后者可以通过无形投资（例如咨询或培训）来改变。其次，管理既提高了生产力，又降低了活力的运营成本：购买、销售、开设和关闭工厂。我们在人口普查微观数据上结构性地估计模型，拟合我们的关键动态时刻，然后用它来建立三个额外的结果。首先，并购通过将工厂重新分配给管理能力较高的企业来提高整个经济的管理水平和生产率。禁止并购将使 GDP 和管理水平下降约 15%。其次，更激烈的产品市场竞争通过重新配置管理不善的工厂来提高管理和生产力。最后，管理实践约占跨国生产力与美国差异的五分之一。

title: Losses from Natural Disasters: County-Level Data on Damages, Injuries, and Fatalities
authors: Matteo Crosignani, Martin Hiti
abstract: We introduce the first comprehensive publicly available dataset on county-level damages, injuries, and fatalities from natural disasters in the U.S. and present a few facts on the economic and human costs of extreme climate events. Our source is the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration’s Storm Events Database, which reports losses for geographic areas largely defined based on meteorological science. We map these areas to counties using geographic tools together with the spatial distribution of population, housing stock, and economic activity. Our estimates are particularly accurate for severe disasters. The Losses from Natural Disasters dataset is regularly updated at https://newyorkfed.org/research/policy/natural-disaster-losses.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 自然灾害造成的损失：县级损失、受伤和死亡数据
abstract_zh: 我们介绍了第一个关于美国县级自然灾害造成的损失、伤害和死亡的全面公开数据集，并介绍了有关极端气候事件的经济和人员成本的一些事实。我们的来源是国家海洋和大气管理局的风暴事件数据库，该数据库报告了主要根据气象科学定义的地理区域的损失。我们使用地理工具以及人口、住房存量和经济活动的空间分布将这些区域映射到县。我们的估计对于严重灾害尤其准确。自然灾害损失数据集定期更新于 https://newyorkfed.org/research/policy/natural-disaster-losses。

title: The Theory of Financial Stability Meets Reality
authors: Nina Boyarchenko, Kinda Hachem, Anya V. Kleymenova
abstract: A large literature at the intersection of economics and finance offers prescriptions for regulating banks to increase financial stability. This literature abstracts from the discretion that accounting standards give banks over financial reporting, creating a gap between the information assumed to be available to regulators in models of optimal regulation and the information available to regulators in reality. We bridge insights from the economics, finance, and accounting literatures to synthesize knowledge about the design and implementation of bank regulation and identify areas where more work is needed. We present a simple framework for organizing the relevant ideas, namely the externalities that motivate bank regulation, the rationales for allowing accounting discretion, and the use of discretion to circumvent regulation. Our takeaway from reviewing work in these areas is that academic studies of bank regulation and accounting discretion require a more unified approach to design optimal policy for the real world.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 金融稳定理论与现实的结合
abstract_zh: 经济学和金融交叉领域的大量文献为监管银行以提高金融稳定性提供了处方。该文献抽象了会计准则赋予银行财务报告的自由裁量权，从而在最优监管模型中假定监管机构可获得的信息与监管机构实际可获得的信息之间造成了差距。我们将经济学、金融学和会计文献的见解结合起来，综合有关银行监管设计和实施的知识，并确定需要开展更多工作的领域。我们提出了一个简单的框架来组织相关想法，即激发银行监管的外部性、允许会计自由裁量权的理由以及利用自由裁量权规避监管。我们回顾这些领域的工作得出的结论是，银行监管和会计自由裁量权的学术研究需要更统一的方法来为现实世界设计最佳政策。

title: Expectations and Information Frictions Within Couples: Evidence from a Sequential Survey of Spouses
authors: Adeline Delavande, Gizem Koşar, Basit Zafar
abstract: This paper combines descriptive and experimental evidence to examine how expectations align and information flows within couples. Using an online survey of 2,200 middle-aged U.S. married couples, we focus on expectations about Social Security benefits. We first document substantial misalignment: the correlation between spouses’ expectations about a given partner’s benefits is 0.70, below full agreement, and varies systematically with couple characteristics, reaching as low as 0.45 for couples with belowmedian earnings. To identify causal information spillovers, we implement a randomized information experiment paired with a sequential survey design in which one spouse receives targeted information and the other is surveyed later. Information provided to one spouse partially spills over to the other, with the effect on the untreated spouse about half that on the treated one. Spillovers are larger when communication barriers are low and the information is more valuable. Finally, the information treatment improves conditions for more efficient intra-household decision-making.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 夫妻之间的期望和信息摩擦：来自配偶序贯调查的证据
abstract_zh: 本文结合描述性和实验证据来研究夫妻之间的期望如何协调和信息如何流动。我们对 2,200 名美国中年已婚夫妇进行了在线调查，重点关注对社会保障福利的期望。我们首先记录了严重的偏差：配偶对特定伴侣福利的期望之间的相关性为 0.70，低于完全一致，并且随着夫妇特征的不同而系统性地变化，对于收入低于中位数的夫妇来说，相关性低至 0.45。为了识别因果信息溢出，我们实施了一项随机信息实验，并结合序贯调查设计，其中一方收到有针对性的信息，另一方随后接受调查。提供给一方配偶的信息会部分传播给另一方，对未接受治疗的配偶的影响约为接受治疗的配偶的一半。当沟通障碍较低并且信息更有价值时，溢出效应就更大。最后，信息处理改善了更有效的家庭内部决策的条件。

title: The Price of Processing: Information Frictions and Market Efficiency in DeFi
authors: Pablo D. Azar, Sergio Olivas, Nish Sinha
abstract: This paper investigates the speed of price discovery when information becomes publicly available but requires costly processing to become common knowledge. We exploit the unique institutional setting of hacks on decentralized finance (DeFi) protocols. Public blockchain data provides the precise time a hack’s transactions are recorded—becoming public information—while subsequent social media disclosures mark the transition to common knowledge. This empirical design allows us to isolate the price impact occurring during the interval characterized by information asymmetry driven purely by differential processing capabilities. Our central empirical finding is that substantial price discovery precedes common knowledge: approximately 36 percent of the total 24-hour price decline (∼27 percent) materializes before the public announcement. This evidence suggests sophisticated traders rapidly exploit their ability to process complex, publicly available on-chain data, capturing informational rents. We develop a theoretical model of informed trading under processing costs which predicts strategic, slow information revelation, consistent with our empirical findings. Our results quantify the limits imposed by information processing costs on market efficiency, demonstrating that transparency alone does not guarantee immediate information incorporation into prices.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 处理的代价：DeFi 中的信息摩擦和市场效率
abstract_zh: 本文研究了当信息公开但需要昂贵的处理才能成为常识时价格发现的速度。我们利用了去中心化金融（DeFi）协议黑客的独特制度设置。公共区块链数据提供了黑客交易记录的精确时间（成为公共信息），而随后的社交媒体披露则标志着向常识的转变。这种经验设计使我们能够隔离在纯粹由差异化处理能力驱动的信息不对称特征区间内发生的价格影响。我们的核心实证发现是，实质性价格发现先于常识：大约 36% 的 24 小时总价格下跌（约 27%）是在公开宣布之前实现的。这一证据表明，经验丰富的交易者迅速利用他们处理复杂的、公开的链上数据的能力，捕获信息租金。我们开发了一个处理成本下知情交易的理论模型，该模型预测战略性的、缓慢的信息披露，与我们的实证结果一致。我们的结果量化了信息处理成本对市场效率的限制，表明仅靠透明度并不能保证信息立即纳入价格。

title: Component-Based Dynamic Factor Nowcast Model
authors: Hannah O’Keeffe, Katerina Petrova
abstract: In this paper, we propose a component-based dynamic factor model for nowcasting GDP growth. We combine ideas from “bottom-up” approaches, which utilize the national income accounting identity through modelling and predicting sub-components of GDP, with a dynamic factor (DF) model, which is suitable for dimension reduction as well as parsimonious real-time monitoring of the economy. The advantages of the new model are twofold: (i) in contrast to existing dynamic factor models, it respects the GDP accounting identity; (ii) in contrast to existing “bottom-up” approaches, it models all GDP components jointly through the dynamic factor model, inheriting its main advantages. An additional advantage of the resulting CBDF approach is that it generates nowcast densities and impact decompositions for each component of GDP as a by-product. We present a comprehensive forecasting exercise, where we evaluate the model’s performance in terms of point and density forecasts, and we compare it to existing models (e.g. the model of Almuzara, Baker, O’Keeffe, and Sbordone (2023)) currently used by the New York Fed, as well as the model of Higgins (2014) currently used by the Atlanta Fed. We demonstrate that, on average, the point nowcast performance (in terms of RMSE) of the standard DF model can be improved by 15 percent and its density nowcast performance (in terms of log-predictive scores) can be improved by 20 percent over a large historical sample.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 基于组件的动态因子临近预报模型
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种基于组件的动态因子模型来预测 GDP 增长。我们将“自下而上”方法的思想与动态因子（DF）模型相结合，该方法通过建模和预测 GDP 的子组成部分来利用国民收入核算恒等式，该模型适用于降维以及对经济的简约实时监控。新模型的优点有两个：（i）与现有的动态因子模型相比，它尊重GDP核算恒等式； (ii)与现有的“自下而上”方法相比，它通过动态因子模型对所有GDP组成部分进行联合建模，继承了其主要优点。由此产生的 CBDF 方法的另一个优点是，它可以作为副产品生成临近预报密度和 GDP 每个组成部分的影响分解。我们提出了一项全面的预测练习，评估模型在点和密度预测方面的表现，并将其与纽约联储目前使用的现有模型（例如 Almuzara、Baker、O’Keeffe 和 Sbordone (2023) 的模型）以及亚特兰大联储目前使用的 Higgins (2014) 模型进行比较。我们证明，与大型历史样本相比，标准 DF 模型的点即时预报性能（以 RMSE 计）平均可以提高 15%，其密度即时预报性能（以对数预测分数计）可以提高 20%。

title: Uniform Inference with General Autoregressive Processes
authors: Tassos Magdalinos, Katerina Petrova
abstract: A unified theory of estimation and inference is developed for an autoregressive process with root in (-∞, ∞) that includes the stationary, local-to-unity, explosive and all intermediate regions. The discontinuity of the limit distribution of the t-statistic outside the stationary region and its dependence on the distribution of the innovations in the explosive regions (-∞, -1) ∪ (1, ∞) are addressed simultaneously. A novel estimation procedure, based on a data-driven combination of a near-stationary and a mildly explosive artificially constructed instrument, delivers mixed-Gaussian limit theory and gives rise to an asymptotically standard normal t-statistic across all autoregressive regions. The resulting hypothesis tests and confidence intervals are shown to have correct asymptotic size (uniformly over the space of autoregressive parameters and the space of innovation distribution functions) in autoregressive, predictive regression and local projection models, thereby establishing a general and unified framework for inference with autoregressive processes. Extensive Monte Carlo simulation shows that the proposed methodology exhibits very good finite sample properties over the entire autoregressive parameter space (-∞, ∞) and compares favorably to existing methods within their parametric (-1, 1] validity range. We demonstrate how our procedure can be used to construct valid confidence intervals in standard epidemiological models as well as to test in real-time for speculative bubbles in the price of the Magnificent Seven tech stocks.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 通用自回归过程的统一推理
abstract_zh: 为根部为 (-∞, ∞) 的自回归过程开发了统一的估计和推理理论，其中包括静止区域、局部统一区域、爆炸区域和所有中间区域。同时解决了静止区域外 t 统计量极限分布的不连续性及其对爆炸区域 (-∞, -1) ∪ (1, ∞) 中创新分布的依赖性。一种新颖的估计程序，基于近乎平稳和轻度爆炸的人工构造仪器的数据驱动组合，提供混合高斯极限理论，并在所有自回归区域产生渐近标准正态 t 统计量。由此产生的假设检验和置信区间在自回归、预测回归和局部投影模型中显示出正确的渐近大小（在自回归参数空间和创新分布函数空间上一致），从而建立了一个通用且统一的自回归过程推理框架。广泛的蒙特卡罗模拟表明，所提出的方法在整个自回归参数空间（-∞，∞）上表现出非常好的有限样本属性，并且与参数（-1, 1]有效范围内的现有方法相比具有优势。我们演示了如何使用我们的程序在标准流行病学模型中构建有效的置信区间，以及如何实时测试七大科技股价格中的投机泡沫。

title: How Do We Learn About the Long Run?
authors: Richard K. Crump, Stefano Eusepi, Emanuel Moench, Bruce Preston
abstract: Using a novel and unique panel dataset of individual-level professional forecasts at short, medium, and very-long horizons, we provide new stylized facts about survey forecasts. We present direct evidence that forecasters use multivariate models in an environment with imperfect information about the current state, leading to heterogenous non-stationary expectations about the long run. We show forecast revisions are consistent with the predictions of a multivariate unobserved trend and cycle model. Our results suggest models of expectations formation which are either univariate, stationary, or both, are inherently misspecified and that macroeconomic modelling should reconsider the conventional assumption that agents operate in a well-understood stationary environment.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 我们如何了解长期？
abstract_zh: 我们使用新颖且独特的短期、中期和超长期个人水平专业预测面板数据集，提供有关调查预测的新的程式化事实。我们提出的直接证据表明，预测者在当前状态信息不完善的环境中使用多元模型，导致对长期的异质非平稳预期。我们表明预测修正与多元未观察趋势和周期模型的预测一致。我们的结果表明，单变量、静态或两者兼而有之的预期形成模型本质上是错误指定的，宏观经济模型应该重新考虑代理人在充分理解的静态环境中运作的传统假设。

title: The Risk Sensitivity of Global Liquidity Flows: Heterogeneity, Evolution, and Drivers
authors: Stefan Avdjiev, Leonardo Gambacorta, Linda S. Goldberg, Stefano Schiaffi
abstract: The period after the Global Financial Crisis (GFC) was characterized by a considerable risk migration within global liquidity flows, away from cross-border bank lending towards international bond issuance. We show that the post-GFC shifts in the risk sensitivities of global liquidity flows are related to the tightness of the balance sheet (capital and leverage) constraints faced by international (bank and nonbank) lenders and to the migration of borrowers across funding sources. We document that the risk sensitivity of global liquidity flows is higher when funding is provided by financial intermediaries that are facing greater balance sheet constraints. We also provide evidence that the post-GFC migration of borrowers from cross-border loans to international debt securities was associated with a decline in the risk sensitivity of global liquidity flows to EME borrowers.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 全球流动性流动的风险敏感性：异质性、演变和驱动因素
abstract_zh: 全球金融危机（GFC）后时期的特点是，全球流动性流动中的风险相当大，从跨境银行贷款转向国际债券发行。我们表明，全球金融危机后全球流动性流动风险敏感性的变化与国际（银行和非银行）贷款人面临的资产负债表（资本和杠杆）约束的紧张性以及借款人跨融资来源的迁移有关。我们发现，当资金由面临更大资产负债表约束的金融中介机构提供时，全球流动性流动的风险敏感性更高。我们还提供证据表明，全球金融危机后借款人从跨境贷款转向国际债务证券与全球流动性流向新兴市场借款人的风险敏感性下降有关。

title: Subjective Uncertainty and the Marginal Propensity to Consume
authors: Gizem Koşar, Davide Melcangi
abstract: Earnings uncertainty is central to most heterogeneous-household models. Yet, there is little evidence on how subjective uncertainty, the uncertainty individuals actually perceive, is related to consumption behavior. Using unique data from the Survey of Consumer Expectations, we show that the marginal propensity to consume (MPC) is increasing and concave in individual–specific earnings growth uncertainty. In the workhorse consumption–savings model, augmented with risk heterogeneity, MPCs decline with earnings uncertainty, contrary to the empirical evidence. We pinpoint which mechanisms, central to the model, create this disconnect. Embedding empirically disciplined biased beliefs in the canonical model reconciles the theory with the empirical findings.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 主观不确定性与边际消费倾向
abstract_zh: 收益不确定性是大多数异质家庭模型的核心。然而，几乎没有证据表明主观不确定性（个人实际感知的不确定性）与消费行为有何关系。利用消费者预期调查的独特数据，我们表明边际消费倾向 (MPC) 正在增加，并且在个人特定收入增长不确定性中呈凹形。在主力消费储蓄模型中，随着风险异质性的增强，货币政策预测随着收益不确定性而下降，这与经验证据相反。我们查明模型的核心机制是哪些机制造成了这种脱节。将经验纪律的偏见信念嵌入规范模型中可以使理论与实证结果相一致。

title: Tradeoffs for the Poor, Divine Coincidence for the Rich
authors: Marco Del Negro, Ibrahima Diagne, Keshav Dogra, Pranay Gundam, Donggyu Lee, Brian Pacula
abstract: We use an estimated medium-scale HANK model to investigate how the tradeoff between stabilizing inflation and consumption volatility varies for households with different levels of wealth. Consumption for the rich is mostly affected by demand shocks via their exposure to highly procyclical profits—for them, stabilizing consumption and inflation coincide. The poor are more vulnerable to supply shocks, hence aggressively stabilizing inflation is costly in terms of their consumption volatility. While they dislike inflation because it erodes real wages, they are hurt even more by an aggressive monetary policy response to inflation, which reduces real wages further while increasing unemployment.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 穷人的权衡，富人的神圣巧合
abstract_zh: 我们使用估计的中等规模 HANK 模型来研究不同财富水平的家庭在稳定通胀和消费波动之间的权衡如何变化。富人的消费主要通过获得高度顺周期的利润而受到需求冲击的影响——对他们来说，稳定消费和通胀是一致的。穷人更容易受到供应冲击的影响，因此，就其消费波动而言，积极稳定通胀的代价高昂。虽然他们不喜欢通货膨胀，因为它会侵蚀实际工资，但针对通货膨胀采取激进的货币政策对他们的伤害更大，这种政策进一步降低了实际工资，同时增加了失业率。

title: U.S. Treasury Market Functioning from the GFC to the Pandemic
authors: Tobias Adrian, Michael J. Fleming, Kleopatra Nikolaou
abstract: This article examines U.S. Treasury securities market functioning from the global financial crisis (GFC) through the Covid-19 pandemic given the ensuing market developments and associated policy responses. We describe the factors that have affected intermediaries, including regulatory changes, shifts in ownership patterns, and increased electronic trading. We also discuss their implications for market functioning in both normal times and times of stress. We find that alternative liquidity providers have stepped in as constraints on dealer liquidity provision have tightened, supporting liquidity during normal times, but with less clear effects at times of stress. We conclude with a brief discussion of more recent policy initiatives that are intended to promote market resilience.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 美国国债市场从全球金融危机到新冠疫情的运作
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了美国国债市场从全球金融危机 (GFC) 到 Covid-19 大流行期间的运作情况，并考虑到随后的市场发展和相关政策反应。我们描述了影响中介机构的因素，包括监管变化、所有权模式的转变以及电子交易的增加。我们还讨论了它们在正常时期和压力时期对市场运作的影响。我们发现，随着对交易商流动性供应的限制收紧，另类流动性提供者已经介入，在正常时期支持流动性，但在压力时期效果不太明显。最后，我们简要讨论了旨在增强市场弹性的近期政策举措。

title: Coexistence of Banks and Non-Banks: Intermediation Functions and Strategies
authors: Nicola Cetorelli, Gonzalo Cisternas, Asani Sarkar
abstract: What is the essence of non-bank financial intermediation? How does it emerge and interact with intermediation performed by banks? To investigate these questions, we develop a model-based survey: we classify existing models into different intermediation functions á la Merton (1995) to show that variations of them admit a common modeling structure; then, we extend or reinterpret the resulting models to connect equilibrium strategies to non-bank activities in practice. Particular emphasis is placed on the coexistence of banks and non-banks: how their competition, or the extent of cooperation through contractual arrangements, varies across intermediation functions. Through this approach we speak to a variety of entities such as traditional banks, open-end funds, special purpose vehicles, private credit entities, and fintech lenders. We also discuss innovation, regulation, and market liquidity as drivers of non-bank activities.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 银行与非银行的共存：中介功能与策略
abstract_zh: 非银行金融中介的本质是什么？它是如何出现并与银行进行的中介互动的？为了研究这些问题，我们开发了一项基于模型的调查：我们将现有模型分类为不同的中介函数，如 Merton (1995) 所示，以表明它们的变体具有共同的建模结构；然后，我们扩展或重新解释所得模型，将均衡策略与实践中的非银行活动联系起来。特别强调银行和非银行的共存：它们的竞争或通过合同安排的合作程度如何因中介职能而异。通过这种方法，我们与传统银行、开放式基金、特殊目的工具、私人信贷实体和金融科技贷方等各种实体进行交流。我们还讨论了作为非银行活动驱动因素的创新、监管和市场流动性。

title: Bank Economic Capital
authors: Beverly Hirtle, Matthew Plosser
abstract: Conventional measures of bank solvency fail to account for the unique liquidity risks posed by deposits. Using public regulatory data, we develop a novel measure, economic capital, that jointly quantifies the impact of credit, liquidity, and market risk. We validate that economic capital is a more timely and accurate indicator of bank health than standard solvency measures. Using our framework, we examine the evolution of banking sector solvency and find that following the GFC low interest rates depressed economic capital even as liquidity and market risks grew. We conclude with several examples that highlight additional applications.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 银行经济资本
abstract_zh: 银行偿付能力的传统衡量标准无法解释存款带来的独特流动性风险。利用公共监管数据，我们开发了一种新颖的衡量标准——经济资本，共同量化信贷、流动性和市场风险的影响。我们验证了经济资本是比标准偿付能力指标更及时、更准确的银行健康指标。利用我们的框架，我们研究了银行业偿付能力的演变，发现全球金融危机后的低利率压低了经济资本，尽管流动性和市场风险有所增加。我们以几个突出显示其他应用程序的示例作为结束。

title: Credit Card Banking
authors: Itamar Drechsler, Hyeyoon Jung, Weiyu Peng, Dominik Supera, Guanyu Zhou
abstract: Credit card interest rates, the marginal cost of consumption for nearly half of households, currently average 23 percent, far exceeding the rates on any other major type of loan or bond. Why are these rates so high? To understand this, and the economics of credit card banking more generally, we analyze regulatory account-level data on 330 million monthly accounts, representing 90 percent of the US credit card market. Default rates are relatively high at around 5 percent, but explain only a fraction of cards’ rates. Non-interest expenses and rewards payments are more than offset by interchange and non-interest income. Operating expenses, such as marketing, are very large, and are used to generate pricing power. Deducting them, we find that credit card lending still earns a 6.8 percent return on assets (ROA), more than four times the banking sector’s ROA. Using the cross section of accounts by FICO score, we estimate that credit card rates price in a 5.3 percent default risk premium, which we show is comparable to the one in high-yield bonds. Adjusting for this, we estimate that card lending still earns a 1.17 percent to 1.44 percent “alpha” relative to the overall banking sector.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 信用卡银行业务
abstract_zh: 信用卡利率是近一半家庭的边际消费成本，目前平均为 23%，远远超过任何其他主要贷款或债券类型的利率。为什么这些比率如此之高？为了了解这一点，以及更广泛地了解信用卡银行业务的经济学，我们分析了 3.3 亿个每月账户的监管账户级数据，这些账户占美国信用卡市场的 90%。违约率相对较高，约为 5%，但这只能解释信用卡违约率的一小部分。非利息支出和奖励支付被互换和非利息收入所抵消。营销等运营费用非常大，用于产生定价权。扣除它们后，我们发现信用卡贷款仍能获得 6.8% 的资产回报率 (ROA)，是银行业 ROA 的四倍多。使用 FICO 评分的账户横截面，我们估计信用卡利率的违约风险溢价为 5.3%，我们发现这与高收益债券的违约风险溢价相当。对此进行调整后，我们估计信用卡贷款相对于整个银行业仍能获得 1.17% 至 1.44% 的“阿尔法”收益。

title: The Prudential Toolkit with Shadow Banking
authors: Kinda Hachem, Martin Kuncl
abstract: Several countries now require banks or money market funds to impose state-contingent costs on short-term creditors to absorb financial stress. We study these requirements as part of the broader prudential toolkit in a model with five key ingredients: banks may face an aggregate stress state with high withdrawals; a fire-sale externality motivates a mix of non-contingent and state-contingent regulation; banks may use shadow technologies to circumvent regulation; parameters of the shadow technologies may be private information; and bailouts may occur. We characterize the optimal policy for various combinations of these ingredients and demonstrate that the threat of shadow activities constrains state-contingent regulation more than noncontingent regulation, especially when imperfect information and limited commitment coexist. The planner triggers shadow activities with positive probability under imperfect information, and shadow activities that deplete resources in the stress state elicit larger bailouts under limited commitment, rendering the requirement of state-contingent costs a weak instrument.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 影子银行的审慎工具包
abstract_zh: 一些国家现在要求银行或货币市场基金向短期债权人施加国家或有成本，以吸收金融压力。我们将这些要求作为更广泛的审慎工具包的一部分，在一个具有五个关键要素的模型中进行研究：银行可能面临高提款的总体压力状态；甩卖的外部性激发了非偶然性和国家偶然性监管的结合；银行可能利用影子技术规避监管；影子技术的参数可能是私人信息；并且可能会发生救助。我们描述了这些因素的各种组合的最优政策，并证明影子活动的威胁比非偶然性监管更能限制国家偶然性监管，特别是当信息不完全和承诺有限并存时。规划者在不完全信息下以正概率触发影子活动，而在压力状态下耗尽资源的影子活动会在有限的承诺下引发更大的救助，从而使国家或有成本的要求成为一个较弱的工具。

title: Input Sourcing Under Supply Chain Risk: Evidence from U.S. Manufacturing Firms
authors: Joaquín Blaum, Federico Esposito, Sebastian Heise
abstract: We study the effect of climate risk on how firms organize their supply chains. We use transaction-level data on U.S. manufacturing imports to construct a novel measure of input sourcing risk based on the historical volatility of ocean shipping times. Our measure isolates the unexpected component of shipping times that is induced by weather conditions along more than 40,000 maritime routes. We first document that unexpected shipping delays induced by weather shocks have significant negative effects on importers’ revenues, profits, and employment. We then show that more exposed firms actively diversify the risk of weather delays by using more routes and sourcing from more foreign suppliers, although their total imports decline. To rationalize these findings, we introduce shipping time risk into a general equilibrium model of importing with firm heterogeneity. Our quantitative analysis predicts substantial costs for the U.S. economy associated with different sources of supply chain risk.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 供应链风险下的投入采购：来自美国制造企业的证据
abstract_zh: 我们研究气候风险对企业组织供应链的影响。我们使用美国制造业进口的交易级数据，根据海运时间的历史波动性构建了一种新的投入采购风险衡量标准。我们的措施可隔离 40,000 多条海上航线上因天气条件而导致的运输时间意外部分。我们首先记录了天气冲击引起的意外运输延误对进口商的收入、利润和就业产生了重大负面影响。然后我们发现，尽管进口总量有所下降，但受影响程度较高的公司通过使用更多航线和从更多外国供应商处采购来积极分散天气延误的风险。为了合理化这些发现，我们将运输时间风险引入具有企业异质性的进口一般均衡模型中。我们的定量分析预测，美国经济将因不同来源的供应链风险而付出巨大成本。

title: Repo Intermediation and Central Clearing: An Analysis of Sponsored Repo
authors: Adam Copeland, R. Jay Kahn
abstract: This paper evaluates the salient forces behind a dealer-intermediary’s decision to move a bilateral repo transaction with a customer into central clearing. We provide evidence that dealers turn to sponsored repo on occasions when balance sheet space is scarce, such as when there is a large issuance of Treasury coupon securities and end-of-month dates. We also find that sponsored repo spreads tend to be affected by a range of factors, with the three largest drivers being money market fund assets, a proxy for hedge fund demand for repo funding, and end-of-month dates.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 回购中介和中央清算：赞助回购分析
abstract_zh: 本文评估了交易商中介机构决定将与客户的双边回购交易转移到中央清算背后的显着力量。我们提供的证据表明，交易商在资产负债表空间稀缺的情况下转向保荐回购，例如当大量发行国库券和月末时。我们还发现，赞助性回购利差往往受到一系列因素的影响，其中三个最大的驱动因素是货币市场基金资产、对冲基金回购融资需求的代理以及月末日期。

title: Corporate Debt Structure over the Global Credit Cycle
authors: Nina Boyarchenko, Leonardo Elias
abstract: We study the determinants of active debt management through issuance and refinancing decisions for firms around the world. We leverage instrument-level data to create a comprehensive picture of the maturity, currency, and security type composition of firms' debt for a large cross-section of countries. At the instrument level, we estimate a predictive model of prepayment as a function of interest costs savings and maturity lengthening motives. We document that there is substantial heterogeneity in prepayment across bonds and loans and across firms, depending on their reliance on bank lending. While debt prepayment is generally successful at extending average maturities and lowering interest rate costs at the firm level, these benefits appear smaller for issuers in emerging market economies. Tight global credit conditions reduce both the ability to prepay debt early and the effectiveness of debt refinancing in reducing interest costs and rollover risk. Put together, our results show that the impact of global credit conditions on firms' debt structure can be traced back to how instrument-level prepayment incentives change over the global credit cycle.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 全球信贷周期中的企业债务结构
abstract_zh: 我们通过世界各地公司的发行和再融资决策来研究主动债务管理的决定因素。我们利用工具级数据来全面了解大部分国家的公司债务的期限、货币和证券类型构成。在工具层面，我们根据利息成本节省和期限延长动机来估计提前还款的预测模型。我们发现，不同债券和贷款以及不同公司的提前还款存在很大的异质性，具体取决于它们对银行贷款的依赖程度。虽然债务提前偿还通常可以成功地延长平均期限并降低公司层面的利率成本，但对于新兴市场经济体的发行人来说，这些好处似乎较小。全球信贷状况趋紧，既降低了提前偿还债务的能力，也降低了债务再融资在降低利息成本和展期风险方面的有效性。综上所述，我们的结果表明，全球信贷状况对企业债务结构的影响可以追溯到工具层面的提前还款激励措施在全球信贷周期中的变化。

title: The Long-Term Rise and Geographic Concentration of Labor Market Detachment
authors: Jaison R. Abel, Richard Deitz
abstract: This paper analyzes the long-term rise of labor market detachment within the United States. We construct a measure of the detachment rate that identifies prime-age men and women who have been out of the labor force for more than a year. Detachment has risen for men in most local labor markets since 1980, and for women since around 2000, with more than a third of the prime-age population detached in some parts of the country. We show there has been a widening in the spatial distribution of detachment and a corresponding increase in its geographic concentration. Empirical results indicate that detachment rose more in places with weak local economies, particularly those that experienced a loss of routine production and administrative support jobs due to globalization and technological change, and that frictions in local labor market adjustment contributed to its uneven rise. Moreover, the rise in detachment has been concentrated among older prime-age individuals and those without a college degree, and, consistent with regional reinvention, occurred less in places with high human capital. These findings point to an important role for place-based economic development policy in distressed regions with persistently high detachment.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 劳动力市场脱离的长期增长和地域集中
abstract_zh: 本文分析了美国劳动力市场脱离的长期增长。我们构建了一种衡量脱离率的指标，用于识别脱离劳动力超过一年的壮年男性和女性。自 1980 年以来，大多数当地劳动力市场中男性的脱离率有所上升，而自 2000 年左右以来，女性的脱离率也有所上升，在该国的一些地区，超过三分之一的壮年人口处于脱离状态。我们发现，脱离的空间分布不断扩大，其地理集中度也相应增加。实证结果表明，在地方经济薄弱的地方，特别是那些因全球化和技术变革而失去日常生产和行政支持工作的地方，脱离现象上升较多，而当地劳动力市场调整的摩擦导致了脱离现象的不平衡上升。此外，脱离感的增加主要集中在年长的壮年个体和没有大学学位的人身上，并且与区域重塑相一致，在人力资本较高的地方发生的情况较少。这些发现表明，在持续高度脱离的贫困地区，基于地方的经济发展政策发挥着重要作用。

title: Discount Window Stigma After the Global Financial Crisis
authors: Olivier Armantier, Marco Cipriani, Asani Sarkar
abstract: We study Discount Window (DW) stigma, the reluctance to access the Federal Reserve’s lender-of-last resort facility, between 2014 and 2024. Despite increased usage since 2020, we find conclusive evidence that the DW is stigmatized, especially among smaller banks and when financial markets experience disruptions. In particular, evidence of DW stigma emerged months before the 2023 banking turmoil and had not subsided a year later. We also identify new determinants and consequences of DW stigma. The implications of these results for the provision of emergency liquidity are discussed.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 全球金融危机后贴现窗口的耻辱
abstract_zh: 我们研究了 2014 年至 2024 年间贴现窗口 (DW) 的耻辱，即不愿使用美联储最后贷款人工具的情况。尽管自 2020 年以来使用量有所增加，但我们发现确凿的证据表明，贴现窗口 (DW) 受到了耻辱，尤其是在小型银行中以及当金融市场经历混乱时。特别是，德国之声耻辱的证据在 2023 年银行业动荡前几个月就出现了，并且在一年后并未消退。我们还确定了 DW 耻辱的新决定因素和后果。讨论了这些结果对提供紧急流动性的影响。

title: Firms’ Supply Chain Adaptation to Carbon Taxes
authors: Pierre Coster, Julian di Giovanni, Isabelle Méjean
abstract: This paper studies how firms adjust input sourcing in response to climate policy. Using the EU Emissions Trading System (ETS) as a natural experiment and French product-level import and production data, we show that firms increasingly shifted imports of ETS-regulated inputs to non-EU countries over the 2010s as the policy became more stringent, indicating carbon leakage. This leakage is economically significant: the share of ETS-regulated products sourced from outside the EU rose by 4.3 percentage points after the ETS was implemented. Motivated by these empirical findings, we estimate a heterogeneous firm model using pre-ETS data. Simulating the model under a €100 carbon tax reproduces observed leakage, raises domestic prices, and modestly reduces French emissions. Adding a carbon tariff similar to the EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) reverses the leakage but further increases prices. The combined ETS+CBAM regime is seven times more effective than the ETS alone in reducing emissions.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 企业供应链对碳税的适应
abstract_zh: 本文研究企业如何调整投入来源以应对气候政策。使用欧盟排放交易体系 (ETS) 作为自然实验和法国产品级进口和生产数据，我们发现，随着政策变得更加严格，企业在 2010 年代越来越多地将受 ETS 监管的投入品的进口转移到非欧盟国家，这表明碳泄漏。这种泄漏具有重大的经济意义：ETS 实施后，来自欧盟以外地区的 ETS 监管产品比例上升了 4.3 个百分点。受这些实证研究结果的启发，我们使用 ETS 之前的数据估计了异质公司模型。在 100 欧元碳税下模拟该模型可以重现观察到的泄漏，提高国内价格，并适度减少法国的排放量。增加类似于欧盟碳边境调整机制（CBAM）的碳关税可以扭转泄漏，但会进一步提高价格。 ETS+CBAM 联合制度在减少排放方面比单独的 ETS 有效七倍。

title: Clustering in Natural Disaster Damages
authors: Jacob Kim-Sherman, Lee Seltzer
abstract: Empirical research in climate economics often relies on panel regressions of different outcomes on disaster damages. Interpreting these regressions requires an assumption that error terms are uncorrelated across counties and time, which climate science research suggests is unlikely to hold. We introduce a methodology to identify spatial and temporal clusters in natural disaster damages datasets, and show that accounting for clustering affects observed economic effects of disasters. Specifically, counties tend to experience 0.45% more disaster damage for every 1% increase in damage across other intra-cluster counties. Moreover, accounting for clustering makes some hazard types, such as droughts, appear more damaging.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 自然灾害损失集中
abstract_zh: 气候经济学的实证研究通常依赖于不同灾害损失结果的面板回归。解释这些回归需要假设误差项在各个县和时间之间不相关，但气候科学研究表明这一假设不太可能成立。我们引入了一种方法来识别自然灾害损失数据集中的空间和时间集群，并表明集群的解释会影响观察到的灾害的经济影响。具体而言，其他集群内县的损失每增加 1%，县遭受的灾害损失往往会增加 0.45%。此外，考虑到集群性，某些灾害类型（例如干旱）看起来更具破坏性。

title: Who Collaborates with the Soviets? Financial Distress and Technology Transfer During the Great Depression
authors: Jerry Jiang, Jacob P. Weber
abstract: We provide evidence that financial distress induces firms to sell their technology to foreign competitors. To do so, we construct a novel, spatial panel dataset by individually researching and locating U.S. firms who signed Technology Transfer Agreements (TTAs) with the Soviet Union during the 1920s and 1930s in various U.S. counties. By relating the number of TTAs signed in each county to the number of bank failures, we establish a significant, positive relationship between financial distress and the number of firms signing TTAs with the Soviet Union. Our findings suggest that banking panics may create opportunities for foreign countries to acquire affected firms’ technology.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 谁与苏联合作？大萧条期间的财务困境和技术转让
abstract_zh: 我们提供的证据表明，财务困境促使公司将其技术出售给外国竞争对手。为此，我们通过单独研究和定位 1920 年代和 1930 年代在美国各个县与苏联签署技术转让协议 (TTAs) 的美国公司，构建了一个新颖的空间面板数据集。通过将每个县签署的 TTA 数量与银行倒闭数量联系起来，我们在财务困境与与苏联签署 TTA 的公司数量之间建立了显着的正相关关系。我们的研究结果表明，银行业恐慌可能为外国获取受影响公司的技术创造机会。

title: A New Jackknife Variance Estimator for Time-Series and Panel Regressions
authors: Richard K. Crump, Nikolay Gospodinov, Ignacio Lopez Gaffney
abstract: We introduce a new jackknife variance estimator for time-series and panel-data regressions. The novelty in our approach is that we first rotate the data using a particular choice of trigonometric basis functions. This rotation removes serial correlation in a broad class of time-series processes, including random walks, and enables the use of the conventional leave-one-out jackknife on the transformed space of the regressors and residuals. The procedure is tuning-parameter free and naturally adapts to the degree of persistence of the data. We prove the asymptotic validity of our variance estimator under general conditions and demonstrate excellent finite-sample properties in extensive simulation experiments, spanning a wide range of time-series and panel-data designs.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 用于时间序列和面板回归的新折刀方差估计器
abstract_zh: 我们引入了一种新的折刀方差估计器，用于时间序列和面板数据回归。我们方法的新颖之处在于，我们首先使用特定选择的三角基函数来旋转数据。这种旋转消除了广泛的时间序列过程（包括随机游走）中的序列相关性，并允许在回归量和残差的变换空间上使用传统的留一折刀法。该过程无需调整参数，并且自然地适应数据的持久性程度。我们证明了方差估计器在一般条件下的渐近有效性，并在广泛的模拟实验中展示了出色的有限样本特性，涵盖了广泛的时间序列和面板数据设计。

title: A Simple Diagnostic for Time-Series and Panel-Data Regressions
authors: Richard K. Crump, Nikolay Gospodinov, Ignacio Lopez Gaffney
abstract: We introduce a new regression diagnostic, tailored to time-series and panel-data regressions, which characterizes the sensitivity of the OLS estimate to distinct time-series variation at different frequencies. The diagnostic is built on the novel result that the eigenvectors of a random walk asymptotically orthogonalize a wide variety of time-series processes. Our diagnostic is based on leave-one-out OLS estimation on transformed variables using these eigenvectors. We illustrate how our diagnostic allows applied researchers to scrutinize regression results and probe for underlying fragility of the sample OLS estimate. We demonstrate the utility of our approach using a variety of empirical applications.
keywords: high time-series persistence and spurious regressions
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 时间序列和面板数据回归的简单诊断
abstract_zh: 我们引入了一种新的回归诊断，专门针对时间序列和面板数据回归，它表征了 OLS 估计对不同频率下不同时间序列变化的敏感性。该诊断建立在随机游走的特征向量渐近正交化各种时间序列过程的新结果之上。我们的诊断基于使用这些特征向量对变换变量进行留一 OLS 估计。我们说明了我们的诊断如何允许应用研究人员仔细检查回归结果并探究样本 OLS 估计的潜在脆弱性。我们使用各种实证应用来证明我们的方法的实用性。

title: Financial Education and Household Financial Decisions During the Pandemic
authors: Donghoon Lee, Daniel Mangrum, Wilbert Van der Klaauw, Crystal Wang
abstract: We examine the impact of financial education on credit decisions during COVID-19. The pandemic presented economic challenges, but policy responses provided opportunities for savvy borrowers. Using variation in state-mandated financial education during high school, we find that mandated borrowers reduced revolving credit card balances by larger amounts after stimulus checks were distributed and were more likely to buy homes and refinance mortgages during times of low interest rates. Paused student loan borrowers bound by mandates originated more auto loans and mortgages while reducing growth in credit card balances. Our findings underscore the importance of financial education for economic resilience.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 大流行期间的金融教育和家庭财务决策
abstract_zh: 我们研究了 COVID-19 期间金融教育对信贷决策的影响。疫情带来了经济挑战，但政策应对措施为精明的借款人提供了机会。利用高中期间国家规定的金融教育的变化，我们发现，在发放刺激支票后，强制借款人减少了循环信用卡余额，并且更有可能在低利率时期购买房屋和为抵押贷款再融资。受强制规定暂停的学生贷款借款人发放了更多的汽车贷款和抵押贷款，同时减少了信用卡余额的增长。我们的研究结果强调了金融教育对经济弹性的重要性。

title: Extend-and-Pretend in the U.S. CRE Market
authors: Matteo Crosignani, Saketh Prazad
abstract: We show that in the post-pandemic period, weakly capitalized banks provided maturity extensions and granted payment relief to distressed commercial real estate (CRE) borrowers to preserve capital, leading to credit misallocation and a buildup of financial fragility. Using supervisory data, we detect this “extend-and- pretend” behavior in CRE mortgage lending and in bank lending to REITs exposed to distressed CRE. These maturity extensions increased the stock of CRE mortgages maturing in the near term, raising the risk of large losses materializing over a short period. Extend-and-pretend is also associated with reduced origination of new CRE mortgages and C&I credit to firms.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 美国 CRE 市场的延伸与假装
abstract_zh: 我们发现，在大流行后时期，资本实力较弱的银行向陷入困境的商业房地产（CRE）借款人提供期限延长和付款减免，以保存资本，从而导致信贷错配和金融脆弱性加剧。利用监管数据，我们在商业地产抵押贷款和银行向暴露​​于不良商业地产的房地产投资信托基金提供的贷款中发现了这种“延伸假装”行为。这些期限延长增加了近期到期的商业地产抵押贷款存量，增加了短期内发生巨额损失的风险。扩展和假装还与企业新的商业地产抵押贷款和商业与工业信贷的减少有关。

title: Demographic Differences in Letters of Recommendation for Economics Ph.D. Students
authors: Beverly Hirtle, Anna Kovner
abstract: We analyze letters of recommendation for more than 2,200 economics and finance Ph.D. graduates and document that letters for female and Black or Hispanic job candidates are weaker in some dimensions, while letters for Asian candidates are notably less positive overall. Female and Asian candidates are less likely to be recommended to top academic departments. Letter characteristics, especially a top recommendation, have meaningful effects on initial job placements and journal publications. The effect appears to be causal—we instrument for better letters and still estimate a meaningful impact of letter quality on outcomes.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 经济学博士推荐信中的人口统计学差异学生
abstract_zh: 我们分析了 2,200 多名经济学和金融学博士的推荐信。毕业生和文件显示，女性和黑人或西班牙裔求职者的推荐信在某些方面较弱，而亚洲求职者的推荐信总体上明显不那么积极。女性和亚裔候选人被推荐到顶级学术部门的可能性较小。信件特征，尤其是顶级推荐，对最初的工作安排和期刊发表具有有意义的影响。这种效应似乎是因果关系——我们为更好的信件进行检测，并且仍然估计信件质量对结果的有意义的影响。

title: Wage Growth and Labor Market Tightness
authors: Sebastian Heise, Jeremy Pearce, Jacob P. Weber
abstract: Good measures of labor market tightness are essential to predict wage inflation and to calibrate monetary policy. This paper highlights the importance of two measures of labor market tightness in determining wage growth: the quits rate and vacancies per effective searcher (V/ES)—where searchers include both employed and non-employed job seekers. Amongst a broad set of indicators of labor market tightness, we find that these two measures are independently the most strongly correlated with wage inflation both in aggregate time series data and in industry-level panel data, and also predict wage growth best out of sample. Transitory shocks to productivity have little impact on wage growth. These results are consistent with the predictions of a New Keynesian DSGE model where firms have the power to set wages and workers search on the job. Based on our findings, we develop a new composite indicator of labor market tightness that can be used by policymakers to predict wage pressures in real time.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 工资增长和劳动力市场紧张
abstract_zh: 衡量劳动力市场紧张程度的良好指标对于预测工资通胀和调整货币政策至关重要。本文强调了衡量劳动力市场紧张程度的两项指标在决定工资增长方面的重要性：辞职率和有效求职者的职位空缺率（V/ES）——其中求职者包括就业和非就业求职者。在一系列广泛的劳动力市场紧张指标中，我们发现这两项指标在总体时间序列数据和行业层面面板数据中与工资通胀的相关性最强，并且在样本外也能最好地预测工资增长。生产率的暂时冲击对工资增长影响不大。这些结果与新凯恩斯主义 DSGE 模型的预测一致，在该模型中，企业有权设定工资和工人在工作中的搜索。根据我们的研究结果，我们开发了一种新的劳动力市场紧张程度综合指标，政策制定者可以用它来实时预测工资压力。

title: Need for Speed: Quality of Innovations and the Allocation of Inventors
authors: Santiago Caicedo, Jeremy Pearce
abstract: This paper studies how the speed-quality tradeoff in innovation interacts with firm dynamics, concentration, and economic growth. Empirically, we document long-run trends in the increasing speed of innovation alongside declining quality at large firms. Leveraging variation from an exogenous policy change, we document the existence of the speed-quality tradeoff both at the firm and aggregate level. We develop an endogenous growth model that incorporates the speed-quality tradeoff and show that allocating less labor towards speed increases growth, particularly in the presence of private benefits to innovation and spillovers from heterogeneous innovations. We quantify the model to link firms’ decisions across speed and quality to aggregate outcomes. Quantitatively, the recent growth slowdown is mainly due to changes in the innovation production function, while the allocation of inventors between speed and quality within firms has a modest impact. When spillovers across firms are taken into account, the effect becomes significantly larger; the shift to speed over the last 30 years explains up to one-quarter of the decrease in growth.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 极品速度：创新质量和发明人分配
abstract_zh: 本文研究了创新速度与质量的权衡如何与企业活力、集中度和经济增长相互作用。根据经验，我们记录了大公司创新速度加快和质量下降的长期趋势。利用外生政策变化的变化，我们记录了公司和总体层面上速度与质量权衡的存在。我们开发了一种内生增长模型，该模型结合了速度与质量的权衡，并表明，为速度分配更少的劳动力会促进增长，特别是在存在创新私人利益和异质创新溢出效应的情况下。我们量化该模型，将公司在速度和质量方面的决策与总体结果联系起来。从数量上看，近期增长放缓主要是由于创新生产函数的变化，而企业内部发明人在速度和质量之间的配置影响不大。当考虑到企业之间的溢出效应时，影响会变得更大；过去 30 年增长速度的转变解释了增长下降的四分之一。

title: Firm Wage Setting and On-the-Job Search Limit Wage-Price Spirals
authors: Justin Bloesch, Seung Joo Lee, Jacob P. Weber
abstract: We develop a novel, tractable New Keynesian model where firms post wages and workers search on the job, motivated by microeconomic evidence on wage setting. Because firms set wages to avoid costly turnover, the rate that workers quit their jobs features prominently in the model’s wage Phillips curve, matching U.S. empirical evidence. We then examine the response of wages to cost-of-living shocks, i.e., shocks that raise the price of household’s consumption goods but do not affect the marginal product of labor. Such shocks pass through to wages only to the extent that higher cost of living improves workers’ outside options, such as competing jobs or unemployment, relative to their current job. However, higher cost of living lowers real wages at all jobs evenly, and unemployment is rarely a credible outside option. We conclude that wage posting and on-the-job search limit the scope for pass-through from prices to wages.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 固定工资设定和在职搜索限制了工资价格螺旋
abstract_zh: 我们开发了一种新颖、易于处理的新凯恩斯主义模型，在该模型中，公司公布工资，工人在工资设定的微观经济证据的推动下寻找工作。由于公司设定工资是为了避免代价高昂的人员流动，因此工人辞职率在模型的工资菲利普斯曲线中占据显着位置，与美国的经验证据相匹配。然后，我们研究工资对生活成本冲击的反应，即提高家庭消费品价格但不影响劳动力边际产量的冲击。只有当较高的生活成本改善了工人相对于当前工作的外部选择（例如竞争性工作或失业）时，这种冲击才会传导至工资。然而，较高的生活成本会均匀地降低所有工作的实际工资，而且失业很少是可靠的外部选择。我们的结论是，工资发布和在职搜索限制了从价格到工资的传导范围。

title: Inequality Within Countries is Falling: Underreporting Robust Estimates of World Poverty, Inequality, and the Global Distribution of Income
authors: Kasey Chatterji-Len, William Nober, Maxim L. Pinkovskiy, Xavier X. Sala-i-Martin
abstract: Household surveys suffer from persistent and growing underreporting. We propose a novel procedure to adjust reported survey incomes for underreporting by estimating a model of misreporting whose main parameter of interest is the elasticity of regional national accounts income to regional survey income, which is closely related to the elasticity of underreporting with respect to income. We find this elasticity to be substantial but roughly constant over time, implying a large but relatively constant correction to survey-derived inequality estimates. Underreporting of income by the bottom 50 percent of the world income distribution has become particularly important in recent decades. We reconfirm the findings of the literature that global poverty and inequality have declined dramatically between 1980 and 2019. Finally, we find that within-country inequality is falling on average and has been largely constant since the 1990s.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 国家内部的不平等正在下降：低估了对世界贫困、不平等和全球收入分配的稳健估计
abstract_zh: 家庭调查持续存在且日益严重的漏报问题。我们提出了一种新颖的程序，通过估计误报模型来调整报告的调查收入以防止漏报，该模型的主要兴趣参数是区域国民账户收入对区域调查收入的弹性，这与收入的漏报弹性密切相关。我们发现这种弹性很大，但随着时间的推移大致保持不变，这意味着对调查得出的不平等估计值进行了较大但相对恒定的修正。近几十年来，世界收入分配最底层 50% 的人少报收入变得尤为重要。我们再次证实了文献的研究结果，即 1980 年至 2019 年间全球贫困和不平等现象急剧下降。最后，我们发现国内不平等现象平均正在下降，并且自 20 世纪 90 年代以来基本保持不变。

title: The Pay and Non-Pay Content of Job Ads
authors: Richard Audoly, Manudeep Bhuller, Tore Adam Reiremo
abstract: How informative are job ads about the actual pay and amenities offered by employers? Using a comprehensive database of job ads posted by Norwegian employers, we develop a methodology to systematically classify the information on both pay and non-pay job attributes advertised in vacancy texts. We link this information to measures of employer attractiveness, which we derive from a job search model estimated on observed wages and worker mobility flows. About 55 percent of job ads provide information related to pay and nearly all ads feature information on non-pay attributes. We show that publicly advertised job attributes are meaningful predictors of employer attractiveness, and non-pay attributes are about as predictive as pay-related attributes. High-pay employers mention pay-related attributes more often, while high-amenity employers are more likely to advertise flexible working hours and contract duration.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 招聘广告的付费和非付费内容
abstract_zh: 招聘广告关于雇主提供的实际工资和便利设施的信息有多少？利用挪威雇主发布的招聘广告综合数据库，我们开发了一种方法，对空缺文本中广告的带薪和无薪工作属性信息进行系统分类。我们将这些信息与雇主吸引力的衡量标准联系起来，这些衡量标准是根据观察到的工资和工人流动性而估算的求职模型得出的。大约 55% 的招聘广告提供与薪酬相关的信息，几乎所有广告都提供有关非薪酬属性的信息。我们表明，公开广告的工作属性是雇主吸引力的有意义的预测因素，非薪酬属性与薪酬相关属性的预测能力大致相同。高薪雇主更频繁地提及与薪酬相关的属性，而高福利雇主更有可能宣传灵活的工作时间和合同期限。

title: Payout Restrictions and Bank Risk-Shifting
authors: Fulvia Fringuellotti, Thomas Kroen
abstract: This paper studies the effects of regulatory payout restrictions on bank risk-shifting. Using policies imposed during the Covid-crisis on U.S. banks as a natural experiment and a high frequency differences-in-differences approach, we show that, when payouts are restricted, banks’ equity prices fall while their debt values appreciate. Moreover, banks that are ex-ante more exposed to the payout restrictions decrease risk-taking in lending relative to less exposed banks. Consistent with a risk-shifting channel, these effects revert once restrictions are lifted. These results indicate that payout and risk-taking choices are complementary and that regulatory payout restrictions endogenously affect bank risk-shifting.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 支付限制和银行风险转移
abstract_zh: 本文研究监管支付限制对银行风险转移的影响。我们将新冠危机期间对美国银行实施的政策作为自然实验和高频双重差分方法，结果表明，当支出受到限制时，银行的股价下跌，而债务价值升值。此外，与风险较小的银行相比，事前更容易受到支付限制影响的银行会降低贷款风险。与风险转移渠道一致，一旦限制解除，这些影响就会恢复。这些结果表明，支付和风险承担选择是互补的，监管支付限制会内生地影响银行风险转移。

title: Financial System Architecture and Technological Vulnerability
authors: Selman Erol, Michael Junho Lee
abstract: This paper presents a framework to study of technological resiliency of financial system architecture. Financial market infrastructures, or platforms, compete with services critical functions along various stages in the lifecycle of a trade, and make investments in technological resiliency to guard against attackers seeking to exploit system weaknesses. Platforms’ financial network effects attenuate competition between platforms on security. Exposure to vulnerabilities is magnified in the presence of strategic adversaries. Private provision of technological resiliency is generally sub-optimal, with over- and underinvestment in security depending on market structure. Vulnerabilities evolve over the maturity of a financial system, but there generically exists a tipping point at which technological resiliency diverges from optimal and creates technological drag on the financial system. We find supportive evidence in tri-party repo settlement: the exit of duopolist resulted in a significant drop in IT-related investment by the sole provider, even as peer firms ramp up investment.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 金融系统架构和技术漏洞
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一个研究金融系统架构技术弹性的框架。金融市场基础设施或平台在交易生命周期的各个阶段与服务关键功能竞争，并在技术弹性方面进行投资，以防范试图利用系统弱点的攻击者。平台的金融网络效应削弱了平台之间在安全方面的竞争。当存在战略对手时，脆弱性就会被放大。私人提供的技术弹性通常不是最佳的，安全投资过度或不足取决于市场结构。脆弱性随着金融体系的成熟而演变，但通常存在一个转折点，在这个转折点上，技术弹性偏离最佳状态，并对金融体系造成技术拖累。我们在三方回购结算中找到了支持性证据：双寡头的退出导致唯一供应商的 IT 相关投资大幅下降，尽管同行企业加大了投资。

title: Optimal Design of Tokenized Markets
authors: Michael Junho Lee, Antoine Martin, Robert M. Townsend
abstract: Trades in today’s financial system are inherently subject to settlement uncertainty. This paper explores tokenization as a potential technological solution. A token system, by enabling programmability of assets, can be designed to eradicate settlement uncertainty. We study the allocations achieved in a decentralized market with either the legacy settlement system or a token system. Tokenization can improve efficiency in markets subject to a limited commitment problem. However, it also materially alters the information environment, which in turn aggravates a hold-up problem. This limits potential gains from resolving settlement uncertainty, particularly for markets that depend on intermediaries. We show that optimal design hinges on joint design of settlement and trading systems, and in particular, that token systems work best when matched with direct trading.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 代币化市场的优化设计
abstract_zh: 当今金融体系中的交易本质上受到结算不确定性的影响。本文探讨了代币化作为一种​​潜在的技术解决方案。通过实现资产的可编程性，代币系统可以被设计为消除结算的不确定性。我们研究使用遗留结算系统或代币系统在去中心化市场中实现的分配。代币化可以提高受有限承诺问题影响的市场效率。然而，它也极大地改变了信息环境，进而加剧了劫持问题。这限制了解决结算不确定性的潜在收益，特别是对于依赖中介机构的市场。我们表明，最优设计取决于结算和交易系统的联合设计，特别是，代币系统在与直接交易相匹配时效果最佳。

title: Zero Settlement Risk Token Systems
authors: Michael Junho Lee, Antoine Martin, Robert M. Townsend
abstract: How might modern settlement systems with distributed ledger technology achieve zero settlement risk? We consider the design of settlement systems that satisfies two integral features: information-leakage proof and zero settlement risk. Legacy settlement systems partition private information but are vulnerable to settlement fails. A token system with dynamic ownership representation, or a dynamic ledger, can be designed to achieve both, as long as it employs a protocol that enforces two restrictions: programs must be immediately implemented and must involve transactions based on verifiable claims. We show how such a system can support various arrangements, including insurance, derivatives, collateralized loans, and securitization.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 零结算风险代币系统
abstract_zh: 采用分布式账本技术的现代结算系统如何实现零结算风险？我们考虑结算系统的设计满足两个整体特征：防信息泄露和零结算风险。传统结算系统分割私人信息，但很容易出现结算失败的情况。具有动态所有权表示的代币系统或动态分类账可以被设计为实现这两者，只要它采用强制执行两个限制的协议即可：程序必须立即实施，并且必须涉及基于可验证声明的交易。我们展示了这样的系统如何支持各种安排，包括保险、衍生品、抵押贷款和证券化。

title: Where Do Banks End and NBFIs Begin?
authors: Viral V. Acharya, Nicola Cetorelli, Bruce Tuckman
abstract: In recent years, assets of nonbank financial intermediaries (NBFIs) have grown significantly relative to those of banks. These two sectors are commonly viewed either as operating in parallel, performing different activities, or as substitutes, performing substantially similar activities, with banks inside and NBFIs outside the perimeter of banking regulation. We argue instead that NBFI and bank businesses and risks are so interwoven that they are better described as having transformed over time, rather than as having migrated from banks to NBFIs. These transformations are at least in part a response to regulation and are such that banks remain special as both routine and emergency liquidity providers to NBFIs. We support this perspective as follows: (i) the new and enhanced financial accounts data for the United States (“From Whom to Whom”) show that banks and NBFIs finance each other, with NBFIs especially dependent on banks; (ii) case studies and regulatory data show that banks remain exposed to credit and funding risks, which at first glance seem to have moved to NBFIs, and also to contingent liquidity risk from the provision of credit lines to NBFIs; and (iii) empirical work confirms bank-NBFI linkages through the correlation of their abnormal equity returns and market-based measures of systemic risk. We discuss some potential regulatory responses, including treating the two sectors holistically, recognizing the implications for risk propagation and amplification, and exploring new ways to internalize the costs of systemic risk.
