source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 银行和非银行金融机构从哪里开始？
abstract_zh: 近年来，非银行金融中介机构（NBFI）的资产相对于银行的资产大幅增长。这两个部门通常被视为并行运作、从事不同的活动，或者被视为替代品、从事基本相似的活动，其中银行位于银行监管范围之内，非银行金融机构位于银行监管范围之外。相反，我们认为，非银行金融机构和银行的业务和风险是如此交织在一起，因此最好将它们描述为随着时间的推移而发生转变，而不是从银行转移到非银行金融机构。这些转变至少在一定程度上是对监管的回应，使得银行作为非银行金融机构的常规和紧急流动性提供者保持特殊地位。我们支持这一观点如下：(i) 美国新的和增强的金融账户数据（“从谁到谁”）显示，银行和非银行金融机构相互融资，非银行金融机构尤其依赖银行； (ii) 案例研究和监管数据显示，银行仍然面临信贷和融资风险（乍一看似乎已转移到非银行金融机构），并且还面临向非银行金融机构提供信贷额度带来的或有流动性风险； (iii) 实证研究通过银行与非银行金融机构的异常股权回报与基于市场的系统性风险衡量指标的相关性证实了银行与非银行金融机构之间的联系。我们讨论了一些潜在的监管对策，包括整体对待这两个行业，认识到风险传播和放大的影响，以及探索将系统性风险成本内部化的新方法。

title: The Nonbank Footprint of Banks
authors: Nicola Cetorelli, Saketh Prazad
abstract: U.S. bank holding companies (BHCs) have developed a significant nonbank footprint over the last five decades, accounting for a sizable share of both BHC assets and the broader nonbank financial sector. We argue that this structure is partly explained by internal capital markets: when affiliates face imperfectly correlated liquidity outflows, internal transfers reduce the need for precautionary buffers. Using unique data on BHC structure and intracompany funding balances, we find evidence that affiliates provide implicit liquidity insurance through internal transfers, and that the BHC organizational scope responds to shocks that affect the value of this insurance. Our findings suggest that internal liquidity insurance plays a central role in determining both firm boundaries and asset allocation in modern financial groups.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 银行的非银行足迹
abstract_zh: 美国银行控股公司 (BHC) 在过去 50 年中在非银行领域占据了重要地位，在 BHC 资产和更广泛的非银行金融部门中占据了相当大的份额。我们认为，这种结构在一定程度上是由内部资本市场解释的：当附属机构面临不完全相关的流动性流出时，内部转移减少了对预防性缓冲的需求。利用有关 BHC 结构和公司内部资金余额的独特数据，我们发现有证据表明附属公司通过内部转移提供隐性流动性保险，并且 BHC 组织范围对影响该保险价值的冲击做出了反应。我们的研究结果表明，内部流动性保险在确定现代金融集团的公司边界和资产配置方面发挥着核心作用。

title: Failing Banks
authors: Sergio A. Correia, Stephan Luck, Emil Verner
abstract: Why do banks fail? We create a panel covering most commercial banks from 1863 through 2024 to study the history of failing banks in the United States. Failing banks are characterized by rising asset losses, deteriorating solvency, and an increasing reliance on expensive noncore funding. These commonalities imply that bank failures are highly predictable using simple accounting metrics from publicly available financial statements. Failures with runs were common before deposit insurance, but these failures are strongly related to weak fundamentals, casting doubt on the importance of non-fundamental runs. Furthermore, low recovery rates on failed banks’ assets suggest that most failed banks were fundamentally insolvent, barring strong assumptions about the value destruction of receiverships. Altogether, our evidence suggests that the primary cause of bank failures and banking crises is almost always and everywhere a deterioration of bank fundamentals.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 倒闭的银行
abstract_zh: 银行为何倒闭？我们创建了一个涵盖 1863 年至 2024 年大多数商业银行的小组，以研究美国破产银行的历史。破产银行的特点是资产损失增加、偿付能力恶化以及对昂贵的非核心资金的依赖日益增加。这些共性意味着，使用公开财务报表中的简单会计指标，银行倒闭是高度可预测的。在存款保险出现之前，挤兑失败很常见，但这些失败与基本面疲软密切相关，这让人们对非基本面挤兑的重要性产生了怀疑。此外，破产银行资产的回收率较低，这表明大多数破产银行基本上已经资不抵债，除非对破产接管的价值破坏做出强有力的假设。总而言之，我们的证据表明，银行倒闭和银行危机的主要原因几乎在任何地方都是银行基本面的恶化。

title: Brand Reallocation and Market Concentration
authors: Jeremy Pearce, Liangjie Wu
abstract: We study the interaction of customer capital and productivity through brand reallocation across firms. We develop a firm dynamics model with brands as transferable customer capital, heterogeneous firm productivity, and variable markups. We study the matching process between transferable brand capital and core productivity, which can be inefficient with significant welfare implications. We link USPTO trademark data with Nielsen sales data to study the prevalence of brand reallocation and the response of sales and prices to reallocation. Quantitatively, brand reallocation reduces welfare. Optimal policies deviate substantially from the literature due to the complementarity between brand capital and productivity.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 品牌重新配置与市场集中度
abstract_zh: 我们通过公司之间的品牌重新分配来研究客户资本和生产力的相互作用。我们开发了一个公司动态模型，其中品牌作为可转移的客户资本、异构公司生产力和可变加价。我们研究了可转移品牌资本与核心生产力之间的匹配过程，该过程可能效率低下，并会产生重大的福利影响。我们将美国专利商标局商标数据与尼尔森销售数据联系起来，研究品牌重新分配的普遍性以及销售和价格对重新分配的反应。从数量上讲，品牌重新分配会减少福利。由于品牌资本和生产力之间的互补性，最优政策与文献有很大偏差。

title: Measurement and Theory of Core Inflation
authors: Martín Almuzara, Argia M. Sbordone
abstract: We discuss the concept of core inflation and its relevance for policymakers and then review a variety of approaches that have been pursued for the construction of informative core measures. After illustrating some empirical patterns displayed by U.S. inflation data and discussing conceptual issues around measurement, we provide a unified framework to interpret various widely used core measures and compare their relative properties.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 核心通胀的测量和理论
abstract_zh: 我们讨论了核心通胀的概念及其与政策制定者的相关性，然后回顾了为构建信息丰富的核心指标而采取的各种方法。在说明了美国通胀数据显示的一些经验模式并讨论了有关衡量的概念问题后，我们提供了一个统一的框架来解释各种广泛使用的核心衡量指标并比较它们的相对属性。

title: Consumer Credit Reporting Data
authors: Christa N. Gibbs, Benedict Guttman-Kenney, Donghoon Lee, Scott Nelson, Wilbert Van der Klaauw, Jialan Wang
abstract: Since the 2000s, economists across fields have increasingly used consumer credit reporting data for research. We introduce readers to the economics of and the institutional details of these data. Using examples from the literature, we provide practical guidance on how to use these data to construct economic measures of borrowing, consumption, credit access, financial distress, and geographic mobility. We explain what credit scores measure, and why. We highlight how researchers can access credit reporting data via existing datasets or by creating new datasets, including by linking credit reporting data with surveys and external datasets.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 消费者信用报告数据
abstract_zh: 自 2000 年代以来，各个领域的经济学家越来越多地使用消费者信用报告数据进行研究。我们向读者介绍这些数据的经济学和制度细节。通过文献中的例子，我们提供了如何使用这些数据来构建借贷、消费、信贷获取、财务困境和地理流动性的经济指标的实用指导。我们解释信用评分的衡量标准以及原因。我们重点介绍研究人员如何通过现有数据集或创建新数据集（包括将信用报告数据与调查和外部数据集链接）来访问信用报告数据。

title: OLS Limit Theory for Drifting Sequences of Parameters on the Explosive Side of Unity
authors: Tassos Magdalinos, Katerina Petrova
abstract: A limit theory is developed for the least squares estimator for mildly and purely explosive autoregressions under drifting sequences of parameters with autoregressive roots ρn satisfying ρn → ρ ∈ (—∞, —1] ∪ [1, ∞) and n (|ρn| —1) → ∞. Drifting sequences of innovations and initial conditions are also considered. A standard specification of a short memory linear process for the autoregressive innovations is extended to a triangular array formulation both for the deterministic weights and for the primitive innovations of the linear process, which are allowed to be heteroskedastic L1-mixingales. The paper provides conditions that guarantee the validity of Cauchy limit distribution for the OLS estimator and standard Gaussian limit distribution for the t-statistic under this extended explosive and mildly explosive framework.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 统一爆炸侧参数漂移序列的 OLS 极限理论
abstract_zh: 为最小二乘估计量开发了一种极限理论，用于在参数漂移序列下的轻度和纯爆炸性自回归，其自回归根 ρn 满足 ρn → ρ ε (—∞, —1] ∪ [1, ∞) 和 n (|ρn| —1) → ∞。还考虑了创新的漂移序列和初始条件。用于自回归创新的短记忆线性过程的标准规范被扩展到用于确定性权重和线性过程的原始创新的三角阵列公式，其允许是异方差L1混合。本文提供了在扩展爆炸性和轻度爆炸性框架下保证 OLS 估计量的柯西极限分布和 t 统计量的标准高斯极限分布的有效性的条件。

title: Regulating Decentralized Systems: Evidence from Sanctions on Tornado Cash
authors: Anders Brownworth, Jon Durfee, Michael Junho Lee, Antoine Martin
abstract: Blockchain-based systems are run by a decentralized network of participants and are designed to be censorship-resistant. We use sanctions imposed by the U.S. Department of Treasury on Tornado Cash (TC), a smart contract protocol, to study the impact and effectiveness of regulation in decentralized systems. We document an immediate and lasting impact on TC following the sanction announcement, measured by market reaction, transaction volume, and diversity of users. Still, net flows into TC contracts recover to and surpass pre-announcement levels for most pools, supporting viability of TC. Evidence on cooperation at the settlement layer is mixed: the aggregate share of non-cooperative blocks increases over time, but a shrinking number of actors process Tornado Cash transactions, indicating a fragility to the sustainability of censorship-resistance. Non-cooperation is not explained by tokenomics, and changes in perception around legal authority and clarity of regulation appears to be a key factor for whether to cooperate.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 监管去中心化系统：来自龙卷风现金制裁的证据
abstract_zh: 基于区块链的系统由分散的参与者网络运行，并且被设计为抗审查。我们利用美国财政部对智能合约协议 Tornado Cash (TC) 实施的制裁来研究去中心化系统中监管的影响和有效性。我们通过市场反应、交易量和用户多样性来衡量制裁公告后对 TC 的直接和持久影响。尽管如此，大多数资金池的 TC 合约净流入量已恢复至并超过公告前的水平，支撑了 TC 的生存能力。结算层合作的证据好坏参半：不合作区块的总份额随着时间的推移而增加，但处理龙卷风现金交易的参与者数量不断减少，这表明审查抵抗的可持续性的脆弱性。不合作不能用代币经济学来解释，围绕法律权威和监管清晰度的认知变化似乎是是否合作的关键因素。

title: Financing Private Credit
authors: Nina Boyarchenko, Leonardo Elias
abstract: Using data on balance sheets of both financial and nonfinancial sectors of the economy, we use a “demand system” approach to study how lender composition and willingness to provide credit affect the relationship between credit expansions and real activity. A key advantage of jointly modeling the demand for and supply of credit is the ability to evaluate equilibrium elasticities of credit quantities with respect to variables of interest. We document that the sectoral composition of lenders financing a credit expansion is a key determinant for subsequent real activity and crisis probability. We show that banks and nonbanks respond differentially to changes in macroeconomic conditions, with bank credit more sensitive to economic downturns. Our results thus suggest that secular changes in the structure of the financial sector will affect the dynamics of credit boom-bust cycles.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 私人信贷融资
abstract_zh: 利用经济中金融和非金融部门的资产负债表数据，我们采用“需求系统”方法来研究贷款人构成和提供信贷的意愿如何影响信贷扩张与实际活动之间的关系。联合建模信贷需求和供给的一个关键优势是能够评估信贷数量相对于利益变量的均衡弹性。我们证明，为信贷扩张融资的贷方的部门构成是后续实际活动和危机概率的关键决定因素。我们表明，银行和非银行对宏观经济状况变化的反应不同，银行信贷对经济衰退更为敏感。因此，我们的结果表明，金融部门结构的长期变化将影响信贷繁荣-萧条周期的动态。

title: Nonlinear Binscatter Methods
authors: Matias D. Cattaneo, Richard K. Crump, Max H. Farrell, Yingjie Feng
abstract: Binned scatter plots are a powerful statistical tool for empirical work in the social, behavioral, and biomedical sciences. Available methods rely on a quantile-based partitioning estimator of the conditional mean regression function to primarily construct flexible yet interpretable visualization methods, but they can also be used to estimate treatment effects, assess uncertainty, and test substantive domain-specific hypotheses. This paper introduces novel binscatter methods based on nonlinear, possibly nonsmooth M-estimation methods, covering generalized linear, robust, and quantile regression models. We provide a host of theoretical results and practical tools for local constant estimation along with piecewise polynomial and spline approximations, including (i) optimal tuning parameter (number of bins) selection, (ii) confidence bands, and (iii) formal statistical tests regarding functional form or shape restrictions. Our main results rely on novel strong approximations for general partitioning-based estimators covering random, data-driven partitions, which may be of independent interest. We demonstrate our methods with an empirical application studying the relation between the percentage of individuals without health insurance and per capita income at the zip-code level. We provide general-purpose software packages implementing our methods in Python, R, and Stata.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 非线性分箱法
abstract_zh: 分箱散点图是社会、行为和生物医学领域实证研究的强大统计工具。可用的方法依赖于条件均值回归函数的基于分位数的划分估计器来主要构建灵活但可解释的可视化方法，但它们也可用于估计治疗效果、评估不确定性和测试实质性的特定领域假设。本文介绍了基于非线性、可能非平滑 M 估计方法的新型 binscatter 方法，涵盖广义线性、鲁棒和分位数回归模型。我们提供了大量用于局部常数估计的理论结果和实用工具以及分段多项式和样条近似，包括（i）最佳调整参数（箱数）选择，（ii）置信带，以及（iii）有关函数形式或形状限制的正式统计测试。我们的主要结果依赖于基于通用分区的估计器的新颖的强近似，涵盖随机的、数据驱动的分区，这可能是独立的兴趣。我们通过实证应用来展示我们的方法，研究没有健康保险的个人百分比与邮政编码级别的人均收入之间的关系。我们提供通用软件包，在 Python、R 和 Stata 中实现我们的方法。

title: The Countercyclical Benefits of Regulatory Costs
authors: Alexander Mechanick, Jacob P. Weber
abstract: Legal academics, journalists, and senior executive branch officials alike have assumed that the cost of imposing new regulatory requirements is higher in severe recessions that drive the central bank’s policy rate to zero than in other times. This is not correct; the aggregate output costs of regulatory requirements decrease, not increase, in such recessions. This article is the first to analyze how this effect arises, drawing on both conventional macroeconomic models and empirical findings from the econometrics literature. Scholars and policymakers have likely missed the countercyclical benefits of regulatory costs because of informal, ad hoc macroeconomic assumptions embedded in regulatory analysis.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 监管成本的反周期效益
abstract_zh: 法律学者、记者和高级行政部门官员都认为，在严重衰退导致央行政策利率降至零的情况下，实施新监管要求的成本比其他时期更高。这是不正确的；在这种衰退中，监管要求的总产出成本会减少，而不是增加。本文首次利用传统宏观经济模型和计量经济学文献的实证结果来分析这种效应是如何产生的。由于监管分析中嵌入了非正式的、临时的宏观经济假设，学者和政策制定者可能错过了监管成本的反周期效益。

title: Unconventional Monetary Policies and Inequality
authors: Donggyu Lee
abstract: This paper examines the effects of unconventional monetary policies on household welfare across the wealth distribution following the Great Recession. Using a heterogeneous agent New Keynesian model, estimated with Bayesian methods, I analyze how forward guidance and quantitative easing affected inequality during this period. The findings show that while these policies boosted economic activity and benefited all households, they had non-linear distributional effects. Unconventional monetary policies reduced inequality within the bottom 90 percent by lowering unemployment but widened the income gap between the top 10 percent and the rest by raising profits and equity prices. Additionally, I find that forward guidance amplified both the aggregate and distributional effects of asset purchase programs. In comparison to conventional monetary policy, interest rate policy would have had more adverse distributional effects than quantitative easing if the policy rate had not been constrained by the zero lower bound.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 非常规货币政策和不平等
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了大衰退后非常规货币政策对整个财富分配过程中家庭福利的影响。我使用贝叶斯方法估计的异质代理新凯恩斯模型，分析了前瞻性指导和量化宽松如何影响这一时期的不平等。研究结果表明，虽然这些政策促进了经济活动并使所有家庭受益，但它们具有非线性分配效应。非常规货币政策通过降低失业率，减少了底层 90% 人口的不平等，但通过提高利润和股价，扩大了顶层 10% 人口与其他人口之间的收入差距。此外，我发现前瞻性指引放大了资产购买计划的总体效应和分配效应。与传统货币政策相比，如果政策利率不受零下限的约束，利率政策将比量化宽松产生更不利的分配效应。

title: Insurance, Weather, and Financial Stability
authors: Charles M. Kahn, Ahyan Panjwani, João A. C. Santos
abstract: In this paper, we introduce a model to study the interaction between insurance and banking. We build on the Federal Crop Insurance Act of 1980, which significantly expanded and restructured the decades-old federal crop insurance program and adverse weather shocks – over-exposure of crops to heat and acute weather events – to investigate some insights from our model. Banks increased lending to the agricultural sector in counties with higher insurance coverage after 1980, even when affected by adverse weather shocks. Further, while they increased risky lending, they were sufficiently compensated by insurance such that their overall risk did not increase meaningfully. We discuss the implications of our results in the light of potential changes to insurance availability as a consequence of global warming.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 保险、天气和金融稳定
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们介绍了一个模型来研究保险与银行之间的相互作用。我们以 1980 年《联邦作物保险法》为基础，该法显着扩展和重组了已有数十年历史的联邦作物保险计划和恶劣天气冲击（作物过度暴露于高温和急性天气事件），以研究我们模型中的一些见解。 1980 年后，即使受到恶劣天气冲击的影响，银行也增加了对保险覆盖率较高县的农业部门的贷款。此外，虽然他们增加了风险贷款，但他们得到了保险的充分补偿，因此他们的整体风险并没有显着增加。我们根据全球变暖对保险供应的潜在变化讨论我们的结果的影响。

title: The Financial Consequences of Undiagnosed Memory Disorders
authors: Carole Roan Gresenz, Jean M Mitchell, Belicia Rodriguez, R. Scott Turner, Wilbert Van der Klaauw
abstract: We examine the effect of undiagnosed memory disorders on credit outcomes using nationally representative credit reporting data merged with Medicare data. Years prior to eventual diagnosis, average credit scores begin to weaken and payment delinquency begins to increase, overall and for mortgage and credit card accounts specifically. Credit outcomes consistently deteriorate over the quarters leading up to diagnosis. The harmful financial effects of undiagnosed memory disorders exacerbate the already substantial financial pressure households face upon diagnosis of a memory disorder. Our findings substantiate the possible utility of credit reporting data for facilitating early identification of those at risk for memory disorders.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 未确诊的记忆障碍的经济后果
abstract_zh: 我们使用具有全国代表性的信用报告数据与医疗保险数据合并，研究了未诊断的记忆障碍对信用结果的影响。在最终诊断之前的几年，总体而言，尤其是抵押贷款和信用卡账户，平均信用评分开始下降，拖欠付款的情况开始增加。在诊断前的几个季度中，信用结果持续恶化。未确诊的记忆障碍所带来​​的有害经济影响，加剧了家庭在诊断出记忆障碍后所面临的巨大经济压力。我们的研究结果证实了信用报告数据对于促进早期识别那些有记忆障碍风险的人的可能用途。

title: Wage Insurance for Displaced Workers
authors: Benjamin Hyman, Brian K. Kovak, Adam Leive
abstract: Wage insurance provides income support to displaced workers who find reemployment at a lower wage. We analyze wage insurance in the context of the U.S. Trade Adjustment Assistance (TAA) program by merging linked employer-employee Census data to TAA petitions and leveraging a discontinuity in eligibility based on worker age. Wage insurance eligibility increases short-run employment probabilities and leads to higher long-run cumulative earnings. We find shorter non-employment durations largely drive increased long-term earnings among workers eligible for wage insurance. Our results are quantitatively consistent with a standard non-stationary partial equilibrium search model. The program is self-financing even under conservative assumptions.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 失业工人工资保险
abstract_zh: 工资保险为以较低工资重新就业的失业工人提供收入支持。我们通过将关联的雇主-雇员人口普查数据与 TAA 申请合并，并利用基于工人年龄的资格不连续性，在美国贸易调整援助 (TAA) 计划的背景下分析工资保险。工资保险资格增加了短期就业概率，并导致更高的长期累积收入。我们发现，较短的非就业持续时间在很大程度上推动了有资格享受工资保险的工人长期收入的增加。我们的结果在数量上与标准非平稳部分平衡搜索模型一致。即使在保守的假设下，该计划也是自筹资金的。

title: Tracing Bank Runs in Real Time
authors: Marco Cipriani, Thomas M. Eisenbach, Anna Kovner
abstract: Using high-frequency interbank payments data to trace deposit flows in March 2023, we identify twentytwo bank runs — ten times the two bank failures. Runs are driven by relatively few but large depositors fleeing to the largest banks and out of the banking system altogether. Run banks’ characteristics highlight a role for both fundamental and non-fundamental drivers of runs, including solvency, liquidity, deposit concentration and coordination through public signals. Surviving banks bridge the deposit reallocation by borrowing from Federal Home Loan Banks and the discount window, eventually replacing lost uninsured deposits with insured deposits at higher rates in the medium term.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 实时追踪银行挤兑情况
abstract_zh: 使用高频银行间支付数据追踪 2023 年 3 月的存款流向，我们发现了 22 起银行挤兑事件，是两家银行倒闭事件的十倍。挤兑是由相对较少但规模较大的储户逃往最大的银行并完全逃离银行系统造成的。挤兑银行的特征凸显了挤兑的基本面和非基本面驱动因素的作用，包括偿付能力、流动性、存款集中度以及通过公共信号进行的协调。幸存的银行通过从联邦住房贷款银行借款和贴现窗口来弥补存款的重新分配，最终在中期内以更高的利率用保险存款取代损失的未保险存款。

title: Can Discount Window Stigma Be Cured? An Experimental Investigation
authors: Olivier Armantier, Charles Holt
abstract: A core responsibility of a central bank is to ensure financial stability by acting as the “lender of last resort” through its Discount Window. The Discount Window, however, has not been effective because its usage is stigmatized. In this paper, we study experimentally how such stigma can be cured. We find that, once a Discount Window facility is stigmatized, removing stigma is difficult. This result is consistent with the Federal Reserve’s experiences which have been unsuccessful at removing the stigma associated with its Discount Window.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 折扣窗口耻辱可以治愈吗？实验研究
abstract_zh: 中央银行的核心职责是通过贴现窗口充当“最后贷款人”，确保金融稳定。然而，折扣窗口并没有发挥作用，因为它的使用受到了污名化。在本文中，我们通过实验研究了如何消除这种耻辱。我们发现，一旦折扣窗口设施被污名化，消除污名就很困难。这一结果与美联储在消除贴现窗口相关耻辱方面未能成功的经验是一致的。

title: Natural Centralization in Decentralized Finance
authors: Pablo D. Azar, Adrian Casillas, Maryam Farboodi
abstract: Can centralization arise absent barriers to entry? We confront this question by studying the Ethereum blockchain, a market featuring permissionless entry, standardized protocols, and a transparent public ledger. We show that natural centralization emerges when information asymmetry confronts risk-sharing. Using a novel dataset distinguishing private from public order flow, we find that a 1 percent increase in the value of private information causally increases an intermediary’s profit share by 0.57 percent. We use a dynamic bargaining model to illustrate that intermediaries leverage private information by threatening to withhold valuable trades, creating an outside option that sustains their market power. Our results provide causal evidence that information can be a fundamental source of endogenous centralization in the market structure, demonstrating how natural oligopolies can emerge even in purportedly decentralized economies.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 去中心化金融中的自然中心化
abstract_zh: 如果没有进入壁垒，集中化会产生吗？我们通过研究以太坊区块链来面对这个问题，以太坊区块链是一个具有无需许可进入、标准化协议和透明公共账本的市场。我们表明，当信息不对称面临风险分担时，就会出现自然的集中化。使用区分私人订单流和公共订单流的新颖数据集，我们发现私人信息价值每增加 1%，中介机构的利润份额就会增加 0.57%。我们使用动态讨价还价模型来说明中介机构通过威胁扣留有价值的交易来利用私人信息，从而创造维持其市场力量的外部选择。我们的研究结果提供了因果证据，表明信息可以成为市场结构内生集中化的基本来源，证明即使在所谓的去中心化经济体中，自然寡头垄断也是如何出现的。

title: Do Mortgage Lenders Respond to Flood Risk?
authors: Kristian S. Blickle, Evan Perry, João A. C. Santos
abstract: Using unique nationwide property-level mortgage, flood risk, and flood map data, we analyze whether lenders respond to flood risk that is not captured in FEMA flood maps. We find that lenders are less willing to originate mortgages and charge higher rates for lower LTV loans that face “un-mapped” flood risk. This effect is weaker for high income applicants, as well as non-banks and small local banks. However, we find evidence that non-banks and local banks are more likely to securitize/sell mortgages to borrowers prone to flood risk. Taken together, our results are indicative that mortgage lenders are aware of flood risk outside FEMA’s identified flood zones.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 抵押贷款机构是否应对洪水风险？
abstract_zh: 使用独特的全国性财产级抵押贷款、洪水风险和洪水地图数据，我们分析贷款人是否对 FEMA 洪水地图中未捕获的洪水风险做出反应。我们发现，贷方不太愿意发放抵押贷款，并对面临“未映射”洪水风险的贷款价值较低的贷款收取更高的利率。对于高收入申请人以及非银行和小型本地银行来说，这种影响较弱。然而，我们发现有证据表明，非银行和本地银行更有可能将抵押贷款证券化/出售给容易遭受洪水风险的借款人。总而言之，我们的结果表明抵押贷款机构意识到 FEMA 确定的洪水区域之外的洪水风险。

title: The Nonlinear Case Against Leaning Against the Wind
authors: Nina Boyarchenko, Richard K. Crump, Keshav Dogra, Leonardo Elias, Ignacio Lopez Gaffney
abstract: We re-examine the relationship between monetary policy and financial stability in a setting that allows for nonlinear, time-varying relationships between monetary policy, financial stability, and macroeconomic outcomes. Using novel machine-learning techniques, we estimate a flexible “nonlinear VAR” for the stance of monetary policy, real activity, inflation, and financial conditions, and evaluate counterfactual evolutions of downside risk to real activity under alternative monetary policy paths. We find that a tighter path of monetary policy in 2003-05 would have increased the risk of adverse real outcomes three to four years ahead, especially if the tightening had been large or rapid. This suggests that there is limited evidence to support “leaning against the wind” even once one allows for rich nonlinearities, intertemporal dependence, and crisis predictability.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 反对逆风而行的非线性案例
abstract_zh: 我们在允许货币政策、金融稳定和宏观经济结果之间存在非线性、时变关系的环境中重新审视货币政策和金融稳定之间的关系。使用新颖的机器学习技术，我们估计货币政策、实际活动、通货膨胀和金融状况立场的灵活“非线性VAR”，并评估替代货币政策路径下实际活动下行风险的反事实演变。我们发现，2003-05 年收紧的货币政策将增加未来三到四年出现不利实际结果的风险，特别是如果收紧幅度较大或较快的话。这表明，即使考虑到丰富的非线性、跨期依赖性和危机可预测性，支持“逆风而行”的证据也是有限的。

title: Personal Bankruptcy Protection and Household Debt
authors: Meta Brown, Rajashri Chakrabarti, Felipe Severino
abstract: Increasing personal bankruptcy protection raises consumers’ desire to borrow and lenders’ cost of extending credit; the impact on equilibrium borrowing is ambiguous. Using bankruptcy protection changes between 1999 and 2005 across U.S. states, we find that borrowers respond to greater protection by increasing their unsecured debt. Border county estimates suggest that local economic conditions do not drive these results. Borrowers pay more for protection through higher interest rates, yet delinquency is unaffected. Remarkably, our results indicate that rising borrower demand outstripped decreasing supply. Increased protections did not reduce the aggregate level of household debt but affected the composition of borrowing.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 个人破产保护和家庭债务
abstract_zh: 增加个人破产保护会提高消费者的借贷意愿和贷款人提供信贷的成本；对均衡借贷的影响是不明确的。根据 1999 年至 2005 年美国各州破产保护的变化，我们发现借款人通过增加无担保债务来应对更大的保护。边境县的估计表明，当地经济条件并不会推动这些结果。借款人通过更高的利率支付更多的费用来获得保护，但拖欠行为不受影响。值得注意的是，我们的结果表明借款人需求的增长超过了供应的下降。保护措施的增加并没有降低家庭债务的总体水平，而是影响了借款的构成。

title: Is There Hope for the Expectations Hypothesis?
authors: Richard K. Crump, Stefano Eusepi, Emanuel Moench
abstract: Most macroeconomic models impose a tight link between the term structure of interest rates and expected future short rates via the expectations hypothesis (EH). While systematically rejected in the data, existing tests of the EH typically assume full information rational expectations, stationarity of beliefs, or both. As such, they are ill-equipped to refute the EH when these assumptions fail to hold, leaving the door open for a “resurrection.” We re-evaluate the EH using direct measures of expected short rates from all available U.S. surveys of professional forecasters, combined with a parsimonious model of expectations formation to construct the term structure of expectations. We show that deviations from rationality and time variation in long-run beliefs consistent with the observed survey data, while sizable, do not come close to bridging the gap between the term structure of expectations and the term structure of interest rates. We introduce a novel test of the EH and show that the EH is decisively rejected in the data. Outside of short maturities, expectations display, at best, only a weak co-movement with the forward rates of corresponding maturities, both unconditionally and in response to a monetary policy shock.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 预期假说还有希望吗？
abstract_zh: 大多数宏观经济模型通过预期假设（EH）在利率期限结构和预期未来短期利率之间建立了紧密联系。虽然数据被系统地拒绝，但现有的 EH 测试通常假设完整的信息理性预期、信念的稳定性或两者兼而有之。因此，当这些假设不成立时，他们没有能力反驳 EH，从而为“复活”敞开了大门。我们使用所有可用的美国专业预测者调查中预期短期利率的直接衡量标准，结合预期形成的简约模型来重新评估 EH，以构建预期的期限结构。我们表明，与观察到的调查数据一致的长期信念的理性偏差和时间变化虽然相当大，但并没有接近弥合预期期限结构和利率期限结构之间的差距。我们引入了一种新颖的 EH 测试，并表明 EH 在数据中被果断拒绝。除了短期期限之外，预期充其量只能与相应期限的远期利率出现微弱的联动，无论是无条件的还是对货币政策冲击的反应。

title: The Life-Cycle Dynamics of Wealth Mobility
authors: Richard Audoly, Rory McGee, Sergio Ocampo, Gonzalo Paz-Pardo
abstract: We use 25 years of tax records for the Norwegian population to study the mobility of wealth over people’s lifetimes. We find considerable wealth mobility over the life cycle—exceeding income mobility. To understand the underlying mobility patterns, we group individuals with similar wealth histories using agglomerative hierarchical clustering, a tool from statistical learning. The mobility patterns we elicit provide evidence of segmented mobility. Over 60 percent of the population remains at the top or bottom of the wealth distribution throughout their lives. Mobility is driven by the remaining 40 percent, who move only within the middle of the distribution, reflecting glass ceilings preventing most people from rising to the top or from the bottom of the distribution. We show parental wealth is the key predictor of who is persistently rich or poor, while human capital is the main predictor of those who rise and fall through the middle of the distribution. Highly-educated individuals drive upwards mobility by converting high labor incomes into property wealth early in life and financial assets afterwards. Downward mobility is primarily driven by declining or stalling business wealth.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 财富流动的生命周期动态
abstract_zh: 我们使用挪威人口 25 年的税务记录来研究人们一生中的财富流动性。我们发现生命周期中的财富流动性相当大——超过了收入流动性。为了了解潜在的流动模式，我们使用凝聚层次聚类（统计学习的工具）将具有相似财富历史的个人分组。我们得出的流动模式提供了分段流动的证据。超过60%的人口一生都处于财富分配的顶部或底部。流动性是由剩下的 40% 驱动的，他们只在分布的中间范围内流动，这反映出玻璃天花板阻止了大多数人上升到分布的顶部或底部。我们证明，父母的财富是谁持续富裕或贫穷的关键预测因素，而人力资本是那些在分布中间的上升和下降的主要预测因素。受过高等教育的人通过将高劳动收入转化为早期的财产财富和随后的金融资产来推动向上流动。向下流动性主要是由企业财富下降或停滞所驱动的。

title: Securing Technological Leadership? The Cost of Export Controls on Firms
authors: Matteo Crosignani, Lina Han, Marco Macchiavelli, André F. Silva
abstract: To safeguard its technological leadership, the U.S. has restricted domestic suppliers from exporting specific cutting-edge technologies to selected Chinese firms. Domestic firms affected by these export controls halt sales to Chinese customers, as intended, but struggle to establish new relations with alternative customers domestically or in politically aligned regions. As a result, domestic suppliers experience a $130 billion decline in market capitalization, along with reductions in profitability, employment, and bank lending. We also show how Chinese firms strategically respond to export controls. Overall, export controls impose significant costs on domestic firms producing the very technologies these policies intend to protect.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 确保技术领先地位？出口管制对企业的成本
abstract_zh: 为了维护其技术领先地位，美国限制国内供应商向特定的中国企业出口特定的尖端技术。受这些出口管制影响的国内公司按计划停止向中国客户销售，但很难与国内或政治一致地区的其他客户建立新关系。结果，国内供应商的市值下降了 1300 亿美元，盈利能力、就业和银行贷款也随之减少。我们还展示了中国企业如何战略性地应对出口管制。总体而言，出口管制给生产这些政策旨在保护的技术的国内企业带来了巨大成本。

title: Investor Attention to Bank Risk During the Spring 2023 Bank Run
authors: Natalia Fischl-Lanzoni, Martin Hiti, Nathan Kaplan, Asani Sarkar
abstract: We examine how investors’ perceptions of bank balance sheet risk evolved before and during the bank run in March-April 2023. To do so, we estimate the covariance (“beta”) of bank excess stock returns with returns on factors constructed from long-short portfolios sorted on shares of uninsured deposits and unrealized losses on securities. We find that investor perception of bank risk shifted, as the factor betas are insignificant before the bank run but become positive and significant during the run. In the crosssection, increases in the betas occurred for a limited set of banks and cannot be predicted by balance sheet risk in Q3 or Q4 of 2022. Instead, we find evidence that published bank news coordinated investor actions: they are informative to stock investors and significantly affect factor betas during the bank run, even three days after publication. In particular, for banks downgraded by rating agencies during the run, news arrivals increased (decreased) the share of factor betas that responded positively (negatively) to news. These results suggest that stock market investors have limited ability to discipline banks in a timely fashion during a bank run.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 2023年春季银行挤兑期间投资者对银行风险的关注
abstract_zh: 我们研究了投资者在 2023 年 3 月至 4 月银行挤兑之前和期间对银行资产负债表风险的看法如何演变。为此，我们估计了银行超额股票收益与根据未保险存款份额和未实现证券损失排序的多空投资组合构建的因子收益的协方差（“beta”）。我们发现投资者对银行风险的看法发生了变化，因为因子贝塔在银行挤兑之前微不足道，但在挤兑期间变得积极且显着。在横截面中，贝塔值的增加发生在有限的银行中，并且无法通过 2022 年第三季度或第四季度的资产负债表风险来预测。相反，我们发现有证据表明发布的银行新闻协调了投资者的行动：它们为股票投资者提供了信息，并在银行挤兑期间显着影响因子贝塔值，甚至在发布三天后也是如此。特别是，对于在运行期间被评级机构下调评级的银行来说，新闻到来增加（减少）了对新闻做出积极（消极）反应的贝塔系数比例。这些结果表明，股市投资者在银行挤兑期间及时约束银行的能力有限。

title: The Global Credit Cycle
authors: Nina Boyarchenko, Leonardo Elias
abstract: We document a global credit cycle that generates predictable co-movement in corporate bond returns worldwide. Using a large panel of international corporate bonds, we construct a single factor as a nonlinear function of credit spreads, equity market volatility, and their interactions. The global credit factor explains up to 13 percent of in-sample and up to 8 percent of out-of-sample variation in bond-level three-month-ahead returns. Unlike broader measures of global financial conditions, the global credit factor simultaneously captures time-series return predictability and cross-sectional differences in risk exposures across ratings, currencies, and countries. Tighter global credit conditions are associated with deteriorations in local credit conditions and outflows from global bond funds. Taken together, our results are consistent with the factor proxying for a common, time-varying global price of credit risk.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 全球信贷周期
abstract_zh: 我们记录了全球信贷周期，该周期在全球范围内产生了可预测的公司债券回报联动。我们利用大量国际公司债券，构建了一个单一因素作为信用利差、股市波动及其相互作用的非线性函数。全球信用因子解释了债券水平未来三个月回报率中高达 13% 的样本内变化和高达 8% 的样本外变化。与更广泛的全球金融状况衡量标准不同，全球信用因子同时捕捉时间序列回报的可预测性以及评级、货币和国家之间风险敞口的横截面差异。全球信贷状况收紧与当地信贷状况恶化和全球债券基金流出相关。总而言之，我们的结果与代表共同的、随时间变化的全球信用风险价格的因素是一致的。

title: Paradoxes and Problems in the Causal Interpretation of Equilibrium Economics
authors: Keshav Dogra
abstract: Equilibrium assumptions posit relations between different people's beliefs and behavior without describing a process that causes these relations to hold. I show that because equilibrium models do not describe a causal process whereby one endogenous variable affects another, attempts to decompose the effects of shocks into “direct” and “indirect” effects can suggest misleading predictions about how these models work. Equilibrium assumptions also imply absurd paradoxes: history can determine future behavior without affecting any intervening state variables today; individuals can learn information that no one originally possesses by observing each other’s actions. This makes equilibrium models unreliable tools to study how economic systems coordinate activity and aggregate dispersed information. I describe how to construct non-equilibrium models that avoid these paradoxes and can be interpreted causally.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 均衡经济学因果解释中的悖论与问题
abstract_zh: 均衡假设假定了不同人的信念和行为之间的关系，但没有描述导致这些关系成立的过程。我表明，由于均衡模型没有描述一个内生变量影响另一个内生变量的因果过程，因此尝试将冲击的影响分解为“直接”和“间接”影响可能会对这些模型的运作方式提出误导性的预测。均衡假设还意味着荒谬的悖论：历史可以决定未来的行为，而不影响今天的任何干预状态变量；个体可以通过观察彼此的行为来了解原本没有人拥有的信息。这使得均衡模型成为研究经济系统如何协调活动和聚合分散信息的可靠工具。我描述了如何构建避免这些悖论并且可以因果解释的非平衡模型。

title: Miss-Allocation: The Value of Workplace Gender Composition and Occupational Segregation
authors: Rachel Schuh
abstract: I analyze the value workers ascribe to the gender composition of their workplace and the consequences of these valuations for occupational segregation, tipping, and welfare. To elicit these valuations, I survey 9,000 U.S. adults using a hypothetical job choice experiment. This reveals that on average women and men value gender diversity, but these average preferences mask substantial heterogeneity. Older female workers are more likely to value gender homophily. This suggests that gender norms and discrimination, which have declined over time, may help explain some women’s desire for homophily. Using these results, I estimate a structural model of occupation choice to assess the influence of gender composition preferences on gender sorting and welfare. I find that workers’ composition valuations are not large enough to create tipping points, but they do reduce female employment in male-dominated occupations substantially. Reducing segregation could improve welfare: making all occupations evenly gender balanced improves utility as much as a 0.4 percent wage increase for women and a 1 percent wage increase for men, on average.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 错误分配：工作场所性别构成和职业隔离的价值
abstract_zh: 我分析了员工对其工作场所性别构成的评价，以及这些评价对职业隔离、小费和福利的影响。为了得出这些评价，我使用假设的工作选择实验对 9,000 名美国成年人进行了调查。这表明，平均而言，女性和男性都重视性别多样性，但这些平均偏好掩盖了巨大的异质性。年长的女性员工更有可能重视性别同质性。这表明，随着时间的推移，性别规范和歧视逐渐减少，这可能有助于解释一些女性对同质性的渴望。利用这些结果，我估计了职业选择的结构模型，以评估性别构成偏好对性别排序和福利的影响。我发现工人的构成估值还不足以创造临界点，但它们确实大大减少了男性主导职业中的女性就业。减少隔离可以改善福利：使所有职业均匀地实现性别平衡，可以提高效用，平均而言，女性工资增加 0.4%，男性工资增加 1%。

title: International Banking and Nonbank Financial Intermediation: Global Liquidity, Regulation, and Implications
authors: Claudia M. Buch, Linda S. Goldberg
abstract: Global liquidity flows are largely channeled through banks and nonbank financial institutions. The common drivers of global liquidity flows include monetary policy in advanced economies and risk conditions. At the same time, the sensitivities of liquidity flows to changes in these drivers differ across institutions and have been evolving over time. Microprudential regulation of banks plays a role, influencing leverage and capitalization, changing sensitivities to shocks, and also driving risk migration from banks to nonbank financial institutions. Risk sensitivities and flightiness of global liquidity are now strongest in more leveraged nonbank financial institutions, raising challenges in stress episodes. Current policy initiatives target linkages across different types of financial institutions and associated risks. Meanwhile, significant gaps remain. This paper concludes by discussing policy options for addressing systemic risk in banks and nonbanks.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 国际银行和非银行金融中介：全球流动性、监管和影响
abstract_zh: 全球流动性流动主要通过银行和非银行金融机构进行。全球流动性流动的共同驱动因素包括发达经济体的货币政策和风险状况。与此同时，流动性流动对这些驱动因素变化的敏感性因机构而异，并且随着时间的推移而不断变化。银行的微观审慎监管发挥着重要作用，影响杠杆率和资本化，改变对冲击的敏感性，并推动风险从银行向非银行金融机构转移。目前，杠杆率较高的非银行金融机构的风险敏感性和全球流动性的波动最为强烈，这给压力时期带来了挑战。当前的政策举措旨在不同类型的金融机构和相关风险之间的联系。与此同时，仍然存在巨大差距。本文最后讨论了解决银行和非银行系统性风险的政策选择。

title: Micro Responses to Macro Shocks
authors: Martín Almuzara, Víctor Sancibrián
abstract: We study panel data regression models when the shocks of interest are aggregate and possibly small relative to idiosyncratic noise. This speaks to a large empirical literature that targets impulse responses via panel local projections. We show how to interpret the estimated coefficients when units have heterogeneous responses and how to obtain valid standard errors and confidence intervals. A simple recipe leads to robust inference: including lags as controls and then clustering at the time level. This strategy is valid under general error dynamics and uniformly over the degree of signal-to-noise of macro shocks.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 对宏观冲击的微观反应
abstract_zh: 当感兴趣的冲击是聚合的并且相对于特殊噪声可能很小时，我们研究面板数据回归模型。这涉及到大量的实证文献，这些文献通过面板局部投影来确定脉冲响应。我们展示了当单位具有异质响应时如何解释估计系数以及如何获得有效的标准误差和置信区间。一个简单的方法可以产生稳健的推理：包括滞后作为控制，然后在时间级别进行聚类。该策略在一般误差动态下有效，并且在宏观冲击的信噪比范围内一致。

title: Spillovers and Spillbacks
authors: Sushant Acharya, Paolo Pesenti
abstract: We study international monetary policy spillovers and spillbacks in a tractable two-country Heterogeneous Agent New Keynesian model. Relative to Representative Agent (RANK) models, our framework introduces a precautionary-savings channel, as households in both countries face uninsurable income risk, and a real-income channel, as households have heterogeneous marginal propensities to consume (MPC). While both channels amplify the size of spillovers/spillbacks, only precautionary savings can change their sign relative to RANK. Spillovers are likely to be larger in economies with higher fractions of high MPC households and more countercyclical income risk. Quantitatively, both channels amplify spillovers by 30-60 percent relative to RANK.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 溢出和回溢
abstract_zh: 我们在易于处理的两国异质代理新凯恩斯主义模型中研究国际货币政策溢出和溢出。相对于代表代理人（RANK）模型，我们的框架引入了预防性储蓄渠道（因为两国家庭都面临不可保险的收入风险）和实际收入渠道（因为家庭具有异质的边际消费倾向（MPC））。虽然这两个渠道都会放大溢出/回溢的规模，但只有预防性储蓄才能改变它们相对于 RANK 的符号。在高 MPC 家庭比例较高且反周期收入风险较多的经济体中，溢出效应可能会更大。从数量上来说，相对于 RANK，两个渠道的溢出效应都放大了 30-60%。

title: Nonlinear Firm Dynamics
authors: Davide Melcangi, Silvia Sarpietro
abstract: This paper presents empirical evidence on the nature of idiosyncratic shocks to firms and discusses its role for firm behavior and aggregate fluctuations. We document that firm-level sales and productivity are hit by heavy-tailed shocks, mostly unexplained by observable factors, and follow a nonlinear stochastic process, thus departing from the linear AR(1). We estimate a state-of-the-art model to flexibly capture the rich dynamics uncovered in the data and characterize the drivers of nonlinear persistence and non-Gaussian shocks. We show the implications of these features for the volatility and persistence of micro-originated (granular) aggregate fluctuations.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 非线性企业动力学
abstract_zh: 本文提供了关于企业特殊冲击性质的经验证据，并讨论了其对企业行为和总体波动的作用。我们记录了公司层面的销售和生产率受到重尾冲击的影响，大部分无法用可观察因素来解释，并且遵循非线性随机过程，从而偏离线性 AR(1)。我们估计了最先进的模型，可以灵活地捕获数据中发现的丰富动态，并表征非线性持久性和非高斯冲击的驱动因素。我们展示了这些特征对微观（粒状）总体波动的波动性和持久性的影响。

title: Drivers of Dollar Share in Foreign Exchange Reserves
authors: Linda S. Goldberg, Oliver Zain Hannaoui
abstract: The share of U.S. dollar assets in the official foreign exchange reserve portfolios of central banks, at times, is taken as an indicator of the dollar’s global status. We provide a decomposition that shows two distinct channels contributing to the changes in the dollar share of reserves aggregated across countries: shifts in preferences for dollar assets and changes in reserve balances driven by countries whose portfolio allocations differ from the aggregate. We document how the concentrated nature of foreign exchange reserve holdings allows countries that contribute a large share of aggregated reserves to exert substantial influence on aggregate dollar shares over time, potentially dominating the narrative. In recent periods, the key contributors to changes in aggregate preference shifts for dollar assets are changes in bilateral country trade with the United States and dollar debt share, with geopolitics additionally working through the investment tranches of central bank portfolios. Diversification away from dollar assets is more prevalent conditional on official reserves of countries being large enough to satisfy country liquidity needs.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 美元在外汇储备中所占份额的驱动因素
abstract_zh: 美元资产在各国央行官方外汇储备投资组合中所占的份额有时被视为美元全球地位的指标。我们提供了一个分解，显示了导致各国合计储备中美元份额变化的两个不同渠道：美元资产偏好的转变以及由投资组合配置与总量不同的国家驱动的储备余额变化。我们记录了外汇储备持有量的集中性如何使得在总储备中贡献较大份额的国家随着时间的推移对美元总份额产生重大影响，从而有可能主导这一叙述。最近一段时期，美元资产总体偏好变化变化的关键因素是与美国的双边贸易和美元债务份额的变化，此外地缘政治还通过央行投资组合的投资部分发挥作用。如果国家的官方储备足够大，能够满足国家的流动性需求，那么美元资产的多元化更为普遍。

title: The Unemployment-Inflation Trade-off Revisited: The Phillips Curve in COVID Times
authors: Richard K. Crump, Stefano Eusepi, Marc Giannoni, Aysegul Sahin
abstract: Using a New Keynesian Phillips curve, we document the rapid and persistent increase in the natural rate of unemployment, ut*, in the aftermath of the pandemic and characterize its implications for inflation dynamics. While the bulk of the inflation surge is attributed to temporary supply factors, we also find an important role for current and expected negative unemployment gaps. Through the lens of the model, the 2022-23 disinflation was driven by the expectation that the unemployment gap will close through a progressive decline in ut* and a rise in the unemployment rate. This implies that convergence to long-run price stability depends critically on expectations about labor market tightness. Using a variety of cross-sectional data sources, we provide corroborating evidence of unusually tight labor market conditions, consistent with our estimated rise in ut*.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 重新审视失业与通胀之间的权衡：新冠时代的菲利普斯曲线
abstract_zh: 我们使用新凯恩斯菲利普斯曲线记录了大流行之后自然失业率 ut* 的快速持续增长，并描述了其对通胀动态的影响。虽然通胀飙升大部分归因于临时供应因素，但我们也发现当前和预期的负失业率差距也发挥着重要作用。从模型的角度来看，2022-23 年的通货紧缩是由失业差距将通过 ut* 逐步下降和失业率上升而缩小的预期推动的。这意味着长期价格稳定的趋同主要取决于对劳动力市场紧张的预期。使用各种横截面数据源，我们提供了劳动力市场状况异常紧张的确凿证据，这与我们估计的 ut* 增长一致。

title: Self-Employment and Labor Market Risks
authors: Richard Audoly
abstract: I study the labor market risks associated with being self-employed. I document that the self-employed are subject to larger earnings fluctuations than employees and that they frequently transition into unemployment. Given that the self-employed are not eligible to unemployment insurance, I analyze the provision of benefits targeted at these risks using a calibrated search model with (i) precautionary savings, (ii) work opportunities in paid and self-employment, and (iii) skill heterogeneity. This exercise suggests that extending the current U.S. unemployment insurance scheme to the self-employed comes with a clear increase in the transition rate from self-employment to unemployment and an unequal benefits-to-contributions ratio across skill groups. At the calibrated parameters, the self-employed in the middle of the skill distribution lose welfare.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 自营职业和劳动力市场风险
abstract_zh: 我研究与个体经营相关的劳动力市场风险。我记录到，自营职业者的收入波动比雇员更大，而且他们经常陷入失业状态。鉴于自营职业者没有资格领取失业保险，我使用校准搜索模型分析了针对这些风险的福利提供情况，其中包括（i）预防性储蓄，（ii）带薪和自营职业的工作机会，以及（iii）技能异质性。这项研究表明，将当前的美国失业保险计划扩大到自营职业者，会导致从自营职业到失业的转变率明显增加，并且不同技能群体的福利与缴款比率不平等。在校准参数下，处于技能分布中间的自营职业者会失去福利。

title: On the Validity of Classical and Bayesian DSGE-Based Inference
authors: Katerina Petrova
abstract: This paper studies large sample classical and Bayesian inference in a prototypical linear DSGE model and demonstrates that inference on the structural parameters based on a Gaussian likelihood is unaffected by departures from Gaussianity of the structural shocks. This surprising result is due to a cancellation in the asymptotic variance resulting into a generalized information equality for the block corresponding to the structural parameters. The underlying reason for the cancellation is the certainty equivalence property of the linear rational expectation model. The main implication of this result is that classical and Bayesian Gaussian inference achieve a semi-parametric efficiency bound and there is no need for a “sandwich-form” correction of the asymptotic variance of the structural parameters. Consequently, MLE-based confidence intervals and Bayesian credible sets of the deep parameters based on a Gaussian likelihood have correct asymptotic coverage even when the structural shocks are non-Gaussian. On the other hand, inference on the reduced-form parameters characterizing the volatility of the shocks is invalid whenever the structural shocks have a non-Gaussian density and the paper proposes a simple Metropolis-within-Gibbs algorithm that achieves correct large sample inference for the volatility parameters.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 论基于经典和贝叶斯 DSGE 的推理的有效性
abstract_zh: 本文研究了原型线性 DSGE 模型中的大样本经典和贝叶斯推理，并证明基于高斯似然的结构参数推理不受结构冲击高斯性偏离的影响。这个令人惊讶的结果是由于渐近方差的抵消导致与结构参数相对应的块的广义信息相等。取消的根本原因是线性理性预期模型的确定性等价性质。这一结果的主要含义是经典和贝叶斯高斯推理实现了半参数效率界限，并且不需要对结构参数的渐近方差进行“三明治形式”校正。因此，即使结构冲击是非高斯的，基于 MLE 的置信区间和基于高斯似然的贝叶斯可信深度参数集也具有正确的渐近覆盖范围。另一方面，当结构性冲击具有非高斯密度时，对表征冲击波动性的简化形式参数的推断是无效的，本文提出了一种简单的吉布斯内都市算法，该算法可以实现对波动性参数的正确大样本推断。

title: Monetary Policy across Inflation Regimes
authors: Valeria Gargiulo, Christian Matthes, Katerina Petrova
abstract: Does the effect of monetary policy depend on the prevailing level of inflation? In order to answer this question, we construct a parsimonious nonlinear time series model that allows for inflation regimes. We find that the effects of monetary policy are markedly different when year-over-year inflation exceeds 5.5 percent. Below this threshold, changes in monetary policy have a short-lived effect on prices, but no effect on the unemployment rate, giving a potential explanation for the recent “soft landing” in the United States. Above this threshold, the effects of monetary policy surprises on both inflation and unemployment can be larger and longer lasting.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 通货膨胀制度下的货币政策
abstract_zh: 货币政策的效果是否取决于当前的通货膨胀水平？为了回答这个问题，我们构建了一个考虑到通货膨胀机制的简约非线性时间序列模型。我们发现，当同比通胀超过5.5%时，货币政策的效果明显不同。低于这个阈值，货币政策的变化对物价的影响是短暂的，但对失业率没有影响，这为美国最近的“软着陆”提供了一个可能的解释。超过这个阈值，货币政策意外对通胀和失业的影响可能更大、更持久。

title: The New York Fed DSGE Model: A Post-Covid Assessment
authors: Marco Del Negro, Keshav Dogra, Aidan Gleich, Pranay Gundam, Donggyu Lee, Ramya Nallamotu, Brian Pacula
abstract: We document the real-time forecasting performance for output and inflation of the New York Fed dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) model since 2011. We find the DSGE's accuracy to be comparable to that of private forecasters before Covid, but somewhat worse thereafter.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 纽约联储 DSGE 模型：疫情后评估
abstract_zh: 我们记录了自 2011 年以来纽约联储动态随机一般均衡 (DSGE) 模型对产出和通胀的实时预测表现。我们发现 DSGE 的准确性与新冠疫情之前的私人预测机构相当，但此后稍差。

title: Fed Transparency and Policy Expectation Errors: A Text Analysis Approach
authors: Eric Fischer, Rebecca McCaughrin, Saketh Prazad, Mark Vandergon
abstract: This paper seeks to estimate the extent to which market-implied policy expectations could be improved with further information disclosure from the FOMC. Using text analysis methods based on large language models, we show that if FOMC meeting materials with five-year lagged release dates—like meeting transcripts and Tealbooks—were accessible to the public in real time, market policy expectations could substantially improve forecasting accuracy. Most of this improvement occurs during easing cycles. For instance, at the six-month forecasting horizon, the market could have predicted as much as 125 basis points of additional easing during the 2001 and 2008 recessions, equivalent to a 40-50 percent reduction in mean squared error. This potential forecasting improvement appears to be related to incomplete information about the Fed’s reaction function, particularly with respect to financial stability concerns in 2008. In contrast, having enhanced access to meeting materials would not have improved the market’s policy rate forecasting during tightening cycles.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 美联储透明度和政策预期错误：文本分析方法
abstract_zh: 本文旨在估计随着联邦公开市场委员会进一步披露信息，市场隐含政策预期可以改善的程度。使用基于大语言模型的文本分析方法，我们表明，如果公众可以实时获取发布日期滞后五年的 FOMC 会议材料（如会议记录和 Tealbook），市场政策预期可以大幅提高预测准确性。这种改善大部分发生在宽松周期期间。例如，在六个月的预测范围内，市场可能预测 2001 年和 2008 年经济衰退期间额外宽松政策多达 125 个基点，相当于均方误差减少 40-50%。这种潜在的预测改善似乎与美联储反应函数的不完整信息有关，特别是关于 2008 年金融稳定问题的信息。相比之下，增加会议材料的获取并不会改善市场在紧缩周期期间的政策利率预测。

title: Pandemic-Era Inflation Drivers and Global Spillovers
authors: Julian di Giovanni, Ṣebnem Kalemli-Özcan, Alvaro Silva, Muhammed A. Yildirim
abstract: We estimate a multi-country, multi-sector New Keynesian model to quantify the drivers of domestic inflation during 2020–23 in several countries, including the United States. The model matches observed inflation together with sector-level prices and wages. We further measure the relative importance of different types of shocks on inflation across countries over time. The key mechanism, the international transmission of demand, supply and energy shocks through global linkages helps us to match the behavior of the USD/EUR exchange rate. The quantification exercise yields four key findings. First, negative supply shocks to factors of production, labor and intermediate inputs, initially sparked inflation in 2020-21. Global supply chains and complementarities in production played an amplification role in this initial phase. Second, positive aggregate demand shocks, due to stimulative policies, widened demand-supply imbalances, amplifying inflation further during 2021-22. Third, the reallocation of consumption between goods and service sectors, a relative sector-level demand shock, played a role in transmitting these imbalances across countries through the global trade and production network. Fourth, global energy shocks have differential impacts on the U.S. relative to other countries’ inflation rates. Further, complementarities between energy and other inputs to production play a particularly important role in the quantitative impact of these shocks on inflation.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 大流行时代的通胀驱动因素和全球溢出效应
abstract_zh: 我们估计了一个多国家、多部门的新凯恩斯主义模型，以量化包括美国在内的多个国家 2020-23 年国内通胀的驱动因素。该模型将观察到的通货膨胀与部门层面的价格和工资相匹配。我们进一步衡量一段时间内不同类型的冲击对各国通胀的相对重要性。关键机制是通过全球联系进行需求、供应和能源冲击的国际传导，有助于我们匹配美元/欧元汇率的行为。量化工作得出了四个主要发现。首先，生产要素、劳动力和中间投入的负供给冲击最初引发了 2020-21 年的通胀。全球供应链和生产互补性在这一初始阶段发挥了放大作用。其次，由于刺激政策，总需求受到积极冲击，供需失衡扩大，2021-22年通胀进一步放大。第三，商品和服务部门之间消费的重新分配，即相对部门层面的需求冲击，在通过全球贸易和生产网络在各国之间传递这些不平衡方面发挥了作用。第四，相对于其他国家的通胀率，全球能源冲击对美国的影响有所不同。此外，能源和其他生产投入之间的互补性在这些冲击对通货膨胀的定量影响中发挥着特别重要的作用。

title: Stakeholders’ Aversion to Inequality and Bank Lending to Minorities
authors: Matteo Crosignani, Hanh Le
abstract: We document large and persistent cross-sectional differences in banks’ propensity to lend to minorities based on bank stakeholders’ aversion to inequality. Using mortgage application data from the Home Mortgage Disclosure Act, we show that banks with more inequality-averse stakeholders are more likely to approve applications in high-minority relative to low-minority areas and, within census tracts, from non-white borrowers relative to white borrowers. These differences (i) are not driven by applicant selection or loan officer assignment, (ii) coincide with stakeholder alignment, reflected in depositor retention and disclosure of initiatives for underserved communities, and (iii) do not predict worse ex-post loan performance.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 利益相关者对不平等和银行向少数群体贷款的厌恶
abstract_zh: 我们记录了基于银行利益相关者对不平等的厌恶，银行向少数族裔提供贷款的倾向存在巨大且持续的横截面差异。利用《住房抵押贷款披露法案》中的抵押贷款申请数据，我们发现，与低少数族裔地区相比，拥有更多厌恶不平等的利益相关者的银行更有可能批准高少数族裔地区的申请，并且在人口普查区内，相对于白人借款人，批准非白人借款人的申请。这些差异 (i) 不是由申请人选择或信贷员分配驱动的，(ii) 与利益相关者的一致性一致，反映在储户保留和服务不足社区举措的披露上，以及 (iii) 不会预测更差的事后贷款绩效。

title: Banks versus Hurricanes: A Case Study of Puerto Rico after Hurricanes Irma and Maria
authors: Peter Anagnostakos, Jason Bram, Benjamin Chan, Natalia Fischl-Lanzoni, Hasan Latif, James M. Mahoney, Donald P. Morgan, Ladd Morgan, Ivelisse Suarez
abstract: We study Puerto Rico’s experience after the severe hurricane season of 2017 to better understand how extreme weather disasters affect bank stability and their ability to lend. Despite the devastation wrought by two category 5 hurricanes in a single month, we find relatively modest and transitory impacts on bank performance with no evident decline in lending capacity. We discuss various mitigants that help limit bank exposure to extreme weather and whether these mitigants may be vulnerable given the potential for more severe and more impactful climate events.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 银行与飓风：飓风艾尔玛和玛丽亚后波多黎各的案例研究
abstract_zh: 我们研究波多黎各在 2017 年严重飓风季节后的经历，以更好地了解极端天气灾害如何影响银行稳定性及其放贷能力。尽管一个月内发生了两次 5 级飓风造成的破坏，但我们发现对银行业绩的影响相对较小且短暂，贷款​​能力没有明显下降。我们讨论了有助于限制银行遭受极端天气影响的各种缓解措施，以及考虑到可能发生更严重和更具影响力的气候事件，这些缓解措施是否容易受到影响。

title: The Optimal Supply of Central Bank Reserves under Uncertainty
authors: Gara Afonso, Gabriele La Spada, Thomas M. Mertens, John C. Williams
abstract: This paper provides an analytically tractable theoretical framework to study the optimal supply of central bank reserves when the demand for reserves is uncertain and nonlinear. We fully characterize the optimal supply of central bank reserves and associated market equilibrium. We find that the optimal supply of reserves under uncertainty is greater than that absent uncertainty. With a sufficient degree of uncertainty, it is optimal to supply a level of reserves that is abundant (on the flat portion of the demand curve). The model captures the empirical observation that the variability of interest rate spreads depends on reserves supply.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 不确定性下央行准备金的最优供给
abstract_zh: 本文提供了一个分析上易于处理的理论框架来研究当准备金需求不确定和非线性时央行准备金的最优供给。我们充分描述了央行准备金的最优供给和相关的市场均衡。我们发现，不确定性条件下的储备最优供应量大于不确定性条件下的储备量最优供应量。在具有足够程度的不确定性的情况下，最佳的做法是提供充足的储备水平（在需求曲线的平坦部分）。该模型捕捉了利率利差的可变性取决于准备金供应的经验观察。

title: Trade Uncertainty and U.S. Bank Lending
authors: Ricardo Correa, Julian di Giovanni, Linda S. Goldberg, Camelia Minoiu
abstract: This paper uses U.S. loan-level credit register data and the 2018–2019 Trade War to test for the effects of international trade uncertainty on domestic credit supply. We exploit cross-sectional heterogeneity in banks’ ex-ante exposure to trade uncertainty and find that an increase in trade uncertainty is associated with a contraction in bank lending to all firms irrespective of the uncertainty that the firms face. This baseline result holds for lending at the intensive and extensive margins. We document two channels underlying the estimated credit supply effect: a wait-and-see channel by which exposed banks assess their borrowers as riskier and reduce the maturity of their loans, and a financial frictions channel by which exposed banks facing relatively higher balance sheet constraints contract lending more. The decline in credit supply has real effects: firms that borrow from more exposed banks experience lower debt growth and investment rates. These effects are stronger for firms that are more reliant on bank finance.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 贸易不确定性和美国银行贷款
abstract_zh: 本文使用美国贷款级​​信用登记数据和2018-2019年贸易战来检验国际贸易不确定性对国内信贷供给的影响。我们利用银行事前贸易不确定性敞口的横截面异质性，发现贸易不确定性的增加与银行向所有企业的贷款收缩有关，无论企业面临的不确定性如何。这一基准结果适用于集约利润率和粗放利润率的贷款。我们记录了估计信贷供给效应背后的两个渠道：一个是观望渠道，暴露银行将其借款人评估为风险较高并缩短贷款期限；另一个是金融摩擦渠道，暴露银行面临相对较高的资产负债表约束，从而更多地签订贷款合同。信贷供应的下降产生了实际影响：从风险敞口较大的银行借款的公司的债务增长率和投资率较低。对于更依赖银行融资的企业来说，这些影响更为强烈。

title: Congestion in Onboarding Workers and Sticky R&D
authors: Justin Bloesch, Jacob P. Weber
abstract: R&D investment spending exhibits a delayed and hump-shaped response to shocks. We show in a simple partial equilibrium model that rapidly adjusting R&D investment is costly if the probability of converting new hires into productive R&D workers (“onboarding”) is decreasing in the number of new hires (“congestion”). Congestion thus causes R&D-producing firms to slowly hire new workers in response to good shocks and hoard workers in response to bad shocks, providing a microfoundation for convex adjustment costs in R&D investment. Using novel, high-frequency productivity data on individual software developers collected from GitHub, a popular online collaboration platform, we provide quantitative evidence for such congestion. Calibrated to this evidence, a sticky-wage new Keynesian model with heterogeneous investment-producing firms subject to congestion in onboarding and no other frictions yields hump-shaped responses of R&D investment to shocks.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 入职人员拥堵和研发粘性
abstract_zh: 研发投资支出对冲击表现出延迟和驼峰状的反应。我们在一个简单的部分均衡模型中表明，如果将新员工转化为生产性研发人员（“入职”）的可能性随着新员工数量（“拥堵”）的减少而减少，快速调整研发投资的成本就会很高。因此，拥堵导致研发生产型企业缓慢雇用新员工以应对良好的冲击，并囤积员工以应对不良的冲击，从而为研发投资的凸调整成本提供了微观基础。使用从流行的在线协作平台 GitHub 收集的有关单个软件开发人员的新颖、高频的生产力数据，我们为这种拥塞提供了定量证据。根据这一证据进行校准，一种粘性工资的新凯恩斯主义模型，其中异质投资生产企业受到入职拥堵的影响，并且没有其他摩擦，会产生研发投资对冲击的驼峰状反应。

title: Corporate Credit Conditions Around the World: Novel Facts Through Holistic Data
authors: Nina Boyarchenko, Leonardo Elias
abstract: We collect comprehensive granular data on various aspects of firms’ access to credit markets. We document ten facts that show that inferring credit conditions for new debt from those for existing debt – and vice versa – leads to erroneous conclusions. Secondary market spreads are poor proxies of the cost of new debt. Investment grade issuance is driven by firms’ own secondary market spreads, while high yield issuance responds to macroeconomic conditions. Bond issuances overstate changes in firm indebtedness. Emerging market bond and loan borrowing is complementary for firms with access to both markets, but borrowing of loan-only firms appears disconnected.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 全球企业信用状况：通过整体数据了解新奇事实
abstract_zh: 我们收集有关公司进入信贷市场各个方面的全面详细数据。我们记录了十个事实，这些事实表明，从现有债务的信用条件推断新债务的信用条件（反之亦然）会导致错误的结论。二级市场利差不能很好地反映新债务的成本。投资级发行是由公司自身的二级市场利差驱动的，而高收益债券的发行则是对宏观经济状况的反应。债券发行夸大了公司债务的变化。新兴市场债券和贷款借款对于进入这两个市场的公司来说是互补的，但仅贷款公司的借款似乎是脱节的。

title: Runs and Flights to Safety: Are Stablecoins the New Money Market Funds?
authors: Kenechukwu E. Anadu, Pablo D. Azar, Catherine Huang, Marco Cipriani, Thomas M. Eisenbach, Gabriele La Spada, Mattia Landoni, Marco Macchiavelli, Antoine Malfroy-Camine, J. Christina Wang
abstract: Similar to the more traditional money market funds (MMFs), stablecoins aim to provide investors with safe, money-like assets. We investigate similarities and differences between these two investment products. Like MMFs, stablecoins suffer from “flight-to-safety” dynamics: we document net flows from riskier to safer stablecoins on days of crypto-market stress and estimate a discrete “break-the-buck” threshold of $1, below which stablecoin redemptions accelerate. We then focus on two specific stablecoin runs, in 2022 and 2023, showing that the same flight-to-safety dynamics also characterized these episodes. Finally, as flight-to-safety flows occur within MMF families, stablecoin flows tend to happen within blockchains.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 逃往安全之地：稳定币是新的货币市场基金吗？
abstract_zh: 与更传统的货币市场基金（MMF）类似，稳定币旨在为投资者提供安全的、类似货币的资产。我们研究这两种投资产品之间的异同。与MMF一样，稳定币也受到“逃向安全”动态的影响：我们记录了在加密货币市场面临压力的日子里从风险较高的稳定币流向更安全的稳定币的净流量，并估计了一个离散的“突破性”阈值1美元，低于该阈值稳定币赎回会加速。然后，我们重点关注 2022 年和 2023 年两次特定的稳定币运行，表明这些事件也具有相同的逃往安全动态。最后，由于避险资金流发生在 MMF 家族内，稳定币资金流往往发生在区块链内。

title: Capital Management and Wealth Inequality
authors: James Best, Keshav Dogra
abstract: Wealthier individuals have stronger incentives to seek higher returns. We investigate theoretically the effect this has on long-run wealth inequality. Incorporating capital management into a standard Ramsey-Cass-Koopmans model generates substantial long-run inequality: the majority of the population works and holds no capital, while a small minority holds a large amount of capital and manages it full-time. Counterintuitively, financial innovations or policies that reduce return differentials increase long-run wealth inequality. Egalitarian steady states may exist, but are inefficient and unstable: a small concentration in capital ownership causes a transition to an unequal steady state. Capital management introduces a novel equity-efficiency tradeoff: scale economies make it efficient for a few individuals to manage capital full-time, but under laissez-faire this generates substantial inequality. A utilitarian planner would instead instruct a few individuals to manage capital on behalf of society and transfer most of their income to the workers.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 资本管理与财富不平等
abstract_zh: 富裕的人有更强的动力去寻求更高的回报。我们从理论上研究了这对长期财富不平等的影响。将资本管理纳入标准的拉姆齐-卡斯-库普曼斯模型会产生严重的长期不平等：大多数人工作但不持有资本，而少数人则持有大量资本并全职管理资本。与直觉相反，减少回报差异的金融创新或政策会加剧长期财富不平等。平等主义的稳态可能存在，但效率低下且不稳定：资本所有权的少量集中会导致向不平等稳态的过渡。资本管理引入了一种新颖的股权效率权衡：规模经济使少数人全职管理资本变得高效，但在自由放任的情况下，这会产生严重的不平等。相反，功利主义规划者会指示少数人代表社会管理资本，并将大部分收入转移给工人。

title: Estimating HANK for Central Banks
authors: Sushant Acharya, William Chen, Marco Del Negro, Keshav Dogra, Aidan Gleich, Shlok Goyal, Donggyu Lee, Ethan Matlin, Reca Sarfati, Sikata Sengupta
abstract: We provide a toolkit for efficient online estimation of heterogeneous agent (HA) New Keynesian (NK) models based on Sequential Monte Carlo methods. We use this toolkit to compare the out-of-sample forecasting accuracy of a prominent HANK model, Bayer et al. (2022), to that of the representative agent (RA) NK model of Smets and Wouters (2007, SW). We find that HANK’s accuracy for real activity variables is notably inferior to that of SW. The results for consumption in particular are disappointing since the main difference between RANK and HANK is the replacement of the RA Euler equation with the aggregation of individual households’ consumption policy functions, which reflects inequality.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 为中央银行估算 HANK
abstract_zh: 我们提供了一个工具包，用于基于序贯蒙特卡罗方法的异构代理（HA）新凯恩斯主义（NK）模型的高效在线估计。我们使用该工具包来比较著名的 HANK 模型（Bayer 等人）的样本外预测准确性。 （2022），到 Smets 和 Wouters 的代表代理（RA）NK 模型（2007，SW）。我们发现 HANK 对实际活动变量的准确性明显低于 SW。消费方面的结果尤其令人失望，因为RANK和HANK之间的主要区别在于用个体家庭消费政策函数的汇总取代了RA欧拉方程，这反映了不平等。

title: Dealer Capacity and U.S. Treasury Market Functionality
authors: Darrell Duffie, Michael J. Fleming, Frank M. Keane, Claire Nelson, Or Shachar, Peter Van Tassel
abstract: We show a significant loss in U.S. Treasury market functionality when intensive use of dealer balance sheets is needed to intermediate bond markets, as in March 2020. Although yield volatility explains most of the variation in Treasury market liquidity over time, when dealer balance sheet utilization reaches sufficiently high levels, liquidity is much worse than predicted by yield volatility alone. This is consistent with the existence of occasionally binding constraints on the intermediation capacity of bond markets.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 交易商能力和美国国债市场功能

title: Firm Dynamics and Random Search over the Business Cycle
authors: Richard Audoly
abstract: I build a tractable random search model with firm dynamics, on-the-job search, and aggregate shocks. Multi-worker firms make recruitment decisions, choose whether to enter or exit the market, and design wage contracts. Tractability is obtained by showing that, under a set of assumptions on the recruitment technology, the decisions of workers and firms depend on the firms’ current productivity. I confront the model to salient business cycle moments on the reallocation of workers across the firm productivity distribution derived from firm-level data that the model successfully replicates. I use this framework to quantify the drivers of worker reallocation over the post-war business cycle in Britain.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 经济周期中的企业动态和随机搜索
abstract_zh: I build a tractable random search model with firm dynamics, on-the-job search, and aggregate shocks. Multi-worker firms make recruitment decisions, choose whether to enter or exit the market, and design wage contracts.可处理性是通过表明在招聘技术的一系列假设下，工人和企业的决策取决于企业当前的生产率而获得的。我将模型与模型成功复制的公司级数据所得出的公司生产力分布中的工人重新分配的重要经济周期时刻进行比较。 I use this framework to quantify the drivers of worker reallocation over the post-war business cycle in Britain.

title: Beta-Sorted Portfolios
authors: Matias D. Cattaneo, Richard K. Crump, Weining Wang
abstract: Beta-sorted portfolios—portfolios comprised of assets with similar covariation to selected risk factors— are a popular tool in empirical finance to analyze models of (conditional) expected returns. Despite their widespread use, little is known of their econometric properties in contrast to comparable procedures such as two-pass regressions. We formally investigate the properties of beta-sorted portfolio returns by casting the procedure as a two-step nonparametric estimator with a nonparametric first step and a beta-adaptive portfolios construction. Our framework rationalizes the well-known estimation algorithm with precise economic and statistical assumptions on the general data generating process. We provide conditions which ensure valid estimation and inference allowing for a range of hypotheses of interest in financial applications. We show that the rate of convergence of the estimator changes depending on the value of beta. We demonstrate that valid inference depends critically on the object of interest and discuss shortcomings of the widely-used Fama-MacBeth variance estimator. To address these limitations, we propose a new variance estimator. In an empirical application, we introduce a novel risk factor—a measure of the business credit cycle—and show that it is strongly predictive of both the cross-section and time-series behavior of U.S. stock returns.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 贝塔排序投资组合
abstract_zh: 贝塔排序投资组合（由与选定风险因素具有相似协变的资产组成的投资组合）是实证金融中分析（条件）预期回报模型的流行工具。尽管它们被广泛使用，但与两遍回归等类似程序相比，人们对它们的计量经济学特性知之甚少。我们通过将过程转换为具有非参数第一步和 beta 自适应投资组合构建的两步非参数估计器来正式研究 beta 排序投资组合收益的属性。我们的框架通过对一般数据生成过程的精确经济和统计假设，合理化了众所周知的估计算法。我们提供确保有效估计和推理的条件，允许金融应用中一系列感兴趣的假设。我们表明估计器的收敛速度根据 beta 的值而变化。我们证明了有效的推理很大程度上取决于感兴趣的对象，并讨论了广泛使用的 Fama-MacBeth 方差估计器的缺点。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了一种新的方差估计器。在实证应用中，我们引入了一种新的风险因素——商业信贷周期的衡量标准——并表明它可以强烈预测美国股票回报的横截面和时间序列行为。

title: A Measure of Trend Wage Inflation
authors: Richard Audoly, Martín Almuzara, Davide Melcangi
abstract: We extend time-series models that have so far been used to study price inflation (Stock and Watson [2016a]) and apply them to a micro-level dataset containing worker-level information on hourly wages. We construct a measure of aggregate nominal wage growth that (i) filters out noise and very transitory movements, (ii) quantifies the importance of idiosyncratic factors for aggregate wage dynamics, and (iii) strongly co-moves with labor market tightness, unlike existing indicators of wage inflation. We show that our measure is a reliable real-time indicator of wage pressures and a good predictor of future wage growth.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 工资通胀趋势的衡量标准
abstract_zh: 我们扩展了迄今为止用于研究价格通胀的时间序列模型（Stock 和 Watson [2016a]），并将其应用于包含工人级别的小时工资信息的微观数据集。我们构建了一种衡量总名义工资增长的指标，该指标（i）过滤掉噪音和非常短暂的变动，（ii）量化特殊因素对总工资动态的重要性，以及（iii）与劳动力市场紧张程度密切相关，这与现有的工资通胀指标不同。我们表明，我们的衡量标准是工资压力的可靠实时指标，也是未来工资增长的良好预测指标。

title: Physical Climate Risk Factors and an Application to Measuring Insurers’ Climate Risk Exposure
authors: Robert Engle, Shan Ge, Hyeyoon Jung, Xuran Zeng
abstract: We construct a novel physical risk factor using a portfolio of REITs, long on those with properties highly exposed to climate risk and short on those with less exposure. Combined with a transition risk factor, we assess U.S. insurers’ climate risk through operations and $13 trillion in asset holdings. Estimating dynamic climate betas, we find higher stock return sensitivity to the physical risk among insurers operating in riskier regions and to transition risk among those holding more brown assets. Using these betas, we calculate capital shortfalls under climate stress scenarios, offering insights into insurers’ resilience to climate risks.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 物理气候风险因素以及衡量保险公司气候风险暴露的应用
abstract_zh: 我们利用房地产投资信托基金的投资组合构建了一个新的物理风险因素，长期关注那些高度暴露于气候风险的房产，短期关注那些暴露程度较低的房产。结合转型风险因素，我们通过运营和 13 万亿美元资产持有来评估美国保险公司的气候风险。在估计动态气候贝塔值时，我们发现在风险较高地区运营的保险公司对实体风险的股票回报率以及持有更多棕色资产的保险公司对风险转移的敏感性更高。利用这些贝塔值，我们计算了气候压力情景下的资本短缺，从而深入了解保险公司对气候风险的抵御能力。

title: Stimulus through Insurance: The Marginal Propensity to Repay Debt
authors: Gizem Koşar, Davide Melcangi, Laura Pilossoph, David Wiczer
abstract: Using detailed micro data, we document that households often use “stimulus” checks to pay down debt, especially those with low net wealth-to-income ratios. To rationalize these patterns, we introduce a borrowing price schedule into an otherwise standard incomplete markets model. Because interest rates rise with debt, borrowers have increasingly larger incentives to use an additional dollar to reduce debt service payments rather than consume. Using our calibrated model, we then study whether and how this marginal propensity to repay debt (MPRD) alters the aggregate implications of fiscal transfers. We uncover a trade-off between stimulus and insurance, as high-debt individuals gain considerably from transfers, but consume relatively little immediately. We show how this mechanism can lower short-run fiscal multipliers but sustain aggregate consumption for longer.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 通过保险刺激：偿还债务的边际倾向
abstract_zh: 使用详细的微观数据，我们记录了家庭经常使用“刺激”支票来偿还债务，特别是那些净财富与收入比率较低的家庭。为了使这些模式合理化，我们将借款价格表引入到其他标准的不完全市场模型中。由于利率随着债务而上升，借款人越来越有动力使用额外的美元来减少还本付息，而不是消费。然后，我们使用我们的校准模型来研究这种边际偿还债务倾向（MPRD）是否以及如何改变财政转移支付的总体影响。我们发现了刺激和保险之间的权衡，因为高负债个人从转移中获得了大量收益，但立即消费相对较少。我们展示了这种机制如何降低短期财政乘数，但更长时间地维持总消费。

title: Global Liquidity: Drivers, Volatility and Toolkits
authors: Linda S. Goldberg
abstract: Global liquidity refers to the volumes of financial flows—largely intermediated through global banks and non-bank financial institutions—that can move at relatively high frequencies across borders. The amplitude of responses to global conditions like risk sentiment, discussed in the context of the global financial cycle, depends on the characteristics and vulnerabilities of the institutions providing funding flows. Evidence from across empirical approaches and using granular data provides policy-relevant lessons. International spillovers of monetary policy and risk sentiment through global liquidity evolve in response to regulation, the characteristics of financial institutions, and actions of official institutions around liquidity provision. Strong prudential policies in the home countries of global banks and official facilities reduce funding strains during stress events. Country-specific policy challenges, summarized by the monetary and financial trilemmas, are partially alleviated. However, risk migration across types of financial intermediaries underscores the importance of advancing regulatory agendas related to non-bank financial institutions.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 全球流动性：驱动因素、波动性和工具包
abstract_zh: 全球流动性是指能够以相对较高的频率跨境流动的资金流动量（主要通过全球银行和非银行金融机构中介）。在全球金融周期的背景下讨论的对风险情绪等全球状况的反应幅度取决于提供资金流的机构的特征和脆弱性。来自经验方法和使用精细数据的证据提供了与政策相关的经验教训。通过全球流动性产生的货币政策和风险情绪的国际溢出效应是根据监管、金融机构的特征以及官方机构围绕流动性供应采取的行动而演变的。全球银行和官方设施所在国强有力的审慎政策减轻了压力事件期间的资金压力。货币和金融三难困境所概括的具体国家政策挑战已部分缓解。然而，跨类型金融中介机构的风险迁移凸显了推进与非银行金融机构相关的监管议程的重要性。

title: Measuring the Natural Rate of Interest after COVID-19
authors: Kathryn Holston, Thomas Laubach, John C. Williams
abstract: We modify the Laubach-Williams and Holston-Laubach-Williams models of the natural rate of interest to account for time-varying volatility and a persistent COVID supply shock during the pandemic. Resulting estimates of the natural rate of interest in the United States, Canada, and the Euro Area at the end of 2022 are close to their respective levels estimated directly before the pandemic; that is, we do not find evidence that the era of historically low estimated natural rates of interest has ended. In contrast, estimates of the natural rate of output have declined relative to those projected before the pandemic.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 衡量 COVID-19 后的自然利率
abstract_zh: 我们修改了自然利率的劳巴赫-威廉姆斯模型和霍尔斯顿-劳巴赫-威廉姆斯模型，以考虑到随时间变化的波动性和大流行期间持续的新冠供应冲击。对美国、加拿大和欧元区 2022 年底自然利率的估计结果接近各自在疫情爆发前估计的水平；也就是说，我们没有发现证据表明估计自然利率处于历史低位的时代已经结束。相比之下，对自然产出率的估计相对于大流行前的预测有所下降。

title: Estimates of Cost-Price Passthrough from Business Survey Data
authors: Wändi Bruine de Bruin, Keshav Dogra, Sebastian Heise, Edward S. Knotek, Brent Meyer, Robert W. Rich, Raphael Schoenle, Giorgio Topa, Wilbert Van der Klaauw
abstract: We examine businesses’ price-setting practices via open-ended interviews and in a quantitative survey module with business contacts from the Federal Reserve Banks of Atlanta, Cleveland, and New York in December 2022 and January 2023. Businesses indicated that their prices were strongly influenced by demand, a desire to maintain steady profit margins, and wages and labor costs. Survey respondents expected reduced growth in costs and prices of about 5 percent on average over the next year. Backward-looking, forward-looking, and hypothetical scenarios reveal average cost-price passthrough of around 60 percent, with meaningful heterogeneity across firms.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 根据商业调查数据估算成本价格传递
abstract_zh: 我们于 2022 年 12 月和 2023 年 1 月通过开放式访谈和定量调查模块，与来自亚特兰大、克利夫兰和纽约联邦储备银行的业务联系人，研究了企业的定价实践。企业表示，他们的价格受到需求、保持稳定利润率的愿望以及工资和劳动力成本的强烈影响。受访者预计明年成本和价格的增长平均将下降约 5%。回顾、前瞻性和假设情景显示，平均成本价格传递约为 60%，各公司之间存在显着的异质性。

title: Working Remotely? Selection, Treatment, and the Market for Remote Work
authors: Natalia Emanuel, Emma Harrington
abstract: How does remote work affect productivity and how productive are workers who choose remote jobs? We estimate both effects in a U.S. Fortune 500 firm’s call centers that employed both remote and on-site workers in the same jobs. Prior to COVID-19, remote workers answered 12 percent fewer calls per hour than on-site workers. When the call centers closed due to COVID-19, the productivity of formerly on-site workers declined by 4 percent relative to already-remote workers, indicating that a third of the initial gap was due to a negative treatment effect of remote work. Yet an 8 percent productivity gap persisted, indicating that the majority of the productivity gap was due to negative worker selection into remote work. Difference-in-differences designs also indicate that remote work degraded call quality— particularly for inexperienced workers—and reduced workers’ promotion rates. In a model of the market provision of remote work, we find that firms were in a prisoner’s dilemma: all firms would have gained from offering comparable remote and on-site jobs, but any individual firm was loathe to attract less productive workers.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 远程工作？远程工作的选择、待遇和市场
abstract_zh: 远程工作如何影响生产力以及选择远程工作的工人的生产力如何？我们对一家美国财富 500 强公司的呼叫中心估算了这两种影响，该呼叫中心同时雇用远程员工和现场员工从事相同的工作。在 COVID-19 之前，远程工作人员每小时接听的电话比现场工作人员少 12%。当呼叫中心因 COVID-19 关闭时，以前的现场员工的生产力相对于已经远程员工下降了 4%，这表明最初差距的三分之一是由于远程工作的负面待遇影响。然而，8% 的生产率差距仍然存在，这表明生产率差距的大部分是由于员工消极选择远程工作造成的。双重差异设计还表明，远程工作降低了通话质量（尤其是对于缺乏经验的员工而言），并降低了员工的晋升率。在远程工作的市场供应模型中，我们发现公司陷入了囚徒困境：所有公司都会从提供类似的远程和现场工作中获益，但任何单个公司都不愿意吸引生产力较低的工人。

title: Applications or Approvals: What Drives Racial Disparities in the Paycheck Protection Program?
authors: Sergey V. Chernenko, Nathan Kaplan, Asani Sarkar, David Scharfstein
abstract: We use the 2020 Small Business Credit Survey to study the sources of racial disparities in use of the Paycheck Protection Program (PPP). Black-owned firms are 8.9 percentage points less likely than observably similar white-owned firms to receive PPP loans. About 55% of this take-up disparity is attributable to a disparity in application propensity, while the remainder is attributable to a disparity in approval rates. The finding in prior research that Black-owned PPP recipients are less likely than whiteowned recipients to borrow from banks and more likely to borrow from fintech lenders is driven entirely by application behavior. Conditional on applying for a PPP loan, Black-owned firms are 9.9 percentage points less likely than white-owned firms to apply to banks and 7.8 percentage points more likely to apply to fintechs. However, they face similar average approval disparities at banks (7.4 percentage points) and fintechs (8.4 percentage points). Sorting by Black-owned firms away from banks and toward fintechs is significantly stronger in more racially biased counties, and the bank approval disparity is also larger in more racially biased counties. Neither differences in PPP demand nor differences in eligibility rates are able to explain any of our findings. Racial disparities in program awareness and in the burden of application requirements (e.g., submitting all required documentation) both appear to be important drivers of application disparities, and the latter also helps to explain both bank and fintech approval disparities.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 申请或批准：是什么导致了薪资保护计划中的种族差异？
