abstract_zh: 我们利用 2020 年小型企业信用调查来研究薪资保护计划 (PPP) 使用中种族差异的根源。黑人拥有的公司获得 PPP 贷款的可能性比明显相似的白人拥有的公司低 8.9 个百分点。大约 55% 的采用率差异归因于申请倾向的差异，而其余的则归因于批准率的差异。之前的研究发现，黑人拥有的 PPP 接受者比白人拥有的接受者从银行借款的可能性更低，而更有可能从金融科技贷款机构借款，这完全是由申请行为驱动的。在申请 PPP 贷款的条件下，黑人拥有的公司向银行申请贷款的可能性比白人拥有的公司低 9.9 个百分点，而向金融科技公司申请的可能性则高 7.8 个百分点。然而，他们在银行（7.4 个百分点）和金融科技公司（8.4 个百分点）方面也面临着类似的平均支持率差异。在种族偏见较多的县，黑人拥有的公司从银行转向金融科技的排序明显更强，而且在种族偏见较多的县，银行的认可差异也更大。 PPP 需求的差异和合格率的差异都无法解释我们的任何发现。计划意识和申请要求负担（例如，提交所有必需的文件）方面的种族差异似乎都是申请差异的重要驱动因素，后者也有助于解释银行和金融科技审批差异。

title: Climate Stress Testing
authors: Viral V. Acharya, Richard Berner, Robert Engle, Hyeyoon Jung, Johannes Stroebel, Xuran Zeng, Yihao Zhao
abstract: We explore the design of climate stress tests to assess and manage macro-prudential risks from climate change in the financial sector. We review the climate stress scenarios currently employed by regulators, highlighting the need to (i) consider many transition risks as dynamic policy choices; (ii) better understand and incorporate feedback loops between climate change and the economy; and (iii) further explore “compound risk” scenarios in which climate risks co-occur with other risks. We discuss how the process of mapping climate stress scenarios into financial firm outcomes can incorporate existing evidence on the effects of various climate-related risks on credit and market outcomes. We argue that more research is required to (i) identify channels through which plausible scenarios can lead to meaningful short-run impact on credit risks, given typical bank loan maturities; (ii) incorporate bank-lending responses to climate risks; (iii) assess the adequacy of climate risk pricing in financial markets; and (iv) better understand how market participants form climate risk expectations and how this affects financial stability. Finally, we discuss the advantages and disadvantages of using market-based climate stress tests that can be conducted using publicly available data to complement existing stress testing frameworks.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 气候压力测试
abstract_zh: 我们探索气候压力测试的设计，以评估和管理金融部门气候变化带来的宏观审慎风险。我们回顾了监管机构目前采用的气候压力情景，强调需要 (i) 将许多转型风险视为动态政策选择； (ii) 更好地理解和纳入气候变化与经济之间的反馈循环； (iii) 进一步探讨气候风险与其他风险同时发生的“复合风险”情景。我们讨论了将气候压力情景映射到金融公司结果的过程如何能够纳入各种气候相关风险对信贷和市场结果影响的现有证据。我们认为，需要进行更多的研究来（i）在考虑到典型的银行贷款期限的情况下，确定合理的情景可以对信用风险产生有意义的短期影响的渠道； (ii) 将银行贷款应对气候风险纳入其中； (iii) 评估金融市场气候风险定价的充分性； (iv) 更好地了解市场参与者如何形成气候风险预期以及这如何影响金融稳定。最后，我们讨论使用基于市场的气候压力测试的优点和缺点，这些测试可以使用公开数据进行，以补充现有的压力测试框架。

title: U.S. Banks’ Exposures to Climate Transition Risks
authors: Hyeyoon Jung, João A. C. Santos, Lee Seltzer
abstract: We propose a new approach to estimate banks’ credit exposures to transition risks that combines sectoral effects of climate policies from general equilibrium (GE) models with historical information on loans’ default risks. At worst, estimated exposures reach 14 percent of bank loan portfolio values. Accounting for historic loan payoff structures reduces exposures to 0.5 percent–2 percent. Exposures can increase by 3–5 percentage points due to aggregate economic shocks. Analyses surrounding climate transition events suggest our estimates can serve as an upper bound on banks’ transition risk exposures. Highlighting our measure’s novelty, emissions explain at most 60 percent of variation in banks’ exposures.
keywords: Network for Greening the Financial System (NGFS) scenarios
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 美国银行面临的气候转型风险
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种估计银行转型风险信贷敞口的新方法，该方法将一般均衡（GE）模型中气候政策的部门影响与贷款违约风险的历史信息相结合。在最坏的情况下，估计风险敞口达到银行贷款组合价值的 14%。考虑到历史贷款偿还结构，将风险敞口降低至 0.5% 至 2%。由于总体经济冲击，风险敞口可能会增加 3-5 个百分点。围绕气候转型事件的分析表明，我们的估计可以作为银行转型风险敞口的上限。排放量最多可以解释银行风险敞口变化的 60%，这突显了我们的衡量标准的新颖性。

title: Non-Bank Financial Institutions and Banks’ Fire-Sale Vulnerabilities
authors: Nicola Cetorelli, Mattia Landoni, Lina Lu
abstract: Banks carry significant exposures to nonbanks from direct dealings, but they can also be exposed, indirectly, through losses in asset values resulting from fire-sale events. We assess the vulnerability of U.S. banks to fire sales potentially originating from any of twelve separate nonbank segments and identify network-like externalities driven by the interconnectedness across nonbank types in terms of asset holdings. We document that such network externalities can contribute to very large multiples of an original fire sale, thus suggesting that conventional assessments of fire-sale vulnerabilities can be grossly understated and highlighting the value of treating nonbank financial institutions as one organic whole for monitoring purposes.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 非银行金融机构和银行的甩卖漏洞
abstract_zh: 银行因直接交易而对非银行机构造成重大风险，但它们也可能因抛售事件造成的资产价值损失而间接受到风险。我们评估了美国银行对可能源自十二个独立非银行部门中任何一个部门的抛售的脆弱性，并确定了由非银行类型在资产持有方面的相互关联性驱动的类似网络的外部性。我们证明，这种网络外部性可能会导致原始甩卖的数倍，因此表明对甩卖脆弱性的传统评估可能被严重低估，并强调了将非银行金融机构视为一个有机整体以进行监控的价值。

title: Workers’ Perceptions of Earnings Growth and Employment Risk
authors: Gizem Koşar, Wilbert Van der Klaauw
abstract: In addition to realized earnings and employment shocks, forward-looking individuals are presumed to condition their consumption and labor supply decisions on their subjective beliefs about future labor market risks. This paper uses rich panel data to document considerable individual heterogeneity in earnings growth expectations and in the perceived likelihood of voluntary and involuntary job exits. We examine how expectations evolve over the working life and business cycle, and how they co-vary with macroeconomic expectations and personal experiences. While largely consistent with patterns in realized outcomes, our findings highlight the unanticipated nature of the pandemic recession and the ensuing resignation wave.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 工人对收入增长和就业风险的看法
abstract_zh: 除了已实现的收入和就业冲击之外，具有前瞻性的个人还被认为会根据他们对未来劳动力市场风险的主观信念来调整他们的消费和劳动力供应决策。本文使用丰富的面板数据来记录收入增长预期以及自愿和非自愿退出工作的感知可能性的相当大的个体异质性。我们研究预期在工作寿命和商业周期中如何演变，以及它们如何与宏观经济预期和个人经历共同变化。虽然与已实现结果的模式基本一致，但我们的研究结果凸显了大流行性衰退和随之而来的辞职浪潮的意外性质。

title: Noncognitive Skills at the Time of COVID-19: An Experiment with Professional Traders and Students
authors: Marco Angrisani, Marco Cipriani, Antonio Guarino, Ryan Kendall, Julen Ortiz de Zarate Pina
abstract: We study the stability of noncognitive skills by comparing experimental results gathered before and during the COVID-19 pandemic. Using a sample of professional traders, we find a significant decrease in agreeableness and locus of control and a moderate decrease in grit. These patterns are primarily driven by those with more negative experiences of the pandemic. Other skills, such as trust, conscientiousness, and self-monitoring, are unchanged. We contrast these results with those from a sample of undergraduate students whose noncognitive skills remain constant (except conscientiousness). Our findings provide evidence against the stability of noncognitive skills, particularly among professional traders.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: COVID-19 时期的非认知技能：针对专业交易员和学生的实验
abstract_zh: 我们通过比较 COVID-19 大流行之前和期间收集的实验结果来研究非认知技能的稳定性。通过对专业交易员的样本分析，我们发现宜人性和控制力显着下降，毅力也略有下降。这些模式主要是由那些对大流行有更多负面经历的人驱动的。其他技能，例如信任、责任心和自我监控，没有改变。我们将这些结果与非认知技能保持不变（责任心除外）的本科生样本的结果进行了对比。我们的研究结果提供了证据证明非认知技能的稳定性，特别是在专业交易者中。

title: Market-Function Asset Purchases
authors: Darrell Duffie, Frank M. Keane
abstract: This paper investigates the goals, costs, and benefits of official-sector purchases of government securities for the purpose of restoring market functionality. We explore the design of market-function purchase programs, including their communication, triggers, operational protocols, exit, and wind-down strategies. We further discuss whether, under some circumstances, fiscal buybacks might be a useful alternative or complement to central-bank market-function purchase programs, and how these buybacks could be funded. The use of fiscal buybacks to support market functionality can be aligned with the fiscal authority’s goal of minimizing the government’s interest expense and can reduce challenges that can be faced by a central bank when asset purchases are not naturally congruent with monetary policy. Depending on the setting and circumstances, fiscal buybacks can also mitigate perceptions of risks to the central bank’s independence.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 市场功能资产购买
abstract_zh: 本文研究了官方部门为恢复市场功能而购买政府证券的目标、成本和收益。我们探索市场功能购买计划的设计，包括其沟通、触发、操作协议、退出和逐步结束策略。我们进一步讨论在某些情况下，财政回购是否可能是央行市场功能购买计划的有用替代方案或补充，以及如何为这些回购提供资金。使用财政回购来支持市场功能可以符合财政当局最大限度地减少政府利息支出的目标，并且可以减少央行在资产购买与货币政策不自然一致时可能面临的挑战。根据具体情况和情况，财政回购还可以减轻人们对央行独立性风险的看法。

title: Is the Green Transition Inflationary?
authors: Marco Del Negro, Julian di Giovanni, Keshav Dogra
abstract: We develop a multi-sector New Keynesian model to analyze the inflationary effects of climate policies. Climate policies need not be inflationary, but can generate an inflation-output tradeoff whose size depends on how flexible prices are in the “dirty” and “green” sectors relative to the rest of the economy, and on whether climate policies consist of taxes or subsidies. A quantitative version of the model calibrated to U.S. data on input-output linkages and sectoral heterogeneity in emissions and price stickiness suggests that an increase in carbon taxes would generate a sizable tradeoff: containing the impact on headline or core inflation would lead to a deep recession. But while sizeable, the tradeoff is relatively short-lived as it wanes after one year.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 绿色转型会引发通货膨胀吗？
abstract_zh: 我们开发了一个多部门新凯恩斯主义模型来分析气候政策的通胀影响。气候政策不一定会引发通货膨胀，但可以产生通货膨胀与产出的权衡，其规模取决于“肮脏”和“绿色”部门相对于其他经济部门的价格弹性，以及气候政策是否包含税收或补贴。该模型的定量版本根据美国投入产出联系以及排放和价格粘性的部门异质性数据进行校准，表明增加碳税将产生相当大的权衡：遏制对整体或核心通胀的影响将导致深度衰退。但虽然规模很大，但这种权衡相对短暂，因为它会在一年后减弱。

title: The Bitcoin–Macro Disconnect
authors: Gianluca Benigno, Carlo Rosa
abstract: This paper investigates the link between Bitcoin and macroeconomic fundamentals by estimating the impact of macroeconomic news on Bitcoin using an event study with intraday data. The key result is that, unlike other U.S. asset classes, Bitcoin is orthogonal to monetary and macroeconomic news. This disconnect is puzzling as unexpected changes in discount rates should, in principle, affect the price of Bitcoin even when interpreting Bitcoin as a purely speculative asset.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 比特币与宏观经济脱节
abstract_zh: 本文通过使用日内数据的事件研究来估计宏观经济新闻对比特币的影响，研究了比特币与宏观经济基本面之间的联系。关键结果是，与其他美国资产类别不同，比特币与货币和宏观经济新闻正交。这种脱节令人费解，因为即使将比特币解释为纯粹的投机资产，原则上贴现率的意外变化也会影响比特币的价格。

title: International Capital Flow Pressures and Global Factors
authors: Linda S. Goldberg, Signe Krogstrup
abstract: The risk sensitivity of international capital flow pressures is explored using a new Exchange Market Pressure index that combines pressures observed in exchange rate adjustments with model-based estimates of incipient pressures that are masked by foreign exchange interventions and policy rate adjustments. The sensitivity of capital flow pressures to risk sentiment, including for so-called safe-haven currencies, evolves over time, varies significantly across countries, and differs between normal times and extreme stress events. Across countries, risk sensitivities and safe-haven status are associated with self-fulfilling exchange rate expectations and carry trade funding currencies. In contrast, association with more traditional macroeconomic country characteristics is weak.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 国际资本流动压力和全球因素
abstract_zh: 使用新的外汇市场压力指数来探讨国际资本流动压力的风险敏感性，该指数将汇率调整中观察到的压力与基于模型的对外汇干预和政策利率调整所掩盖的初期压力的估计相结合。资本流动压力对风险情绪（包括所谓的避险货币）的敏感性随着时间的推移而变化，各国之间差异很大，并且在正常时期和极端压力事件之间也存在差异。在各个国家，风险敏感性和避险地位与自我实现的汇率预期和套利交易融资货币相关。相比之下，与更传统的宏观经济国家特征的关联较弱。

title: Quantifying the Inflationary Impact of Fiscal Stimulus under Supply Constraints
authors: Julian di Giovanni, Ṣebnem Kalemli-Özcan, Alvaro Silva, Muhammed A. Yildirim
abstract: This paper builds on Baqaee and Farhi (2022) and di Giovanni et al. (2022) to quantify the contribution of fiscal policy to U.S. inflation over the December 2019-June 2022 period. Model calibrations show that aggregate demand shocks explain roughly two-thirds of total model-based inflation, and that the fiscal stimulus contributed half or more of the total aggregate demand effect.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 量化供应限制下财政刺激的通胀影响
abstract_zh: 本文以 Baqaee 和 Farhi (2022) 以及 di Giovanni 等人为基础。 （2022）量化 2019 年 12 月至 2022 年 6 月期间财政政策对美国通胀的贡献。模型校准表明，总需求冲击大约解释了基于模型的总通胀的三分之二，而财政刺激贡献了总需求效应的一半或更多。

title: Sparse Trend Estimation
authors: Richard K. Crump, Nikolay Gospodinov, Hunter Wieman
abstract: The low-frequency movements of economic variables play a prominent role in policy analysis and decision-making. We develop a robust estimation approach for these slow-moving trend processes that is guided by a judicious choice of priors and characterized by sparsity. We present novel stylized facts from longer-run survey expectations that inform the structure of the estimation procedure. The general version of the proposed Bayesian estimator with a spike-and-slab prior accounts explicitly for cyclical dynamics. We show that it performs well in simulations against relevant benchmarks and report empirical estimates of trend growth for U.S. output and annual mean temperature.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 稀疏趋势估计
abstract_zh: 经济变量的低频变动在政策分析和决策中发挥着突出作用。我们为这些缓慢移动的趋势过程开发了一种稳健的估计方法，该方法以明智的先验选择为指导，并以稀疏性为特征。我们提出了来自长期调查预期的新颖的程式化事实，这些事实为估计程序的结构提供了信息。所提出的具有尖峰和平板先验的贝叶斯估计器的通用版本明确地解释了周期性动态。我们证明它在针对相关基准的模拟中表现良好，并报告了对美国产出和年平均气温趋势增长的实证估计。

title: Does the Community Reinvestment Act Improve Consumers’ Access to Credit
authors: Jacob Conway, Jack Glaser, Matthew Plosser
abstract: We study the impact of the Community Reinvestment Act (CRA) on access to consumer credit since 1999 using an individual-level panel and three distinct identification strategies: a regression discontinuity design centered on a CRA-eligibility cutoff; a comparison of neighboring census blocks; and an event study of changes in eligibility. All three rule out a significant effect of the CRA on consumer borrowing. We show that this is in part explained by a shift in mortgages from nonbanks, which are free from CRA obligations, to banks in need of CRA-eligible mortgages. Our findings underscore the pitfalls of a circumscribed regulatory regime.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 《社区再投资法案》是否改善了消费者获得信贷的机会
abstract_zh: 我们使用个人层面的小组和三种不同的识别策略，研究自 1999 年以来《社区再投资法案》(CRA) 对获得消费信贷的影响：以 CRA 资格截止为中心的回归不连续性设计；邻近人口普查区的比较；以及资格变化的事件研究。这三者都排除了 CRA 对消费者借贷的重大影响。我们表明，造成这种情况的部分原因是抵押贷款从不受 CRA 义务的非银行机构转向需要符合 CRA 资格的抵押贷款的银行。我们的研究结果强调了受限制的监管制度的缺陷。

title: Financial Sanctions, SWIFT, and the Architecture of the International Payments System
authors: Marco Cipriani, Linda S. Goldberg, Gabriele La Spada
abstract: Financial sanctions, alongside economic sanctions, are components of the toolkit used by governments as part of international diplomacy. The use of sanctions, especially financial, has increased over the last seventy years. Financial sanctions have been particularly important whenever the goals of the sanctioning countries were related to democracy and human rights. Financial sanctions restrict entities—countries, businesses, or even individuals—from purchasing or selling financial assets, or from accessing custodial or other financial services. They can be imposed on a sanctioned entity’s ability to access the infrastructures that are in place to execute international payments, irrespective of whether such payments underpin financial or real activity. This article explains how financial sanctions can be designed to limit access to the international payments system and, in particular, the SWIFT network, and provides some recent examples.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 金融制裁、SWIFT 和国际支付系统的架构
abstract_zh: 金融制裁与经济制裁一样，都是各国政府在国际外交中使用的工具包的组成部分。过去七十年来，制裁（尤其是金融制裁）的使用有所增加。当制裁国家的目标与民主和人权相关时，金融制裁就显得尤为重要。金融制裁限制实体（国家、企业甚至个人）购买或出售金融资产，或获得托管或其他金融服务。它们可以针对受制裁实体访问执行国际支付的基础设施的能力而施加，无论此类支付是否支持金融活动或实际活动。本文解释了如何设计金融制裁来限制对国际支付系统（特别是 SWIFT 网络）的访问，并提供了一些最新示例。

title: Assessing the Relative Progressivity of the Biden Administration’s Federal Student Loan Forgiveness Proposal
authors: Jacob Goss, Daniel Mangrum, Joelle Scally
abstract: We quantify the total stock of balances eligible for the Biden Administration’s student loan forgiveness policy announced and examine which groups benefit most. Up to $442 billion in loans are eligible. Those benefiting most are younger, have lower credit scores, and live in lower- and middle-income neighborhoods. We also find that Black and Hispanic borrowers disproportionately benefit from the proposal. We then compare the distribution of beneficiaries for the announced policy to several alternative hypothetical forgiveness proposals and three existing tax credits. The additional forgiveness for Pell grant recipients increased the progressivity of the policy at a cost of $129 billion. Reducing the income eligibility criterion in half from the announced policy would have reduced the cost by nearly $100 billion and made the policy more progressive. Compared to existing tax credits, the announced forgiveness policy is less progressive than the Earned Income Tax Credit but more progressive than the 2019 Child Tax Credit and higher education tax credits. We conclude by describing the remaining federal portfolio if the policy is implemented, and we summarize current credit conditions for federal borrowers. Rising credit card and auto delinquencies for borrowers with paused payments foreshadow future credit difficulties for borrowers if federal loan payments resume without relief.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 评估拜登政府联邦学生贷款减免提案的相对进步性
abstract_zh: 我们量化了符合拜登政府宣布的学生贷款减免政策资格的余额总额，并研究哪些群体受益最多。高达 4,420 亿美元的贷款符合资格。受益最多的人年龄较小，信用评分较低，并且居住在中低收入社区。我们还发现黑人和西班牙裔借款人从该提案中受益匪浅。然后，我们将已宣布政策的受益人分布与几个替代的假设宽恕提案和三个现有税收抵免进行比较。对佩尔助学金接受者的额外宽恕提高了该政策的累进性，成本为 1,290 亿美元。将已公布的政策中的收入资格标准降低一半，将减少近 1000 亿美元的成本，并使政策更加进步。与现有的税收抵免相比，宣布的减免政策的累进性低于劳动所得税抵免，但比 2019 年儿童税收抵免和高等教育税收抵免的累进性更高。最后，我们描述了政策实施后剩余的联邦投资组合，并总结了联邦借款人当前的信贷状况。暂停付款的借款人的信用卡和汽车拖欠率不断上升，预示着如果联邦贷款付款在没有救济的情况下恢复，借款人未来将面临信贷困难。

title: The Dollar’s Imperial Circle
authors: Ozge Akinci, Gianluca Benigno, Serra Pelin, Jonathan Turek
abstract: In this paper we highlight a new channel through which dollar fluctuations can become a self-fulfilling pro-cyclical force. We call this mechanism “Imperial Circle” as it makes the dollar the dominant macroeconomic variable in the context of the current international monetary system. At the core of it, there is a fundamental asymmetry between the shrinking exposure of the “real” U.S. economy to global developments versus the growing global role of the U.S. dollar. Dollar appreciation leads to a decline in global economic activity, which in turn benefits, in relative terms, the dollar itself, reinforcing the initial appreciation and its effects.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 美元的帝国圈
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们强调了美元波动可以成为自我实现的顺周期力量的新渠道。我们将这种机制称为“帝国圈”，因为它使美元成为当前国际货币体系背景下的主导宏观经济变量。其核心是，美国“实体”经济对全球发展的影响不断缩小，而美元在全球的作用日益增强，两者之间存在着根本性的不对称。美元升值导致全球经济活动下降，相对而言，这反过来又使美元本身受益，强化了最初的升值及其影响。

title: Strategic Sophistication and Trading Profits: An Experiment with Professional Traders
authors: Marco Angrisani, Marco Cipriani, Antonio Guarino
abstract: We run an experiment where professional traders, endowed with private information, trade an asset over multiple periods. After the trading game, we gather information about the professional traders’ characteristics by having them carry out a series of tasks. We study which of these characteristics predict profits in the trading game. We find that strategic sophistication, as measured in the Guessing Game (for example, through level-k theory), is the only significant determinant of professional traders’ profits. In contrast, profits are not driven by individual characteristics such as cognitive abilities or behavioral traits. Moreover, higher profits are due to the ability to trade at favorable prices rather than to the ability to earn higher dividends. Comparing these results to those of a sample of students, we show that whereas cognitive skills are important for students, they are not for traders, whereas the opposite is the case for strategic sophistication.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 战略复杂性和交易利润：专业交易者的实验
abstract_zh: 我们进行了一项实验，让拥有私人信息的专业交易者在多个时期内交易资产。交易游戏结束后，我们通过让专业交易者执行一系列任务来收集有关他们特征的信息。我们研究这些特征中的哪些可以预测交易游戏中的利润。我们发现，通过猜谜游戏（例如通过 k 级理论）衡量的战略复杂性是专业交易者利润的唯一重要决定因素。相比之下，利润并不是由认知能力或行为特征等个人特征驱动的。此外，较高的利润是由于能够以有利的价格进行交易，而不是由于能够赚取更高的股息。将这些结果与学生样本的结果进行比较，我们发现，虽然认知技能对学生很重要，但对交易者来说并不重要，而战略复杂性则相反。

title: Job Ladder, Human Capital, and the Cost of Job Loss
authors: Richard Audoly, Federica De Pace, Giulio Fella
abstract: High-tenure workers who lose their jobs experience a large and prolonged fall in wages and earnings. To quantify the forces behind this empirical regularity, we propose a rich structural model of the labor market with heterogeneous firms, on-the-job search, and specific and general human capital. By jointly matching moments of workers’ mobility and wages, the model can replicate the losses in earnings and wages observed in the data. The loss of specific human capital is the primary driver of the cumulated wage losses post-displacement (49 percent), followed by the loss of a job with a more productive employer (33 percent).
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 工作阶梯、人力资本和失业成本
abstract_zh: 失去工作的高任期工人的工资和收入会经历长期的大幅下降。为了量化这种经验规律背后的力量，我们提出了一个丰富的劳动力市场结构模型，其中包括异质企业、在职搜索以及特定和一般人力资本。通过共同匹配工人流动性和工资的时刻，该模型可以复制数据中观察到的收入和工资损失。特定人力资本的损失是失业后累积工资损失的主要原因（49%），其次是失去生产力更高的雇主的工作（33%）。

title: Bank Funding Risk, Reference Rates, and Credit Supply
authors: Harry Cooperman, Darrell Duffie, Stephan Luck, Zachry Wang, Yilin Yang
abstract: Corporate credit lines are drawn more heavily when funding markets are more stressed. This covariance elevates expected bank funding costs. We show that credit supply is dampened by the associated debt-overhang cost to bank shareholders. Until 2022, this impact was reduced by linking the interest paid on lines to credit-sensitive reference rates such as LIBOR. We show that transition to risk-free reference rates may exacerbate this friction. The adverse impact on credit supply is offset if drawdowns are expected to be left on deposit at the same bank, which happened at some of the largest banks during the COVID recession.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 银行融资风险、参考利率和信贷供应
abstract_zh: 当融资市场压力更大时，企业信贷额度就会增加。这种协方差提高了预期的银行融资成本。我们的研究表明，信贷供应受到银行股东相关债务负担成本的抑制。到 2022 年，通过将额度支付的利息与 LIBOR 等信用敏感的参考利率挂钩，可以减少这种影响。我们表明，向无风险参考利率的过渡可能会加剧这种摩擦。如果预计提款将保留在同一家银行的存款上，那么对信贷供应的不利影响就会被抵消，在新冠疫情衰退期间，一些最大的银行就发生了这种情况。

title: Bank Regulation and Monetary Policy: The Role of Non-Bank Financial Institutions
authors: Gara Afonso, Marco Cipriani, Gabriele La Spada
abstract: Using a quasi-natural experiment, we show that quantitative easing (QE) interacts with bank regulation, impacting the size and portfolio choices of non-banks. In 2021, upon the expiration of the Supplementary Leverage Ratio relief, banks were incentivized to reduce leverage, shedding deposits and reducing the supply of wholesale debt. We show that as a result, money-market funds experienced large inflows and shifted their portfolios toward the Federal Reserve’s ONRRP facility. Our results imply that when non-banks can access the central-bank balance sheet, they end up holding a share of central-bank liabilities, draining reserves and affecting the impact of QE through banks.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 银行监管和货币政策：非银行金融机构的作用
abstract_zh: 通过准自然实验，我们表明量化宽松（QE）与银行监管相互作用，影响非银行的规模和投资组合选择。 2021年，补充杠杆率减免到期后，银行将被激励降低杠杆率、减少存款并减少批发债务的供应。我们的结果表明，货币市场基金经历了大量资金流入，并将其投资组合转向美联储的 ONRRP 工具。我们的结果表明，当非银行机构能够进入央行资产负债表时，它们最终会持有一定比例的央行负债，从而耗尽准备金并影响银行量化宽松的影响。

title: How Abundant Are Reserves? Evidence from the Wholesale Payment System
authors: Gara Afonso, Darrell Duffie, Lorenzo Rigon, Hyun Song Shin
abstract: Before the era of large central bank balance sheets, banks relied on incoming payments to fund outgoing payments in order to conserve scarce liquidity. Even in the era of large central bank balance sheets, rather than funding payments with abundant reserve balances, we show that outgoing payments remain highly sensitive to incoming payments. By providing a window on liquidity constraints revealed by payment behavior, our results shed light on thresholds for the adequacy of reserve balances. Our findings are timely, given the ongoing shrinking of central bank balance sheets around the world in response to inflation.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 储备有多丰富？来自批发支付系统的证据
abstract_zh: 在央行大型资产负债表时代之前，银行依靠收款为支出提供资金，以保存稀缺的流动性。即使在中央银行资产负债表庞大的时代，我们也表明支出仍然对收入高度敏感，而不是用大量准备金余额为支付提供资金。通过提供支付行为所揭示的流动性约束的窗口，我们的结果揭示了准备金余额充足性的阈值。鉴于世界各地央行为应对通胀而不断缩减资产负债表，我们的研究结果是及时的。

title: The Impact of U.S. Monetary Policy on Foreign Firms
authors: Julian di Giovanni, John H. Rogers
abstract: This paper uses cross-country firm-level data to explore the impact of U.S. monetary policy shocks on firms’ sales, investment, and employment. We estimate a significant impact of U.S. monetary policy on the average foreign firm, while controlling for other macroeconomic and financial variables like the VIX and exchange rate fluctuations that accompany U.S. monetary policy changes. We then estimate the role of international trade exposure and financial constraints in transmitting monetary policy shocks to firms, allowing for a better identification of the importance of external demand effects and the financial channel. We first exploit cross-country sector-level data on intermediate and final goods to show that greater global production linkages amplify the impact of U.S. monetary policy at the firm level. We then show that the impact varies along the firm-level distribution of proxies for firms’ financial constraints (for example, size and net worth), with the impact being significantly attenuated for less constrained firms.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 美国货币政策对外国企业的影响
abstract_zh: 本文使用跨国企业层面的数据来探讨美国货币政策冲击对企业销售、投资和就业的影响。我们估计美国货币政策对普通外国公司的重大影响，同时控制其他宏观经济和金融变量，如波动率指数和伴随美国货币政策变化的汇率波动。然后，我们估计国际贸易敞口和金融约束在向企业传递货币政策冲击方面的作用，以便更好地识别外部需求效应和金融渠道的重要性。我们首先利用中间产品和最终产品的跨国部门级数据来表明，更大的全球生产联系放大了美国货币政策对企业层面的影响。然后我们表明，影响随着公司财务约束（例如规模和净值）的代理在公司层面的分布而变化，对于约束较少的公司，影响显着减弱。

title: Should Mothers Work? How Perceptions of the Social Norm Affect Individual Attitudes Toward Work in the U.S
authors: Patricia Cortes, Gizem Koşar, Jessica Pan, Basit Zafar
abstract: We study how peer beliefs shape individual attitudes toward maternal labor supply using realistic hypothetical scenarios that elicit recommendations on the labor supply choices of a mother with a young child and an information treatment embedded within representative surveys. Across the scenarios, we find that individuals systematically overestimate the extent of gender conservativeness among the people around them. Exposure to information on peer beliefs leads to a shift in recommendations, driven largely by information-based belief updating. The information treatment also increases (intended and actual) donations to a nonprofit organization advocating for women in the workplace.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 母亲应该工作吗？对社会规范的看法如何影响美国个人对工作的态度
abstract_zh: 我们使用现实的假设情景来研究同伴信念如何塑造个人对孕产妇劳动力供应的态度，这些情景引出了关于带幼儿的母亲的劳动力供应选择的建议以及代表性调查中嵌入的信息处理。在所有情景中，我们发现个人系统性地高估了周围人的性别保守程度。接触同伴信念的信息会导致推荐的转变，这主要是由基于信息的信念更新驱动的。信息处理还增加了对倡导工作场所女性权益的非营利组织的（有意和实际）捐款。

title: The Curious Case of the Rise in Deflation Expectations
authors: Olivier Armantier, Gizem Koşar, Jason Somerville, Giorgio Topa, Wilbert Van der Klaauw, John C. Williams
abstract: We study the behavior of U.S. consumers’ inflation expectations during the high inflation period of 2021-23 using data from the New York Fed’s Survey of Consumer Expectations. Inflation expectations rose and fell as inflation surged and then moderated, but with notable differences across forecast horizons. Inflation uncertainty and disagreement also rose markedly and then abated. Despite the sharp rise in inflation, we see a sizable increase in the left tail of the distribution of medium- and longer-term expectations and increased expectations of deflation. Using a pair of special surveys, we find that those who expect deflation are more likely to expect price mean reversion and generally expect better, not worse, economic outcomes. We show that although a standard learning model of inflation expectations formation captures some of the movements in inflation expectations and inflation uncertainty over this period, the model is not able to replicate the timing of the rise in medium-term expectations and inflation uncertainty, some aspects of disagreement, or the rise in deflation expectations.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 通货紧缩预期上升的奇怪案例
abstract_zh: 我们使用纽约联储消费者预期调查的数据研究了 2021-23 年高通胀时期美国消费者通胀预期的行为。通胀预期随着通胀先飙升后放缓而上升和下降，但不同预测范围之间存在显着差异。通胀不确定性和分歧也显着上升，然后减弱。尽管通胀大幅上升，但我们看到中长期预期分布左尾大幅增加，通货紧缩预期上升。通过两项特别调查，我们发现那些预期通货紧缩的人更有可能预期价格均值回归，并且普遍预期经济结果会更好，而不是更糟。我们发现，尽管通胀预期形成的标准学习模型捕捉到了这一时期通胀预期和通胀不确定性的一些变动，但该模型无法复制中期预期和通胀不确定性上升的时间、某些方面的分歧或通货紧缩预期的上升。

title: All-to-All Trading in the U.S. Treasury Market
authors: Alain P. Chaboud, Caren Cox, Michael J. Fleming, Ellen Correia Golay, Yesol Huh, Frank M. Keane, Kyle Lee, Krista B. Schwarz, Clara Vega, Carolyn Windover
abstract: Although the U.S. Treasury market remains the deepest and most liquid securities market in the world, several episodes of market dysfunction over recent years have brought the market’s resilience into focus. The adoption of all-to-all trading in the Treasury market could be one avenue to strengthening market resilience. Conceptually, all-to-all trading would allow any market participant to trade directly with any other market participant. This could be helpful in times of stress when the capacity of traditional intermediaries may be tested. In this article, we discuss what all-to-all trading would mean for the Treasury market, the benefits it might bring, and what can be learned from the experience of other markets. We also review several trading protocols operating in the Treasury market that widen the field of trading partners and discuss the challenges to the broader use of such protocols or to the adoption of new all-to-all protocols.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 美国国债市场的全方位交易
abstract_zh: 尽管美国国债市场仍然是世界上最深入、流动性最强的证券市场，但近年来发生的几次市场功能失调事件使市场的弹性成为人们关注的焦点。在国债市场采用全面交易可能是增强市场弹性的途径之一。从概念上讲，全方位交易将允许任何市场参与者直接与任何其他市场参与者进行交易。当传统中介机构的能力受到考验时，这在压力时期可能会有所帮助。在本文中，我们讨论全方位交易对国债市场意味着什么、它可能带来的好处以及可以从其他市场的经验中学到什么。我们还回顾了在国债市场上运行的几种扩大贸易伙伴领域的交易协议，并讨论了更广泛使用此类协议或采用新的全面协议所面临的挑战。

title: Intermediation Frictions in Debt Relief: Evidence from CARES Act Forbearance
authors: You Suk Kim, Donghoon Lee, Tess C. Scharlemann, James Vickery
abstract: We study how intermediaries—mortgage servicers—shaped the implementation of mortgage forbearance during the COVID-19 pandemic and use servicer-level variation to trace out the causal effect of forbearance on borrowers. Forbearance provision varied widely across servicers. Small servicers and nonbanks, especially nonbanks with small liquidity buffers, facilitated fewer forbearances and saw a higher incidence of forbearance-related complaints. Easier access to forbearance substantially increased mortgage nonpayment but also reduced delinquencies outside of forbearance. Part of the liquidity from forbearance was used to reduce credit card debt, but most was saved or used for nondurable consumption.
keywords: Coronavirus Aid Relief and Economic Security (CARES) Act
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 债务减免中的中介摩擦：来自 CARES 法案宽容的证据
abstract_zh: 我们研究了中介机构（抵押贷款服务商）如何在 COVID-19 大流行期间影响抵押贷款宽限的实施，并利用服务机构层面的变化来追踪贷款宽限对借款人的因果影响。不同服务商的宽容规定差异很大。小型服务机构和非银行机构，尤其是流动性缓冲较小的非银行机构，促成了较少的宽容，并且与宽容相关的投诉发生率较高。更容易获得延期付款大大增加了抵押贷款拖欠率，但也减少了延期付款之外的拖欠情况。宽限期产生的部分流动性被用于减少信用卡债务，但大部分被储蓄或用于非耐用消费。

title: The Financial Stability Implications of Digital Assets
authors: Pablo D. Azar, Garth Baughman, Francesca Carapella, Jacob Gerszten, Arazi Lubis, JP Perez-Sangimino, David E. Rappoport, Chiara Scotti, Nathan Swem, Alexandros Vardoulakis, Aurite Werman
abstract: The value of assets in the digital ecosystem has grown rapidly amid periods of high volatility. Does the digital financial system create new potential challenges to financial stability? This paper explores this question using the Federal Reserve’s framework for analyzing vulnerabilities in the traditional financial system. The digital asset ecosystem has recently proven itself to be highly fragile. However, adverse digital asset market shocks have had limited spillovers to the traditional financial system. Currently, the digital asset ecosystem does not provide significant financial services outside the ecosystem, and it exhibits limited interconnections with the traditional financial system. The paper describes emerging vulnerabilities that could present risks to financial stability in the future if the digital asset ecosystem becomes more systemic, including run risks among large stablecoins, valuation pressures in crypto-assets, fragilities of DeFi platforms, growing interconnectedness, and a general lack of regulation.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 数字资产对金融稳定的影响
abstract_zh: 数字生态系统中的资产价值在高波动时期快速增长。数字金融体系是否会给金融稳定带来新的潜在挑战？本文利用美联储分析传统金融体系脆弱性的框架来探讨这个问题。数字资产生态系统最近被证明是非常脆弱的。然而，数字资产市场的不利冲击对传统金融体系的溢出效应有限。目前，数字资产生态系统并未向生态系统之外提供重要的金融服务，与传统金融体系的互联互通也有限。该论文描述了如果数字资产生态系统变得更加系统化，未来可能对金融稳定带来风险的新出现的漏洞，包括大型稳定币的运行风险、加密资产的估值压力、DeFi 平台的脆弱性、日益增强的互联性以及普遍缺乏监管。

title: Approximating Grouped Fixed Effects Estimation via Fuzzy Clustering Regression
authors: Daniel J. Lewis, Davide Melcangi, Laura Pilossoph, Aidan Toner-Rodgers
abstract: We propose a new, computationally-efficient way to approximate the “grouped fixed-effects” (GFE) estimator of Bonhomme and Manresa (2015), which estimates grouped patterns of unobserved heterogeneity. To do so, we generalize the fuzzy C-means objective to regression settings. As the regularization parameter m approaches 1, the fuzzy clustering objective converges to the GFE objective; moreover, we recast this objective as a standard Generalized Method of Moments problem. We replicate the empirical results of Bonhomme and Manresa (2015) and show that our estimator delivers almost identical estimates. In simulations, we show that our approach delivers improvements in terms of bias, classification accuracy, and computational speed.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 通过模糊聚类回归近似分组固定效应估计
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新的、计算高效的方法来近似 Bonhomme 和 Manresa（2015）的“分组固定效应”（GFE）估计器，该估计器估计未观察到的异质性的分组模式。为此，我们将模糊 C 均值目标推广到回归设置。当正则化参数m接近1时，模糊聚类目标收敛于GFE目标；此外，我们将这个目标重新定义为标准的广义矩量法问题。我们复制了 Bonhomme 和 Manresa (2015) 的实证结果，并表明我们的估计器提供了几乎相同的估计。在模拟中，我们表明我们的方法在偏差、分类精度和计算速度方面都有所改进。

title: Risk-Free Rates and Convenience Yields Around the World
authors: William Diamond, Peter Van Tassel
abstract: We infer risk-free rates from index option prices to estimate safe asset convenience yields in ten G-11 currencies. Countries' convenience yields increase linearly with the level of their interest rates, with U.S. convenience yields being the fifth largest. During financial crises, convenience yields grow, but the difference between U.S. and foreign convenience yields generally does not. Covered interest parity (CIP) deviations using our option-implied rates are roughly the same size between the U.S. and each other country. A model where convenience yields depend on domestic financial intermediaries, but CIP deviations depend on international arbitrageurs funded with wholesale dollar-denominated debt, explains these results.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 全球无风险利率和便利收益
abstract_zh: 我们从指数期权价格推断无风险利率，以估计 10 种 G-11 货币的安全资产便利收益率。各国的便利收益率随利率水平线性增长，其中美国的便利收益率排名第五。在金融危机期间，便利收益率会增长，但美国和外国便利收益率之间的差异通常不会增长。使用我们的期权隐含利率计算的备兑利率平价 (CIP) 偏差在美国和其他国家/地区之间的大小大致相同。在一个模型中，便利收益率取决于国内金融中介机构，但 CIP 偏差取决于以批发美元计价债务资助的国际套利者，这解释了这些结果。

title: 800,000 Years of Climate Risk
authors: Tobias Adrian, Nina Boyarchenko, Domenico Giannone, Ananthakrishnan Prasad, Dulani Seneviratne, Yanzhe Xiao
abstract: We use a long history of global temperature and atmospheric carbon dioxide (CO2) concentration to estimate the conditional joint evolution of temperature and CO2 at a millennial frequency. We document three basic facts. First, the temperature–CO2 dynamics are non-linear, so that large deviations in either temperature or CO2 concentrations take a long time to correct–on the scale of multiple millennia. Second, the joint dynamics of temperature and CO2 concentrations exhibit multimodality around historical turning points in temperature and concentration cycles, so that prior to the start of cooling periods, there is a noticeable probability that temperature and CO2 concentrations may continue to increase. Finally, evaluating the future evolution of temperature and CO2 concentration conditional on alternative scenarios realizing, we document that, even conditional on the net-zero 2050 scenario, there remains a significant risk of elevated temperatures for at least a further five millennia.
keywords: Network for Greening the Financial System (NGFS) scenarios
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 80万年的气候风险
abstract_zh: 我们利用全球温度和大气二氧化碳 (CO2) 浓度的长期历史来估计千禧年频率下温度和二氧化碳的条件联合演化。我们记录了三个基本事实。首先，温度-二氧化碳动态是非线性的，因此温度或二氧化碳浓度的巨大偏差需要很长时间才能纠正——达到数千年的规模。其次，温度和二氧化碳浓度的联合动态在温度和浓度循环的历史转折点附近表现出多模态，因此在冷却期开始之前，温度和二氧化碳浓度很可能会继续增加。最后，在评估替代情景实现的条件下温度和二氧化碳浓度的未来演变时，我们记录到，即使以 2050 年净零情景为条件，至少在未来五千年内仍然存在气温升高的重大风险。

title: Leader-Follower Dynamics in Shareholder Activism
authors: Doruk Cetemen, Gonzalo Cisternas, Aaron Kolb, S Viswanathan
abstract: We propose a theory of coordination and influence among blockholders. Privately informed activists time their trades in sequence to lower acquisition costs, prompting a strategic use of order flows. Leader activists create trading gains for their followers, ultimately influencing their willingness to bear greater value-enhancing intervention costs. Through this channel, informed trades can exhibit predictability, in sharp contrast with Kyle (1985). We explain how this novel predictability shapes free-rider problems affecting governance, and how it produces price abnormalities analogous to those documented empirically. We also uncover how private information interdependence can be a key catalyst for the mechanism studied.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 股东积极性中的领导者-追随者动态
abstract_zh: 我们提出了大股东之间的协调和影响理论。私下知情的积极分子按顺序安排交易时间，以降低获取成本，从而促进对订单流的战略性利用。领导者积极分子为追随者创造交易收益，最终影响他们承担更大的增值干预成本的意愿。通过这个渠道，知情交易可以表现出可预测性，这与 Kyle (1985) 形成鲜明对比。我们解释了这种新颖的可预测性如何塑造影响治理的搭便车问题，以及它如何产生类似于经验记录的价格异常。我们还揭示了私人信息相互依赖如何成为所研究机制的关键催化剂。

title: Nonconforming Preferences: Jumbo Mortgage Lending and Large Bank Stress Tests
authors: Andrew F. Haughwout, Donald P. Morgan, Michael Neubauer, Maxim L. Pinkovskiy, Wilbert Van der Klaauw
abstract: The 2010s saw a profound shift towards jumbo mortgage lending by large banks that are regulated under the Dodd-Frank Act. Using data from the Home Mortgage Disclosure Act, we show that the “jumbo shift” is correlated with being subject to the Comprehensive Capital Analysis and Review (CCAR) stress tests, and that financial regulation caused CCAR-regulated banks to change preference for nonconforming relative to conforming loans of similar size. We discuss potential mechanisms through which regulation could have affected bank incentives.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 不合格偏好：巨额抵押贷款和大型银行压力测试
abstract_zh: 2010 年代，受《多德弗兰克法案》监管的大型银行发生了向巨额抵押贷款的深刻转变。使用《住房抵押贷款披露法案》中的数据，我们表明“巨额转变”与接受综合资本分析和审查 (CCAR) 压力测试相关，并且金融监管导致受 CCAR 监管的银行相对于类似规模的合格贷款改变了对不合格贷款的偏好。我们讨论了监管可能影响银行激励的潜在机制。

title: Misinformation in Social Media: The Role of Verification Incentives
authors: Gonzalo Cisternas, Jorge Vásquez
abstract: We develop a model of a platform featuring producers of fake news as well as users who can share content and verify it at a cost. Since users supply news to other users, their actions affect fake news prevalence and strategic complementarities can arise: high levels of verification can lead to low prevalence of fake content, in turn inducing more unverified sharing that sustains high levels of verification. Equilibria in this market then arise as intersection points between a standard supply curve and a novel correspondence that generalizes a demand function to account for the users’ strategic environment. Equilibria exhibiting more fake news production and diffusion can be consistent with higher user welfare due to the strong verification complementarities at play. We also quantify externalities associated with users affecting the average quality of news items in the platform and examine the effects on outcomes of (i) lowering verification costs, (ii) certifying verified content, and (iii) using algorithmic filters.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 社交媒体中的错误信息：验证激励的作用
abstract_zh: 我们开发了一个平台模型，其中包括假新闻的制作者以及可以分享内容并以一定成本验证内容的用户。由于用户向其他用户提供新闻，他们的行为会影响假新闻的流行，并且可能会出现战略互补性：高水平的验证可以导致虚假内容的低流行，进而引发更多未经验证的共享，从而维持高水平的验证。然后，该市场中的均衡出现为标准供给曲线和新对应关系之间的交点，该新对应关系概括了需求函数以解释用户的战略环境。由于强大的验证互补性，表现出更多假新闻生产和传播的均衡可以与更高的用户福利相一致。我们还量化了与影响平台中新闻项目平均质量的用户相关的外部性，并检查了对以下结果的影响：(i) 降低验证成本，(ii) 认证经过验证的内容，以及 (iii) 使用算法过滤器。

title: GDP Solera: The Ideal Vintage Mix
authors: Dante Amengual, Gabriele Fiorentini, Martín Almuzara, Enrique Sentana
abstract: We exploit the information in the successive vintages of gross domestic expenditure (GDE) and gross domestic income (GDI) from the current comprehensive revision to obtain an improved, timely measure of U.S. aggregate output by exploiting cointegration between the different measures and taking their monthly release calendar seriously. We also combine all existing overlapping comprehensive revisions to achieve further improvements. We pay particular attention to the Great Recession and the pandemic, which, despite producing dramatic fluctuations, does not generate noticeable revisions in previous growth rates. The estimated parameters of our dynamic state-space model suggest that comprehensive revisions have not changed the long-run growth rate of U.S. GDP.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: GDP Solera：理想的复古组合
abstract_zh: 我们利用当前综合修订中连续年份的国内总支出 (GDE) 和国内总收入 (GDI) 的信息，通过利用不同指标之间的协整并认真对待其月度发布日历，获得改进的、及时的美国总产出指标。我们还将现有的所有重叠的综合修订结合起来，以实现进一步的改进。我们特别关注大衰退和大流行病，尽管它们产生了剧烈的波动，但并没有对之前的增长率产生明显的修正。我们的动态状态空间模型的估计参数表明，全面修正并没有改变美国GDP的长期增长率。

title: Fragility of Safe Asset Markets
authors: Thomas M. Eisenbach, Gregory Phelan
abstract: In March 2020, safe asset markets experienced surprising and unprecedented price crashes. We explain how strategic investor behavior can create such market fragility in a model with investors valuing safety, investors valuing liquidity, and constrained dealers. While safety investors and liquidity investors can interact symbiotically with offsetting trades in times of stress, liquidity investors’ strategic interaction harbors the potential for self-fulfilling fragility. When the market is fragile, standard flight-to-safety can have a destabilizing effect and trigger a “dash-for-cash” by liquidity investors. Well-designed policy interventions can reduce market fragility ex ante and restore orderly functioning ex post.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 安全资产市场的脆弱性
abstract_zh: 2020 年 3 月，安全资产市场经历了令人惊讶且前所未有的价格暴跌。我们解释了战略投资者行为如何在投资者重视安全性、投资者重视流动性和受限交易商的模型中造成这种市场脆弱性。虽然安全投资者和流动性投资者可以在压力时期通过抵消交易共生互动，但流动性投资者的战略互动却存在自我实现脆弱性的可能性。当市场脆弱时，标准的避险行为可能会产生破坏稳定的效果，并引发流动性投资者的“抢钱”行为。精心设计的政策干预措施可以事前降低市场脆弱性，事后恢复有序运作。

title: A Bayesian Approach to Inference on Probabilistic Surveys
authors: Federico Bassetti, Roberto Casarin, Marco Del Negro
abstract: We propose a nonparametric Bayesian approach for conducting inference on probabilistic surveys. We use this approach to study whether U.S. Survey of Professional Forecasters density projections for output growth and inflation from 1982 to 2022 are consistent with the noisy rational expectations hypothesis. We find that, in contrast to theory, for horizons close to two years there is no relationship whatsoever between subjective uncertainty and forecast accuracy for output growth density projections, both across forecasters and over time, and only a mild relationship for inflation projections. As the horizon shortens, the relationship becomes one-to-one as theory predicts.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 概率调查推理的贝叶斯方法
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种非参数贝叶斯方法来对概率调查进行推理。我们使用这种方法来研究美国专业预测者调查对 1982 年至 2022 年产出增长和通货膨胀的密度预测是否与嘈杂的理性预期假设一致。我们发现，与理论相反，在接近两年的时间范围内，主观不确定性与产出增长密度预测的预测准确性之间没有任何关系，无论是在预测者之间还是随着时间的推移，而与通货膨胀预测之间只有温和的关系。随着时间范围的缩短，这种关系正如理论预测的那样变成一对一的。

title: Global Supply Chain Pressures, International Trade, and Inflation
authors: Julian di Giovanni, Ṣebnem Kalemli-Özcan, Alvaro Silva, Muhammed A. Yildirim
abstract: We study the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on euro area inflation and how it compares to the experiences of other countries, such as the United States, over the two-year period 2020-21. Our model-based calibration exercises deliver four key results: (1) compositional effects, or the switch from services to goods consumption, are amplified through global input-output linkages, affecting both trade and inflation; (2) inflation can be higher under sector-specific labor shortages relative to a scenario with no such supply shocks; (3) foreign shocks and global supply chain bottlenecks played an outsized role relative to domestic aggregate demand shocks in explaining euro area inflation over 2020–21; and (4) international trade did not respond to changes in GDP as strongly as it did during the 2008–09 crisis despite strong demand for goods. These lower trade elasticities in part reflect supply chain bottlenecks. These four results imply that policies aimed at stimulating aggregate demand would not have produced as high an inflation as the one observed in the data without the negative sectoral supply shocks.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 全球供应链压力、国际贸易和通货膨胀
abstract_zh: 我们研究了 COVID-19 大流行对欧元区通胀的影响，以及与美国等其他国家在 2020-21 年两年期间的经验的比较。我们基于模型的校准工作取得了四个关键成果：(1) 构成效应，即从服务消费到商品消费的转变，通过全球投入产出联系被放大，影响贸易和通货膨胀； (2) 相对于没有此类供应冲击的情况，在特定部门劳动力短缺的情况下，通货膨胀可能会更高； (3) 相对于国内总需求冲击，外国冲击和全球供应链瓶颈在解释 2020-21 年欧元区通胀方面发挥了巨大作用； (4) 尽管商品需求强劲，但国际贸易对 GDP 变化的反应不如 2008-09 年危机期间那么强烈。贸易弹性较低在一定程度上反映了供应链瓶颈。这四项结果意味着，如果没有负面的部门供应冲击，旨在刺激总需求的政策不会产生像数据中观察到的那样高的通货膨胀。

title: Intermediary Balance Sheets and the Treasury Yield Curve
authors: Wenxin Du, Benjamin Hébert, Wenhao Li
abstract: We have documented a regime change in the U.S. Treasury market post-Global Financial Crisis (GFC). We first derived bounds on Treasury yields that account for dealer balance sheet costs, which we call the net short and net long curves. We show that actual Treasury yields moved from the net short curve pre- GFC to the net long curve post-GFC, consistent with the shift in the dealers’ net position. We then use a stylized model to demonstrate that increased bond supply and tightening leverage constraints can explain this change in regime. This change, in turn, helps explain negative swap spreads and the co-movement between swap spreads, dealer positions, yield curve slope, and covered-interest-parity violations, and implies changing effects for a wide range of monetary and regulatory policy interventions.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 中介资产负债表和国债收益率曲线
abstract_zh: 我们记录了全球金融危机（GFC）后美国国债市场的政权更迭。我们首先推导出考虑交易商资产负债表成本的国债收益率界限，我们称之为净空头和净多头曲线。我们发现，实际国债收益率从全球金融危机前的净空头曲线转向全球金融危机后的净多头曲线，这与交易商净头寸的变化一致。然后，我们使用一个程式化模型来证明增加债券供应和收紧杠杆限制可以解释这种制度变化。这一变化反过来有助于解释负掉期利差以及掉期利差、交易商头寸、收益率曲线斜率和覆盖利率平价违规之间的联动，并意味着广泛的货币和监管政策干预的影响发生变化。

title: When It Rains, It Pours: Cyber Risk and Financial Conditions
authors: Thomas M. Eisenbach, Anna Kovner, Michael Junho Lee
abstract: We analyze how systemic cyber risk relates to the financial cycle and show that the potential impact of a cyber attack is systematically greater during stressed financial conditions. This is true over the past two decades and particularly at the onset of the COVID-19 pandemic, when changes in payment activity increased vulnerability by approximately 50 percent relative to the rest of 2020 through more concentration and intraday liquidity stress. We evaluate the effectiveness of policy interventions used to stabilize markets at mitigating cyber vulnerability. We argue that cyber and other financial shocks cannot be treated as uncorrelated vulnerabilities and policy solutions for cyber need to be calibrated for adverse financial conditions.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 下雨时倾盆大雨：网络风险和财务状况
abstract_zh: 我们分析了系统性网络风险与金融周期的关系，并表明在金融环境紧张的情况下，网络攻击的潜在影响会更大。过去二十年确实如此，尤其是在新冠肺炎 (COVID-19) 大流行爆发之初，由于更加集中和日内流动性压力，支付活动的变化使脆弱性相对 2020 年剩余时间增加了约 50%。我们评估用于稳定市场、减轻网络脆弱性的政策干预措施的有效性。我们认为，网络和其他金融冲击不能被视为不相关的漏洞，网络政策解决方案需要针对不利的金融状况进行调整。

title: Income Inequality and Job Creation
authors: Sebastian Doerr, Thomas Drechsel, Donggyu Lee
abstract: We propose a novel channel through which rising income inequality affects job creation and macroeconomic outcomes. High-income households save relatively more in stocks and bonds but less in bank deposits. A rising top income share thereby increases the relative financing cost for bank-dependent firms, which in turn create fewer jobs. Exploiting variation in top income shares across US states and an instrumental variable strategy, we provide evidence for this channel. We then build a general equilibrium macro model with heterogeneous households and heterogeneous firms and calibrate it to our empirical estimates. The model shows that the secular rise in top incomes accounts for 13 percent of the decline in the employment share of small firms since 1980. Through the new channel, rising inequality also reduces the labor share and aggregate output. Model experiments show that ignoring the link between inequality and job creation understates welfare effects of income redistribution.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 收入不平等和创造就业机会
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种新的渠道，收入不平等的加剧可以通过这种渠道影响就业创造和宏观经济成果。高收入家庭的股票和债券储蓄相对较多，但银行存款较少。因此，最高收入份额的上升增加了依赖银行的企业的相对融资成本，从而创造了更少的就业机会。利用美国各州最高收入份额的差异和工具变量策略，我们为该渠道提供了证据。然后，我们建立了一个包含异质家庭和异质企业的一般均衡宏观模型，并根据我们的经验估计对其进行校准。该模型显示，自 1980 年以来，小企业就业份额下降的 13% 归因于顶层收入的长期增长。通过新的渠道，不平等的加剧也降低了劳动份额和总产出。模型实验表明，忽视不平等与创造就业之间的联系会低估收入再分配的福利效应。

title: A Robust Test for Weak Instruments with Multiple Endogenous Regressors
authors: Daniel J. Lewis, Karel Mertens
abstract: We extend the popular bias-based test of Stock and Yogo (2005) for instrument strength in linear instrumental variables regressions with multiple endogenous regressors to be robust to heteroskedasticity and autocorrelation. Equivalently, we extend the robust test of Montiel Olea and Pflueger (2013) for one endogenous regressor to the general case with multiple endogenous regressors. We describe a simple procedure for applied researchers to conduct our generalized first-stage test of instrument strength and provide efficient and easy-to-use Matlab code for its implementation. We demonstrate our testing procedures by considering the estimation of the state-dependent effects of fiscal policy as in Ramey and Zubairy (2018).
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 具有多个内生回归量的弱仪器的稳健测试
abstract_zh: 我们扩展了 Stock 和 Yogo (2005) 流行的基于偏差的检验，以检测具有多个内生回归量的线性工具变量回归中的工具强度，以对异方差和自相关具有鲁棒性。同样，我们将 Montiel Olea 和 Pflueger (2013) 对一个内生回归量的稳健检验扩展到具有多个内生回归量的一般情况。我们描述了一个简单的程序，供应用研究人员进行仪器强度的广义第一阶段测试，并为其实现提供高效且易于使用的 Matlab 代码。我们通过考虑对财政政策的国家依赖性影响的估计（如 Ramey 和 Zubairy，2018 年）来展示我们的测试程序。

title: Scarce, Abundant, or Ample? A Time-Varying Model of the Reserve Demand Curve
authors: Gara Afonso, Domenico Giannone, Gabriele La Spada, John C. Williams
abstract: What level of central bank reserves satiates banks’ demand for liquidity? We estimate the slope of the reserve demand curve in the U.S. over 2010–2024 using a time-varying instrumental-variable approach at the daily frequency. When reserves exceed 12-13 percent of banks’ assets, demand for reserves is satiated and reserves are abundant; below this threshold, the curve’s slope becomes increasingly negative as reserves decline from ample to scarce. We also find that reserve demand has shifted over time, both vertically and horizontally, and identify important drivers of vertical shifts. Our methodology works well out-of-sample and can assess reserve ampleness in real time.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 稀缺、丰富还是充足？准备金需求曲线的时变模型
abstract_zh: 央行的储备水平多少才能满足银行的流动性需求？我们使用时变工具变量方法以每日频率估算 2010 年至 2024 年美国准备金需求曲线的斜率。当准备金超过银行资产的12-13%时，准备金需求满足，准备金充裕；低于这个阈值，随着储备从充足下降到稀缺，曲线的斜率变得越来越负。我们还发现，储备需求随着时间的推移发生了垂直和水平的变化，并确定了垂直变化的重要驱动因素。我们的方法在样本外效果很好，可以实时评估储备充足程度。

title: Expectations Data in Structural Microeconomic Models
authors: Gizem Koşar, Cormac O'Dea
abstract: A growing literature uses now widely available data on beliefs and expectations in the estimation of structural models. In this chapter, we review this literature, with an emphasis on models of individual and household behavior. We first show how expectations data have been used to relax strong assumptions about beliefs and outline how they can be used in estimation to substitute for, or as a complement to, data on choices. Next, we discuss the literature that uses different types of expectations data in the estimation of structural models. We conclude by noting directions for future research.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 结构微观经济模型中的预期数据
abstract_zh: 越来越多的文献使用现在广泛可用的有关信念和期望的数据来估计结构模型。在本章中，我们回顾了这些文献，重点是个人和家庭行为模型。我们首先展示如何使用期望数据来放松关于信念的强烈假设，并概述如何在估计中使用它们来替代或补充选择数据。接下来，我们讨论在结构模型估计中使用不同类型的期望数据的文献。最后，我们指出了未来研究的方向。

title: The GSCPI: A New Barometer of Global Supply Chain Pressures
authors: Gianluca Benigno, Julian di Giovanni, Jan J. J. Groen, Adam I. Noble
abstract: We propose a novel indicator to capture pressures that arise at the global supply chain level, the Global Supply Chain Pressure Index (GSCPI). The GSCPI provides a new monitoring tool to gauge global supply chain conditions. We assess the index’s capacity to explain inflation outcomes, using the local projection method. Our analysis shows that recent inflationary pressures are closely related to the behavior of the GSCPI, especially at the level of producer price inflation in the United States and the euro area.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: GSCPI：全球供应链压力的新晴雨表
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个新的指标来捕捉全球供应链层面出现的压力，即全球供应链压力指数（GSCPI）。 GSCPI 提供了一种新的监测工具来衡量全球供应链状况。我们使用局部预测方法评估该指数解释通胀结果的能力。我们的分析表明，近期的通胀压力与 GSCPI 的表现密切相关，特别是在美国和欧元区的生产者价格通胀水平上。

title: Uncertainty Shocks, Capital Flows, and International Risk Spillovers
authors: Ozge Akinci, Ṣebnem Kalemli-Özcan, Albert Queraltó
abstract: Foreign investors’ changing appetite for risk-taking has been shown to be a key determinant of the global financial cycle. Such fluctuations in risk sentiment also correlate with the dynamics of uncovered interest parity (UIP) premia, capital flows, and exchange rates. To understand how these risk sentiment changes transmit across borders, we propose a two-country macroeconomic framework. Our model features cross-border holdings of risky assets by U.S. financial intermediaries that operate under financial frictions and act as global intermediaries in that they take on foreign asset risk. In this setup, an exogenous increase in U.S.-specific uncertainty, modeled as higher volatility in U.S. assets, leads to higher risk premia in both countries. This occurs because higher uncertainty leads to deleveraging pressure on U.S. intermediaries, triggering higher global risk premia and lower global asset values. Moreover, when U.S. uncertainty rises, the exchange rate in the foreign country vis-a-vis the dollar depreciates, capital flows out of the foreign country, and the UIP premium increases in the foreign country and decreases in the U.S., as in the data.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 不确定性冲击、资本流动和国际风险溢出
abstract_zh: 事实证明，外国投资者冒险偏好的变化是全球金融周期的关键决定因素。风险情绪的这种波动还与未偿还利率平价（UIP）溢价、资本流动和汇率的动态相关。为了了解这些风险情绪变化如何跨境传播，我们提出了一个两国宏观经济框架。我们的模型的特点是美国金融中介机构跨境持有风险资产，这些金融中介机构在金融摩擦下运作，并充当全球中介机构，承担外国资产风险。在这种情况下，美国特有的不确定性的外生增加（以美国资产波动性加大为模型）会导致两国风险溢价上升。出现这种情况的原因是，较高的不确定性导致美国中介机构面临去杠杆化压力，引发全球风险溢价上升和全球资产价值下降。此外，当美国的不确定性上升时，外国的汇率相对于美元贬值，资本流出外国，UIP溢价在外国增加，在美国减少，正如数据所示。

title: Managing Monetary Policy Normalization
authors: Gianluca Benigno, Pierpaolo Benigno
abstract: We propose a new framework for monetary policy analysis to study monetary policy normalization when exiting a liquidity trap. The optimal combination of reserves and interest rate policy requires an increase in liquidity (reserves) a few quarters after the policy rate is set at the effective lower bound. Removal of accommodation requires that quantitative tightening starts before the liftoff of the policy rate. Moreover, the withdrawal of liquidity takes place at a very slow pace relative to the normalization of the policy rate.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 管理货币政策正常化
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个新的货币政策分析框架，以研究退出流动性陷阱时的货币政策正常化。准备金和利率政策的最佳组合需要在政策利率设定为有效下限后几个季度增加流动性（准备金）。取消宽松政策要求在政策利率提升之前开始量化紧缩。此外，相对于政策利率正常化而言，流动性的撤出速度非常缓慢。

title: Climate Regulatory Risks and Corporate Bonds
authors: Lee Seltzer, Laura Starks, Qifei Zhu
abstract: Investor and policymaker concerns about climate risks suggest these risks should affect the risk assessment and pricing of corporate securities, particularly for firms facing stricter regulatory enforcement. Using corporate bonds, the authors find support for this hypothesis. Employing a shock to expected climate regulations, they show climate regulatory risks causally affect bond credit ratings and spreads. A structural credit model indicates that the increased spreads for high carbon issuers, especially those located in stricter regulatory environments, are driven by changes in firms' asset volatilities rather than asset values, highlighting that regulatory uncertainty affects security pricing. The results have important implications for policy-making.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 气候监管风险与公司债券
abstract_zh: 投资者和政策制定者对气候风险的担忧表明，这些风险应该会影响公司证券的风险评估和定价，特别是对于面临更严格监管执法的公司而言。作者利用公司债券找到了对这一假设的支持。通过对预期气候监管的冲击，他们表明气候监管风险会因果影响债券信用评级和利差。结构性信贷模型表明，高碳发行人（尤其是那些处于更严格监管环境的发行人）利差的增加是由公司资产波动性而不是资产价值的变化驱动的，这凸显了监管的不确定性影响了证券定价。结果对政策制定具有重要影响。

title: The Narrow Channel of Quantitative Easing: Evidence from YCC Down Under
authors: David O. Lucca, Jonathan H. Wright
abstract: We study the recent Australian experience with yield curve control (YCC) of government bonds as perhaps the best evidence of how this policy might work in other developed economies. We interpret the evidence with a simple model in which YCC affects prices of both government and other bonds via “broad” transmission channels, but only government bond prices through “narrow” liquidity channels. YCC seemingly worked well in 2020 while the market expected short rates to stay at zero for long. But as the global recovery and inflation gained momentum in 2021, liftoff expectations moved up, the Reserve Bank of Australia purchased most of the outstanding amount of the targeted government bond, and its yield dislocated from other financial market instruments. The model and empirical evidence point to narrow transmission channels playing more prominent roles than broad channels considered in prior studies of quantitative easing (QE), such as portfolio balance effects and signaling about short term rates. We argue that asset-specific narrow channels may be primary transmission mechanisms of quantity-based QE policies as well.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 量化宽松的狭窄通道：来自澳大利亚 YCC 的证据
abstract_zh: 我们研究了澳大利亚最近在政府债券收益率曲线控制（YCC）方面的经验，这也许是该政策如何在其他发达经济体发挥作用的最佳证据。我们用一个简单的模型来解释证据，其中 YCC 通过“广泛”的传导渠道影响政府债券和其他债券的价格，但仅通过“狭窄”的流动性渠道影响政府债券的价格。 YCC 似乎在 2020 年表现良好，而市场预计短期利率将长期保持在零。但随着2021年全球复苏和通胀势头增强，升值预期上升，澳联储购买了大部分目标国债，其收益率与其他金融市场工具脱节。该模型和经验证据表明，狭窄的传导渠道比之前的量化宽松（QE）研究中考虑的广泛渠道发挥着更重要的作用，例如投资组合平衡效应和短期利率信号。我们认为，特定资产的窄渠道也可能是基于数量的量化宽松政策的主要传导机制。

title: Unintended Consequences of "Mandatory" Flood Insurance
authors: Kristian S. Blickle, João A. C. Santos
abstract: We show that the National Flood Insurance Program inadvertently concentrated flood risk among households least able to bear it. Using nationwide flood map data, HMDA records, and credit panel data, we show: (i) insurance mandates reduce mortgage lending, particularly for low-income applicants, (ii) these households disproportionately sort into areas immediately adjacent to flood zones, where credit is still available to them but actual flood risk remains, (iii) following disasters, households in these areas experience sharp increases in debt and delinquency rates. Our results show that binary insurance mandates, which are not reflective of true underlying risk, have adverse unintended consequences.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: “强制性”洪水保险的意外后果
abstract_zh: 我们发现，国家洪水保险计划无意中将洪水风险集中在最无力承受的家庭身上。利用全国洪水地图数据、HMDA 记录和信用小组数据，我们显示：(i) 保险规定减少了抵押贷款，特别是对低收入申请人而言，(ii) 这些家庭不成比例地分布在紧邻洪水区的地区，这些地区仍然可以获得信贷，但实际的洪水风险仍然存在，(iii) 灾害发生后，这些地区的家庭的债务和拖欠率急剧上升。我们的结果表明，二元保险指令不能反映真正的潜在风险，会产生意想不到的不利后果。

title: Macroeconomic Drivers and the Pricing of Uncertainty, Inflation, and Bonds
authors: Brandyn Bok, Thomas M. Mertens, John C. Williams
abstract: The correlation between uncertainty shocks, as measured by changes in the VIX, and changes in breakeven inflation rates declined and turned negative after the Great Recession. This estimated time-varying correlation is shown to be consistent with the predictions of a standard New Keynesian model with a lower bound on interest rates and a trend decline in the natural rate of interest. In one equilibrium of the model, higher uncertainty raises the probability of large shocks that leave the central bank constrained by the lower bound and unable to offset negative shocks. Resulting inflation shortfalls lower average inflation rates.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 宏观经济驱动因素以及不确定性、通货膨胀和债券的定价
abstract_zh: 大衰退后，以波动率指数变化衡量的不确定性冲击与盈亏平衡通胀率变化之间的相关性下降并转为负值。这种估计的时变相关性与标准新凯恩斯主义模型的预测一致，该模型具有利率下限和自然利率的趋势下降。在模型的一种均衡中，较高的不确定性增加了发生大规模冲击的可能性，从而使央行受到下限的限制，无法抵消负面冲击。由此产生的通胀缺口降低了平均通胀率。

title: The Global Dash for Cash: Why Sovereign Bond Market Functioning Varied across Jurisdictions in March 2020
authors: Jordan Barone, Alain P. Chaboud, Adam Copeland, Cullen Kavoussi, Frank M. Keane, Seth Searls
abstract: As the economic disruptions associated with the COVID-19 pandemic increased in March 2020, there was a global dash-for-cash by investors. This selling pressure occurred across advanced sovereign bond markets and caused a deterioration in market functioning, leading to central bank interventions. We show that these market disruptions occurred disproportionately in the U.S. Treasury market and were due to investors’ selling pressures being far more pronounced and broad-based. Furthermore, we assess differences in key drivers of the market disruptions across sovereign bond markets, based on an analysis of the data as well as structured outreach to a range of market participants.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 全球现金争夺战：为何 2020 年 3 月各司法管辖区的主权债券市场运行情况各不相同
abstract_zh: 2020 年 3 月，随着新冠肺炎 (COVID-19) 大流行对经济造成的干扰加剧，全球投资者纷纷抢购现金。这种抛售压力遍及发达主权债券市场，导致市场功能恶化，导致央行干预。我们发现，这些市场扰乱在美国国债市场上发生得不成比例，这是由于投资者的抛售压力更加明显和广泛。此外，我们根据数据分析以及对一系列市场参与者的结构化推广，评估了主权债券市场市场混乱的关键驱动因素的差异。

title: Money Market Fund Vulnerabilities: A Global Perspective
authors: Antoine Bouveret, Antoine Martin, Patrick E. McCabe
abstract: Money market funds (MMFs) are popular around the world, with over $9 trillion in assets under management globally. From their origins in the 1970s, MMFs have operated in a niche between the capital markets and the banking system, as investment funds that offer private money-like assets with features similar to those of bank deposits. Hence, they are vulnerable to runs that arise from liquidity transformation and from sudden changes in investor perceptions of the funds’ ability to serve as money-like assets. Since 2000, MMF runs have occurred in many countries and under many regulatory regimes. The global pattern of runs and crises shows that MMF vulnerabilities are not unique to a particular set of governing arrangements, and that mitigating these vulnerabilities requires fundamental reforms that either place MMFs more clearly within the investment-fund sector or establish protections for MMFs similar to those for deposits.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 货币市场基金的脆弱性：全球视角
abstract_zh: 货币市场基金 (MMF) 在全球范围内广受欢迎，全球管理的资产超过 9 万亿美元。自 20 世纪 70 年代诞生以来，货币市场基金一直在资本市场和银行体系之间的利基市场中运作，作为提供类似于银行存款特征的私人货币类资产的投资基金。因此，它们很容易受到流动性转型和投资者对基金作为货币类资产的能力的看法突然变化而引起的挤兑的影响。自 2000 年以来，MMF 挤兑在许多国家和多种监管制度下发生。全球挤兑和危机模式表明，货币市场基金的脆弱性并非特定治理安排所独有，而减轻这些脆弱性需要进行根本性改革，要么将货币市场基金更明确地置于投资基金领域，要么为货币市场基金建立类似于存款的保护措施。

title: Monetary Policy, Investor Flows, and Loan Fund Fragility
authors: Nicola Cetorelli, Gabriele La Spada, João A. C. Santos
abstract: We show that monetary policy shocks have a positive effect on flows in bank-loan mutual funds. This relationship, however, is asymmetric: positive shocks cause small inflows, whereas negative shocks cause large outflows. Further, the effect of monetary policy shocks is stronger when short-term rates are higher. Finally, we document that large outflows from loan funds lead to significant declines in loan-level prices in the secondary leveraged loan market. Our results identify a novel channel of monetary policy transmission that not only affects a critical segment of the credit sector, but also has the potential to impact financial stability.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 货币政策、投资者流动和贷款资金脆弱性
abstract_zh: 我们表明，货币政策冲击对银行贷款共同基金的流动有积极影响。然而，这种关系是不对称的：正向冲击导致小额资金流入，而负向冲击则导致大量资金流出。此外，当短期利率较高时，货币政策冲击的效果更强。最后，我们记录了贷款资金的大量流出导致二级杠杆贷款市场的贷款水平价格大幅下降。我们的研究结果确定了一种新颖的货币政策传导渠道，它不仅影响信贷部门的关键部分，而且有可能影响金融稳定。

title: A New Approach to Assess Inflation Expectations Anchoring Using Strategic Surveys
authors: Olivier Armantier, Argia M. Sbordone, Giorgio Topa, Wilbert Van der Klaauw, John C. Williams
abstract: We propose a new approach to assessing the anchoring of inflation expectations using “strategic surveys.” Namely, we measure households’ revisions in long-run inflation expectations after they are presented with different economic scenarios. A key advantage of this approach is that it provides a causal interpretation in terms of how inflation events affect long-run inflation expectations. We implement the method in the summer of 2019 and the spring-summer of 2021 when the anchoring of long-run inflation expectations was in question. We find that the risk of unanchoring of expectations was reasonably low in both periods, and that long-run inflation expectations were essentially as well anchored in August 2021 as in July 2019, before the COVID-19 pandemic.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 使用战略调查来评估通胀预期的新方法
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种使用“战略调查”来评估通胀预期锚定情况的新方法。也就是说，我们衡量家庭在面对不同的经济情景后对长期通胀预期的修正。这种方法的一个关键优点是，它提供了通胀事件如何影响长期通胀预期的因果解释。我们在 2019 年夏季和 2021 年春夏季实施了该方法，当时长期通胀预期的锚定存在问题。我们发现，这两个时期的预期脱锚风险都相当低，而且长期通胀预期在 2021 年 8 月基本上与 2019 年 7 月（即 COVID-19 大流行之前）一样稳定。

title: Buy Big or Buy Small? Procurement Policies, Firms' Financing, and the Macroeconomy
authors: Julian di Giovanni, Manuel García-Santana, Priit Jeenas, Enrique Moral-Benito, Josep Pijoan-Mas
abstract: This paper examines the macroeconomic effects of public procurement. We exploit novel data to show that procurement eases firms’ borrowing constraints and has persistent effects on firm growth. Using a macroeconomic model with heterogeneous firms, asset- and earnings-based borrowing frictions, and government purchasing, we simulate revenue-neutral reforms that increase the share of small firms in procurement. We find that, despite helping financially constrained firms grow, these policies lead to non-trivial unintended negative effects. On net, the policies lead to a modest decline in GDP. The findings highlight how procurement design influences aggregate outcomes through firm-level financial frictions and reallocation dynamics.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 买大还是买小？采购政策、企业融资和宏观经济
abstract_zh: 本文研究了公共采购的宏观经济影响。我们利用新颖的数据表明，采购缓解了企业的借贷限制，并对企业增长产生持续影响。我们使用包含异质企业、基于资产和收益的借贷摩擦以及政府采购的宏观经济模型，模拟收入中性的改革，以增加小企业在采购中的份额。我们发现，尽管这些政策有助于财务受限的企业发展，但仍会带来非同寻常的意外负面影响。从净值来看，这些政策导致GDP小幅下降。研究结果强调了采购设计如何通过公司层面的财务摩擦和重新分配动态影响总体结果。

title: Who Can Tell Which Banks Will Fail?
authors: Kristian S. Blickle, Markus K. Brunnermeier, Stephan Luck
abstract: We study the run on the German banking system in 1931 to study whether depositors anticipate which banks will fail. We find that deposits decline by around 20 percent during the run. There is an equal outflow of retail and non-financial wholesale deposits from both failing and surviving banks. In contrast, we find that interbank deposits decline almost exclusively for failing banks. Our evidence suggests that while regular depositors are uninformed, banks have precise information about which banks will fail. In turn, banks being informed allows the interbank market to continue providing liquidity even during times of severe financial distress.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 谁能知道哪些银行会倒闭？
abstract_zh: 我们研究 1931 年德国银行系统的挤兑情况，以研究储户是否预期哪些银行会倒闭。我们发现存款在运行期间下降了约 20%。倒闭银行和幸存银行的零售和非金融批发存款流出量相等。相比之下，我们发现银行间存款下降几乎完全是针对破产银行。我们的证据表明，虽然普通储户不知情，但银行却拥有关于哪些银行将倒闭的准确信息。反过来，即使在严重的金融危机时期，银行获知信息也使得银行间市场能够继续提供流动性。

title: Exorbitant Privilege? Quantitative Easing and the Bond Market Subsidy of Prospective Fallen Angels
authors: Viral V. Acharya, Ryan N. Banerjee, Matteo Crosignani, Tim Eisert, Renée Spigt
abstract: We document capital misallocation in the U.S. investment-grade (IG) corporate bond market, driven by quantitative easing (QE). Prospective fallen angels—risky firms just above the IG rating cutoff—enjoyed subsidized bond financing since 2009, especially when the scale of QE purchases peaked and from IGfocused investors that held more securities purchased in QE programs. The benefitting firms used this privilege to fund risky acquisitions and increase market share, exploiting the sluggish adjustment of credit ratings in downgrading after M&A and adversely affecting competitors' employment and investment. Eventually, these firms suffered more severe downgrades at the onset of the pandemic.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 过高的特权？量化宽松与未来堕落天使的债券市场补贴
abstract_zh: 我们记录了在量化宽松 (QE) 推动下美国投资级 (IG) 公司债券市场的资本错配。自 2009 年以来，潜在的堕落天使（风险程度略高于 IG 评级截止值的公司）享受补贴债券融资，尤其是当量化宽松购买规模达到顶峰时，以及来自持有更多在量化宽松计划中购买的证券的专注于 IG 的投资者。受益企业利用这一特权为高风险收购提供资金并增加市场份额，利用并购后信用评级调整缓慢的机会进行降级，对竞争对手的就业和投资产生不利影响。最终，这些公司在疫情爆发时遭受了更严重的评级下调。

title: Financial Stability Considerations for Monetary Policy: Empirical Evidence and Challenges
authors: Nina Boyarchenko, Giovanni Favara, Moritz Schularick
abstract: This paper reviews literature on the empirical relationship between vulnerabilities in the financial system and the macroeconomy, and how monetary policy affects that connection. Financial vulnerabilities build up over time, with both risk appetite and risk taking rising during economic expansions. To some extent, financial crises are predictable and have severe real economic consequences when they occur. Empirically it is difficult to link monetary policy to financial vulnerabilities, in part because financial cycles have long durations, making it difficult to separate effects of changes in monetary policy from other business cycle effects.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 货币政策的金融稳定考虑因素：经验证据和挑战
abstract_zh: 本文回顾了有关金融体系脆弱性与宏观经济之间的实证关系以及货币政策如何影响这种联系的文献。随着时间的推移，金融脆弱性不断增加，经济扩张期间风险偏好和风险承担都会上升。在某种程度上，金融危机是可以预测的，并且一旦发生就会对实际经济造成严重后果。从经验来看，很难将货币政策与金融脆弱性联系起来，部分原因是金融周期持续时间较长，因此很难将货币政策变化的影响与其他商业周期影响分开。

title: Financial Stability Considerations for Monetary Policy: Theoretical Mechanisms
authors: Andrea Ajello, Nina Boyarchenko, François Gourio, Andrea Tambalotti
abstract: This paper reviews the theoretical literature at the intersection of macroeconomics and finance to draw lessons on the connection between vulnerabilities in the financial system and the macroeconomy, and on how monetary policy affects that connection. This literature finds that financial vulnerabilities are inherent to financial systems and tend to be procyclical. Moreover, financial vulnerabilities amplify the effects of adverse shocks to the economy, so that even a small shock to fundamentals or a small revision of beliefs can create a self-reinforcing feedback loop that impairs credit provision, lowers asset prices, and depresses economic activity and inflation. Finally, monetary policy may affect the buildup of vulnerabilities, but the sign of the impact along some of its transmission channels is theoretically ambiguous and may vary with the state of the economy.
source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York staff report
title_zh: 货币政策的金融稳定考虑：理论机制
abstract_zh: 本文回顾了宏观经济学和金融学交叉领域的理论文献，以总结金融体系脆弱性与宏观经济之间的联系以及货币政策如何影响这种联系的经验教训。该文献发现，金融脆弱性是金融体系固有的，并且往往具有顺周期性。此外，金融脆弱性会放大经济不利冲击的影响，因此，即使是对基本面的小幅冲击或信念的小幅修正，也可能形成自我强化的反馈循环，从而损害信贷供应、降低资产价格、抑制经济活动和通胀。最后，货币政策可能会影响脆弱性的积累，但其某些传导渠道的影响迹象在理论上是不明确的，并且可能会随着经济状况的不同而变化。

title: A Mythos moment? Frontier AI and cyber risk
authors: Iñaki Aldasoro, Raphael Auer, Jon Frost, Fernando Perez-Cruz
abstract: Frontier artificial intelligence (AI) models increase the speed, scale and complexity of cyber attacks, and they also strengthen cyber defence. But the costs are asymmetric and may favour attackers. The medium-term impact on systemic cyber risk depends on the various actors' access to the most advanced tools, on compute power to run the tools and on economic incentives. Given the pace of recent developments, swift adoption of frontier AI models to review code bases and fix vulnerabilities is essential. International coordination can support authorities in addressing these issues.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 神话时刻？前沿人工智能和网络风险
abstract_zh: 前沿人工智能 (AI) 模型提高了网络攻击的速度、规模和复杂性，同时也加强了网络防御。但成本是不对称的，并且可能有利于攻击者。对系统性网络风险的中期影响取决于各个参与者能否获得最先进的工具、运行这些工具的计算能力以及经济激励措施。鉴于最近的发展速度，迅速采用前沿人工智能模型来审查代码库和修复漏洞至关重要。国际协调可以支持当局解决这些问题。

title: AI disruption in private credit: exposure to software firms in BDCs
authors: Fernando Avalos, Giulio Cornelli, Egemen Eren
abstract: Business development companies (BDCs) have lent around $115 billion to software firms, which represents about a fifth of all their lending and over 80% of their fast-growing technology portfolios.Borrowers' revenue uncertainty posed by generative artificial intelligence has not affected these loans yet, and neither BDCs nor their equity investors have priced software exposure differently. Recently, credit spreads have narrowed, reducing the buffers to absorb losses, and a few large BDCs are exposed to a shared pool of borrowers, though low leverage and secured lending may limit spillovers.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 人工智能对私人信贷的颠覆：商业发展中心软件公司的风险敞口
abstract_zh: 业务开发公司 (BDC) 已向软件公司提供了约 1150 亿美元的贷款，约占其全部贷款的五分之一，占其快速增长的技术投资组合的 80% 以上。生成式人工智能带来的借款人收入不确定性尚未影响这些贷款，而且 BDC 及其股权投资者都没有对软件风险进行不同的定价。最近，信用利差已经收窄，减少了吸收损失的缓冲，并且一些大型 BDC 面临着共享借款人池的风险，尽管低杠杆和担保贷款可能会限制溢出效应。

title: Competition in retail digital payments
authors: Daniele Natalizi, Vatsala Shreeti
abstract: Retail payments have digitalised rapidly in both advanced economies and emerging market and developing economies.Digitalisation has altered the competitive landscape, with new entrants (eg fintechs and big techs) and new technologies, yet incumbent banks and card networks retain their dominant position in key markets.In their role as operators, overseers and catalysts in payment systems, central banks support competition in diverse ways, depending on their mandates and institutional arrangements.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 零售数字支付的竞争
abstract_zh: 无论是发达经济体还是新兴市场和发展中经济体，零售支付都已迅速实现数字化。数字化改变了竞争格局，新进入者（例如金融科技和大型科技公司）和新技术不断涌现，但现有银行和卡网络仍保持在关键市场的主导地位。作为支付系统的运营商、监管者和催化剂，央行根据其职责和制度安排，以多种方式支持竞争。

title: Blockchain consensus mechanisms and fragmentation
authors: Daniel Eidan, Jon Frost, Rudraksh Kansal, Ulf Lewrick, Sang Hyuk Lim, Tomasz Rybarczyk
abstract: While all permissionless blockchains use token-based incentives to sustain honest validation, differences in how validator rewards, coordination and participation are structured lead to distinct equilibria and trade-offs between decentralisation, security and scalability. These trade-offs underpin the emergence of multiple layer 1 networks and the expansion of layer 2 solutions, resulting in fragmentation of infrastructure, liquidity and assets across and within chains.Tools to mitigate fragmentation – eg bridges and native multi-chain issuance – can reduce frictions, but they reintroduce new dependencies on trust, governance and operational resilience.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 区块链共识机制和碎片化
abstract_zh: 虽然所有无需许可的区块链都使用基于代币的激励来维持诚实验证，但验证者奖励、协调和参与结构的差异导致了去中心化、安全性和可扩展性之间的明显平衡和权衡。这些权衡支撑了多个第 1 层网络的出现和第 2 层解决方案的扩展，导致链间和链内的基础设施、流动性和资产碎片化。减轻碎片化的工具（例如桥接和本地多链发行）可以减少摩擦，但它们重新引入了对信任、治理和运营弹性的新依赖。

title: Stablecoin remuneration on centralised exchanges
authors: Wenqian Huang, Nikola Tarashev, Xinyi Wang
abstract: Centralised exchanges remunerate stablecoin holders, using the return on the issuer's reserve assets or income from market activity. Under the reserve-based model, yields track policy rates – akin to yields on cash-management instruments – whereas under the activity-based model, yields are much more volatile. By turning stablecoins into substitutes for bank deposits or money market funds or into funding instruments for exchanges' risky activities, remuneration models may shape the macro financial implications of wide stablecoin adoption in the future.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 中心化交易所的稳定币报酬
abstract_zh: 中心化交易所利用发行人储备资产的回报或市场活动的收入来奖励稳定币持有者。在基于准备金的模型下，收益率跟踪政策利率（类似于现金管理工具的收益率），而在基于活动的模型下，收益率的波动性要大得多。通过将稳定币变成银行存款或货币市场基金的替代品，或者成为交易所风险活动的融资工具，薪酬模式可能会影响未来广泛采用稳定币的宏观财务影响。

title: Monetary policy transmission to exchange rates: the role of currency carry trades
authors: Ryan Niladri Banerjee, Lena Boneva, Gabor Pinter, Vladyslav Sushko
abstract: Carry trade activity can shape the exchange rate response to monetary policy. Significant short positions of carry traders in funding currencies amplify the impact of policy tightening. This amplification arises from the unwinding of leveraged carry trade positions accumulated prior to the policy announcement, creating a state-dependent monetary policy transmission to the exchange rate. The currency trading strategies of hedge funds and other leveraged investors can play a key role in shaping the exchange rate response to monetary policy and therefore warrant careful monitoring.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 货币政策对汇率的传导：货币套利交易的作用
abstract_zh: 套利交易活动可以影响汇率对货币政策的反应。套利交易者大量持有融资货币空头头寸，放大了政策紧缩的影响。这种放大源于政策宣布前积累的杠杆套利交易头寸的平仓，从而形成了依赖于国家的货币政策对汇率的传导。对冲基金和其他杠杆投资者的货币交易策略可以在塑造汇率对货币政策的反应方面发挥关键作用，因此值得仔细监控。

title: Investment funds' de facto currency risk exposure
authors: Inês Lindoso, Andreas Schrimpf, Vladyslav Sushko, Toma Tomov
