abstract: The sensitivity of fund returns to exchange rates, once underlying asset returns are accounted for, provides a measure of funds' exposure to currency risk, ie their de facto hedge ratio. Bond funds have high and stable hedge ratios, though with some sensitivity to hedging costs. Equity funds' hedging is volatile and consistent with opportunistic currency speculation. In the run-up to April 2025, equity funds with low hedge ratios attracted most inflows and outperformed those with high hedge ratios, but this relation flipped following "Liberation Day".
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 投资基金事实上的货币风险敞口
abstract_zh: 一旦考虑了基础资产回报，基金回报对汇率的敏感度就可以衡量基金面临的货币风险，即事实上的对冲比率。债券基金的对冲比率较高且稳定，但对对冲成本有一定敏感性。股票基金的对冲波动较大，与机会主义的货币投机行为一致。在 2025 年 4 月之前，低对冲比率的股票基金吸引了大部分资金流入，并且表现优于高对冲比率的股票基金，但这种关系在“解放日”之后发生了逆转。

title: Global giants in the AI supply chain
authors: Jon Frost, Kumar Rishabh, Vatsala Shreeti
abstract: Globally, the largest artificial intelligence (AI) firms are based in the United States, China, Chinese Taipei, Korea and the Netherlands. These global AI giants account for an increasing share of total market capitalisation, capital expenditure and revenues in their respective jurisdictions. For many AI giants – and particularly those from the United States and China – scope and scale go together as they expand the breadth of their activities into multiple layers in the AI supply chain.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 全球AI供应链巨头
abstract_zh: 全球最大的人工智能 (AI) 公司位于美国、中国、中国台北、韩国和荷兰。这些全球人工智能巨头在各自管辖范围内的总市值、资本支出和收入中所占的份额越来越大。对于许多人工智能巨头来说——尤其是来自美国和中国的巨头——当他们将活动的广度扩展到人工智能供应链的多个层面时，范围和规模是相辅相成的。

title: Economic impact of AI in emerging market economies
authors: Leonardo Gambacorta, Enisse Kharroubi, Aaron Mehrotra, Livia Pancotto
abstract: The productivity and growth effects of artificial intelligence (AI) vary widely across countries, reflecting differences in sectoral composition and in the capacity to adopt and deploy AI. While advanced economies (AEs) are generally better positioned to reap the benefits of AI in the near term, substantial heterogeneity exists within emerging market economies (EMEs). AI preparedness – covering digital infrastructure, skills and institutional capacity – is a key determinant of overall gains, amplifying productivity effects where it is strong and constraining them where gaps persist, particularly in many EMEs. Closing AI preparedness gaps can support long-term convergence, as stronger infrastructure, human capital and institutions would enable EMEs to harness AI more effectively, help mitigate labour market risks through reskilling and retraining policies, and narrow growth differences with AEs.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 人工智能对新兴市场经济体的经济影响
abstract_zh: 人工智能（AI）对生产力和增长的影响在不同国家有很大差异，反映了部门构成以及采用和部署人工智能能力的差异。虽然发达经济体（AE）通常更有能力在短期内从人工智能中获益，但新兴市场经济体（EME）内部存在很大的异质性。人工智能准备——涵盖数字基础设施、技能和机构能力——是整体收益的关键决定因素，在生产力影响强劲的地方放大生产力效应，在差距持续存在的地方限制生产力效应，特别是在许多新兴市场经济体。缩小人工智能准备差距可以支持长期融合，因为更强大的基础设施、人力资本和机构将使新兴市场经济体能够更有效地利用人工智能，通过再培训和再培训政策帮助缓解劳动力市场风险，并缩小与发达经济体的增长差异。

title: Financing the AI boom: from cash flows to debt
authors: Iñaki Aldasoro, Sebastian Doerr, Daniel Rees
abstract: Investment related to artificial intelligence (AI) is surging – both in nominal amounts and as a share of GDP – and currently accounts for a substantial share of economic growth. The size of anticipated investment needs will require firms to shift the source of financing from operating cash flows to debt, with private credit playing a rapidly increasing role. While macroeconomic and financial stability risks from the AI boom appear moderate, the boom's sustainability hinges on AI firms meeting high earnings expectations. The fact that equity prices have run far ahead of debt market pricing underscores this tension.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 为人工智能热潮融资：从现金流到债务
abstract_zh: 与人工智能 (AI) 相关的投资无论是名义金额还是占 GDP 的比重都在激增，目前在经济增长中占据了很大份额。预期投资需求的规模将要求企业将融资来源从经营现金流转向债务，而私人信贷的作用迅速增强。虽然人工智能繁荣带来的宏观经济和金融稳定风险似乎不大，但繁荣的可持续性取决于人工智能公司能否满足高收益预期。股票价格远远领先于债务市场定价的事实凸显了这种紧张局势。

title: Enhancing cross-border payments: state of play and way forward
authors: Thomas Lammer, Daniel Rees, Tara Rice, Takeshi Shirakami
abstract: The G20 Roadmap for enhancing cross-border payments has created significant momentum. Most international policy actions are completed, providing a solid foundation for addressing persistent cross-border payment challenges and fostering a more inclusive global payments ecosystem. However, it is unlikely that the end-2027 targets envisaged by the G20 will be achieved on time, and improvements in outcomes for end users have so far been modest. Timely and consistent implementation of the Roadmap priorities, both within and beyond G20 jurisdictions, is essential to achieve the Roadmap's goals and must be accompanied by robust public-private collaboration.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 加强跨境支付：现状和前进方向
abstract_zh: G20加强跨境支付的路线图创造了巨大的动力。大多数国际政策行动已经完成，为解决持续存在的跨境支付挑战和培育更具包容性的全球支付生态系统奠定了坚实的基础。然而，G20 设想的 2027 年底目标不太可能按时实现，而且迄今为止，最终用户成果的改善也有限。在 G20 管辖范围内和之外及时、一致地实施路线图优先事项对于实现路线图目标至关重要，并且必须辅之以强有力的公私合作。

title: International footprint of global firms: residence and nationality perspectives on maritime shipments
authors: Han Qiu, Hyun Song Shin, Leanne Si Ying Zhang
abstract: Nationality-based measurement that consolidates firms according to the nationality of the ultimate parent firm provides new insights on questions of ownership and control that underpin the operation of global value chains. Nationality-based shipment data highlight significant "within-nationality" shipments, especially between entities of the same parent group, revealing a strikingly different picture of global shipments compared with conventional residence-based measures.Foreign subsidiaries operate under two distinct shipment models: the "outpost" model which relies on upstream counterparties from the parent region, common among Asian firms, and the "going-global" model characterised by globally distributed trading partners, prevalent among North American firms.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 全球公司的国际足迹：海运的居住地和国籍视角
abstract_zh: 基于国籍的衡量标准根据最终母公司的国籍对公司进行合并，为支撑全球价值链运作的所有权和控制权问题提供了新的见解。基于国籍的出货量数据突显了显着的“国籍内”出货量，特别是同一母公司集团的实体之间的出货量，与传统的基于居住地的衡量标准相比，揭示了全球出货量的显着不同。外国子公司以两种不同的出货量模式运营：依赖母公司地区上游交易对手的“前哨”模式，在亚洲公司中常见，以及以全球分布的贸易伙伴为特征的“走出去”模式，在北美公司中普遍存在。

title: Unpacking repo haircuts and their implications for leverage
authors: Felix Hermes, Maik Schmeling, Andreas Schrimpf
abstract: Haircuts vary with repo trading motives, notably whether market participants primarily seek to raise cash or gain access to a specific security. Haircuts tend to increase with repo maturity and are lower for less volatile collateral assets. Benchmark sovereign bonds are often associated with subdued haircuts. Zero-haircut borrowing is common in hedge fund repo activity, with the largest hedge funds benefiting from the lowest haircuts, enabling very high levels of leverage.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 拆解回购协议削减及其对杠杆率的影响
abstract_zh: 折扣因回购交易动机而异，特别是市场参与者是否主要寻求筹集现金或获得特定证券。随着回购到期，折扣往往会增加，而对于波动性较小的抵押资产，折扣则较低。基准主权债券通常与温和的减记联系在一起。零折扣借款在对冲基金回购活动中很常见，最大的对冲基金受益于最低的折扣，从而实现非常高的杠杆水平。

title: The rise of non-bank financial institutions: implications for monetary policy
authors: Ryan Niladri Banerjee, Boris Hofmann, Ding Xuan Ng, Gabor Pinter
abstract: Non-bank financial institutions (NBFIs) have grown significantly in recent years, mainly driven by the growth of investment funds, including hedge funds. These changes reflect the role of bond markets, which have expanded on the back of surging government debt. The rise of NBFIs adds uncertainty to monetary policy transmission, as there could be dampening and amplifying effects. Investment funds appear to strengthen transmission while at the same time making it less stable. Greater uncertainty about transmission due to structural changes in the financial system reinforces the principle of a gradual policy approach while at the same time calling for flexibility in adjusting policy.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 非银行金融机构的崛起：对货币政策的影响
abstract_zh: 近年来，非银行金融机构（NBFI）大幅增长，主要受到包括对冲基金在内的投资基金增长的推动。这些变化反映了债券市场的作用，债券市场在政府债务激增的背景下扩大了。非银行金融机构的崛起增加了货币政策传导的不确定性，因为可能会产生抑制和放大效应。投资基金似乎加强了传导，但同时也降低了稳定性。金融体系结构性变化带来的传导不确定性加大，强化了渐进式政策方针的原则，同时要求政策调整具有灵活性。

title: The rise of tokenised money market funds
authors: Matteo Aquilina, Ulf Lewrick, Federico Ravenna, Lorenzo Schönleber
abstract: Tokenised money market funds (TMMFs) are a fast-growing collateral asset and savings instrument in the crypto ecosystem. Like stablecoins, TMMFs circulate on public permissionless blockchains but offer returns at money market rates and regulatory protections as securities. TMMFs currently cater strongly to decentralised finance protocols and rely on "allow-listing" of blockchain wallets to constrain peer-to-peer trading of their tokens to ensure regulatory compliance. However, such allow lists only constrain direct holding of TMMFs. TMMFs give rise to risks that mirror, and potentially amplify, those found in conventional money market funds, such as liquidity mismatches, as well as the operational and anti-money laundering / countering the financing of terrorism-related risks associated with stablecoins.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 代币化货币市场基金的兴起
abstract_zh: 代币化货币市场基金（TMMF）是加密生态系统中快速增长的抵押资产和储蓄工具。与稳定币一样，TMMF 在公共、无需许可的区块链上流通，但提供货币市场利率的回报和作为证券的监管保护。 TMMF 目前大力迎合去中心化金融协议，并依靠区块链钱包的“允许上市”来限制其代币的点对点交易，以确保监管合规性。然而，此类允许列表仅限制 TMMF 的直接持有。 TMMF 产生的风险与传统货币市场基金中的风险相似，甚至可能会放大这些风险，例如流动性错配，以及与稳定币相关的运营和反洗钱/打击恐怖主义融资相关风险。

title: Financial channel implications of a weaker dollar for emerging market economies
authors: Mikael Juselius, Philip Wooldridge, Dora Xia
abstract: The depreciation of the US dollar in 2025 has occurred against the backdrop of continued resilience of trade and economic activity in emerging market economies (EMEs). A depreciating dollar affects both borrowers' and foreign investors' balance sheets and tends to loosen financial conditions in EMEs through the risk-taking channel of exchange rates. As EMEs have increasingly become net creditors to the rest of the world, the currency hedging behaviour of EME investors has played a greater role in currency market dynamics in 2025.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 美元疲软对新兴市场经济体的金融渠道影响
abstract_zh: 2025年美元贬值是在新兴市场经济体（EME）贸易和经济活动持续弹性的背景下发生的。美元贬值会影响借款人和外国投资者的资产负债表，并往往通过汇率风险承担渠道放松新兴市场经济体的金融状况。随着新兴市场经济体日益成为世界其他地区的净债权人，新兴市场经济体投资者的货币对冲行为在2025年的货币市场动态中发挥了更大的作用。

title: Financial conditions indices in Latin America
authors: Eduardo Amaral, Rafael Guerra, Ilhyock Shim, Alexandre Tombini
abstract: Global factors shaped financial conditions in Latin America in 2025, with exchange rate appreciations against the US dollar loosening conditions in most countries. Short-run monetary policy transmission in the region operates through financial conditions. In general, monetary easing leads to looser financial conditions and faster short-term output growth. Measurement of overall financial conditions depends on the methodologies and assumptions used to construct financial conditions indices (FCIs). Understanding these differences helps central banks to use FCIs as an input to monetary policy.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 拉丁美洲金融状况指数
abstract_zh: 全球因素影响了 2025 年拉丁美洲的金融状况，兑美元汇率升值导致大多数国家的金融状况宽松。该地区的短期货币政策传导是通过金融状况发挥作用的。总体而言，货币宽松会导致金融状况更加宽松和短期产出增长加快。总体财务状况的衡量取决于用于构建财务状况指数（FCI）的方法和假设。了解这些差异有助于央行利用 FCI 作为货币政策的输入。

title: Labour markets at a crossroads: softening trends amid elevated uncertainty
authors: Leonardo Gambacorta, Enisse Kharroubi, Emanuel Kohlscheen, Ko Munakata
abstract: Labour market conditions in emerging market economies remain broadly stable, but unemployment in several advanced economies is edging up, and forward-looking indicators point to further weakening. Cyclical forces partly explain these developments, but longer-term structural forces are also at play, including deregulation and demographic pressures (ageing, migration, participation of older workers). Weaker labour markets may weigh on output, especially in the absence of productivity gains. In some emerging market economies, tighter conditions and stronger wage-price pass-through could raise the risk of de-anchoring inflation expectations.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 劳动力市场正处于十字路口：不确定性加剧，趋势趋软
abstract_zh: 新兴市场经济体的劳动力市场状况基本保持稳定，但一些发达经济体的失业率正在小幅上升，前瞻性指标表明失业率将进一步走弱。周期性力量在一定程度上解释了这些发展，但长期结构性力量也在发挥作用，包括放松管制和人口压力（老龄化、移民、老年工人的参与）。劳动力市场疲软可能会影响产出，尤其是在生产率没有提高的情况下。在一些新兴市场经济体，形势趋紧和工资价格传导增强可能会增加通胀预期脱离的风险。

title: An approach to anti-money laundering compliance for cryptoassets
authors: Iñaki Aldasoro, Jon Frost, Sang Hyuk Lim, Fernando Perez-Cruz, Hyun Song Shin
abstract: Existing anti-money laundering (AML) approaches relying on trusted intermediaries have limited effectiveness with decentralised record-keeping in permissionless public blockchains. The public transaction history on blockchains can enable AML and other compliance efforts, such as FX regulations, by leveraging the provenance and history of any particular unit or balance of a cryptoasset, including stablecoins. An AML compliance score based on the likelihood that a particular cryptoasset unit or balance is linked with illicit activity may be referenced at points of contact with the banking system ("off-ramps"), preventing inflows of the proceeds of illicit activity and supporting a culture of "duty of care" among crypto market participants.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 加密资产反洗钱合规方法
abstract_zh: 现有的依赖可信中介的反洗钱 (AML) 方法在无需许可的公共区块链中分散记录保存的效果有限。区块链上的公共交易历史可以通过利用任何特定单位或加密资产（包括稳定币）余额的来源和历史记录来实现反洗钱和其他合规工作，例如外汇法规。基于特定加密资产单位或余额与非法活动相关的可能性的反洗钱合规性评分可以在与银行系统的接触点（“出口匝道”）参考，以防止非法活动收益流入并支持加密市场参与者之间的“注意义务”文化。

title: Macroeconomic impact of tariffs and policy uncertainty
authors: Emanuel Kohlscheen, Phurichai Rungcharoenkitkul, Dora Xia, Fabrizio Zampolli
abstract: Tariffs affect economies most directly through trade volume and prices. Tariffs lower output growth everywhere, though the magnitude varies by country and scenario. They also tend to raise inflation, most notably in the imposing countries. Tariffs have indirect effects, including exchange rate shifts, supply chain disruptions, trade diversion and heightened uncertainty. These could worsen growth and inflation effects as well as the policy trade-offs central banks face. If it proves persistent, trade policy uncertainty could depress domestic demand and put global growth at risk.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 关税和政策不确定性的宏观经济影响
abstract_zh: 关税最直接地通过贸易量和价格影响经济。关税降低了世界各地的产出增长，尽管幅度因国家和情况而异。它们还往往会加剧通货膨胀，尤其是在强加国家。关税会产生间接影响，包括汇率变化、供应链中断、贸易转移和不确定性加剧。这些可能会加剧增长和通胀影响以及央行面临的政策权衡。如果这种情况持续下去，贸易政策的不确定性可能会抑制国内需求，并使全球增长面临风险。

title: Navigating global headwinds: Africa's trade landscape and growth opportunities
authors: Michael Chui, Leonardo Gambacorta, Emanuel Kohlscheen, Han Qiu
abstract: Africa is not immune from trade challenges. Its direct exposure to new US tariffs is relatively limited, but indirect effects through slower global demand and financial conditions may be larger. Strengthening regional trade integration through initiatives like the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) can help build regional supply chains and reduce reliance on commodity exports. Africa's young workforce, digital innovation and rich natural resources provide longer-term growth tailwinds. Unlocking these opportunities requires investment in skills, infrastructure and financial integration to boost trade and value-added.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 应对全球逆风：非洲的贸易格局和增长机会
abstract_zh: 非洲也未能幸免于贸易挑战。它受到美国新关税的直接影响相对有限，但全球需求放缓和金融状况带来的间接影响可能更大。通过非洲大陆自由贸易区（AfCFTA）等举措加强区域贸易一体化可以帮助建立区域供应链并减少对大宗商品出口的依赖。非洲年轻的劳动力、数字创新和丰富的自然资源提供了长期增长的动力。释放这些机会需要对技能、基础设施和金融一体化进行投资，以促进贸易和增值。

title: Stablecoin growth - policy challenges and approaches
authors: Iñaki Aldasoro, Matteo Aquilina, Ulf Lewrick, Sang Hyuk Lim
abstract: Stablecoins' linkages with the traditional financial system are growing, which raises policy challenges ranging from preserving financial integrity to mitigating financial stability risks. Broader use of foreign currency-denominated stablecoins could raise concerns about monetary sovereignty and, in some jurisdictions, erode the effectiveness of existing foreign exchange regulations. The principle of "same risks, same regulation" faces limitations in the context of stablecoins, highlighting the need for tailored regulatory approaches that address the nature and specific features of stablecoins.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 稳定币增长——政策挑战和方法
abstract_zh: 稳定币与传统金融体系的联系日益紧密，这带来了从维护金融诚信到减轻金融稳定风险等一系列政策挑战。更广泛地使用以外币计价的稳定币可能会引起人们对货币主权的担忧，并在某些司法管辖区削弱现有外汇监管的有效性。 “相同风险、相同监管”的原则在稳定币背景下面临局限性，凸显需要针对稳定币的性质和具体特征采取量身定制的监管方法。

title: Tokenisation of government bonds: assessment and roadmap
authors: Iñaki Aldasoro, Giulio Cornelli, Jon Frost, Priscilla Koo Wilkens, Ulf Lewrick, Vatsala Shreeti
abstract: Government securities play a crucial role in the financial system – as a savings vehicle for households and firms, collateral in a range of transactions and a means of pricing assets. Despite their early stage of development ($8 billion in issuance to date), tokenised bonds have lower bid-ask spreads than conventional bonds and comparable issuance costs. Government bond tokenisation could improve market efficiency and support financial innovation, but its success depends on addressing regulatory and infrastructure challenges.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 政府债券的代币化：评估和路线图
abstract_zh: 政府证券在金融体系中发挥着至关重要的作用——作为家庭和企业的储蓄工具、一系列交易的抵押品以及资产定价手段。尽管仍处于发展初期（迄今为止发行量为 80 亿美元），但代币化债券的买卖价差低于传统债券且发行成本相当。政府债券代币化可以提高市场效率并支持金融创新，但其成功取决于解决监管和基础设施挑战。

title: Retail investors in private credit
authors: Iñaki Aldasoro, Sebastian Doerr, Karamfil Todorov
abstract: Private credit is poised for wider participation from retail investors through the rapid growth of business development companies and, more recently, private credit exchange-traded funds (ETFs). ETFs may introduce price signals that make the opaque private credit market more transparent, especially during downturns when discounts to net asset value could be large and persistent.The rise of retail investment vehicles may also give impetus to the creation of secondary markets for currently illiquid private loans, which could erode the benefits of private credit as an asset class.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 私人信贷的散户投资者
abstract_zh: 通过业务开发公司以及最近私人信贷交易所交易基金（ETF）的快速增长，私人信贷有望吸引散户投资者更广泛的参与。 ETF 可能会引入价格信号，使不透明的私人信贷市场更加透明，特别是在经济低迷时期，资产净值的折扣可能会很大且持续。零售投资工具的兴起也可能会推动目前流动性较差的私人贷款二级市场的创建，这可能会削弱私人信贷作为资产类别的好处。

title: US dollar's slide in April 2025: the role of FX hedging
authors: Hyun Song Shin, Philip Wooldridge, Dora Xia
abstract: Currency hedging by non-US investors holding US dollar securities appears to have made an important contribution to the weakness of the dollar in April and May 2025. In recent years, the strength of the dollar and high currency hedging costs driven by elevated short-term dollar interest rates had discouraged non-US investors from hedging their US dollar exposures. Clues as to the location of currency hedging activity can be gleaned from intraday exchange rate movements. In April, the largest declines in the US dollar occurred during Asian trading hours, suggesting an important role for Asian investors.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 2025 年 4 月美元下滑​​：外汇对冲的作用
abstract_zh: 持有美元证券的非美国投资者的货币对冲似乎对2025年4月和2025年5月美元的疲软做出了重要贡献。近年来，美元走强以及短期美元利率上升导致的高货币对冲成本阻碍了非美国投资者对冲美元风险。关于货币对冲活动地点的线索可以从盘中汇率变动中收集到。 4月份，美元最大跌幅发生在亚洲交易时段，这表明亚洲投资者发挥着重要作用。

title: Household perceptions and expectations in the wake of the inflation surge: survey evidence
authors: Fiorella De Fiore, Damiano Sandri, James Yetman
abstract: A novel international survey across 29 advanced and emerging market economies reveals that household inflation expectations remain elevated, despite inflation rates approaching targets. Perceptions of significant price hikes post-pandemic tend to feed into higher household inflation expectations, pointing to the risk of a lasting impact of temporary inflation bursts. Households with greater knowledge of central banks and their price stability mandates report lower inflation expectations. Therefore, central bank communications can help improve the public's understanding of central banks and foster the anchoring of inflation expectations.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 通胀飙升后家庭的看法和预期：调查证据
abstract_zh: 一项针对 29 个发达和新兴市场经济体的新颖国际调查显示，尽管通胀率接近目标，但家庭通胀预期仍然较高。对大流行后价格大幅上涨的看法往往会导致家庭通胀预期上升，这表明暂时通胀爆发存在持久影响的风险。对央行及其价格稳定指令有更多了解的家庭表示，通胀预期较低。因此，央行沟通有助于提高公众对央行的了解，促进通胀预期的锚定。

title: Investment in an increasingly uncertain global landscape
authors: Matthias Burgert, Michael Chui, Denis Gorea, Fabrizio Zampolli
abstract: Private business fixed investment has fallen or remained flat in advanced economies for decades, with a recent levelling-off also observed in several emerging market economies. The recent increase in uncertainty due to trade tensions will dampen investment while also reducing the effectiveness of monetary policy. In the long run, the outlook for private business investment depends on the potential need to reconfigure supply chains disrupted by higher trade tariffs as well as governments' efforts to boost public investment and implement structural reforms.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 在日益不确定的全球格局中进行投资
abstract_zh: 几十年来，发达经济体的私营企业固定投资一直下降或保持平稳，几个新兴市场经济体最近也出现了趋于平稳的情况。近期贸易紧张局势导致的不确定性增加将抑制投资，同时也会降低货币政策的有效性。从长远来看，私营企业投资的前景取决于重新配置因贸易关税上升而中断的供应链的潜在需要，以及政府促进公共投资和实施结构性改革的努力。

title: Regional integration amid global fragmentation
authors: Ilhyock Shim, Torsten Ehlers, Fredy Gamboa, Han Qiu
abstract: Regional integration among emerging market economies complements global integration rather than substituting for it, which implies that strong regional ties act as buffers against global fragmentation.Emerging Asia is more integrated than other emerging market regions due to a higher share of manufacturing with complex supply chains and the presence of regional financial centres in Hong Kong SAR and Singapore.Trade and banking integration reinforce each other, and regional payment system integration has positive externalities by reducing the transaction costs of trade and enabling cross-border banking services.Tapping the significant potential for further regional integration requires concerted efforts on cross-border cooperation and the implementation of targeted trade and banking sector liberalisation policies.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 全球碎片化中的区域一体化
abstract_zh: 新兴市场经济体之间的区域一体化是对全球一体化的补充而不是替代，这意味着牢固的区域联系可以缓冲全球碎片化。由于供应链复杂的制造业所占比例较高，以及香港特别行政区和新加坡等区域金融中心的存在，亚洲新兴市场比其他新兴市场区域一体化程度更高。贸易和银行一体化相互促进，区域支付系统一体化通过降低贸易交易成本和实现跨境银行服务而具有正外部性。挖掘进一步区域一体化的巨大潜力需要共同努力开展跨境合作，实施有针对性的贸易和银行业自由化政策。

title: Elasticity in the monetary system
authors: Ryan Niladri Banerjee, Jon Frost, Michael Chui, Jose Maria Vidal Pastor
abstract: Today's two-tier monetary system performs a crucial role: providing money in an elastic way through overdrafts and lines of credit in the face of uncertainty and unforeseen shocks.During the Covid-19 pandemic, such elasticity allowed central banks and commercial banks to provide a discretionary increase in the money supply to manage global shocks.In recent months, banks have expanded their loan commitments to sectors impacted by US tariffs in anticipation of client demand for working capital.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 货币体系的弹性
abstract_zh: 当今的两级货币体系发挥着至关重要的作用：在面对不确定性和不可预见的冲击时，通过透支和信贷额度以弹性方式提供资金。在Covid-19大流行期间，这种弹性允许中央银行和商业银行酌情增加货币供应量，以应对全球冲击。近几个月来，银行因预期客户对营运资金的需求而将贷款承诺扩大到受美国关税影响的行业。

title: Artificial intelligence and human capital: challenges for central banks
authors: Sarah Bell, Blaise Gadanecz, Leonardo Gambacorta, Fernando Perez-Cruz, Vatsala Shreeti
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how central banks use human capital. Two scenarios illustrate the uncertainty around the trajectory of AI development: "AI copilots", which augment rather than replace human skills, and "AI agents", which automate specific central bank tasks and can act as substitutes for human roles. Central banks are already integrating "AI copilots" in their daily operations. These tools enhance staff productivity without fundamentally altering how their work is conducted. In contrast, "AI agents" could transform workflows in the next decade, though human oversight will remain essential to ensure their responsible and ethical adoption. To successfully transition toward AI-intensive workflows under either scenario, a focus on retraining and upskilling existing staff, attracting new talent and fostering a culture that embraces innovation is warranted.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 人工智能和人力资本：央行面临的挑战
abstract_zh: 人工智能（AI）正在改变央行使用人力资本的方式。两个场景说明了人工智能发展轨迹的不确定性：“人工智能副驾驶”，它增强而不是取代人类技能；“人工智能代理”，它自动执行特定的中央银行任务，并可以充当人类角色的替代品。各国央行已经将“人工智能副驾驶”融入日常运营中。这些工具可以提高员工的工作效率，而不会从根本上改变他们的工作方式。相比之下，“人工智能代理”可以在未来十年改变工作流程，尽管人类监督对于确保其负责任和道德的采用仍然至关重要。无论哪种情况，为了成功过渡到人工智能密集型工作流程，都需要重点关注现有员工的再培训和技能提升、吸引新人才以及培育拥抱创新的文化。

title: How far can digital innovation improve credit to small firms in emerging market economies?
authors: Julian Caballero, Sebastian Doerr, Aaron Mehrotra, Fabrizio Zampolli
abstract: Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in emerging market economies struggle to access credit, partly due to firms' short financial histories and lack of collateral. The rise of big tech and fintech lenders that make better use of data and digital innovation could reduce the need for collateral and improve SMEs' access to credit. However, big tech and fintech lending so far constitutes only a small share of the total. Digital innovation by itself may not be enough to substantially improve SME lending without further progress in overcoming more deep-seated obstacles.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 数字创新能在多大程度上改善新兴市场经济体小企业的信贷？
abstract_zh: 新兴市场经济体的中小企业 (SME) 难以获得信贷，部分原因是企业财务历史较短且缺乏抵押品。大型科技和金融科技贷款机构的崛起可以更好地利用数据和数字创新，从而减少对抵押品的需求，并改善中小企业获得信贷的机会。然而，到目前为止，大型科技和金融科技贷款仅占总数的一小部分。如果在克服更根深蒂固的障碍方面没有取得进一步进展，数字创新本身可能不足以大幅改善中小企业贷款。

title: Macroeconomic impact of extreme weather events
authors: Torsten Ehlers, Jon Frost, Carlos Madeira, Ilhyock Shim
abstract: Different types of extreme weather event have different transmission channels to economic activity and inflation. An analysis of eight major economies in the Americas shows that droughts reduce economic output over the two years after they occur due to lasting effects on agriculture, forestry and electricity production. It also shows that, while droughts and wildfires temporarily increase food prices and droughts and storms raise energy prices over the following three months, in general there is no persistent impact on inflation. Considering the trade-off between growth and inflation, monetary policy may have to react differently in different circumstances: by tightening if price impacts are large and threaten to become persistent, and by loosening if events destroy physical capital and have lasting effects on economic output.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 极端天气事件对宏观经济的影响
abstract_zh: 不同类型的极端天气事件对经济活动和通胀的传导渠道不同。对美洲八个主要经济体的分析表明，由于对农业、林业和电力生产的持久影响，干旱发生后两年内经济产出减少。它还表明，虽然干旱和野火暂时提高了粮食价格，并且干旱和风暴在接下来的三个月内提高了能源价格，但总体而言，对通胀没有持久影响。考虑到增长和通胀之间的权衡，货币政策可能必须在不同情况下做出不同的反应：如果价格影响很大并且可能持续存在，则货币政策采取紧缩政策；如果事件破坏了实物资本并对经济产出产生持久影响，则货币政策采取宽松政策。

title: Completing the post-pandemic landing
authors: Boris Hofmann, Ko Munakata, Tom Rosewall, Damiano Sandri
abstract: The global economy is on track for a soft landing, but the outlook has become more uncertain as new challenges loom. The lingering effects of the rise in the cost of living, large fiscal deficits, heightened policy uncertainty and a stronger US dollar pose risks to the landing. In such a complex environment, risk management considerations and clear communication are key for central banks to complete the disinflation process while supporting economic activity.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 完成疫情后落地
abstract_zh: 全球经济有望软着陆，但随着新挑战的出现，前景变得更加不确定。生活成本上升、巨额财政赤字、政策不确定性加剧以及美元走强等挥之不去的影响给着陆带来了风险。在如此复杂的环境下，风险管理考虑和清晰的沟通是央行在支持经济活动的同时完成通货紧缩过程的关键。

title: Commodity prices and monetary policy: old and new challenges
authors: Fernando Avalos, Ryan Niladri Banerjee, Matthias Burgert, Boris Hofmann, Cristina Manea, Matthias Rottner
abstract: Major price increases in energy and food were key drivers of the 2021–22 inflation surge. These large supply-driven commodity price increases, occurring when inflation was already elevated in many countries, increased the risk of moving to a high-inflation regime. Central banks have tended to look through commodity price fluctuations due to their often transitory nature and the implied trade-off between inflation and output stabilisation in the case of supply-driven price shocks. Growing geopolitical disruptions, climate change and a bumpy transition to green energy threaten to make commodity price shifts larger and more frequent going forward. This potentially raises greater risks for price stability, thereby limiting the scope for monetary policy to look through them.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 大宗商品价格与货币政策：新旧挑战
abstract_zh: 能源和食品价格大幅上涨是 2021-22 年通胀飙升的关键驱动因素。这些由供应驱动的大宗商品价格大幅上涨是在许多国家的通胀已经很高的情况下发生的，增加了进入高通胀体制的风险。央行倾向于审视大宗商品价格波动，因为大宗商品价格波动往往是短暂的，而且在供应驱动的价格冲击的情况下，通胀与产出稳定之间隐含着权衡。日益严重的地缘政治干扰、气候变化以及向绿色能源转型的坎坷，可能会导致未来大宗商品价格的波动更大、更频繁。这可能会给价格稳定带来更大的风险，从而限制货币政策审视这些风险的范围。

title: Anatomy of the VIX spike in August 2024
authors: Karamfil Todorov, Grigory Vilkov
abstract: On 5 August 2024, the Cboe volatility index (VIX) derived from option prices on the S&P 500 recorded its biggest ever one-day spike, increasing by 180% to almost 66 pre-market (ie before the US market open). In this Bulletin, we delve into this episode for clues to the possible reasons for the spike. Our analysis indicates that the asymmetric widening of bid-ask spreads likely played a key role in exacerbating the spike, as it lifted mid-quotes of option prices used in the calculation of VIX. Market makers’ (MMs) adjustment of quotes was behind the widening, as MMs sought to avert an imbalanced book in uncertain conditions.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 2024 年 8 月 VIX 峰值剖析
abstract_zh: 2024 年 8 月 5 日，基于标准普尔 500 指数期权价格的芝加哥期权交易所波动率指数 (VIX) 创下有史以来最大单日涨幅，在盘前（即美国市场开盘前）上涨 180% 至近 66。在本公告中，我们深入研究了这一事件，以寻找导致峰值的可能原因的线索。我们的分析表明，买卖价差的不对称扩大可能在加剧价格上涨方面发挥了关键作用，因为它提高了用于计算 VIX 的期权价格的中间报价。做市商（MM）对报价的调整是价格扩大的原因，因为做市商试图在不确定的条件下避免账面失衡。

title: Evidence of nearshoring in the Americas?
authors: Ana Aguilar, Julian Caballero, Jon Frost, Alejandro Parada
abstract: After decades of deepening economic integration, trade conflicts and geopolitical tensions have recently disrupted global trade patterns (IMF (2023a, 2023b), Qiu et al (2024)). Tariffs and non-tariff measures on goods and investment, and threats of further measures, have increased economic and trade policy uncertainty (Graph 1.A). While the focus is on tensions between the United States and China, restrictions on imports and investment have risen globally, particularly after the Covid-19 pandemic (Graph 1.B).
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 美洲近岸外包的证据？
abstract_zh: 经过数十年不断深化的经济一体化，贸易冲突和地缘政治紧张局势最近扰乱了全球贸易格局（IMF (2023a, 2023b), Qiu et al (2024)）。针对商品和投资的关税和非关税措施以及采取进一步措施的威胁增加了经济和贸易政策的不确定性（图1.A）。虽然焦点是美国和中国之间的紧张关系，但全球范围内对进口和投资的限制有所增加，特别是在 Covid-19 大流行之后（图 1.B）。

title: Productivity in the post-pandemic world: old trend or new path?
authors: Deniz Igan, Tom Rosewall, Phurichai Rungcharoenkitkul
abstract: Productivity growth is a key variable of interest for central banks. It influences inflation and is the most important determinant of long-run growth in real income. Recently, subdued productivity growth in many countries (with the notable exception of the United States) has raised concerns about the underlying drivers across countries. What explains subdued productivity growth? Why is the United States different? Do the recent patterns reflect conjunctural factors that should fade over time or do they indicate structural forces that would prevail in the coming years?
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 后疫情时代的生产力：旧趋势还是新路径？
abstract_zh: 生产率增长是央行关注的一个关键变量。它影响通货膨胀，是实际收入长期增长的最重要决定因素。最近，许多国家（美国除外）生产率增长疲弱引发了人们对各国潜在驱动因素的担忧。生产率增长低迷的原因是什么？为什么美国不一样？最近的模式是否反映了随着时间的推移而逐渐消失的联合因素，或者它们是否表明了未来几年将盛行的结构性力量？

title: Central clearing in government bond markets: keeping the "safe asset" safe?
authors: Matteo Aquilina, Martin Scheicher, Andreas Schrimpf
abstract: Government bond markets – traditionally viewed as safe havens, at least in many advanced economies – have become focal points of market stress. Liquid and well-functioning markets for government debt critically rest on the intermediation capacity of dealers, which often form part of large banking groups. This capacity has been pressured by both the trajectory of government debt, which has been on an upward trend since the Great Financial Crisis (GFC), and the growth of leveraged strategies by investors that lead to one-sided markets during stress episodes (Schrimpf et al, 2020). Hence, the safe asset typically continues to be “safe” in terms of credit risk but faces mounting concerns about the ease of buying and selling it in a stressed market environment.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 政府债券市场的中央清算：确保“安全资产”的安全？
abstract_zh: 政府债券市场 — — 传统上被视为避风港，至少在许多发达经济体中 — — 已成为市场压力的焦点。政府债务市场的流动性和运作良好很大程度上取决于交易商的中介能力，而交易商通常是大型银行集团的一部分。这种能力受到政府债务轨迹（自金融危机（GFC）以来一直呈上升趋势）和投资者杠杆策略增长的压力，这些策略导致压力时期市场的一边倒（Schrimpf 等，2020）。因此，就信用风险而言，安全资产通常仍然是“安全的”，但在紧张的市场环境下，人们越来越担心买卖资产的难易程度。

title: Credit and resource allocation in EMEs: taking stock of two decades of falling interest rates
authors: Ryan Niladri Banerjee, Aaron Mehrotra, Fabrizio Zampolli
abstract: Since interest rates declined in the early 2000s, credit expanded strongly and its allocation changed significantly in emerging market economies (EMEs). Being largely spared by the Great Financial Crisis (GFC), EMEs have seen credit increasingly flowing to the construction and real estate sectors at the expense of manufacturing. Due to lower productivity growth in the housing sector, this shift has coincided with decreasing growth rates. Strong credit growth concentrated in a few sectors has also been associated with greater dispersion of productivity across firms, suggesting less efficient resource allocation.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 新兴市场经济体的信贷和资源配置：回顾二十年的利率下降
abstract_zh: 自 2000 年代初利率下降以来，新兴市场经济体 (EME) 的信贷强劲扩张，其配置发生了显着变化。新兴市场经济体基本上没有受到金融危机（GFC）的影响，信贷越来越多地流向建筑和房地产行业，而制造业却受到损害。由于住房部门生产率增长放缓，这种转变与增长率下降同时发生。集中在少数部门的强劲信贷增长也与企业之间生产率的更大分散有关，这表明资源配置效率较低。

title: The market turbulence and carry trade unwind of August 2024
authors: Matteo Aquilina, Marco Jacopo Lombardi, Andreas Schrimpf, Vladyslav Sushko
abstract: Financial market volatility resurfaced in early August as the unwinding of leveraged trades in equity and currency markets amplified the initial reaction to a negative macro release in the United States. Markets then stabilised quickly, and volatility receded. FX carry trades were hit hard by the deleveraging pressures. Their overall size is difficult to measure. Various estimates based on both on- and off-balance sheet activity yield a rough middle ballpark of ¥40 trillion ($250 billion) going into the event, which, if anything, is biased down due to data gaps. The event was yet another example of volatility exacerbated by procyclical deleveraging and margin increases. Although an outright market dysfunction was averted this time, the structural features of the system underpinning such episodes deserve continued attention by policymakers.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 2024年8月的市场动荡和套利交易平仓
abstract_zh: 8 月初，金融市场再次出现波动，因为股票和货币市场杠杆交易的平仓放大了对美国负面宏观经济数据释放的最初反应。随后市场迅速稳定，波动性消退。外汇套利交易受到去杠杆化压力的沉重打击。它们的总体尺寸很难测量。基于表内和表外活动的各种估计得出的粗略中间值为 40 万亿日元（2500 亿美元），但由于数据差距，这一数字存在偏差。该事件是顺周期去杠杆化和保证金增加加剧波动性的又一个例子。尽管这次避免了彻底的市场失灵，但支撑此类事件的体系结构特征仍值得政策制定者继续关注。

title: Housing costs: a final hurdle in the last mile of disinflation?
authors: Ryan Niladri Banerjee, Denis Gorea, Deniz Igan, Gabor Pinter
abstract: Inflation receded from recent peaks, but housing cost growth remains elevated. This strength reflects pandemic-induced changes in housing supply and demand which further aggravated existing pressures from long-standing housing shortages and demographic trends. Strong growth of the housing component of inflation can be a concern for monetary policy because it tends to be more persistent than components related to other services and goods, reflecting lags in measurement and infrequent changes in rents. In the short term, rents and housing costs may rise after a monetary policy tightening if landlords pass higher financing costs to tenants, property developers reduce new supply or more households opt to rent rather than buy.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 住房成本：通缩最后一英里的最后障碍？
abstract_zh: 通货膨胀已从近期峰值回落，但住房成本增长仍然较高。这种强劲反映了疫情引发的住房供需变化，进一步加剧了长期住房短缺和人口趋势带来的现有压力。通货膨胀中住房部分的强劲增长可能会引起货币政策的担忧，因为它往往比其他服务和商品相关的部分更持久，反映了衡量的滞后性和租金的不频繁变化。短期内，如果房东将更高的融资成本转嫁给租户、房地产开发商减少新增供应或更多家庭选择租房而不是购买，货币政策收紧后的租金和住房成本可能会上升。

title: Resilience in emerging markets: what makes it, what could shake it?
authors: Bryan Hardy, Deniz Igan, Enisse Kharroubi
abstract: Emerging market economies broke with the past by showing resilience in the face of rapid monetary tightening in advanced economies. Structural factors were at play, with better monetary policy and prudential frameworks being key. Conjunctural factors also played a role. The commonality of the Covid-19 shock ameliorated policy trade-offs, while the strong showing in advanced economies supported financial market sentiment globally. Nevertheless, as with the rest of the world economy, emerging markets are not out of the woods. More persistent inflation, in particular in advanced economies, could keep global financial conditions tighter for longer and test emerging market resilience going forward.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 新兴市场的韧性：是什么造就了它，什么可以动摇它？
abstract_zh: 面对发达经济体快速收紧货币政策，新兴市场经济体表现出了韧性，打破了过去的做法。结构性因素在发挥作用，其中更好的货币政策和审慎框架是关键。联合因素也发挥了作用。 Covid-19 冲击的共性改善了政策权衡，而发达经济体的强劲表现支撑了全球金融市场情绪。然而，与世界其他经济体一样，新兴市场尚未走出困境。更持久的通胀，特别是在发达经济体，可能会使全球金融状况在更长时间内趋紧，并考验新兴市场未来的弹性。

title: Next generation correspondent banking
authors: Rodney Garratt, Priscilla Koo Wilkens, Hyun Song Shin
abstract: Existing correspondent banking processes have struggled to adapt to new regulatory and supervisory requirements, posing questions on the future of the correspondent banking model. The tokenisation of correspondent banking, as embodied in Project Agorá (BIS (2024b)), could unlock streamlined pre-screening and atomic settlement, and pave the way for superior customer verification and anti-money laundering (AML) procedures. Tokenisation could substantially reduce duplication and miscoordination, thereby revitalising cross-border payments by fostering a robust network of correspondents and corridors.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 下一代代理银行业务
abstract_zh: 现有代理银行流程一直在努力适应新的监管要求，这对代理银行模式的未来提出了疑问。 Agorá 项目 (BIS (2024b)) 所体现的代理银行代币化可以实现简化的预筛选和原子结算，并为卓越的客户验证和反洗钱 (AML) 程序铺平道路。代币化可以大大减少重复和不协调，从而通过培育强大的代理网络和走廊来重振跨境支付。

title: Survey evidence on gen AI and households: job prospects amid trust concerns
authors: Iñaki Aldasoro, Olivier Armantier, Sebastian Doerr, Leonardo Gambacorta, Tommaso Oliviero
abstract: A representative survey shows that almost half of US households use generative artificial intelligence (gen AI) tools. The use of and knowledge about gen AI are significantly lower among women, the elderly and households with lower income or educational attainment. Respondents expect gen AI to bring more opportunities than risks for job prospects, especially among men and younger, more educated and higher-income households. Nonetheless, all groups trust gen AI less than humans, especially in the provision of financial and medical services. Survey participants express concern over the risks of data breaches and data abuse and overwhelmingly support the regulation of AI. Consistent with previous surveys, respondents trust government agencies and financial institutions more than big techs to safeguard their data.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 关于人工智能和家庭的调查证据：信任担忧中的就业前景
abstract_zh: 一项代表性调查显示，近一半的美国家庭使用生成式人工智能（gen AI）工具。女性、老年人和收入或教育程度较低的家庭对人工智能的使用和了解显着较低。受访者预计人工智能将为就业前景带来更多的机会而不是风险，特别是对于男性和更年轻、受教育程度更高和收入更高的家庭。尽管如此，所有群体对人工智能的信任度都低于对人类的信任度，尤其是在提供金融和医疗服务方面。调查参与者对数据泄露和数据滥用的风险表示担忧，并绝大多数支持人工智能的监管。与之前的调查一致，受访者更信任政府机构和金融机构来保护他们的数据，而不是大型科技公司。

title: From financial inclusion to financial health
authors: Carlos Cantú, Jon Frost, Tirupam Goel, Jermy Prenio
abstract: To successfully manage their financial obligations and have confidence in their financial future (financial health) people need to access and use financial services (financial inclusion). Yet inclusion alone may not be sufficient: financial health can suffer if the quality of use of financial services is poor (eg issues with provision such as scams or a lack of financial literacy and know-how on the part of the consumers). Public policy can boost financial health by promoting financial consumer protection, advancing financial literacy and enacting foundational policies like sound regulation and open finance.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 从金融普惠到金融健康
abstract_zh: 为了成功管理其财务义务并对自己的财务未来（财务健康）充满信心，人们需要获得和使用金融服务（金融普惠）。然而，仅仅包容性可能还不够：如果金融服务的使用质量较差（例如，诈骗等提供问题或消费者缺乏金融知识和专业知识），金融健康可能会受到损害。公共政策可以通过促进金融消费者保护、提高金融知识以及制定健全的监管和开放金融等基础政策来促进金融健康。

title: Artificial intelligence in central banking
authors: Douglas Kiarelly Godoy de Araujo, Sebastian Doerr, Leonardo Gambacorta, Bruno Tissot
abstract: Central banks have been early adopters of machine learning techniques for statistics, macro analysis, payment systems oversight and supervision, with considerable success. Artificial intelligence brings many opportunities in support of central bank mandates, but also challenges – some general and others specific to central banks. Central bank collaboration, for instance through knowledge-sharing and pooling of expertise, holds great promise in keeping central banks at the vanguard of developments in artificial intelligence.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 中央银行中的人工智能
abstract_zh: 中央银行是统计、宏观分析、支付系统监督和监管领域机器学习技术的早期采用者，并取得了相当大的成功。人工智能为支持央行的任务带来了许多机遇，但也带来了挑战——一些是一般性的，另一些是央行特有的。央行合作，例如通过知识共享和专业知识汇集，有望让央行保持在人工智能发展的先锋地位。

title: Testing the cognitive limits of large language models
authors: Fernando Perez-Cruz, Hyun Song Shin
abstract: When posed with a logical puzzle that demands reasoning about the knowledge of others and about counterfactuals, large language models (LLMs) display a distinctive and revealing pattern of failure. The LLM performs flawlessly when presented with the original wording of the puzzle available on the internet but performs poorly when incidental details are changed, suggestive of a lack of true understanding of the underlying logic. Our findings do not detract from the considerable progress in central bank applications of machine learning to data management, macro analysis and regulation/supervision. They do, however, suggest that caution should be exercised in deploying LLMs in contexts that demand rigorous reasoning in economic analysis.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 测试大型语言模型的认知极限
abstract_zh: 当面临需要对他人的知识和反事实进行推理的逻辑难题时，大型语言模型（LLM）会表现出独特且具有启发性的失败模式。当呈现互联网上提供的谜题的原始措辞时，法学硕士表现完美，但当偶然的细节发生变化时，法学硕士表现不佳，这表明缺乏对底层逻辑的真正理解。我们的研究结果并没有影响央行将机器学习应用于数据管理、宏观分析和监管方面取得的巨大进展。然而，他们确实建议，在需要严格经济分析推理的背景下部署法学硕士时应谨慎行事。

title: The contribution of monetary policy to disinflation
authors: Pongpitch Amatyakul, Fiorella De Fiore, Marco Jacopo Lombardi, Benoit Mojon, Daniel Rees
abstract: Much of the inflation increase in 2021 and 2022 was due to sectoral shocks on which monetary policy has close to no traction. What monetary policy can do, or fail to do, is to ensure that the effects of these shocks dissipate swiftly. We argue that, absent the somewhat delayed but vigorous increases in policy interest rates since 2022, inflation would have subsided more slowly in 2023. Central banks' most important contribution to inflation is to demonstrate commitment to achieving their targets and ensuring that low inflation remains the norm for price- and wage-setting decisions.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 货币政策对通货紧缩的贡献
abstract_zh: 2021 年和 2022 年的通胀上升很大程度上是由于货币政策几乎没有任何牵引力的部门冲击造成的。货币政策能做或不能做的是确保这些冲击的影响迅速消散。我们认为，如果没有自 2022 年以来政策利率有所延迟但强劲的增长，通胀在 2023 年的消退将会更加缓慢。央行对通胀最重要的贡献是表明致力于实现其目标，并确保低通胀仍然是价格和工资制定决策的常态。

title: Interest rate risk of non-financial firms: who hedges and does it help?
authors: Ryan Niladri Banerjee, Julián Caballero, Enisse Kharroubi, Renée Spigt, Egon Zakrajsek
abstract: Natural language text analysis of 80,000 company financial statements published by 14,000 non-financial firms in the euro area, United Kingdom and United States shows that around 50% of firms with variable rate debt hedge their interest rate risk. Firms that hedge interest rate risk tend to be larger and have smaller cash buffers and lower equity valuations. When interest rates rise, firms that hedge their interest rate risk experience a smaller negative impact on their interest coverage ratios and market valuations. They are also better able to maintain the size of their workforce. Our analysis highlights the importance of, and the challenges in, getting a comprehensive overview of hedging activity among non-financial firms.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 非金融企业的利率风险：谁来对冲？它有帮助吗？
abstract_zh: 对欧元区、英国和美国 14,000 家非金融公司发布的 80,000 份公司财务报表的自然语言文本分析表明，大约 50% 的浮动利率债务公司对冲利率风险。对冲利率风险的公司往往规模较大，现金缓冲较小，股票估值较低。当利率上升时，对冲利率风险的公司对其利息覆盖率和市场估值的负面影响较小。他们也能够更好地维持劳动力规模。我们的分析强调了全面了解非金融公司对冲活动的重要性和挑战。

title: Monetary policy, financial conditions and real activity: is this time different?
authors: Fernando Avalos, Deniz Igan, Cristina Manea, Richhild Moessner
abstract: During the current monetary policy tightening episode, financial conditions co-moved closely with policy rates, especially in the initial stages but with some differentiation across countries. For advanced economies, the tightening of financial conditions was stronger this time than in the past, while its full impact on real activity appears to be taking longer than usual. Financial conditions may continue tightening long after central banks stop raising policy rates, with possible implications for financial stability.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 货币政策、金融状况和实际活动：这次不同吗？
abstract_zh: 在当前的货币政策紧缩时期，金融状况与政策利率密切相关，特别是在初始阶段，但各国之间存在一定差异。对于发达经济体来说，这次金融状况的收紧程度比过去更强，而其对实际活动的全面影响似乎需要比平常更长的时间。在央行停止提高政策利率后很长一段时间内，金融状况可能会继续收紧，这可能会对金融稳定产生影响。

title: Lessons from recent experiences on exchange rates, capital flows and financial conditions in EMEs
authors: Pietro Patelli, Jimmy Shek, Ilhyock Shim
abstract: Currency appreciation in emerging market economies (EMEs) has gone hand in hand with greater risk-taking, higher capital flows and more accommodative financial conditions, against the backdrop of the increasing share of foreign investment in local currency assets in EMEs' external financing since 2007. The historically positive correlation between US dollar strength against EME currencies and EME sovereign bond spreads over US Treasuries up to 2021 continued in Latin America but reversed in emerging Asia in 2022–23. Such a divergence reflects a range of policy responses by EME central banks in the face of the unprecedented combination of shocks in 2022. In particular, central banks in emerging Asia intervened more actively in FX markets and relied less on monetary policy tightening than those in Latin America.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 新兴市场国家近期汇率、资本流动和金融状况的经验教训
abstract_zh: 自 2007 年以来，新兴市场经济体 (EME) 外部融资中本币资产的外国投资份额不断增加，新兴市场经济体 (EME) 的货币升值与更大的风险承担、更高的资本流动和更宽松的金融条件齐头并进。截至 2021 年，美元兑新兴市场经济体货币的强势与新兴市场经济体主权债券相对于美国国债的利差之间的历史正相关关系在拉丁美洲持续存在，但在 2022-23 年亚洲新兴市场出现了逆转。这种差异反映了新兴市场央行在面对2022年前所未有的多重冲击时采取的一系列政策反应。特别是，与拉丁美洲央行相比，新兴亚洲央行对外汇市场的干预更加积极，对货币政策紧缩的依赖程度也较低。

title: Mapping the realignment of global value chains
authors: Han Qiu, Hyun Song Shin, Leanne Si Ying Zhang
abstract: The latest firm-level network data reveal that global value chains have lengthened, although without the accompanying network densification that might indicate that supplier relationships are diversifying. Lengthening of supply chains is especially significant for supplier-customer linkages from China to the United States, where firms from other jurisdictions, notably in Asia, have interposed themselves in the supply chain. Nevertheless, these recent developments have not so far reversed the long-running trend toward greater regional integration of trade in recent decades, especially in Asia.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 绘制全球价值链的调整图
abstract_zh: 最新的企业级网络数据显示，全球价值链已经延长，尽管没有随之而来的网络致密化，这可能表明供应商关系正在多样化。供应链的延长对于从中国到美国的供应商与客户的联系尤其重要，来自其他司法管辖区（尤其是亚洲）的公司已介入供应链。然而，到目前为止，这些最新进展并没有扭转近几十年来区域贸易一体化的长期趋势，特别是在亚洲。

title: Margins and liquidity in European energy markets in 2022
authors: Fernando Avalos, Wenqian Huang, Kevin Tracol
abstract: European futures markets for natural gas and electricity were deeply disrupted by the events following the Russian invasion of Ukraine, including through large fluctuations in margins. The fluctuations in margins put significant liquidity demands on market participants, prompting the official sector to establish liquidity facilities in some jurisdictions. Fluctuations in initial margins were associated with material reductions in open interest of market participants, in line with standard deleveraging mechanisms seen in financial markets.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 2022 年欧洲能源市场的利润和流动性
abstract_zh: 欧洲天然气和电力期货市场因俄罗斯入侵乌克兰后发生的事件而受到严重干扰，包括利润率大幅波动。利润率的波动给市场参与者带来了巨大的流动性需求，促使官方部门在一些司法管辖区建立流动性便利。初始保证金的波动与市场参与者未平仓合约的大幅减少有关，这符合金融市场的标准去杠杆机制。

title: The oracle problem and the future of DeFi
authors: Chanelle Duley, Leonardo Gambacorta, Rodney Garratt, Priscilla Koo Wilkens
abstract: Crypto-based decentralised finance (DeFi) uses “oracles” to import real-world data into blockchain environments for use in smart contracts. Whether oracles can truly adhere to the complete decentralisation ethos of crypto is debatable. Even if feasible in practice, striving for the ideal of full decentralisation leads to complex consensus protocols that further erode blockchain efficiency. While introducing some degree of centralisation in oracles might boost efficiency, it also means adding trusted parties to a system designed to be trustless. As a result, crypto-based DeFi is likely to remain the preserve of cryptoassets only, rather than being used for real-world assets.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 预言机问题和 DeFi 的未来
abstract_zh: 基于加密货币的去中心化金融（DeFi）使用“预言机”将现实世界的数据导入区块链环境中，以便在智能合约中使用。预言机是否能够真正坚持加密货币的完全去中心化精神是值得商榷的。即使在实践中可行，追求完全去中心化的理想也会导致复杂的共识协议，从而进一步削弱区块链的效率。虽然在预言机中引入一定程度的中心化可能会提高效率，但这也意味着将可信方添加到设计为无需信任的系统中。因此，基于加密货币的 DeFi 很可能仍然只属于加密资产，而不是用于现实世界的资产。

title: Disinflation milestones
authors: Benoit Mojon, Gabriela Nodari, Stefano Siviero
abstract: Insights into how the incomes of workers and firms absorb the disinflation burden in the euro area and the United States can be gained by decomposing changes in the GDP deflator into its underlying components. Nominal wage increases of 4–5% in the euro area and 3–4% in the United States this year and next year are compatible with bringing inflation within reach of 2% by end-2024, provided that import price growth slows and profit margins stabilise or slightly shrink. From a historical perspective, the 2023–24 disinflation path for prices and nominal wages is within the range of past disinflation episodes in both economies, although it remains uncertain how price and wage setters will react to the above-target inflation from 2021 onwards.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 通货紧缩里程碑
abstract_zh: 通过将 GDP 平减指数的变化分解为其基本组成部分，可以深入了解工人和企业的收入如何吸收欧元区和美国的通货紧缩负担。今明两年，欧元区名义工资增长 4% 至 5%，美国名义工资增长 3% 至 4%，只要进口价格增长放缓、利润率稳定或略有收缩，到 2024 年底通胀率将达到 2%。从历史角度来看，2023-24年价格和名义工资的通货紧缩路径处于两个经济体过去通货紧缩时期的范围内，尽管仍不确定价格和工资制定者将如何应对2021年以后高于目标的通胀。

title: The changing nexus between commodity prices and the dollar: causes and implications
authors: Boris Hofmann, Deniz Igan, Daniel Rees
abstract: Commodity prices and the US dollar have moved in tandem recently, in contrast to their usual statistical pattern of moving in opposite directions. The causes of the change in the relationship are partly temporary, such as the unusual combination of recent shocks, and partly structural, such as the United States' emergence as a net energy exporter. The change in the nexus compounds the stagflationary effects of higher commodity prices for commodity importers, while its implications for commodity exporters are more ambiguous. A lasting change in the nexus could create more difficult challenges for macro-financial stability frameworks, particularly in commodity-importing economies.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 大宗商品价格与美元之间关系的变化：原因和影响
abstract_zh: 大宗商品价格和美元最近同步波动，这与通常相反方向波动的统计模式形成鲜明对比。两国关系变化的原因部分是暂时的，例如近期冲击的不寻常组合，部分是结构性的，例如美国成为能源净出口国。这种联系的变化加剧了大宗商品进口国因大宗商品价格上涨而产生的滞胀效应，而对大宗商品出口国的影响则更为模糊。这种关系的持久变化可能会给宏观金融稳定框架带来更加困难的挑战，特别是在大宗商品进口经济体中。

title: Stablecoins versus tokenised deposits: implications for the singleness of money
authors: Rodney Garratt, Hyun Song Shin
abstract: Private tokenised monies that circulate as bearer instruments, like stablecoins, may entail departures in their relative exchange values away from par in violation of the "singleness of money". In contrast, tokenised deposits that do not circulate as bearer instruments but rather settle in central bank money are more conducive to singleness. Tokenised deposits may enable expanded functionality by building on the capacity of programmable ledgers to introduce contingent execution and composability of transactions.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 稳定币与代币化存款：对货币单一性的影响
abstract_zh: 作为不记名工具流通的私人代币化货币（如稳定币）可能会导致其相对交换价值偏离面值，从而违反了“货币的单一性”。相比之下，不作为无记名工具流通而是以央行货币结算的代币化存款更有利于单一化。代币化存款可以通过建立可编程账本的能力来引入交易的偶然执行和可组合性，从而实现扩展功能。

title: The tokenisation continuum
authors: Iñaki Aldasoro, Sebastian Doerr, Leonardo Gambacorta, Rodney Garratt, Priscilla Koo Wilkens
abstract: Tokenising claims involves transforming them into tokens on a common programmable platform that combine a core layer, which contains information about the tokenised asset and its ownership, with a service layer embedding the platform's rules and governance. Tokenisation enables the automation of transactions involving money as well as financial and real assets, opening the way to the contingent transfer of claims and combinations of transactions via smart contracts. Economic, legal and technical challenges span a "tokenisation continuum" which describes the feasibility of tokenising traditional assets; gains are modest where tokenisation is easiest but the most valuable gains would involve the largest challenges.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 代币化连续体
abstract_zh: 代币化声明涉及将它们转换为通用可编程平台上的代币，该平台结合了核心层（包含有关代币化资产及其所有权的信息）和嵌入平台规则和治理的服务层。代币化使得涉及货币以及金融和实物资产的交易实现自动化，为通过智能合约进行债权或有转让和交易组合开辟了道路。经济、法律和技术挑战跨越“代币化连续体”，描述了传统资产代币化的可行性；在代币化最容易的地方，收益是有限的，但最有价值的收益将涉及最大的挑战。

title: Fiscal and monetary policy in emerging market economies: what are the risks and policy trade-offs?
authors: Ana Aguilar, Carlos Cantú, Rafael Guerra
abstract: Since 2021, monetary policy has tightened globally in response to the surge in inflation. Fiscal policies have generally remained expansionary, notably as governments put in place subsidies and transfers to insulate households, first from the pandemic and then from higher energy and food prices. Such fiscal support increases governments' funding needs at a time when tighter monetary policies raise the cost of servicing debts. Financial markets may reassess fiscal sustainability, request higher risk premia or reduce their holdings of sovereign bonds. Although such effects could affect both advanced and emerging market economies, the latter have historically been most vulnerable to a rise in the cost of international financing and a weaker exchange rate.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 新兴市场经济体的财政和货币政策：风险和政策权衡是什么？
abstract_zh: 2021年以来，全球货币政策不断收紧，以应对通胀飙升。财政政策总体上保持扩张性，特别是政府实施补贴和转移支付，以帮助家庭首先免受疫情影响，然后免受能源和食品价格上涨的影响。在紧缩的货币政策提高偿债成本之际，此类财政支持增加了政府的融资需求。金融市场可能会重新评估财政可持续性，要求更高的风险溢价或减少持有的主权债券。尽管此类影响可能同时影响发达市场经济体和新兴市场经济体，但后者历来最容易受到国际融资成本上升和汇率疲软的影响。

title: Private debt, monetary policy tightening and aggregate demand
authors: Miguel Ampudia, Fiorella De Fiore, Enisse Kharroubi, Cristina Manea
abstract: Monetary policy is tightening globally while private debt levels stand at historical highs. When private debt to GDP is high, aggregate demand may be more sensitive to interest rate hikes. Yet, after a decade of low rates, the maturity of private debt has generally lengthened, the prevalence of variable rates has fallen, and household net worth has increased. This should counteract the higher demand sensitivity stemming from elevated debt. Both the level and composition of private debt are important factors, although not the only ones, for the calibration of monetary policy in the current economic environment.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 私人债务、货币政策紧缩和总需求
abstract_zh: 全球货币政策正在收紧，而私人债务水平则处于历史高位。当私人债务占GDP的比重较高时，总需求可能对加息更为敏感。然而，在经历了十年的低利率之后，私人债务的期限普遍延长，可变利率的普及率下降，家庭净资产有所增加。这应该会抵消债务增加带来的更高的需求敏感性。私人债务的水平和构成都是当前经济环境下货币政策校准的重要因素，尽管不是唯一的因素。

title: Crypto shocks and retail losses
authors: Giulio Cornelli, Sebastian Doerr, Jon Frost, Leonardo Gambacorta
abstract: A new data set on retail holdings of cryptoassets reveals that in the wake of the Terra/Luna collapse and the FTX bankruptcy, crypto trading activity increased markedly, with large and sophisticated investors selling and smaller retail investors buying. Data on major crypto trading platforms over August 2015–December 2022 show that, as a result, a majority of crypto app users in nearly all economies made losses on their bitcoin holdings. Nevertheless, despite crypto's large user base and the substantial losses to many investors, the market turmoil in 2022 had little discernible impact on broader financial conditions outside the crypto universe, underlining the largely self-referential nature of crypto as an asset class.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 加密货币冲击和零售损失
abstract_zh: 一份有关散户持有加密资产的新数据显示，在 Terra/Luna 崩盘和 FTX 破产之后，加密货币交易活动显着增加，大型且成熟的投资者抛售，小型散户投资者买入。 2015 年 8 月至 2022 年 12 月主要加密货币交易平台的数据显示，几乎所有经济体的大多数加密应用程序用户都因持有的比特币而遭受损失。然而，尽管加密货币拥有庞大的用户群，并且给许多投资者带来了巨大损失，但 2022 年的市场动荡对加密货币领域之外的更广泛的金融状况几乎没有产生明显的影响，这突显了加密货币作为一种资产类别的很大程度上的自我参考性质。

title: Why are central banks reporting losses? Does it matter?
authors: Sarah Bell, Michael Chui, Tamara Gomes, Paul Moser-Boehm, Albert Pierres Tejada
abstract: Rising interest rates are reducing profits or even leading to losses at some central banks, especially those that purchased domestic currency assets for macroeconomic and financial stability objectives. Losses and negative equity do not directly affect the ability of central banks to operate effectively. In normal times and in crises, central banks should be judged on whether they fulfil their mandates. Central banks can underscore their continued ability to achieve policy objectives by clearly explaining the reasons for losses and highlighting the overall benefits of their policy measures.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 为什么央行会报告亏损？有关系吗？
abstract_zh: 利率上升正在减少一些央行的利润，甚至导致其亏损，特别是那些为了宏观经济和金融稳定目标而购买本币资产的央行。损失和负资产并不直接影响央行有效运作的能力。无论是在正常时期还是在危机时期，人们都应该根据央行是否履行职责来评判它们。央行可以通过明确解释损失原因并强调政策措施的总体效益来强调其持续实现政策目标的能力。

title: Does money growth help explain the recent inflation surge?
authors: Claudio Borio, Boris Hofmann, Egon Zakrajšek
abstract: The strength of the link between money growth and inflation depends on the inflation regime: it is one-to-one when inflation is high and virtually non-existent when it is low. A link can also be seen in the recent possible transition from a low- to a high-inflation regime. An upsurge in money growth preceded the inflation flare-up, and countries with stronger money growth saw markedly higher inflation. Looking at money growth would have helped to improve post-pandemic inflation forecasts, suggesting that its information value may have been neglected.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 货币增长有助于解释最近的通胀飙升吗？
abstract_zh: 货币增长与通货膨胀之间联系的强度取决于通货膨胀制度：当通货膨胀高时，这种联系是一对一的；而当通货膨胀低时，这种联系几乎不存在。从最近可能从低通胀到高通胀的转变中也可以看出其中的联系。货币增长在通胀爆发之前出现激增，货币增长强劲的国家通胀明显较高。关注货币增长将有助于改善大流行后的通胀预测，这表明其信息价值可能被忽视了。

title: Addressing the risks in crypto: laying out the options
authors: Matteo Aquilina, Jon Frost, Andreas Schrimpf
abstract: The recent high-profile failures of FTX and other crypto firms have re-ignited the debate on the appropriate policy response to address the risks in crypto, including through regulation. The "shadow financial" functions enabled by crypto markets share many of the vulnerabilities of traditional finance. These risks are exacerbated by specific features of crypto. Authorities may consider different – not mutually exclusive – lines of action to tackle the risks in crypto. These include containment or regulation of the crypto sector or an outright ban. Central banks and public authorities could also work to make TradFi more attractive. A key option is to encourage sound innovation with central bank digital currencies (CBDCs).
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 解决加密货币的风险：列出选项
abstract_zh: FTX 和其他加密货币公司最近备受瞩目的失败重新引发了关于采取适当政策应对措施（包括通过监管）解决加密货币风险的争论。加密市场带来的“影子金融”功能具有传统金融的许多弱点。加密货币的特定功能加剧了这些风险。当局可能会考虑采取不同的（而不是相互排斥的）行动方针来应对加密货币的风险。其中包括对加密货币行业的遏制或监管或彻底禁止。中央银行和公共当局也可以努力使 TradFi 更具吸引力。一个关键选择是鼓励央行数字货币（CBDC）的健全创新。

title: London as a financial centre since Brexit: evidence from the 2022 BIS Triennial Survey
authors: Jakub Demski, Robert N McCauley, Patrick McGuire
abstract: Historically, London has enjoyed an outsized role in euro-denominated financial transactions. We examine the latest evidence on whether Brexit has affected its central role in trading of interest rate derivatives, foreign exchange, international banking and bond underwriting. The 2022 BIS Triennial Central Bank Survey shows that London remains dominant in FX trading, but has lost share in euro interest rate swaps to euro area centres after five Surveys showing gains. London retains its pre-eminence in international banking, but its banking ties to the euro area have loosened in part owing to the shift of euro repo clearing from London to Paris.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 自英国脱欧以来伦敦作为金融中心：来自 2022 年国际清算银行三年期调查的证据
abstract_zh: 从历史上看，伦敦在欧元计价的金融交易中一直发挥着巨大的作用。我们研究了英国脱欧是否影响其在利率衍生品交易、外汇、国际银行和债券承销中的核心作用的最新证据。 2022 年国际清算银行三年一次的央行调查显示，伦敦在外汇交易中仍占主导地位，但在五次调查显示增长后，其在欧元利率掉期中的份额已输给欧元区中心。伦敦在国际银行业中保持着领先地位，但其与欧元区的银行业联系有所松动，部分原因是欧元回购清算从伦敦转移到巴黎。

title: Energy markets: shock, economic fallout and policy response
authors: Fernando Avalos, Adam Cap, Deniz Igan, Enisse Kharroubi, Gabriela Nodari
abstract: Commodity price increases this year have been larger, more persistent and more broad-based than similar past episodes of commodity price rises. The recent commodity price surge has exerted an overall stagflationary effect on the global economy, lowering growth and raising inflation. Given already high levels of inflation and of government debt, a coherent monetary and fiscal policy mix is needed even more than usual to navigate the policy challenges.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 能源市场：冲击、经济影响和政策反应
abstract_zh: 与过去类似的大宗商品价格上涨相比，今年的大宗商品价格上涨幅度更大、更持久、范围更广泛。近期大宗商品价格飙升对全球经济产生了整体滞胀效应，导致增长放缓、通胀上升。鉴于通货膨胀和政府债务水平已经很高，比平时更需要一致的货币和财政政策组合来应对政策挑战。

title: "Front-loading" monetary tightening: pros and cons
authors: Paolo Cavallino, Giulio Cornelli, Peter Hördahl, Egon Zakrajsek
abstract: In response to the surge in inflation globally, central banks have engaged in the most synchronised and rapid monetary tightening in 50 years. Parsing the evidence from 11 advanced economies since 1970 indicates that "front-loading" of interest rate hikes is successful in countering inflation, even in the face of large and persistent inflationary shocks. Still, front-loaded monetary policy tightening may carry risks to financial stability, especially in an environment of high private and public debt levels or potential fragility in market liquidity.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: “提前”货币紧缩：利与弊
abstract_zh: 为了应对全球通胀飙升，各国央行实施了 50 年来最同步、最迅速的货币紧缩政策。分析1970年以来11个发达经济体的证据表明，即使面对大规模且持续的通胀冲击，“提前”加息也能成功地对抗通胀。尽管如此，提前收紧货币政策可能会给金融稳定带来风险，特别是在私人和公共债务水平较高或市场流动性潜在脆弱的环境下。

title: Global exchange rate adjustments: drivers, impacts and policy implications
authors: Boris Hofmann, Aaron Mehrotra, Damiano Sandri
abstract: The world economy has been hit by two major shocks in succession – the Covid-19 pandemic and the Russian invasion of Ukraine – which have contributed to a significant rise in inflation and a global economic slowdown. These global shocks and the monetary policy responses to contain inflation have been associated with large exchange rate adjustments. In particular, the broad US dollar index has appreciated by around 10% since the beginning of this year, reaching its highest level in almost four decades (Graph 1, left-hand panel). The US dollar’s appreciation has been broad-based against almost all major global currencies, with only a few exceptions (right-hand panel).While exchange rate movements are an integral part of economies’ adjustment to shocks and their asymmetric repercussions, the dollar’s role as the premier international currency in global trade and finance implies that its movements have significant macro-financial consequences. This Bulletin discusses the drivers of recent exchange rate adjustments, the economic impacts and the policy implications.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 全球汇率调整：驱动因素、影响和政策影响
abstract_zh: 世界经济连续遭受两次重大冲击——Covid-19大流行和俄罗斯入侵乌克兰——导致通货膨胀大幅上升和全球经济放缓。这些全球冲击和遏制通胀的货币政策反应与大幅汇率调整有关。特别是，自今年年初以来，美元指数已升值约 10%，达到近四十年来的最高水平（图 1，左图）。美元兑几乎所有主要全球货币的升值基础广泛，只有少数例外（右图）。虽然汇率变动是经济体应对冲击及其不对称影响调整的一个组成部分，但美元作为全球贸易和金融中首要国际货币的角色意味着其变动会产生重大的宏观金融后果。本公告讨论了近期汇率调整的驱动因素、经济影响和政策含义。

title: Global supply chain disruptions: evolution, impact, outlook
authors: Deniz Igan, Phurichai Rungcharoenkitkul, Koji Takahashi
abstract: Global supply chain disruptions ("bottlenecks") have been easing gradually, albeit unevenly across sectors and regions. However, they remain significant relatively to the historical norm. The intricacies of today's global value chains account for the persistence and severe macroeconomic impact of bottlenecks in spite of their recent easing. Highly concentrated sectors such as semiconductors are prime examples. While continued easing of bottlenecks – which should help moderate inflation – is the most likely scenario, there are upside risks to inflation from more protracted bottleneck-induced disruptions. Nor can new bottlenecks be ruled out.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 全球供应链中断：演变、影响、前景
abstract_zh: 全球供应链中断（“瓶颈”）已逐渐缓解，尽管各行业和地区的情况不均衡。然而，相对于历史常态，它们仍然很重要。当今全球价值链的错综复杂导致了瓶颈的持续存在和严重的宏观经济影响，尽管这些瓶颈最近有所缓解。半导体等高度集中的行业就是最好的例子。虽然瓶颈的持续缓解 — — 这将有助于缓和通胀 — — 是最有可能出现的情况，但更长期的瓶颈引发的破坏可能会给通胀带来上行风险。也不能排除新的瓶颈。

title: Inflation indicators amid high uncertainty
authors: Fiorella De Fiore, Marco Jacopo Lombardi, Daniel Rees
abstract: In a low-inflation regime, inflation is driven largely by sector-specific price changes, with little effect on price- and wage-setting decisions. Core inflation measures tend to provide more accurate signals than headline measures do. The opposite holds in a high-inflation regime, when price changes become more synchronised across sectors and become more salient to workers and firms. Several inflation indicators using more detailed information can shed light on the future course of inflation. However, their usefulness depends on the prevailing inflation regime. They become particularly unreliable during transitions between regimes. Indicators based on mean reversion fare especially poorly. There are signals that can help to detect an ongoing transition: drifting inflation expectations, an increase in sectoral price co-movements and spillovers, and a rising pass-through from wages to prices and vice versa. Current readings of such indicators send mixed signals on whether a transition to a highinflation regime is under way.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 通胀指标高度不确定
abstract_zh: 在低通胀体制下，通胀主要由特定部门的价格变化驱动，对价格和工资制定决策影响不大。核心通胀指标往往比总体指标提供更准确的信号。在高通胀体制中，情况恰恰相反，各个部门的价格变化变得更加同步，并且对工人和企业来说变得更加显着。一些使用更详细信息的通胀指标可以揭示未来的通胀走势。然而，它们的有用性取决于现行的通货膨胀制度。在政权更迭期间，它们变得尤其不可靠。基于均值回归的指标尤其糟糕。有一些信号可以帮助检测正在进行的转变：通胀预期的变化、部门价格联动和溢出效应的增加，以及工资到价格的传导不断上升，反之亦然。目前这些指标的读数发出了关于是否正在向高通胀制度过渡的混合信号。

title: Hard or soft landing?
authors: Frederic Boissay, Fiorella De Fiore, Enisse Kharroubi
abstract: Inflation is now at its highest level in several decades and threatens to become entrenched. Whether inflation is demand- or supply-driven, central banks have little choice but to tighten policy to lower aggregate demand and bring inflation back to target. Evidence from past tightening cycles suggests that strong growth and high job vacancies, as well as front-loaded rate hikes, can help prevent a hard landing. But rapidly increasing inflation, low term spreads and elevated debt levels raise the risk of a recession, particularly in the face of persistent negative supply shocks. Central banks need to steer a narrow course between tightening too much or too quickly, which could precipitate a hard landing, and tightening too little or too late, which could lead to inflationary pressures becoming ingrained, necessitating more costly measures down the road.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 硬着陆还是软着陆？
abstract_zh: 通货膨胀目前处于几十年来的最高水平，并且有可能变得根深蒂固。无论通胀是需求驱动还是供给驱动，央行别无选择，只能收紧政策以降低总需求并使通胀回到目标水平。过去紧缩周期的证据表明，强劲增长和高职位空缺以及提前加息有助于防止硬着陆。但通胀快速上升、期限利差较低和债务水平升高会增加经济衰退的风险，特别是在面临持续的负供应冲击的情况下。央行需要在收紧政策过多或过快和收紧过少或过晚之间找到一条狭窄的道路，前者可能导致硬着陆，后者可能导致通胀压力根深蒂固，从而需要采取成本更高的措施。

title: Miners as intermediaries: extractable value and market manipulation in crypto and DeFi
authors: Raphael Auer, Jon Frost, Jose María Vidal Pastor
abstract: Cryptocurrencies such as Ethereum and decentralised finance (DeFi) protocols built on them rely on validators or "miners" as intermediaries to verify transactions and update the ledger. Since these intermediaries can choose which transactions they add to the ledger and in which order, they can engage in activities that would be illegal in traditional markets such as front-running and sandwich trades. The resulting profit is termed "miner extractable value" (MEV). MEV is an intrinsic shortcoming of pseudo-anonymous blockchains. Addressing this form of market manipulation may call for new regulatory approaches to this new class of intermediaries.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 矿工作为中介：加密货币和 DeFi 中的可提取价值和市场操纵
abstract_zh: 以太坊等加密货币和基于其构建的去中心化金融（DeFi）协议依赖验证器或“矿工”作为中介来验证交易并更新账本。由于这些中介机构可以选择将哪些交易添加到分类账中以及以何种顺序添加，因此他们可以从事传统市场中非法的活动，例如抢先交易和三明治交易。由此产生的利润被称为“矿工可提取价值”（MEV）。 MEV是伪匿名区块链的固有缺点。解决这种形式的市场操纵可能需要对这类新型中介机构采取新的监管方法。

title: DeFi lending: intermediation without information?
authors: Sirio Aramonte, Sebastian Doerr, Wenqian Huang, Andreas Schrimpf
abstract: Lending platforms are a key part of the decentralised finance (DeFi) ecosystem, but their institutional features mostly facilitate speculation in cryptoassets rather than real economy lending. Due to the anonymity of borrowers, overcollateralisation is pervasive in DeFi lending, which generates procyclicality. Reliance on collateral also limits access to credit to borrowers who are already asset-rich, negating financial inclusion benefits. For DeFi lending to make inroads into the real economy, it needs to tokenise real assets and rely less on collateral by developing its ability to gather information about borrowers; as such, the system is likely to gravitate towards greater centralisation.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: DeFi 借贷：没有信息的中介？
abstract_zh: 借贷平台是去中心化金融（DeFi）生态系统的关键组成部分，但其制度特征主要促进加密资产投机而非实体经济借贷。由于借款人的匿名性，超额抵押在 DeFi 贷款中普遍存在，从而产生了顺周期性。对抵押品的依赖还限制了资产丰富的借款人获得信贷的机会，从而抵消了普惠金融的好处。 DeFi 贷款要进军实体经济，需要将实体资产代币化，并通过发展收集借款人信息的能力来减少对抵押品的依赖；因此，该系统可能会趋向于更加集中化。

title: Blockchain scalability and the fragmentation of crypto
authors: Frederic Boissay, Giulio Cornelli, Sebastian Doerr, Jon Frost
abstract: Permissionless blockchains work by providing monetary incentives to decentralised validators. Yet the mechanism for maintaining these incentives necessarily entails congestion effects and high fees. These high fees encourage the use of alternative chains, leading to a fragmentation of the crypto landscape. Newer blockchains have higher capacity, even if these come at the cost of greater centralisation and weaker security. Differences in the design also preclude blockchain interoperability. Limited scalability and a lack of interoperability not only prevent network effects from taking root, but a system of parallel blockchains also adds to governance and safety risks. Despite fragmentation, cryptocurrencies on different blockchains exhibit strong price co-movements, as they often share the same investor base, and growth is sustained by speculative buying of coins.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 区块链可扩展性和加密货币的碎片化
abstract_zh: 无需许可的区块链通过向去中心化验证者提供货币激励来发挥作用。然而，维持这些激励措施的机制必然会带来拥堵效应和高额费用。这些高额费用鼓励了替代链的使用，导致加密货币格局的碎片化。较新的区块链具有更高的容量，即使这些是以更大的中心化和更弱的安全性为代价的。设计上的差异也妨碍了区块链的互操作性。有限的可扩展性和缺乏互操作性不仅阻碍了网络效应的扎根，而且并行区块链系统也增加了治理和安全风险。尽管存在碎片化，但不同区块链上的加密货币表现出强烈的价格联动，因为它们通常具有相同的投资者基础，并且通过投机性购买硬币来维持增长。

title: Rising household inflation expectations: what are the communication challenges for central banks?
authors: Fiorella De Fiore, Tirupam Goel, Deniz Igan, Richhild Moessner
abstract: Household inflation expectations have risen alongside higher inflation. These expectations matter for central banks since they affect consumption decisions and wage demands, shaping the public debate on inflation. Households are more influenced by the prices of frequently purchased items. This partly explains why they typically perceive current inflation to be higher than official inflation and why their expectations of future inflation exceed those of professional forecasters. Households may not fully appreciate the link between inflation and monetary policy. Continuous and direct engagement by central banks using simple and relatable messages can make communication more effective.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 家庭通胀预期上升：央行面临哪些沟通挑战？
abstract_zh: 随着通胀上升，家庭通胀预期也随之上升。这些预期对央行很重要，因为它们影响消费决策和工资需求，从而影响有关通胀的公众辩论。家庭更容易受到经常购买物品价格的影响。这在一定程度上解释了为什么他们通常认为当前通胀高于官方通胀，以及为什么他们对未来通胀的预期超过了专业预测者的预期。家庭可能没有完全理解通货膨胀和货币政策之间的联系。央行使用简单且相关的信息持续直接参与可以使沟通更加有效。

title: Commodity market disruptions, growth and inflation
authors: Deniz Igan, Emanuel Kohlscheen, Gabriela Nodari, Daniel Rees
abstract: Higher commodity prices will erode global growth, as the modest growth boost for commodity exporters will only partly offset the output losses of commodity importers. Rising commodity prices will also intensify global inflationary pressures. The effects will be strongest for food and energy prices, but spillovers to other components of inflation are likely. Recent shocks have been smaller than the 1970s oil shocks but broader-based, encompassing food and industrial commodities as well as energy. Nonetheless, structural changes, as well as stronger policy frameworks and nominal anchors, make stagflation less likely to return.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 大宗商品市场混乱、增长和通胀
abstract_zh: 大宗商品价格上涨将侵蚀全球增长，因为大宗商品出口国的温和增长只能部分抵消大宗商品进口国的产出损失。大宗商品价格上涨也将加剧全球通胀压力。食品和能源价格受到的影响最为强烈，但也可能对通胀的其他组成部分产生溢出效应。最近的冲击比 20 世纪 70 年代的石油冲击要小，但影响范围更广，涵盖食品、工业商品以及能源。尽管如此，结构性变化以及更强有力的政策框架和名义锚定使得滞胀不太可能卷土重来。

title: Are major advanced economies on the verge of a wage-price spiral?
authors: Frederic Boissay, Fiorella De Fiore, Deniz Igan, Albert Pierres Tejada, Daniel Rees
abstract: Inflation has returned, reaching levels not seen in decades. Whether inflation enters a persistently higher regime will depend on labour market developments, and on whether a wage-price spiral emerges. To date, evidence for a broad acceleration in wage growth is mixed. Wage growth has picked up significantly in the United States, but remains moderate in most other advanced economies, despite tentative signs of a renewed sensitivity of wages to inflation in some segments of the labour market and a pickup in inflation expectations. But extrapolating behaviour from low-inflation periods is problematic. If inflation remains high, households may ask for higher wages to make up for lost purchasing power and firms may raise prices to protect profit margins. And stubbornly high inflation may lead to institutional changes such as automatic indexation and cost-of-living adjustment clauses.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 主要发达经济体是否正处于工资价格螺旋式上升的边缘？
abstract_zh: 通货膨胀又回来了，达到了几十年来未见的水平。通胀是否进入持续走高的状态将取决于劳动力市场的发展，以及工资价格螺旋是否出现。迄今为止，工资增长普遍加速的证据好坏参半。美国的工资增长显着加快，但大多数其他发达经济体的工资增长仍然温和，尽管有初步迹象表明，劳动力市场某些领域的工资对通胀重新变得敏感，而且通胀预期有所回升。但从低通胀时期推断行为是有问题的。如果通胀居高不下，家庭可能会要求更高的工资来弥补购买力的损失，而企业可能会提高价格以保护利润率。顽固的高通胀可能会导致自动指数化和生活成本调整条款等制度变革。

title: Central banks, the monetary system and public payment infrastructures: lessons from Brazil's Pix
authors: Angelo Duarte, Jon Frost, Leonardo Gambacorta, Priscilla Koo Wilkens, Hyun Song Shin
abstract: Public payment infrastructures build on the central bank's foundational role in the monetary system by promoting competition and interoperability between payment platforms. They can reduce costs for users and promote financial inclusion. Brazil's recent experience with the Pix retail instant payment system illustrates the potential gains. In little over a year since its launch in November 2020, Pix has signed up 67% of adults in Brazil, with free payments between individuals and low charges for merchants. The two key ingredients in the success of Pix are, first, the mandatory participation of large banks to kick-start network effects for users, and second, the central bank's dual role as infrastructure provider and rule setter.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 中央银行、货币体系和公共支付基础设施：巴西 Pix 的经验教训
abstract_zh: 公共支付基础设施通过促进支付平台之间的竞争和互操作性，建立在中央银行在货币体系中的基础性作用之上。它们可以降低用户的成本并促进金融包容性。巴西最近使用 Pix 零售即时支付系统的经验说明了潜在的收益。自 2020 年 11 月推出以来，Pix 已在巴西 67% 的成年人中签约，个人之间免费付款，商家收费低廉。 Pix 成功的两个关键因素是，第一，大型银行的强制参与，为用户启动网络效应；第二，央行作为基础设施提供商和规则制定者的双重角色。

title: Anchoring of inflation expectations: has past progress paid off?
authors: Tirupam Goel, Kostas Tsatsaronis
abstract: In the decade before the pandemic, inflation expectations became less volatile worldwide, as well as more consistent with inflation targets and less sensitive to inflation surprises. This progress has paid off for many economies during the past year's surge in inflation: long-term expectations have remained largely anchored, but with notable exceptions. Anchored expectations provide room for monetary policy manoeuvre, but how strongly they remain anchored will depend on central banks keeping inflation in line with their stated objectives.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 锚定通胀预期：过去的进展是否得到回报？
abstract_zh: 在大流行之前的十年里，全球通胀预期的波动性降低，与通胀目标更加一致，对通胀意外的敏感度降低。在过去一年的通胀飙升期间，这一进展为许多经济体带来了回报：长期预期基本保持稳定，但也有明显的例外。锚定预期为货币政策操作提供了空间，但锚定预期的强度将取决于央行能否保持通胀符合其既定目标。

title: Housing market risks in the wake of the pandemic
authors: Deniz Igan, Emanuel Kohlscheen, Phurichai Rungcharoenkitkul
abstract: House prices rose strongly in advanced economies during the pandemic, breaking with typical post-recession patterns. These developments support domestic demand in the short term but carry risks to the outlook if they reverse. Rapid economic recovery, fiscal support and high saving rates amid negative real interest rates explain part of the strong housing demand. Pandemic-induced demand for space, structural supply constraints and increased demand from investors provide additional support for house prices. The monetary policy response to inflationary pressures will be a relevant factor when assessing housing market risks. Moderate increases in interest rates could help forestall speculative demand.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 疫情过后房地产市场面临风险
abstract_zh: 疫情期间，发达经济体的房价强劲上涨，打破了经济衰退后的典型模式。这些事态发展在短期内支撑了国内需求，但如果出现逆转，就会给前景带来风险。经济快速复苏、财政支持以及负实际利率下的高储蓄率是住房需求强劲的部分原因。疫情引发的空间需求、结构性供应限制以及投资者需求的增加为房价提供了额外支撑。在评估房地产市场风险时，货币政策对通胀压力的反应将是一个相关因素。适度提高利率可能有助于抑制投机需求。

title: Interoperability between payment systems across borders
authors: Codruta Boar, Stijn Claessens, Anneke Kosse, Ross Leckow, Tara Rice
abstract: Interoperability among payment systems – as the foundation for enhancing cross-border payments – requires technical, semantic and business system compatibility so that end users can seamlessly transact with each other across systems.
