Public and private sector options in pursuing cross-border payment system interoperability can be illustrated using four stylised models, ordered in increasing complexity and cost but also greater efficiency – a single access point, bilateral link, hub and spoke or a common platform. The BIS Innovation Hub is putting theory into practice with several innovative projects to foster interoperability across the four stylised models. An ambitious, multi-year G20 programme to enhance cross-border payments is under way.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 跨境支付系统之间的互操作性
abstract_zh: 支付系统之间的互操作性作为增强跨境支付的基础，需要技术、语义和业务系统的兼容性，以便最终用户可以跨系统无缝地进行交易。公共和私营部门在追求跨境支付系统互操作性方面的选择可以使用四种风格化的模型来说明，这些模型的复杂性和成本越来越高，但效率也越来越高——单一接入点、双边链路、中心辐射或通用平台。 BIS 创新中心正在通过多个创新项目将理论付诸实践，以促进四种风格化模型之间的互操作性。一项旨在加强跨境支付的雄心勃勃的 G20 多年计划正在进行中。

title: Bottlenecks: causes and macroeconomic implications
authors: Daniel Rees, Phurichai Rungcharoenkitkul
abstract: Bottlenecks in the supply of commodities, intermediate goods and freight transport have given rise to volatile prices and delivery delays. Bottlenecks started out as pandemic-related supply disruptions amid strong demand from the global economic recovery. But they have been aggravated by the attempts of supply chain participants to build buffers in already lean production networks – so-called bullwhip effects. Bottlenecks have been particularly severe in upstream industries – ie those that supply inputs used in many other products. These constraints have led to large international spillovers through global value chains. The direct inflationary effect of bottlenecks will likely be limited after relative prices have adjusted. However, sustained inflationary pressures could emerge if bottlenecks persist long enough to trigger an upward shift in wage growth and inflation expectations
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 瓶颈：原因和宏观经济影响
abstract_zh: 大宗商品、中间产品和货运供应的瓶颈导致价格波动和交货延误。瓶颈始于全球经济复苏的强劲需求之际，与大流行相关的供应中断。但供应链参与者试图在已经精益的生产网络中建立缓冲——即所谓的牛鞭效应——加剧了这种情况。上游行业的瓶颈尤其严重——即那些为许多其他产品提供原料的行业。这些限制导致全球价值链产生巨大的国际溢出效应。在相对价格调整后，瓶颈的直接通胀效应可能会受到限制。然而，如果瓶颈持续足够长的时间以引发工资增长和通胀预期的上移，则可能会出现持续的通胀压力

title: Labour markets and inflation in the wake of the pandemic
authors: Frederic Boissay, Emanuel Kohlscheen, Richhild Moessner, Daniel Rees
abstract: The pandemic had a significant effect on labour markets. Working hours fell sharply almost everywhere, but the drivers of these declines varied greatly across countries, depending on whether policies to protect worker-firm relationships were in place. Labour markets have bounced back faster than after recent recessions, albeit unevenly. Even in countries where unemployment rates remain high, job vacancies have risen, including in the sectors hardest hit by the pandemic. Frictions are most pronounced where policy responses did not protect worker-firm relationships. Wages are generally rising more slowly than before the pandemic. However, there is significant dispersion across sectors. Wages are rising fastest in sectors such as information & communications where the pandemic boosted demand, and also in high-contact sectors such as recreation where labour supply has receded. A generalised pickup in wage growth still seems unlikely, even though some countries and sectors have seen increases. However, a retreat in globalisation could make inflation more responsive to labour market pressures
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 大流行后的劳动力市场和通货膨胀
abstract_zh: 大流行对劳动力市场产生了重大影响。几乎所有地方的工作时间都大幅减少，但各国造成这些减少的因素差异很大，具体取决于保护工人与企业关系的政策是否到位。劳动力市场的反弹速度比最近的衰退后更快，尽管不均衡。即使在失业率居高不下的国家，职位空缺也有所增加，包括受疫情影响最严重的部门。当政策反应不能保护工人与企业的关系时，摩擦最为明显。工资增长普遍比大流行前慢。然而，不同行业之间存在显着差异。在疫情刺激需求的信息和通信等行业，以及劳动力供应减少的娱乐等高接触行业，工资上涨最快。尽管一些国家和行业已经出现工资增长，但工资增长普遍回升似乎仍然不太可能。然而，全球化的倒退可能会使通胀对劳动力市场压力更加敏感

title: Could corporate credit losses turn out higher than expected?
authors: Mikael Juselius, Nikola Tarashev
abstract: Credit risk forecasts should provide information both about losses in a baseline scenario ("expected losses") and about the potential for extreme outcomes ("unexpected losses"). Policy support measures have kept debt service costs low during the pandemic, thus underpinning benign baseline forecasts of corporate credit losses up to 2024. High indebtedness, built up when the pandemic impaired real activity, suggests increased tail risks: plausible deviations from the baseline scenario feature ballooning corporate insolvencies.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 企业信贷损失是否会高于预期？
abstract_zh: 信用风险预测应提供有关基准情景中的损失（“预期损失”）和极端结果的可能性（“意外损失”）的信息。政策支持措施在大流行期间使偿债成本保持在较低水平，从而支撑了对截至 2024 年企业信用损失的良性基线预测。大流行损害实际活动时积累的高负债表明尾部风险增加：与基线情景的合理偏差表现为企业破产膨胀。

title: Regulating big techs in finance
authors: Agustín Carstens, Stijn Claessens, Fernando Restoy, Hyun Song Shin
abstract: Big tech firms entering financial services can scale up rapidly with user data from their existing business lines in e-commerce and social media, and by harnessing the inherent network effects in digital services. In addition to traditional policy concerns such as financial risks, consumer protection and operational resilience, the entry of big techs into financial services gives rise to new challenges surrounding the concentration of market power and data governance. The current framework for regulating financial services follows an activities-based approach where providers must hold licences for specific business lines. There is scope to address the new policy challenges by developing specific entity-based rules, as proposed in several key jurisdictions – notably the European Union, China and the United States.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 监管金融领域的大型科技公司
abstract_zh: 进入金融服务领域的大型科技公司可以利用电子商务和社交媒体现有业务线的用户数据，并利用数字服务固有的网络效应，迅速扩大规模。除了金融风险、消费者保护和运营弹性等传统政策问题外，科技巨头进入金融服务业还带来了围绕市场力量集中和数据治理的新挑战。当前的金融服务监管框架遵循基于活动的方法，其中提供商必须持有特定业务线的许可证。正如几个主要司法管辖区（特别是欧盟、中国和美国）所提议的那样，通过制定基于实体的具体规则，可以应对新的政策挑战。

title: Covid-19 and bank resilience: where do we stand?
authors: Yuuki Ikeda, Will Kerry, Ulf Lewrick, Christian Schmieder
abstract: A forward-looking view on bank resilience can be obtained through a combination of regulatory capital ratios, market valuations and insights from stress tests. Banks appear to have avoided the losses that once seemed likely given the severity of the pandemic shock, due in large part to policy support. While market valuations have largely recovered to pre-pandemic levels, a weaker tail of banks continues to struggle with anaemic profitability and potential for credit losses. The resilience of these banks could be tested if credit losses materialise following the winding down of policy support.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: Covid-19 和银行复原力：我们处于什么位置？
abstract_zh: 通过结合监管资本比率、市场估值和压力测试的见解，可以获得对银行韧性的前瞻性看法。鉴于大流行冲击的严重性，银行似乎避免了曾经看似可能发生的损失，这在很大程度上要归功于政策支持。尽管市场估值已基本恢复至大流行前的水平，但较弱的银行尾部继续与盈利能力不足和信贷损失的可能性作斗争。如果政策支持结束后出现信贷损失，这些银行的弹性可能会受到考验。

title: Global reflation ?
authors: Flora Budianto, Giovanni Lombardo, Benoit Mojon, Daniel Rees
abstract: Inflation has risen in many countries. In conjunction with a rebound in GDP growth and evidence of significant bottlenecks in some sectors, this has prompted concerns that the low inflation era of recent decades could be nearing its end. A closer look at the data reveals that the pickup in inflation can be ascribed largely to base effects, increases in the prices of a small number of pandemic-affected items and higher energy prices. A common thread through these causes is that their effect on inflation is likely to be temporary. A more persistent increase in inflation would likely require a material pickup in labour costs and an unmooring of inflation expectations. However, wage growth remains contained and the medium-term inflation expectations of professional forecasters and financial markets show little sign of de-anchoring. These developments are consistent with medium-term inflation moving towards central bank targets.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 全球通货再膨胀？
abstract_zh: 许多国家的通货膨胀率上升。再加上GDP增长的反弹以及某些部门出现严重瓶颈的证据，这引发了人们对近几十年来的低通胀时代可能即将结束的担忧。仔细观察数据就会发现，通胀上升主要归因于基数效应、少数受疫情影响的商品价格上涨以及能源价格上涨。这些原因的一个共同点是它们对通胀的影响可能是暂时的。通胀更持续的上升可能需要劳动力成本的大幅上升和通胀预期的放松。然而，工资增长仍然受到控制，专业预测者和金融市场的中期通胀预期几乎没有显示出脱离锚定的迹象。这些事态发展与中期通胀向央行目标迈进是一致的。

title: Whom do consumers trust with their data? US survey evidence
authors: Olivier Armantier, Sebastian Doerr, Jon Frost, Andreas Fuster, Kelly Shue
abstract: In a recent survey, US households say they are more likely to trust traditional financial institutions than government agencies or fintechs to safeguard their personal data. They have far less trust in big techs. This pattern differs across demographic groups: respondents from racial minorities have less trust in financial institutions, while younger respondents trust fintechs relatively more. Female, minority and younger respondents are more concerned about implications of data-sharing for their personal safety. A quarter of respondents say Covid-19 made them less willing to share data. In this group, nearly half became less willing to share with big techs. Concerns centred on identity theft and abuse of data. As the economy becomes increasingly digital, and new players expand further into financial services, strong data protection policies will become more important to shield consumers from these harms.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 消费者信任谁来处理他们的数据？美国调查证据
abstract_zh: 在最近的一项调查中，美国家庭表示，与政府机构或金融科技公司相比，他们更有可能信任传统金融机构来保护他们的个人数据。他们对大型科技公司的信任度要低得多。这种模式在不同人口群体中有所不同：少数族裔受访者对金融机构的信任度较低，而年轻受访者相对而言更信任金融科技。女性、少数族裔和年轻受访者更关心数据共享对其人身安全的影响。四分之一的受访者表示，Covid-19 使他们不太愿意分享数据。在这个群体中，近一半的人变得不太愿意与大型科技公司分享。人们的担忧集中在身份盗窃和数据滥用上。随着经济变得越来越数字化，新参与者进一步扩展到金融服务领域，强有力的数据保护政策将变得更加重要，以保护消费者免受这些伤害。

title: Futures-based commodity ETFs when storage is constrained
authors: Sirio Aramonte, Karamfil Todorov
abstract: Exchange-traded funds (ETFs) that hold futures contracts on commodities are an important link between commodity markets and financial markets. When commodity storage capacity is constrained, investor flows into ETFs holding futures can lower, instead of raise, commodity prices due to potentially high costs of physical storage. April 2020 briefly witnessed negative prices for the nearest-maturity futures contract on WTI oil, possibly due to such a combination of storage constraints and investor flows into ETFs.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 当存储受限时基于期货的商品 ETF
abstract_zh: 持有商品期货合约的交易所交易基金（ETF）是商品市场和金融市场之间的重要纽带。当大宗商品存储容量受到限制时，由于实物存储成本可能较高，投资者流入持有期货的 ETF 可能会降低而不是提高大宗商品价格。 2020 年 4 月，WTI 石油最近到期期货合约短暂出现负价，这可能是由于存储限制和投资者流入 ETF 的综合影响。

title: Liquidity to solvency: transition cancelled or postponed?
authors: Ryan Niladri Banerjee, Joseph Noss, Jose María Vidal Pastor
abstract: Since the start of the Covid-19 pandemic, a "bankruptcy gap" has emerged between measures of expected and realised bankruptcies globally. The ample supply of credit to make up for short-term losses has been an important factor decoupling bankruptcies from the sharp reduction in firms' cash flows. Firms' reliance on credit suggests that it may be too early to dismiss future solvency risk. Significant increases in leverage and weak earnings forecasts in some sectors suggest that for some firms, greater credit extension may have only postponed, rather than cancelled, their insolvency.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 流动性到偿付能力：过渡取消还是推迟？
abstract_zh: 自Covid-19大流行开始以来，全球预期破产与实际破产之间出现了“破产差距”。弥补短期损失的充足信贷供应一直是使破产与企业现金流急剧减少脱钩的重要因素。企业对信贷的依赖表明，现在排除未来偿付能力风险可能还为时过早。一些行业的杠杆率大幅上升和盈利预测疲软表明，对于一些企业来说，更大的信贷扩张可能只会推迟而不是取消它们的破产。

title: Liquidity management and asset sales by bond funds in the face of investor redemptions in March 2020
authors: Andreas Schrimpf, Ilhyock Shim, Hyun Song Shin
abstract: Investor redemptions are one factor behind asset sales by open-ended mutual funds, but an important additional factor is the selling due to the funds' liquidity management. Funds holding illiquid assets reacted to redemptions in March 2020 by adding to their cash buffers even after meeting investor redemptions. For such funds, asset sales exceeded investor redemptions. Increases in end-of-period cash holdings were less pronounced for funds that started the stress period with larger buffers, suggesting that such funds were less prone to selling at the height of the stress.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 2020年3月债券基金面对投资者赎回的流动性管理和资产出售
abstract_zh: 投资者赎回是开放式共同基金出售资产的因素之一，但另一个重要的因素是基金流动性管理导致的出售。持有非流动性资产的基金对 2020 年 3 月的赎回做出了反应，即使在满足投资者赎回后也增加了现金缓冲。对于此类基金，资产出售超过了投资者赎回。对于在压力期开始时缓冲较大的基金来说，期末现金持有量的增加不太明显，这表明此类基金不太容易在压力最严重时出售。

title: Covid-19 bank dividend payout restrictions: effects and trade-offs
authors: Bryan Hardy
abstract: In the context of the Covid crisis, authorities adopted dividend payout restrictions to enhance bank resilience and support stronger growth in bank lending. Restrictions may reduce short-term equity returns for bank shareholders, especially in the case of banks with a low price-to-book ratio. In line with these predictions, bank equity prices fell with dividend restriction announcements, but credit default swap (CDS) spreads indicated that default risk either fell or was unaffected, even in the face of the economic downturn. Bank capitalisation rose in jurisdictions which restricted payouts, supporting institutional and systemwide stability; the increased capital was more likely to support greater lending with restrictions present.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: Covid-19 银行股息支付限制：影响和权衡
abstract_zh: 在新冠危机的背景下，当局采取了股息支付限制，以增强银行的抵御能力并支持银行贷款的强劲增长。限制可能会降低银行股东的短期股权回报，特别是对于市净率较低的银行。与这些预测一致，银行股价因股息限制公告而下跌，但信用违约掉期（CDS）利差表明，即使面对经济低迷，违约风险也下降或不受影响。在限制支付的司法管辖区，银行资本增加，支持机构和系统范围的稳定性；增加的资本更有可能支持在存在限制的情况下增加贷款。

title: Covid-19 and cyber risk in the financial sector
authors: Iñaki Aldasoro, Jon Frost, Leonardo Gambacorta, David Whyte
abstract: The financial sector has been hit by hackers relatively more often than other sectors during the Covid-19 pandemic. While this has not yet led to significant disruptions or a systemic impact, there are substantial risks from cyber attacks for financial institutions, their staff and their customers going forward. Financial authorities are working to mitigate cyber risks, including through international cooperation.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: Covid-19 和金融领域的网络风险
abstract_zh: 在 Covid-19 大流行期间，金融行业比其他行业更容易受到黑客攻击。虽然这尚未导致重大破坏或系统性影响，但未来金融机构及其员工和客户仍面临着来自网络攻击的巨大风险。金融当局正在努力降低网络风险，包括通过国际合作。

title: E-commerce in the pandemic and beyond
authors: Viviana Alfonso C, Codruta Boar, Jon Frost, Leonardo Gambacorta, Jing Liu
abstract: E-commerce has ramped up during the pandemic around the world. The growth has differed across sectors and over different stages of the pandemic. Novel data sources can help to follow these trends. The growth of e-commerce has been higher in countries where there were more stringent containment measures and where e-commerce was initially less developed. Some changes in consumers' shopping habits and payment behaviour may be longer-lasting. This may have implications for structural change and the growth of the digital economy.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 疫情期间及之后的电子商务
abstract_zh: 疫情期间，全球电子商务蓬勃发展。不同行业和疫情不同阶段的增长情况有所不同。新颖的数据源可以帮助跟踪这些趋势。在遏制措施较为严格且电子商务最初不太发达的国家，电子商务的增长较高。消费者购物习惯和支付行为的一些变化可能会持续更长时间。这可能会对结构变革和数字经济的增长产生影响。

title: The recession-mortality nexus and Covid-19
authors: Sebastian Doerr, Boris Hofmann
abstract: Countries with a stronger predicted GDP decline in 2020 have also seen a larger number of deaths in excess of official Covid-19 fatalities. Historical data show that recessions are systematically associated with higher mortality, especially in developing economies. Following a recession, death rates remain elevated for several years. The eventual death toll of Covid-19 may be understated if the impact of the pandemic-induced recession is neglected. Limiting the economic fallout of the pandemic could also reduce excess mortality.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 经济衰退与死亡率的关系和 Covid-19
abstract_zh: 预测 2020 年 GDP 下降幅度较大的国家的死亡人数也超过了官方公布的 Covid-19 死亡人数。历史数据显示，经济衰退与较高的死亡率系统性相关，尤其是在发展中经济体。经济衰退后，死亡率在数年内持续居高不下。如果忽略大流行引发的经济衰退的影响，Covid-19 的最终死亡人数可能会被低估。限制大流行的经济影响也可以降低过高的死亡率。

title: Central bank swap lines and cross-border bank flows
authors: Iñaki Aldasoro, Christian Cabanilla, Piti Disyatat, Torsten Ehlers, Patrick McGuire, Goetz von Peter
abstract: Central banks drew heavily on US dollar swap lines with the Federal Reserve in the first half of 2020, contributing to a surge in cross-border banking flows during this period. The large increase in cross-border claims on banks operating in the United States – in the form of cross-border interbank and intragroup positions – reflected an increase in dollar liquidity demand from non-US banks partly met through use of the swap lines. In a global financial system heavily reliant on the use of the dollar, the network of central bank swap lines centred on the Fed serves as a critical elastic backstop for the private provision of dollar liquidity.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 央行互换额度和跨境银行流动
abstract_zh: 2020年上半年，各国央行大量使用与美联储的美元互换额度，导致这一时期跨境银行业务流量激增。对在美国运营的银行的跨境债权大幅增加（以跨境银行间和集团内部头寸的形式）反映了非美国银行的美元流动性需求增加，部分通过使用互换额度得到满足。在严重依赖美元使用的全球金融体系中，以美联储为中心的央行互换额度网络成为私人提供美元流动性的关键弹性后盾。

title: What comes next? Recovery from an uneven recession
authors: Daniel Rees
abstract: The effects of the Covid crisis have been felt unevenly across sectors, and the output of customer service industries could remain well below its pre-Covid trend for some time. Economies with large customer service industries could grow more slowly in the near term, even after accounting for the stringency of containment measures and the severity of virus outbreaks. Model projections suggest that large advanced economies could face a "98% economy" until constraints on customer service industries ease. The outlook for some economies, such as China, is more positive. While demand stimulus remains necessary in the near term, it will not be sufficient to return economic activity to its pre-Covid trend. That will require public health measures to control the spread of the virus and steps to ease resource reallocation to industries less affected by the pandemic.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 接下来会发生什么？从不平衡的衰退中复苏
abstract_zh: 新冠危机对各个行业的影响并不均衡，客户服务行业的产出可能在一段时间内仍远低于新冠疫情前的趋势。即使考虑到遏制措施的严格性和病毒爆发的严重性，拥有大型客户服务行业的经济体短期内增长可能会更加缓慢。模型预测表明，在客户服务行业的限制放松之前，大型发达经济体可能面临“98%的经济”。中国等一些经济体的前景更为乐观。尽管短期内仍然有必要刺激需求，但不足以使经济活动恢复到新冠疫情前的趋势。这将需要采取公共卫生措施来控制病毒的传播，并采取措施缓解资源向受疫情影响较小的行业的重新分配。

title: Monetary policy response in emerging market economies: why was it different this time?
authors: Ana Aguilar, Carlos Cantú
abstract: During the Covid-19-induced financial stress in March 2020, central banks in emerging market economies (EMEs) departed from their monetary policy playbook by cutting rates even in the face of sharp currency depreciations and massive capital outflows. Two factors were at play. First, the cyclical position of EMEs gave more room for easing of monetary policy, while structural changes improved the anchoring of inflation expectations and kept a lid on exchange rate pass-through. Second, the swift monetary policy easing by the Federal Reserve and other advanced economy central banks calmed global financial conditions. These policies capped the appreciation pressures on the US dollar, an EME risk factor, and gave EMEs greater room to cut interest rates. Monetary easing and asset purchases helped cushion the impact of portfolio outflows on local currency sovereign bond markets. Synchronised monetary and fiscal policies supported one another.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 新兴市场经济体的货币政策反应：为何这次不同？
abstract_zh: 2020 年 3 月，在新冠肺炎 (Covid-19) 引发的金融压力期间，新兴市场经济体 (EME) 的央行背离了其货币政策方针，即使在货币大幅贬值和大规模资本外流的情况下也降息。有两个因素在起作用。首先，新兴市场经济体的周期性状况为货币政策宽松提供了更大的空间，而结构性变化则改善了通胀预期的锚定性并抑制了汇率传导。其次，美联储和其他发达经济体央行迅速放松货币政策，稳定了全球金融状况。这些政策限制了新兴市场经济体风险因素美元的升值压力，并为新兴市场经济体提供了更大的降息空间。货币宽松和资产购买有助于缓解投资组合外流对本币主权债券市场的影响。货币政策和财政政策同步，相互支持。

title: Bankruptcies, unemployment and reallocation from Covid-19
authors: Ryan Niladri Banerjee, Enisse Kharroubi, Ulf Lewrick
abstract: The expected wave of business failures in the Covid-19 recession has yet to materialise, due in part to policy support, but also reflecting the inherent lag between declines in GDP and insolvencies. Bankruptcies weigh heavily on labour markets. Unemployment typically increases three times more if a fall in GDP is accompanied by a similar-sized increase in bankruptcies. Concentration of bankruptcies in those sectors hit especially hard by Covid-19 could exert a significant drag on the labour market. The natural renewal process where young, dynamic firms displace those who exited takes two to three years, leaving a protracted period of lacklustre activity. This underscores the need to reallocate resources quickly and efficiently to drive growth in the post-pandemic world.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: Covid-19 带来的破产、失业和重新分配
abstract_zh: Covid-19经济衰退中预期的企业倒闭潮尚未成为现实，部分原因是政策支持，但也反映出GDP下降和破产之间的内在滞后性。破产给劳动力市场带来沉重压力。如果国内生产总值下降伴随着类似规模的破产增加，那么失业率通常会增加三倍。破产集中在那些受 Covid-19 打击特别严重的行业可能会对劳动力市场造成重大拖累。年轻、充满活力的公司取代那些退出的公司的自然更新过程需要两到三年的时间，从而留下一段长期的低迷时期。这凸显出需要快速有效地重新分配资源，以推动大流行后世界的增长。

title: The outlook for business bankruptcies
authors: Ryan Niladri Banerjee, Giulio Cornelli, Egon Zakrajšek
abstract: Economic growth and forward-looking indicators of default risk inferred from equity markets, two variables that together predict business bankruptcies in advanced economies, show bankruptcies rising significantly by the end of 2021. Projections of real GDP growth embedded in the consensus forecast account for the bulk of this projected increase. Unlike in previous downturns, the stock market-based default indicators contribute very little. As these findings underscore, the pandemic and unprecedented government support for the business sector have driven a sizeable wedge between financial market perceptions of default risk and projections for economic activity.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 企业破产的前景
abstract_zh: 经济增长和从股票市场推断的前瞻性违约风险指标这两个变量共同预测发达经济体的企业破产情况，表明到 2021 年底破产数量将大幅增加。共识预测中包含的实际 GDP 增长预测占了这一预计增长的大部分。与之前的低迷时期不同，基于股市的违约指标的贡献很小。正如这些调查结果所强调的那样，疫情和政府对商业部门前所未有的支持导致金融市场对违约风险的看法与对经济活动的预测之间产生了巨大的分歧。

title: Bonds and syndicated loans during the Covid-19 crisis: decoupled again?
authors: Tirupam Goel, José María Serena Garralda
abstract: Borrowing by non-financial firms in global debt markets surged following the Covid-19 shock. Bond issuance boomed, while syndicated loan originations trailed. Led by easier access to bond markets, large firms significantly increased their borrowing. The rest of the firms faced bottlenecks due to their reliance on a strained syndicated loan market and hurdles in switching to bond markets. Large firms, which had lower cash buffers pre-crisis than smaller firms, used part of the fresh credit to raise their buffers in addition to meeting liquidity shortfalls.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: Covid-19 危机期间的债券和银团贷款：再次脱钩？
abstract_zh: Covid-19 冲击后，全球债务市场上的非金融企业借款激增。债券发行蓬勃发展，而银团贷款发放却落后。在更容易进入债券市场的带动下，大公司大幅增加了借贷。其余公司由于依赖紧张的银团贷款市场以及转向债券市场的障碍而面临瓶颈。危机前现金缓冲水平低于小公司的大公司除了应对流动性短缺之外，还利用部分新信贷来提高缓冲水平。

title: Inflation at risk from Covid-19
authors: Ryan Niladri Banerjee, Aaron Mehrotra, Fabrizio Zampolli
abstract: The pandemic has increased downside tail risks in advanced economies (AEs), while it has increased both downside and upside tail risks in emerging market economies (EMEs). The collapse in output and oil prices, on balance, increases downside inflation risks. Recent exchange rate depreciations increase upside risks to inflation in EMEs. Tighter financial conditions raise both downside and upside risks. In AEs, the increase in downside risks is more prominent.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: Covid-19 带来的通货膨胀风险
abstract_zh: 疫情增加了发达经济体（AE）的下行尾部风险，同时增加了新兴市场经济体（EME）的下行和上行尾部风险。总而言之，产出和油价暴跌会增加下行通胀风险。最近的汇率贬值增加了新兴市场国家通胀的上行风险。金融状况趋紧会增加下行和上行风险。在不良事件中，下行风险的增加更为突出。

title: Global banks' dollar funding needs and central bank swap lines
authors: Iñaki Aldasoro, Torsten Ehlers, Patrick McGuire, Goetz von Peter
abstract: At $13 trillion, the gross dollar liabilities of banks headquartered outside the United States at end-2019 were nearly as high as before the Great Financial Crisis. Most of their dollar funding was booked outside the United States. We measure non-US banks' short-term dollar funding needs by comparing short-term dollar liabilities (including off-balance sheet FX swaps) with holdings of liquid dollar assets. The scale of the central bank swap lines are of similar magnitude to banks' short-term dollar funding needs. Swap line usage peaked in May at $449 billion and has subsided since. However, dollar funding needs of corporates may yet reveal a broader need for dollars outside the banking system.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 全球银行的美元融资需求和央行互换额度
abstract_zh: 截至 2019 年底，总部位于美国境外的银行的美元负债总额为 13 万亿美元，几乎与金融危机前一样高。他们的大部分美元资金都是在美国境外登记的。我们通过比较短期美元负债（包括表外外汇掉期）与持有的流动美元资产来衡量非美国银行的短期美元融资需求。央行互换额度的规模与银行短期美元融资需求的规模相似。互换额度使用量在 5 月份达到 4,490 亿美元的峰值，此后有所下降。然而，企业的美元融资需求可能仍揭示出银行体系之外对美元的更广泛需求。

title: Corporate credit markets after the initial pandemic shock
authors: Sirio Aramonte, Fernando Avalos
abstract: Corporate funding markets partially resumed after seizing up in mid-March 2020 - but at much higher spreads and with sharper sectoral differentiation. In March, wide spreads for highly rated energy firms pointed to significant downgrade risk. Post-GFC leverage build-up amplified the damaging effects of financial stress during the pandemic. The unusually broad impact of the pandemic shock on lower-rated firms threatens CLO structures, though not as much as the bursting of the housing bubble undermined CDOs.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 最初的大流行冲击后的企业信贷市场
abstract_zh: 企业融资市场在 2020 年 3 月中旬陷入困境后部分恢复，但利差更高，行业分化也更明显。 3月份，高评级能源公司的广泛利差表明评级存在重大下调风险。全球金融危机后杠杆率的上升放大了大流行期间金融压力的破坏性影响。疫情冲击对评级较低的公司产生了异常广泛的影响，对抵押贷款债券结构构成了威胁，但影响程度不及房地产泡沫破裂对抵押贷款债券的破坏程度。

title: Investors' risk attitudes in the pandemic and the stock market: new evidence based on internet searches
authors: Marlene Amstad, Giulio Cornelli, Leonardo Gambacorta, Dora Xia
abstract: The sharp drop and subsequent rebound in global stock markets in the current pandemic focuses attention on changes in investors' risk attitudes. A new Covid-19 risk attitude (CRA) index for 61 markets, based on internet searches in Google and Baidu, does a good job at capturing investors' attitudes toward pandemic-related risks. Stock markets are more sensitive to changes in the CRA index in more financially developed economies. Stock markets are less sensitive in jurisdictions that have restricted mobility less and that have enacted other containment measures against the pandemic.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 投资者对疫情和股市的风险态度：基于互联网搜索的新证据
abstract_zh: 此次疫情下全球股市的大幅下跌和随后的反弹，让人们关注投资者风险态度的变化。基于谷歌和百度的互联网搜索，针对 61 个市场的新 Covid-19 风险态度 (CRA) 指数很好地捕捉了投资者对大流行相关风险的态度。在金融较发达的经济体中，股票市场对 CRA 指数的变化更为敏感。在流动性限制较少且针对疫情采取其他遏制措施的司法管辖区，股市不太敏感。

title: Trade credit, trade finance, and the Covid-19 Crisis
authors: Frederic Boissay, Nikhil Patel, Hyun Song Shin
abstract: As the Covid-19 pandemic hits economic activity, the vulnerabilities of longer and more geographically extended trade credit chains are coming to the fore, especially those related to international trade. While risk mitigation is available from financial intermediaries, the bulk of the exposures associated with supply chains is borne by the participating firms themselves, through inter-firm credit. Given the prevalence of the US dollar in trade financing, measures such as central bank swap lines that ease global dollar credit conditions may cushion the impact of the pandemic on global value chains.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 贸易信贷、贸易融资和 Covid-19 危机
abstract_zh: 随着Covid-19大流行对经济活动造成冲击，更长、地域更广的贸易信用链的脆弱性日益凸显，特别是与国际贸易相关的信用链。虽然金融中介机构可以缓解风险，但与供应链相关的大部分风险是由参与公司本身通过公司间信贷承担的。鉴于美元在贸易融资中的普遍存在，央行互换额度等缓解全球美元信贷状况的措施可能会缓解疫情对全球价值链的影响。

title: The fiscal response to the Covid-19 crisis in advanced and emerging market economies
authors: Enrique Alberola-Ila, Yavuz Arslan, Gong Cheng, Richhild Moessner
abstract: The fiscal policy response to the Covid-19 crisis has been swift and strong, in tandem with monetary policy. Advanced economies (AEs) have deployed a much larger fiscal response than emerging market economies (EMEs). The lower incidence of the pandemic in EMEs does not fully explain the difference. A narrower fiscal policy space in EMEs, further reduced by the tightening of their financing conditions induced by the pandemic shock, has constrained their fiscal response. The size and composition of the fiscal response also depend on other factors such as the level of income and the strength of the social safety nets and automatic stabilisers.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 发达和新兴市场经济体对 Covid-19 危机的财政应对措施
abstract_zh: 针对 Covid-19 危机的财政政策与货币政策同步迅速而有力。发达经济体（AE）比新兴市场经济体（EME）采取了更大的财政应对措施。新兴市场国家的疫情发生率较低并不能完全解释这种差异。新兴市场国家的财政政策空间收窄，再加上疫情冲击导致融资条件收紧，进一步缩小了这些空间，限制了它们的财政应对措施。财政应对措施的规模和构成还取决于其他因素，例如收入水平以及社会安全网和自动稳定器的强度。

title: How are household finances holding up against the Covid-19 shock?
authors: Anna Zabai
abstract: As incomes shrink because of the Covid-19 shock, households must balance repaying debt with keeping up reasonable levels of consumption. In several countries, low- and middle-wealth households have insufficient liquid buffers to weather a long spell of unemployment without falling behind on debt repayments. The resilience of middle-wealth households is especially important: they hold relatively more (mortgage) debt and are more vulnerable in the countries that are more heavily exposed to the economic shock.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 家庭财务状况如何抵御 Covid-19 冲击？
abstract_zh: 由于 Covid-19 冲击导致收入缩水，家庭必须在偿还债务与保持合理消费水平之间取得平衡。在一些国家，中低财富家庭没有足够的流动性缓冲来承受长期失业而不拖欠债务偿还。中等富裕家庭的复原力尤其重要：他们持有相对较多的（抵押）债务，并且在受经济冲击更严重的国家更容易受到伤害。

title: Central banks' response to Covid-19 in advanced economies
authors: Paolo Cavallino, Fiorella De Fiore
abstract: Central banks in advanced economies reacted swiftly and forcefully to the Covid-19 pandemic, deploying the full range of crisis tools within weeks. The initial response focused primarily on easing financial stress and ensuring a smooth flow of credit to the private non-financial sector.The pandemic triggered complementary responses from monetary and fiscal authorities. Fiscal backstops and loan guarantees supported central bank actions. Asset purchases, designed to achieve central banks' objectives, helped contain the costs of fiscal expansions. The footprint of central banks' measures will be sizeable. Across the five largest advanced economies, balance sheets are projected to grow on average by 15-23% of GDP before end-2020 and to remain large in the near future.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 发达经济体央行对 Covid-19 的反应
abstract_zh: 发达经济体的央行对 Covid-19 大流行做出了迅速而有力的反应，在几周内部署了全套危机工具。最初的应对措施主要侧重于缓解金融压力并确保信贷顺利流向私人非金融部门。疫情引发了货币和财政当局的补充应对措施。财政支持和贷款担保支持了央行的行动。旨在实现央行目标的资产购买有助于控制财政扩张的成本。央行措施的影响将是相当大的。预计到 2020 年底前，五个最大发达经济体的资产负债表将平均增长 GDP 的 15-23%，并在不久的将来保持庞大规模。

title: Central bank bond purchases in emerging market economies
authors: Yavuz Arslan, Mathias Drehmann, Boris Hofmann
abstract: In response to the Covid-19 shock, many central banks in emerging market economies have launched local currency bond purchase programmes to address bond market dislocations, signalling that they were willing to take the role of a buyer of last resort. Local currency bond yields fell significantly following the programme announcements, with little effect on exchange rates. These positive initial market reactions suggest that the programmes were successful in restoring investor confidence and did not lead to higher inflation expectations, eg due to perceived risks of fiscal dominance. Market reactions varied between countries, depending on initial conditions in each jurisdiction as well as on the scope, scale and communication of the bond purchase programmes.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 新兴市场经济体央行购买债券
abstract_zh: 为了应对Covid-19冲击，许多新兴市场经济体央行推出了本币债券购买计划，以解决债券市场混乱的问题，这表明它们愿意扮演最后买家的角色。计划公布后，本币债券收益率大幅下跌，但对汇率影响不大。这些积极的初步市场反应表明，这些计划成功地恢复了投资者的信心，并且没有导致更高的通胀预期，例如由于财政主导地位的感知风险。各国市场反应各不相同，具体取决于每个司法管辖区的初始条件以及债券购买计划的范围、规模和沟通。

title: Dealing with Covid-19: understanding the policy choices
authors: Frederic Boissay, Daniel Rees, Phurichai Rungcharoenkitkul
abstract: Containment policies save lives but restrict economic activity. Standard approaches to accounting for the value of human lives lend support to these policies despite their high short-term economic costs. Integrated epidemic-macroeconomic models provide a coherent framework for quantifying the costs and benefits of containment policies. Part of the benefit comes from limiting externalities that would otherwise arise if social distancing were purely voluntary. Standard epidemiological and economic parameters suggest that several months of strict containment policies that lead to as much as a 30% decline in GDP for the period of the lockdown could be preferable to alternatives with more casualties and a less severe recession.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 应对 Covid-19：了解政策选择
abstract_zh: 遏制政策拯救生命，但限制经济活动。尽管短期经济成本高昂，但计算人类生命价值的标准方法仍为这些政策提供了支持。综合流行病-宏观经济模型为量化遏制政策的成本和收益提供了一个连贯的框架。部分好处来自于限制外部性，如果社交距离纯粹是自愿的话，就会出现这种外部性。标准的流行病学和经济参数表明，几个月的严格遏制政策可能会导致封锁期间GDP下降30%，这可能比造成更多人员伤亡和不太严重的衰退的替代方案更可取。

title: EME bond portfolio flows and long-term interest rates during the Covid-19 pandemic
authors: Peter Hördahl, Ilhyock Shim
abstract: Bond portfolio outflows from emerging market economies (EMEs) are typically associated with currency depreciation and rising domestic long-term interest rates. This relationship asserted itself in a particularly stark way during the Covid-19 crisis in mid-March 2020. The relationship between bond portfolio outflows and long-term rates varies across EMEs, depending on factors such as bond market depth, FX market functioning and sovereign risk. The impact of these factors on the relationship has been thrown into sharper relief during the Covid-19 pandemic. Recent policy responses, such as bond purchase programmes, duration swaps and efforts to stabilise exchange rates, can play an important role in maintaining financial stability in EMEs when they face bond outflows. Policy measures to develop deep and liquid bond markets and strengthen the resilience of local currency bond and FX markets are likely to enhance market functioning in the longer term.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: Covid-19 大流行期间新兴市场债券投资组合流动和长期利率
abstract_zh: 新兴市场经济体（EME）的债券投资组合流出通常与货币贬值和国内长期利率上升有关。这种关系在 2020 年 3 月中旬的 Covid-19 危机期间表现得尤为明显。债券投资组合流出与长期利率之间的关系因新兴市场经济体而异，具体取决于债券市场深度、外汇市场运作和主权风险等因素。在 Covid-19 大流行期间，这些因素对两国关系的影响更加明显。近期的政策应对措施，例如债券购买计划、久期互换和稳定汇率的努力，可以在新兴市场经济体面临债券流出时维持其金融稳定发挥重要作用。发展深度和流动性债券市场以及增强本币债券和外汇市场弹性的政策措施可能会增强市场的长期运作。

title: On health and privacy: technology to combat the pandemic
authors: Carlos Cantú, Gong Cheng, Sebastian Doerr, Jon Frost, Leonardo Gambacorta
abstract: Technology has been harnessed in the fight against the Covid-19 pandemic, eg to administer remote medical consultations, analyse aggregate movements and track paths of contact. Successful applications are predicated on broad public support. They must address concerns about data privacy, and the potential for misuse of data by governments and companies. Transparent public policies and clear governance frameworks can help to build trust. One possible approach is to differentiate data use during a pandemic and in normal times.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 关于健康和隐私：抗击疫情的技术
abstract_zh: 技术已被用于抗击 Covid-19 大流行，例如管理远程医疗咨询、分析总体活动和跟踪接触路径。成功的申请取决于公众的广泛支持。他们必须解决对数据隐私以及政府和公司滥用数据的可能性的担忧。透明的公共政策和明确的治理框架有助于建立信任。一种可能的方法是区分大流行期间和正常时期的数据使用。

title: Covid-19 and regional employment in Europe
authors: Sebastian Doerr, Leonardo Gambacorta
abstract: We construct employment risk indices for European regions that reflect the share of jobs under threat from Covid-19. The risk index is based on local employment in sectors that are more exposed to the pandemic and on the regional incidence of small firms. Employment in regions in southern Europe and France is shown to have high risk indices, while regions in northern Europe have lower risk indices. Eastern and central European regions have intermediate risk indices. Regions with a higher risk index have a bigger jump in Google searches for unemployment-related terms.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: Covid-19 和欧洲区域就业
abstract_zh: 我们为欧洲地区构建了就业风险指数，反映了受到 Covid-19 威胁的就业岗位比例。该风险指数基于更容易受到疫情影响的行业的当地就业情况以及小企业的区域发生率。南欧和法国地区的就业风险指数较高，而北欧地区的就业风险指数较低。东欧和中欧地区的风险指数处于中等水平。风险指数较高的地区，谷歌搜索与失业相关术语的搜索量增幅较大。

title: US dollar funding markets during the Covid-19 crisis - the international dimension
authors: Egemen Eren, Andreas Schrimpf, Vladyslav Sushko
abstract: Dislocations in domestic US dollar money markets reverberated globally. Non-US banks lost a substantial part of funding from money market funds and had to borrow at shorter maturities. Nevertheless, the severity of dollar funding strains varied substantially across banks, and eased for banks from jurisdictions with standing swap lines with the Federal Reserve. The impact of policy measures to quell the stress was felt unevenly across different funding markets. The divergence between key rates resulted in an unusual divergence of funding cost metrics, with some indicating a "dollar glut" while others a "dollar shortage".
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: Covid-19 危机期间的美元融资市场 - 国际层面
abstract_zh: 国内美元货币市场的混乱在全球范围内产生了影响。非美国银行失去了货币市场基金的很大一部分资金，不得不借入期限较短的资金。尽管如此，各银行美元融资压力的严重程度差异很大，对于与美联储有长期互换额度的司法管辖区的银行来说，美元融资压力的严重程度有所缓解。不同融资市场对缓解压力的政策措施的影响并不均衡。关键利率之间的差异导致融资成本指标出现异常差异，一些指标表明“美元过剩”，而另一些则表明“美元短缺”。

title: US dollar funding markets during the Covid-19 crisis - the money market fund turmoil
authors: Egemen Eren, Andreas Schrimpf, Vladyslav Sushko
abstract: Short-term dollar funding markets experienced severe dislocations in mid-March 2020, with funding diverted from unsecured funding markets as investors withdrew and switched to secured funding markets and government MMFs. Outflows from US prime MMFs led to a loss of funding for banks and a significant shortening of funding maturities; this precipitated spikes in indicators of bank funding costs, such as the LIBOR-OIS spread, despite banks not being at the epicentre of the liquidity squeeze. The turmoil highlights broader lessons for MMF regulation, the role of non-banks for monetary policy implementation, and the role of the central bank during stress.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: Covid-19危机期间的美元融资市场——货币市场基金动荡
abstract_zh: 2020 年 3 月中旬，短期美元融资市场经历了严重混乱，随着投资者撤出并转向有担保融资市场和政府货币市场基金，资金从无担保融资市场转移。美国主要货币市场基金的资金流出导致银行资金损失和资金期限大幅缩短；尽管银行并未处于流动性紧缩的中心，但这仍导致银行融资成本指标（例如 LIBOR-OIS 利差）飙升。这场动荡凸显了货币市场基金监管、非银行机构在货币政策实施中的作用以及央行在压力期间的作用等更广泛的教训。

title: The CCP-bank nexus in the time of Covid-19
authors: Wenqian Huang, Előd Takáts
abstract: During the Covid-19-induced financial turbulence, central counterparties (CCPs) issued large margin calls, weighing on the liquidity of clearing member banks. In spite of the turbulence, CCPs remained resilient, as intended by the post-crisis reforms of financial market infrastructures. Higher margins should be expected during heightened turbulence, but the extent of the procyclicality of margining is the consequence of various design choices. Systemic considerations call to examine the nexus between banks and CCPs. Therefore, when thinking about margining, central banks need to assess banks and CCPs jointly rather than in isolation.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: Covid-19 时期中共与银行的关系
abstract_zh: 在 Covid-19 引发的金融动荡期间，中央对手方 (CCP) 发出了大量追加保证金通知，给清算成员银行的流动性带来压力。尽管经历了动荡，中共仍然保持着韧性，正如危机后金融市场基础设施改革所希望的那样。在动荡加剧期间，应该预期会有更高的裕度，但裕度的顺周期性程度是各种设计选择的结果。系统性考虑要求审视银行和中央对手方之间的关系。因此，在考虑保证金时，央行需要共同评估银行和中央对手方，而不是孤立地评估。

title: Effects of Covid-19 on the banking sector: the market's assessment
authors: Iñaki Aldasoro, Ingo Fender, Bryan Hardy, Nikola Tarashev
abstract: Banks' performance on equity and debt markets since the Covid-19 outbreak has been on a par with that experienced after the collapse of Lehman Brothers in 2008. During the initial phase, the market sell-off swept over all banks, which underperformed significantly relative to other sectors. Still, markets showed some differentiation by bank nationality, and credit default swap (CDS) spreads rose the most for those banks that had entered the crisis with the highest level of credit risk. The subsequent stabilisation, brought about by forceful policy measures since mid-March, has favoured banks with higher profitability and healthier balance sheets. Less profitable banks saw their long-term rating outlooks revised to negative. And the CDS spreads of the riskiest banks continued increasing even through the stabilisation phase.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: Covid-19 对银行业的影响：市场评估
abstract_zh: 自Covid-19爆发以来，银行在股票和债务市场上的表现与2008年雷曼兄弟倒闭后的表现相当。在最初阶段，市场抛售席卷了所有银行，与其他行业相比，银行的表现明显不佳。尽管如此，市场仍因银行国籍而出现一些差异，对于那些进入危机时信用风险最高的银行来说，信用违约掉期（CDS）利差涨幅最大。自3月中旬以来，强有力的政策措施带来了随后的稳定，有利于盈利能力更高、资产负债表更健康的银行。盈利较低的银行的长期评级展望被修正为负面。即使在稳定阶段，风险最高银行的 CDS 利差仍在继续增加。

title: Releasing bank buffers to cushion the crisis - a quantitative assessment
authors: Ulf Lewrick, Christian Schmieder, Jhuvesh Sobrun, Elod Takats
abstract: Banks globally entered the Covid-19 crisis with roughly US$ 5 trillion of capital above their Pillar 1 regulatory requirements. The amount of additional lending will depend on how hard banks' capital is hit by the crisis, on their willingness to use the buffers and on other policy support. In an adverse stress scenario such as the savings and loan crisis, banks' usable buffers would decline to US$ 800 billion, which could support US$ 5 trillion of additional loans (6% of total loans outstanding). Yet in a severely adverse scenario, similar to the Great Financial Crisis, the corresponding figures would be only US$ 270 billion and US$ 1 trillion (1.3% of total loans).
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 释放银行缓冲以缓解危机——定量评估
abstract_zh: 全球银行进入 Covid-19 危机时，其第一支柱监管要求之上的资本大约有 5 万亿美元。额外贷款的数额将取决于银行资本受危机打击的严重程度、银行使用缓冲的意愿以及其他政策支持。在储蓄和贷款危机等不利压力情况下，银行的可用缓冲将下降至8000亿美元，这可以支持5万亿美元的额外贷款（占未偿还贷款总额的6%）。然而，在严重不利的情况下，类似于金融危机，相应的数字将仅为2700亿美元和1万亿美元（占贷款总额的1.3%）。

title: Covid-19 and corporate sector liquidity
authors: Ryan Banerjee, Anamaria Illes, Enisse Kharroubi, José María Serena Garralda
abstract: The Covid-19 shock is placing enormous strains on corporates cash buffers. Corporate financial statements from 2019 suggest that, 50% of firms do not have sufficient cash to cover total debt servicing costs over the coming year. Credit lines could provide firms with additional liquidity. On average undrawn credit stood around 120% of debt servicing costs at end 2019. However, access is uneven and banks may be reluctant to renew or extend them in the current environment. Sticky operating expenses result in many firms running operating losses, placing an additional burden on cash buffers. Estimates indicate that following a 10% drop in revenues, operating expenses only fall by 6% on average. Simulations suggest that if revenues fall by 25% in 2020, then closing the entire funding gap with debt would raise firm leverage by around 10 percentage points.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: Covid-19 和企业部门流动性
abstract_zh: Covid-19 冲击给企业现金缓冲带来了巨大压力。 2019 年的企业财务报表显示，50% 的企业没有足够的现金来支付来年的总偿债成本。信贷额度可以为企业提供额外的流动性。截至 2019 年底，未提取信贷平均占偿债成本的 120% 左右。然而，获取信贷的机会并不均衡，在当前环境下，银行可能不愿续签或延长信贷期限。粘性运营支出导致许多公司出现运营亏损，给现金缓冲带来额外负担。据估计，收入下降 10% 后，运营支出平均仅下降 6%。模拟表明，如果 2020 年收入下降 25%，那么用债务弥补整个资金缺口将使公司杠杆率提高约 10 个百分点。

title: Buffering Covid-19 losses - the role of prudential policy
authors: Mathias Drehmann, Marc Farag, Nicola Tarashev, Kostas Tsatsaronis
abstract: By allowing banks to run down some of their buffers, policymakers are sending a strong signal about their resolve to lessen the economic fallout from the pandemic. Such prudential measures complement the main policy levers: monetary and fiscal instruments. To avoid a reduction in credit to the real economy, authorities need to ensure that banks have the capacity and willingness to make use of the flexibility afforded by the buffer release. Payout restrictions on banks and risk-sharing between banks and the public sector will be key. r banks to continue playing a positive role in the supply of funding during the recovery, they should maintain usable buffers for a long period, as losses from a severe recession will take time to materialise.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 缓冲 Covid-19 损失——审慎政策的作用
abstract_zh: 通过允许银行削减部分缓冲，政策制定者发出了强烈信号，表明他们决心减轻疫情对经济的影响。此类审慎措施是对主要政策杠杆的补充：货币和财政工具。为了避免实体经济信贷减少，当局需要确保银行有能力和意愿利用缓冲释放带来的灵活性。对银行的支付限制以及银行与公共部门之间的风险分担将是关键。银行若要在复苏期间继续在资金供应方面发挥积极作用，就应该长期保持可用的缓冲，因为严重衰退造成的损失需要一段时间才能显现出来。

title: Identifying regions at risk with Google Trends: the impact of Covid-19 on US labour markets
authors: Sebastian Doerr, Leonardo Gambacorta
abstract: Information on local labour markets and Google searches can be used to construct a measure of the vulnerability of employment in different regions of the United States to the Covid-19 shock. Regional exposure to Covid-19 varies significantly, ranging from a low of 2% to a high of 98% of total local employment. We test for the usefulness of the Covid-19 exposure measure by showing that areas with higher exposure report more Google search queries related to the pandemic and unemployment benefits.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 通过 Google 趋势识别面临风险的地区：Covid-19 对美国劳动力市场的影响
abstract_zh: 有关当地劳动力市场和谷歌搜索的信息可用于衡量美国不同地区就业对 Covid-19 冲击的脆弱性。受 Covid-19 影响的地区差异很大，从低至占当地总就业人数的 2% 到高至 98%。我们测试了 Covid-19 暴露指标的实用性，方法是显示暴露程度较高的地区会报告更多与大流行和失业救济相关的 Google 搜索查询。

title: Macroeconomic effects of Covid-19: an early review
authors: Frederic Boissay, Phurichai Rungcharoenkitkul
abstract: Past epidemics had long-lasting effects on economies through illness and the loss of lives, while Covid-19 is marked by widespread containment measures and relatively lower fatalities among young people. The short-term costs of Covid-19 will probably dwarf those of past epidemics, due to the unprecedented and synchronised global sudden stop in economic activity induced by containment measures. The current estimated impact on global GDP growth for 2020 is around -4%, with substantial downside risks if containment policies are prolonged. Output losses are larger for major economies.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: Covid-19 的宏观经济影响：早期回顾
abstract_zh: 过去的流行病通过疾病和死亡对经济产生了长期影响，而 Covid-19 的特点是广泛的遏制措施和相对较低的年轻人死亡率。由于遏制措施导致全球经济活动史无前例、同步突然停止，Covid-19 的短期成本可能会令过去的流行病相形见绌。目前预计对2020年全球GDP增长的影响约为-4%，如果遏制政策延长，则存在巨大的下行风险。主要经济体的产出损失更大。

title: The recent distress in corporate bond markets: cues from ETFs
authors: Sirio Aramonte, Fernando Avalos
abstract: Amid widespread sell-offs in risky asset classes, corporate bond exchange-traded funds (ETFs) traded at steep discounts to underlying asset values in March. Contributing factors were high market volatility, reduced risk-taking by dealers and investors' reaction to policy decisions. Policy interventions that improve market functioning in a given sector can have temporary yet important spillovers to other segments through portfolio rebalancing by investors.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 公司债券市场近期的困境：来自 ETF 的线索
abstract_zh: 在风险资产类别普遍遭到抛售的情况下，公司债券交易所交易基金 (ETF) 3 月份的交易价格较基础资产价值大幅折扣。造成这种情况的因素包括市场波动性大、交易商承担风险的减少以及投资者对政策决定的反应。改善特定部门市场运作的政策干预可以通过投资者的投资组合再平衡对其他部门产生暂时但重要的溢出效应。

title: Emerging market economy exchange rates and local currency bond markets amid the Covid-19 pandemic
authors: Boris Hofmann, Ilhyock Shim, Hyun Song Shin
abstract: Borrowing through domestic currency bonds has not insulated emerging market economies (EMEs) from the financial shock unleashed by Covid-19; EME local currency bond spreads spiked amid sharp currency depreciations and capital outflows. Portfolio investors face amplified losses as local currency spreads and exchange rates move in lockstep; their revised portfolio allocations in turn strengthen this correlation. EMEs with monetary policy frameworks that are equipped to address the feedback loop between exchange rate depreciation and capital outflows stand a better chance of weathering the financial fallout from the Covid-19 pandemic. To counter large stock adjustments in domestic bond markets, EME central banks may need to expand their toolkit to take on a "dealer of last resort" role; a number of them are already moving in this direction.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: Covid-19 大流行期间的新兴市场经济汇率和本币债券市场
abstract_zh: 通过本币债券借款并没有使新兴市场经济体（EME）免受Covid-19引发的金融冲击；由于货币大幅贬值和资本外流，新兴市场本币债券利差飙升。由于当地货币利差和汇率同步变动，投资组合投资者面临更大的损失；他们修改后的投资组合配置反过来又加强了这种相关性。拥有能够解决汇率贬值和资本外流之间反馈循环问题的货币政策框架的新兴市场经济体更有可能经受住 Covid-19 大流行带来的金融影响。为了应对国内债券市场的大幅存量调整，新兴市场央行可能需要扩大其工具箱，以扮演“最后交易商”的角色；其中一些已经在朝这个方向迈进。

title: The macroeconomic spillover effects of the pandemic on the global economy
authors: Emanuel Kohlscheen, Benoit Mojon, Daniel Rees
abstract: Given the historical persistence of economic activity, the reduction of GDP due to confinement measures is likely to drag on over several quarters. The total GDP shortfall could be as much as twice that implied by the direct initial effects of confinement. This persistence reflects in part two types of spillovers across countries. One is due to the risk that uncoordinated confinements lead to repeated virus outbreaks and confinements across the globe. Another is the more traditional trade and financial integration interlinkages. Economic spillovers and spillbacks across the major economic blocs are large. There is no immunity from the economic effects if the epidemic is controlled in only one or two regions. Countries should adopt confinement, border control and macroeconomic policies that internalise these global considerations.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 疫情对全球经济的宏观溢出效应
abstract_zh: 鉴于经济活动的历史持续性，限制措施导致的 GDP 下降可能会持续几个季度。 GDP 总缺口可能是封锁最初直接影响所暗示的两倍。这种持续性在一定程度上反映了各国之间的两种溢出效应。一是由于不协调的封锁可能导致全球范围内病毒反复爆发和封锁的风险。另一个是更传统的贸易和金融一体化相互联系。主要经济体的经济溢出效应和溢出效应都很大。如果疫情仅在一两个地区得到控制，经济就无法免受影响。各国应采取将这些全球考虑因素内在化的限制、边境管制和宏观经济政策。

title: Covid-19, cash, and the future of payments
authors: Raphael Auer, Giulio Cornelli, Jon Frost
abstract: The Covid-19 pandemic has fanned public concerns that the coronavirus could be transmitted by cash. Scientific evidence suggests that the probability of transmission via banknotes is low when compared with other frequently-touched objects, such as credit card terminals or PIN pads. To bolster trust in cash, central banks are actively communicating, urging continued acceptance of cash and, in some instances, sterilising or quarantining banknotes. Some encourage contactless payments. Looking ahead, developments could speed up the shift toward digital payments. This could open a divide in access to payments instruments, which could negatively impact unbanked and older consumers. The pandemic may amplify calls to defend the role of cash - but also calls for central bank digital currencies.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: Covid-19、现金和支付的未来
abstract_zh: Covid-19 大流行加剧了公众对冠状病毒可能通过现金传播的担忧。科学证据表明，与信用卡终端或密码键盘等其他经常触摸的物体相比，通过纸币传播的可能性较低。为了增强对现金的信任，各国央行正在积极沟通，敦促继续接受现金，并在某些情况下对纸币进行消毒或隔离。有些鼓励非接触式支付。展望未来，发展可能会加速向数字支付的转变。这可能会在使用支付工具方面造成鸿沟，从而可能对无银行账户和老年消费者产生负面影响。这场大流行可能会加剧捍卫现金作用的呼声，但也有人呼吁央行使用数字货币。

title: Leverage and margin spirals in fixed income markets during the Covid-19 crisis
authors: Andreas Schrimpf, Hyun Song Shin, Vladyslav Sushko
abstract: For a two-week period in mid-March 2020, government bond markets experienced uncharacteristic turbulence, sometimes selling off sharply in risk-off episodes when they would normally attract safe haven flows. Evidence in the US Treasury market points to forced selling of treasury securities by investors who had attempted to exploit small yield differences through the use of leverage. Even though government bonds are safe assets, large holdings by leveraged investors may detract from orderly market functioning and may necessitate interventions by the central bank.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: Covid-19 危机期间固定收益市场的杠杆率和利润率呈螺旋式上升
abstract_zh: 2020 年 3 月中旬的两周内，政府债券市场经历了不寻常的动荡，有时在避险时期会大幅抛售，而通常会吸引避险资金流。美国国债市场的证据表明，试图通过使用杠杆来利用微小的收益率差异的投资者强制出售国债。尽管政府债券是安全资产，但杠杆投资者大量持有政府债券可能会损害有序的市场运作，并可能需要央行进行干预。

title: Dollar funding costs during the Covid-19 crisis through the lens of the FX swap market
authors: Stefan Avdjiev, Egemen Eren, Patrick McGuire
abstract: Since the start of the Covid-19 pandemic, indicators of dollar funding costs in foreign exchange markets have risen sharply, reflecting both demand and supply factors. The demand for dollar funding has grown in recent years, reflecting the currency hedging needs of corporates and portfolio investors outside the United States. Against this backdrop, the financial turbulence of recent weeks has crimped the supply of dollar funding from financial intermediaries, sharply lifting indicators of dollar funding costs. These costs have narrowed after central banks deployed dollar swap lines, but broader policy challenges remain in ensuring that dollar funding markets remain resilient and that central bank liquidity is channelled beyond the banking system.
source: BIS bulletin
title_zh: 从外汇掉期市场的角度看Covid-19危机期间的美元融资成本
abstract_zh: 自Covid-19大流行开始以来，外汇市场的美元融资成本指标急剧上升，反映了需求和供给因素。近年来，对美元融资的需求不断增长，反映出美国以外的企业和投资组合投资者的货币对冲需求。在此背景下，最近几周的金融动荡抑制了金融中介机构的美元融资供应，大幅提升了美元融资成本指标。在央行部署美元互换额度后，这些成本已经缩小，但在确保美元融资市场保持弹性以及央行流动性被引导到银行体系之外方面，更广泛的政策挑战仍然存在。

title: Valuing Future Lives
authors: Daniel J. Hemel et al.
abstract: Federal regulation often involves a tradeoff between monetary costs in the present and life-saving benefits in the future. A central question in regulatory cost-benefit analysis is how to assign a present dollar value to future lives so that future lives and present dollars can be compared. For regulations that are projected to prevent deaths years or decades down the road, agencies make two key analytical moves. First, they adjust the value of a statistical life upward to reflect the fact that society’s willingness to pay to save lives will rise as people become wealthier in the future. Second, they discount future benefits downward to reflect the fact that the wealthier people of the future will derive less utility from each dollar precisely because they are wealthier. In theory, these upward and downward adjustments could offset exactly, such that lives saved in the future carry the same weight in agency cost-benefit analyses as lives saved today. In practice, agencies adjust the value of a statistical life upward at a much slower rate than they discount future benefits. The consequence is that agencies assign much less weight to lives in the future than to lives in the present.
source: Coase-Sandor Institute for Law & Economics Research Paper Series
title_zh: 珍惜未来的生活
abstract_zh: 联邦监管通常涉及当前的货币成本和未来的救生利益之间的权衡。监管成本效益分析的一个核心问题是如何将当前的美元价值分配给未来的生活，以便可以比较未来的生活和当前的美元。对于预计在未来几年或几十年内防止死亡的法规，各机构采取了两项关键的分析举措。首先，他们向上调整了统计生命值，以反映这样一个事实：随着人们未来变得更加富裕，社会为拯救生命而付费的意愿将会上升。其次，他们将未来的福利向下贴现，以反映这样一个事实：未来较富裕的人将从每一美元中获得的效用较少，正是因为他们更加富有。理论上，这些向上和向下的调整可以完全抵消，这样在机构成本效益分析中，未来挽救的生命与今天挽救的生命具有相同的权重。在实践中，各机构向上调整统计寿命价值的速度比贴现未来福利的速度要慢得多。结果是，各机构对未来生活的重视程度远低于对现在生活的重视程度。

title: Bankruptcy Judging After Williamson
authors: Vincent S.J. Buccola
abstract: This Essay asks how bankruptcy judges ought to orient their substantial, statutory discretion in business reorganization cases. The motivating observation is that bankruptcy law enacts a kind of forced integration of productive assets. To shed light on the contemporary problems that bankruptcy judges face, I thus look to two classic approaches to the economic theory of the firm-from Oliver Williamson and from Oliver Hart. I conclude that nonjudicial institutions have largely surmounted the problems to which their theories point, leaving a different, and probably narrower, set of issues to worry about. Bankruptcy judges who have a notion that their job is, in part, to push parties to a "deal" should instead focus on policing efforts by some of a debtor's investors to capture value from a recapitalization deal to which their pre-distress bargain does not entitle them.
source: Coase-Sandor Institute for Law & Economics Research Paper Series
title_zh: 威廉姆森之后的破产审判
abstract_zh: 本文询问破产法官应如何在企业重组案件中确定其实质性的法定自由裁量权。令人兴奋的观察是，破产法制定了一种生产性资产的强制整合。为了阐明破产法官面临的当代问题，我因此研究了奥利弗·威廉姆森和奥利弗·哈特的两种经典的公司经济理论方法。我的结论是，非司法机构在很大程度上克服了其理论所指出的问题，留下了一系列不同的、可能范围更窄的问题需要担心。破产法官认为，他们的工作在一定程度上是推动各方达成“协议”，而应该把重点放在监管债务人的一些投资者从资本重组协议中获取价值的努力上，而他们在困境前的讨价还价并没有赋予他们权利。

title: Price Drop Damages
authors: Vincent S.J. Buccola et al.
abstract: Assessing damages is often hard. When a reference asset–like stock–that is affected by misconduct trades in a liquid market, there is an appealing shortcut: price drop damages. The logic is simple: a court can leverage the fact that the price of this asset will reflect the consensus view among market participants of harm caused by the misconduct. But because market prices also reflect the expected value of any legal remedy, price drop damages are biased. We develop a simple model that allows us to characterize the magnitude and direction of this bias. We show the price drop damages understate harm when the expected net award flowing to purchasers of the reference asset positive, as in a corporate derivative case. In contrast, when the net recovery is negative, as in a securities fraud case, they overstate harm. Our analysis thus identifies, and offers a means to weigh contextually, an overlooked downside to leveraging the wisdom of crowds.
source: Coase-Sandor Institute for Law & Economics Research Paper Series
title_zh: 价格下跌损害赔偿
abstract_zh: 评估损失通常很困难。当参考资产（例如股票）在流动性市场中受到不当行为影响时，有一个有吸引力的捷径：价格下跌损害赔偿。逻辑很简单：法院可以利用这一事实，即该资产的价格将反映市场参与者对不当行为造成的损害的共识。但由于市场价格也反映了任何法律补救措施的预期价值，因此价格下跌损害赔偿是有偏差的。我们开发了一个简单的模型，使我们能够描述这种偏差的大小和方向。我们表明，当流向参考资产购买者的预期净赔偿为正时（如公司衍生品案例），价格下跌损害低估了损害。相反，当净回收率为负时，例如在证券欺诈案件中，他们就会夸大损失。因此，我们的分析确定了利用群体智慧的一个被忽视的缺点，并提供了一种根据具体情况进行权衡的方法。

title: Finding Debtor's Counsel
authors: Anthony Casey et al.
abstract: In this Essay, we explore the question of how to assess the independence of debtor’s counsel in Chapter 11. The question has arisen in recent high-profile bankruptcy cases, attracting renewed attention from commentators. We examine these cases and revisit the unique role that debtor’s counsel serves. From this analysis, a few guiding principles emerge for determining independence and managing conflicts that may arise. First, consistent with the rules outside of bankruptcy, sophisticated parties are capable of waiving conflicts and should be free to do so when their interests alone are affected by the conflict. Second, the possibility of conflicts—both real and apparent—is much higher for debtor’s counsel than for attorneys in other roles. This creates a challenge for courts, which must address both the real conflicts and the weaponization of apparent conflicts to shift leverage. Conscious of this, courts should rely, whenever possible, on intermediate remedies—such as conflicts counsel and ethical firewalls—to address allegations that debtor’s counsel is not independent. Finally, one should be careful to separate the analysis of the independence of a debtor’s managers (including it
source: Coase-Sandor Institute for Law & Economics Research Paper Series
title_zh: 寻找债务人的律师
abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们在第11章中探讨了如何评估债务人律师的独立性的问题。这个问题在最近备受瞩目的破产案件中出现，再次引起了评论家的关注。我们研究这些案例并重新审视债务人律师所发挥的独特作用。从这一分析中，我们得出了一些确定独立性和管理可能出现的冲突的指导原则。首先，与破产以外的规则一致，成熟的当事人能够放弃冲突，并且当其利益仅受到冲突影响时应该可以自由地这样做。其次，债务人律师发生冲突（无论是真实的还是表面的）的可能性比担任其他角色的律师要高得多。这给法院带来了挑战，法院必须解决真正的冲突以及将明显冲突武器化以转移影响力。意识到这一点，法院应尽可能依靠中间补救措施（例如冲突律师和道德防火墙）来解决债务人律师不独立的指控。最后，应谨慎区分对债务人管理者（包括债务人管理者）独立性的分析。

title: Grading Machines: Can AI Exam-Grading Replace Law Professors?
authors: Kevin L. Cope et al.
abstract: In the past few years, large language models (LLMs) have achieved significant technical advances, such that legal-advocacy organizations are increasingly adopting them as complements to—or substitutes for— lawyers and other human experts. Several studies have examined LLMs’ performance in taking law school exams, finding mixed results. Yet there have been no published studies systematically analyzing LLMs’ competence at one of law professors’ chief responsibilities: grading law school exams. This paper presents results of an analysis of how LLMs perform in evaluating student responses to legal analysis questions of the kind typically administered in law school exams. The underlying data come from exams in four subjects administered at top-30 U.S. law schools. Unlike some projects in computer or data science, our goal is not to design a new LLM that minimizes error or that maximizes agreement with human graders. Rather, we seek to determine whether existing models—which can be straightforwardly applied by most professors and students—are already suitable for the task of law exam evaluation. We find that, when provided with a detailed rubric, the LLM grades correlate with the human g
source: Coase-Sandor Institute for Law & Economics Research Paper Series
title_zh: 评分机：人工智能考试评分能否取代法学教授？
abstract_zh: 在过去的几年中，大型语言模型（LLM）取得了重大的技术进步，因此法律倡导组织越来越多地采用它们作为律师和其他人类专家的补充或替代品。几项研究考察了法学硕士在法学院考试中的表现，结果好坏参半。然而，还没有发表的研究系统地分析法学硕士在法学教授的主要职责之一（即为法学院考试评分）方面的能力。本文介绍了法学硕士在评估学生对法学院考试中通常出现的法律分析问题的反应方面的表现的分析结果。基础数据来自美国前 30 名法学院的四个科目的考试。与计算机或数据科学中的一些项目不同，我们的目标不是设计一个新的法学硕士来最大限度地减少错误或最大限度地与人类评分者达成一致。相反，我们试图确定现有的模型（大多数教授和学生可以直接应用）是否已经适合法律考试评估的任务。我们发现，当提供详细的评分标准时，LLM 成绩与人类的 g 相关。

title: Antitrust Analysis of Vertical Restraints in Labor Markets
authors: Eric A. Posner
abstract: Vertical restraints in labor markets are a neglected topic, but have taken on importance as the harms caused by labor market restraints have gained greater recognition. These restraints are typically a form of input foreclosure, which refers to action of a downstream buyer of inputs to hinder its competitors from accessing those inputs. But while labor markets are important input markets, there has been little discussion of how input foreclosure can be used to evaluate anticompetitive labor market transactions. This article fills that gap by providing a framework for analyzing input foreclosure in labor markets.
source: Coase-Sandor Institute for Law & Economics Research Paper Series
title_zh: 劳动力市场纵向限制的反垄断分析
abstract_zh: 劳动力市场的纵向限制是一个被忽视的话题，但随着劳动力市场限制造成的危害得到更多认识，它变得越来越重要。这些限制通常是投入品取消赎回权的一种形式，是指投入品的下游买家采取行动阻止其竞争对手获得这些投入品。但是，尽管劳动力市场是重要的投入市场，但很少有人讨论如何利用投入止赎来评估反竞争的劳动力市场交易。本文通过提供分析劳动力市场投入止赎的框架来填补这一空白。

title: Ideological Concordance Between Students and Professors
authors: Adam Bonica et al.
abstract: We develop a measure of student-professor ideological concordance based on the share of faculty members who are more liberal than the students at a given school. We then use data on the ideology of students and professors in American law schools over more than a twenty-year period to estimate the degree of ideological concordance in the legal academy. We find that as professors have become more liberal over time, their students have become even more liberal. The result is that ideological concordance has increased over time and that by 2010 the average law student actually attended a law school with more professors to their ideological right than to their ideological left. However, the overall trends mask considerable differences in concordance for liberal and conservative students. While the average liberal student attended a law school with roughly equal shares of professors to their ideological right and left, the average conservative student attended a law school where 90 percent of their professors were more liberal than them.
source: Coase-Sandor Institute for Law & Economics Research Paper Series
title_zh: 学生与教授思想一致
abstract_zh: 我们根据某所学校比学生更自由的教师比例来衡量学生与教授意识形态的一致性。然后，我们利用二十多年来美国法学院学生和教授的意识形态数据来估计法学院意识形态的一致性程度。我们发现，随着时间的推移，教授变得更加自由，他们的学生也变得更加自由。结果是，意识形态的一致性随着时间的推移而增加，到 2010 年，平均法学院学生实际上就读的法学院，其意识形态右派的教授多于意识形态左派的教授。然而，总体趋势掩盖了自由派和保守派学生的一致性的显着差异。自由派学生就读的法学院中，其意识形态右派和左派教授的比例大致相等，而保守派学生就读的法学院中，90%的教授都比他们更自由派。

title: Safety Score Liability
authors: Omri Ben-Shahar
abstract: Data technology is increasingly deployed to assign safety scores to people and products. Could these scores be used by tort law to apportion liability for accidents? Instead of basing tort liability on negligence—on the level of care leading to the specific accident—“safety score liability” would impose liability commensurate with a party’s habitual propensity to behave unsafely. This article describes how safety score liability would work, the incentives it would create, and the principles limiting its adoption. The article suggests that the precision of AI tools generating such scores—scores that have already reshaped other channels of safety regulation in society— offers new and thought-provoking opportunity for tort law. Safety score liability is rooted in a new and intriguing foundation for the notion of fault in tort law, providing surprisingly strong incentives for care, and managing the post-accident compensatory goals of tort law in a simple, low-cost manner.
source: Coase-Sandor Institute for Law & Economics Research Paper Series
title_zh: 安全评分责任
abstract_zh: 数据技术越来越多地用于为人员和产品分配安全评分。侵权法可以使用这些分数来分配事故责任吗？ “安全评分责任”不是将侵权责任基于过失（即导致特定事故的谨慎程度），而是根据一方不安全行为的习惯倾向来施加相应的责任。本文介绍了安全评分责任的运作方式、其产生的激励措施以及限制其采用的原则。文章认为，人工智能工具生成此类分数的精确度（这些分数已经重塑了社会中其他安全监管渠道）为侵权法提供了新的、发人深省的机会。安全评分责任植根于侵权法过错概念的一个新的、有趣的基础，为护理提供了令人惊讶的强大激励，并以简单、低成本的方式管理侵权法的事故后补偿目标。

title: Pillar Two: Much Ado About Next to Nothing?
authors: Julie Roin
abstract: The OECD has spent the last fifteen years working on the design and implementation of rules for the taxation of the income derived from international transactions, rules that its members hope will both increase corporate tax revenues and minimize “destructive” tax competition. In 2021, it released its two-part “Inclusive Framework.” Although Pillar One of this Framework still languishes, legislation necessary for the implementation of Pillar Two, which is designed to force all countries to impose a minimum tax on income derived by large multinational enterprises, has been enacted by most of the countries in the European Union, Japan, South Korea and other economically important countries. At present, though, the U.S. has refused to enact such legislation, and President Trump recently announced his opposition to participating in the entire endeavor. This article explains why the U.S should go forward with Pillar Two, but for reasons that are at odds with the general approbation of Pillar Two by tax academics and international authorities. It argues that, while Pillar Two will undoubtedly be somewhat disruptive, it is largely a “paper tiger.” Instead of reducing overall tax or econom
source: Coase-Sandor Institute for Law & Economics Research Paper Series
title_zh: 第二支柱：无事生非？
abstract_zh: 过去十五年来，经合组织一直致力于设计和实施国际交易收入征税规则，其成员国希望这些规则既能增加企业税收收入，又能最大限度地减少“破坏性”税收竞争。 2021 年，它发布了由两部分组成的“包容性框架”。尽管该框架的第一支柱仍然停滞不前，但大多数欧盟国家、日本、韩国和其他经济重要国家已经颁布了实施第二支柱所需的立法，旨在迫使所有国家对大型跨国企业的收入征收最低税。但目前美国拒绝颁布此类立法，特朗普总统最近也宣布反对参与整个努力。本文解释了为什么美国应该推进第二支柱，但其原因与税务学者和国际当局对第二支柱的普遍认可不一致。它认为，虽然第二支柱无疑会带来一定程度的破坏，但它在很大程度上是一只“纸老虎”。而不是减少总体税收或经济

title: Fraudulent Transfer Law’s Forgotten Foundations
authors: Douglas G. Baird
abstract: Fraudulent transfer law is one of the principal bulwarks of private law. Fraudulent transfer law, however, now faces a crisis. Courts have long assumed that it was easy to determine whether a debtor made a fraudulent transfer of its property. One could use traditional markers of ownership to determine whether the debtor transferred property to a confederate. But today most assets are intangible. Transactions happen in the blink of an eye, and they take place entirely on corporate books. Reliance on simple notions of what constitutes a “transfer” of property are wholly inadequate. Understanding what it means for a debtor to transfer property for fraudulent transfer purposes requires revisiting the foundational principles of fraudulent transfer law, a task that has proved elusive because one of its foundational principles has been forgotten.
source: Coase-Sandor Institute for Law & Economics Research Paper Series
title_zh: 欺诈性转让法被遗忘的基础
abstract_zh: 欺诈性转让法是私法的主要堡垒之一。然而，欺诈性转让法现在面临着危机。法院长期以来一直认为很容易确定债务人是否对其财产进行了欺诈性转移。人们可以使用传统的所有权标记来确定债务人是否将财产转让给同盟者。但如今大多数资产都是无形的。交易发生在眨眼之间，并且完全发生在公司账簿上。仅仅依靠什么构成财产“转让”的简单概念是完全不够的。要了解债务人出于欺诈性转让目的转让财产意味着什么，需要重新审视欺诈性转让法的基本原则，事实证明这项任务难以实现，因为其中一项基本原则已被遗忘。
